papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过非局域有效作用量框架，解除了辅助场与主场的标度维度约束，得到了一个稳健的非平庸物理固定点（Δ_φ* ≈ 0.981，Δ_φ* ≈ 0.415），其导出的临界指数（η_φ ≈ 0.038，Δ_{φ²} ≈ 1.417，ν ≈ 0.6317）与高精度量子蒙特卡洛和共形自举基准定量吻合。；创新点：与传统局域 ansatz 处理不同，该工作允许非局域有效作用量中的标度维度 Δ_φ 和 Δ_φ 作为完全独立、无约束的动力学变量，从而消除了局域处理固有的系统截断误差，同时解决了 Wilson-Fisher 普适类的静态标度和热力学流。
papers.method_zh: 基于非局域有效作用量 ansatz 的重整化群（RG）框架；通过 Hubbard-Stratonovich 变换将四阶相互作用解耦为主场 φ 和辅助场 φ ~ φ² 的系统；在 RG 流中计算自能和顶点涨落至三圈阶，并求解封闭的双变量主方程。

papers.title: Confinement-controlled pattern selection in a finite population-imbalanced dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: We study the ground-state density patterns of a population-imbalanced two-component dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a circular quasi-two-dimensional box. Using a mean-field model, we map out phase diagrams as functions of the axial confinement, interaction imbalance, and population ratio. The system supports a rich sequence of stationary morphologies, including a nearly uniform pancake state, pancake-droplet and ring-droplet coexistence states, droplet arrays, and concentric rings. These patterns show a close structural correspondence to microphase-separated morphologies in diblock-copolymer systems, with the population imbalance acting as an effective volume fraction that selects the pattern topology. Analysis of the density profiles and structure factors reveals that the modulated states possess an intrinsic nonzero characteristic wave vector, which remains essentially unchanged when the box size is varied. We also find that the characteristic pattern spacing scales linearly with the axial confinement length, indicating that the transverse thickness of the condensate controls the effective in-plane length scale. In a finite circular box, this smooth scaling is interrupted by discrete steps, reflecting geometric frustration and the integer locking of the number of rings or droplets. Our results show that box-trapped dipolar mixtures provide a controllable platform for studying finite-size pattern selection and nonlocal microphase formation in quantum fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：mean-field model（平均场模型）、phase diagrams（相图）、analysis of density profiles and structure factors（密度分布与结构因子分析）。；研究对象：有限尺寸圆盘形准二维势阱中，粒子数不平衡的双组分偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate）的基态密度图案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统支持从均匀薄饼态到液滴阵列、同心环等一系列稳态形貌，其图案拓扑由粒子数不平衡（等效于有效体积分数）选择；特征图案间距由轴向约束长度线性控制，但在有限圆盒中受几何阻挫和整数锁定影响而出现离散台阶。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统支持从均匀薄饼态到液滴阵列、同心环等一系列稳态形貌，其图案拓扑由粒子数不平衡（等效于有效体积分数）选择；特征图案间距由轴向约束长度线性控制，但在有限圆盒中受几何阻挫和整数锁定影响而出现离散台阶。；创新点：揭示了有限尺寸圆盒中偶极玻色混合物与嵌段共聚物体系微相分离形貌之间的结构对应关系，并发现轴向约束长度是调控面内特征尺度的关键参数，同时观察到有限尺寸效应导致的离散化图案选择行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用平均场模型（mean-field model）进行数值计算，通过扫描轴向约束强度、相互作用不平衡度和粒子数比绘制相图，并分析密度分布与结构因子以提取特征波矢和图案间距。

papers.title: Perturbation Theory of the Free Energy via the Mesoscopic Combined Partition Function
papers.abstract: We develop a systematic perturbation theory for the Helmholtz free energy of a classical $N$-body system within the mesoscopic framework of~\cite{OsanoMeso,OsanoExtensivity}. The combined coarse-graining operator $\mathcal{C}=\mathcal{C}_x\circ\mathcal{C}_p$ acting on single-particle phase space partitions it into product cells $C_{i,α}=V_i\timesΠ_α$ and generates a mesoscopic partition function $\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(λ)$ whose reference level factorises by the multinomial theorem: $\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}^{(0)}=(Z_1^{(0)})^N$. Perturbation theory for $\mathcal{F}_{\rm meso}(λ)=-k_BT\ln\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(λ)$ in the inter-cell perturbation $\mathcal{V}_{\rm meso}$ yields the mesoscopic Gibbs--Bogoliubov inequality and an exact coupling-parameter integration formula. The full free energy satisfies \begin{equation*} F(λ)=\mathcal{F}_{\rm meso}(λ)-k_BT\!\sum_{i<j}I(i,j;λ)+O\!\left(|Λ|\ell^{-d}e^{-2\ell/ξ}\right), \end{equation*} where the inter-cell mutual informations $I(i,j;λ)$ are the corrections identified in the extensivity analysis. The first-order theory recovers the van der Waals equation and the Barker--Henderson result; the second-order term converges to the structure-factor formula in the fine-cell limit. For long-range interactions, factorisation fails, and the mutual-information corrections quantify the resulting non-extensivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbation theory（微扰理论）、mesoscopic framework（介观框架）、free energy（自由能）。；研究对象：经典N体系统的亥姆霍兹自由能，以及介观粗粒化方法下的微扰理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过介观组合配分函数，建立了自由能的系统微扰理论，并发现互信息修正是非广延性的量化来源；一阶理论可恢复范德瓦尔斯方程和Barker-Henderson结果，二阶项在细胞极限下收敛至结构因子公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过介观组合配分函数，建立了自由能的系统微扰理论，并发现互信息修正是非广延性的量化来源；一阶理论可恢复范德瓦尔斯方程和Barker-Henderson结果，二阶项在细胞极限下收敛至结构因子公式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于介观框架（参考文献OsanoMeso, OsanoExtensivity），引入组合粗粒化算符 \(\mathcal{C}=\mathcal{C}_x\circ\mathcal{C}_p\) 对单粒子相空间进行乘积胞划分，构建介观配分函数 \(\mathcal{Z}_{\rm meso}(\lambda)\)，并利用多胞微扰展开、Gibbs-Bogoliubov不等式及耦合参数积分公式进行理论推导。

papers.title: Weak Fragmentation and Thermalization in a Dipole-Conserving Bose-Hubbard Chain
papers.abstract: We study Hilbert-space fragmentation and thermalization in a one-dimensional dipole-conserving Bose-Hubbard chain. By analyzing the structure of the Hamiltonian matrix in the Fock basis, we show that the system exhibits weak Hilbert-space fragmentation. We further construct an exponentially large family of frozen product states and derive analytical upper and lower bounds on their number. Using exact diagonalization, we examine the consequences of weak fragmentation for eigenstate half-chain entanglement, density relaxation dynamics, and level statistics. All these quantities reveal a transition from a weak eigenstate thermalization regime to a nonergodic regime with increasing on-site interaction strength. These results show that weak Hilbert-space fragmentation \textit{does not} preclude quantum chaos or thermalization, and provides a minimal platform for studying the interplay of dipole conservation, weak fragmentation, and ergodicity breaking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：分析哈密顿量矩阵结构、精确对角化、解析推导上下界）；研究对象：一维偶极矩守恒的Bose-Hubbard链中的希尔伯特空间碎片化与热化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱希尔伯特空间碎片化并不排除量子混沌或热化，且随着在位相互作用强度增加，系统从弱本征态热化区域过渡到非遍历区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱希尔伯特空间碎片化并不排除量子混沌或热化，且随着在位相互作用强度增加，系统从弱本征态热化区域过渡到非遍历区域。；创新点：首次在偶极矩守恒的Bose-Hubbard模型中系统展示了弱碎片化与遍历性破缺的关联，并证明弱碎片化体系仍可存在量子混沌与热化。
papers.method_zh: 通过Fock基下哈密顿量矩阵结构分析、解析推导冻结乘积态数量的上下界、以及精确对角化计算本征态半链纠缠熵、密度弛豫动力学和能级统计。

papers.title: Strong-coupling anisotropic superconductivity in hexagonal HfRuAs from anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive theoretical investigation of the superconducting (SC) properties of hexagonal HfRuAs ($h$-HfRuAs) by solving anisotropic Migdal--Eliashberg (ME) equations with the inputs from \textit{ab initio} calculations of electronic structure, phonon dispersion and electron phonon coupling matrix elements. The calculated Eliashberg spectral function reveals strong electron--phonon coupling (EPC) with a constant $λ\approx 1.56$, dominated by low-frequency phonon modes associated primarily with Hf and Ru vibrations. The SC state is characterized by a single anisotropic gap with overall $s$-wave symmetry, as evidenced by the fully gapped quasiparticle density of states. The momentum-resolved EPC and SC gap exhibit pronounced anisotropy across different Fermi surface sheets, with the largest variations occurring on the hole-like bands. The SC gap is centered around $Δ\approx 2.9$ meV with a spread of $\sim 0.8$ meV, indicating significant multiband anisotropy. The resulting gap ratio $2Δ(0)/k_B T_c \approx 4.2$ exceeds the BCS weak-coupling limit, establishing $h$-HfRuAs as a strong-coupling superconductor. The calculated transition temperature, $T_c$, agrees in the order of magnitude with experiments. Overall, our results identify $h$-HfRuAs as a phonon-mediated, strongly coupled anisotropic superconductor and provide detailed insights into the role of momentum-dependent electron--phonon interactions in determining its SC properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretical investigation”、“solving anisotropic Migdal–Eliashberg equations”、“ab initio calculations”。；研究对象：六方相HfRuAs（h-HfRuAs）的超导性质，具体为强耦合各向异性超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: h-HfRuAs是一种声子介导的强耦合各向异性超导体，具有单一各向异性s波超导能隙，能隙比2Δ(0)/k_B T_c ≈ 4.2超过BCS弱耦合极限，且超导能隙在不同费米面片间表现出显著的各向异性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：h-HfRuAs是一种声子介导的强耦合各向异性超导体，具有单一各向异性s波超导能隙，能隙比2Δ(0)/k_B T_c ≈ 4.2超过BCS弱耦合极限，且超导能隙在不同费米面片间表现出显著的各向异性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（电子结构、声子色散、电声耦合矩阵元）的输入，求解各向异性Migdal–Eliashberg（ME）方程。

papers.title: Localization Transitions in a Half-Filled Helical Aubry-André Model
papers.abstract: We study localization in a one-dimensional quasiperiodic lattice obtained by extending the Aubry-André model with an additional $N$th-neighbor hopping term of strength $J_{N}$. This long-range tunneling couples successive windings of an effective helical chain and introduces a second control parameter beyond the quasiperiodic potential strength $Δ$. Working with noninteracting fermions (typically at half filling), we diagnose the delocalization-localization transition using extensions of the modern theory of polarization. Specifically, we compute the polarization amplitudes of the many-body Slater-determinant ground state and construct a geometric Binder cumulant from polarization amplitudes. The critical potential where the localization transition happens is extracted from the sign change (zero crossing) of the geometric Binder cumulant. We map critical potential as a function of $J_N$ and the helical range $N$, finding that stronger helical hopping generally stabilizes the extended phase (shifting critical potential upward), while the $N$-dependence can display pronounced commensurability-induced spikes. We further compare the geometric Binder cumulant with the Fermi gap, which remains near zero at small values of potential and opens in the same parameter regime where the geometric Binder cumulant departs from extended phase. Finally, to take a controlled thermodynamic limit along Fibonacci system sizes, we employ a Zeckendorf-shift construction that fixes the many-body sector consistently as system size goes to infinity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“研究”（study）、“计算”（compute）、“映射”（map）、“比较”（compare）等理论分析术语，未提及任何实验手段或样品制备。；研究对象：一维准周期晶格中的局域化转变，具体为半填充的螺旋Aubry-André模型（helical Aubry-André model），包含长程N近邻跳跃项。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 更强的螺旋跳跃（J_N）通常稳定扩展相，使临界势向上移动；临界势随N的变化会出现由公度性（commensurability）引起的尖峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：更强的螺旋跳跃（J_N）通常稳定扩展相，使临界势向上移动；临界势随N的变化会出现由公度性（commensurability）引起的尖峰。；创新点：将长程N近邻跳跃项引入Aubry-André模型，引入第二个控制参数（J_N），并利用几何Binder累积量这一新诊断工具来精确确定局域化转变点。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用现代极化理论（modern theory of polarization）的扩展方法，计算多体Slater行列式基态的极化振幅，并构建几何Binder累积量（geometric Binder cumulant），通过其符号变化（过零点）提取局域化转变的临界势。同时采用Zeckendorf-shift构造方法，沿Fibonacci系统尺寸取可控热力学极限。

papers.title: Chemo-mechanical coupling stabilizes mixed $\mathrm{Ag}_{x}\mathrm{Cu}_{1-x}\mathrm{GaSe}_{2}$ solar-cell absorbers: Insights from Monte-Carlo simulations assisted by ab initio informed machine-learning potentials
papers.abstract: Alloying Ag into Cu(In,Ga)Se$_2$ has enabled record solar-cell efficiencies ($\sim23.6\%$), yet their long-term stability remains in question because initio calculations predict a Ag-Cu miscibility gap near ambient temperature. By off-lattice Monte-Carlo simulations using a newly developed machine learning (ML) interatomic potential we show that the presence of coherency strain is resolving the controversy between experimental observations and the predicted phase stability. Incorporating elastic energy contributions present in a coherent setup results in complete Ag-Cu miscibility, whereas the expected phase separation occurs in the absence of coherency strains with respect to the end boundary phases, which are mimicked by an incoherent interface with misfit dislocations. The developed ML-MC framework provides a novel approach for resolving discrepancies in thermodynamic stability for systems where mechanical and chemical effects compete.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Monte-Carlo simulations、ab initio informed machine-learning potentials、off-lattice Monte-Carlo simulations）；研究对象：Ag-Cu合金化的太阳能电池吸收层材料Ag_xCu_{1-x}GaSe₂（属于Cu(In,Ga)Se₂体系），具体研究其热力学稳定性与化学-力学耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在考虑共格应变（coherency strain）的弹性能量贡献后，Ag与Cu在Ag_xCu_{1-x}GaSe₂中可实现完全互溶，从而解释了实验观测与第一性原理预测的Ag-Cu混溶隙（miscibility gap）之间的矛盾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在考虑共格应变（coherency strain）的弹性能量贡献后，Ag与Cu在Ag_xCu_{1-x}GaSe₂中可实现完全互溶，从而解释了实验观测与第一性原理预测的Ag-Cu混溶隙（miscibility gap）之间的矛盾。；创新点：开发了ML-MC（机器学习-蒙特卡洛）框架，用于解决力学与化学效应竞争体系中热力学稳定性的争议，首次将共格应变效应纳入Ag-Cu合金化太阳能电池吸收层的相稳定性分析。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于从头算（ab initio）信息训练的机器学习（ML）原子间势，进行非格点蒙特卡洛（off-lattice Monte-Carlo）模拟。通过对比共格界面（含弹性应变）与非共格界面（含失配位错，模拟无共格应变情形）下的相稳定性。

papers.title: Combinatorial Survey of Structural Phase Distribution and Magnetism in Fe-Ge-Te Composition-spread Thin Film Libraries
papers.abstract: Recently, magnetic 2-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) materials have garnered tremendous attention. The vdW ferromagnet Fe5Ge1Te2 has a Curie temperature Tc of ~ 270 K, which is tailorable by tuning the stoichiometry and the Fe deficiency to reach room temperature. To explore the expanded compositional space, we implemented combinatorial synthesis and high-throughput characterization to investigate the structural phase distribution and ferromagnetism of a Fe-Ge-Te thin film library. The library was prepared by magnetron co-sputtering followed by annealing in vacuum or in an inert environment. Composition and structural phase distribution of the 177 pads in the library were characterized using high-throughput wavelength dispersive spectroscopy (WDS), X-ray diffraction (XRD), and two-point probe resistance measurements. We leverage unsupervised machine learning to cluster the XRD dataset into groups of compositions with similar structural phases, and further study the ferromagnetic properties via SQUID magnetometry and X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) across different clusters. The results are compared against magnetization and structural models calculated using DFT. Our results demonstrate that the hexagonal crystal structure is a critical prerequisite for ferromagnetism in this system, and that unexplored materials adopting this structure can be efficiently identified as possible ferromagnetic materials using our high-throughput, ML-assisted framework. This workflow based on the combinatorial strategy allows us to rapidly capture the composition-structure-magnetic property map across a broad compositional landscape of novel magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：combinatorial synthesis, high-throughput characterization, magnetron co-sputtering, SQUID, XMCD, DFT计算辅助分析）；研究对象：Fe-Ge-Te三元体系薄膜库，特别是具有二维范德瓦尔斯结构的铁磁材料Fe₅Ge₁Te₂及其扩展组分空间的结构相与磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 六方晶体结构是该体系中实现铁磁性的关键前提；通过高通量、机器学习辅助的框架，可以高效识别出可能具有铁磁性的未探索材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：六方晶体结构是该体系中实现铁磁性的关键前提；通过高通量、机器学习辅助的框架，可以高效识别出可能具有铁磁性的未探索材料。；创新点：将组合合成与高通量表征、无监督机器学习聚类相结合，系统绘制了Fe-Ge-Te体系在宽组分范围内的结构-磁性相图，并验证了六方结构作为铁磁性先决条件的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 采用磁控共溅射制备组分梯度薄膜库，结合真空或惰性气氛退火；使用高分辨波长色散X射线光谱（WDS）、X射线衍射（XRD）、两点探针电阻测量进行高通量表征；利用无监督机器学习对XRD数据进行聚类分析；通过SQUID磁强计和X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）研究不同簇的铁磁性质；并与DFT计算的磁性和结构模型进行对比。

papers.title: Real-time Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery of Novel Phase-change Memory Materials
papers.abstract: Autonomous labs enable the integration of automated experiment execution, data analysis and decision making. The main challenge remains the integration of diverse data streams from multiple instruments, where the data is often heterogeneous and unsynchronized. The standard learning process of undetermined synthesis-process-structure-property relationships (SPSPR) usually relies on post-experiment analysis after data is fully collected, not during live experiments, and decision making is carried out independently across characterization equipment. Here, we demonstrate the Multi-instrument Autonomous Discovery (MAD) framework -- combining structural property mapping and functional property optimization simultaneously in a closed-loop manner. As an example, we applied MAD to phase change memory (PCM) materials, and, in particular on the Mn-Sb-Te ternary, a previously unexplored materials system for PCM. A multi-output model is employed to merge data from x-ray diffraction (XRD) and electrical resistance measurements simultaneously through a co-regionalization kernel that models the relationship between them. The output probabilistic posterior and uncertainty quantification facilitate decision making with shared knowledge, while the goals are different across tasks. We aimed to maximize the knowledge of crystal structure distribution using non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), while in parallel, we find the composition with the maximum resistance value, an important figure of merit for PCM. Leveraging MAD, we found promising electrical PCMs and identified the SPSPR within 25 closed-loop iterations, corresponding to a seven-fold speed-up. The framework opens a new path of study in large-scale autonomous facilities, where future experiments can be run in parallel together, not independently.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：autonomous labs、automated experiment execution、closed-loop manner、XRD、electrical resistance measurements）；研究对象：相变存储（PCM）材料，具体为Mn-Sb-Te三元体系（此前未在PCM中探索过的材料系统）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过多仪器自主发现（MAD）框架，在25次闭环迭代内成功发现了有前景的PCM材料，并识别了合成-工艺-结构-性能关系（SPSPR），速度提升约七倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过多仪器自主发现（MAD）框架，在25次闭环迭代内成功发现了有前景的PCM材料，并识别了合成-工艺-结构-性能关系（SPSPR），速度提升约七倍。；创新点：首次在实时实验过程中（而非事后分析）整合来自多台仪器的异构、非同步数据流，实现结构性质映射与功能性质优化的闭环并行决策，并成功应用于此前未探索的Mn-Sb-Te三元PCM材料体系。
papers.method_zh: 采用多仪器自主发现（MAD）框架，结合X射线衍射（XRD）和电阻测量两种表征手段；使用多输出模型（multi-output model）通过协同区域化核（co-regionalization kernel）融合异构数据；利用非负矩阵分解（NMF）最大化晶体结构分布知识，同时并行寻找最大电阻值的成分。

papers.title: Hydrostatic Pressure-Induced Evolution of the Superconducting Transition Temperature of Bi-2212: Insights from First-Principles Calculations
papers.abstract: High-pressure experiments on Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$ (Bi-2212) have reported apparently conflicting evolutions of the superconducting transition temperature $T_c$, ranging from weak enhancement to strong suppression and even a proposed second superconducting dome. To clarify the origin of these discrepancies, we combine first-principles density functional theory calculations with a pressure-dependent low-energy bilayer model solved by the slave-boson mean-field method together with a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless estimate of phase coherence. Our results show that hydrostatic pressure induces a pronounced self-doping effect in Bi-2212: holes are transferred from the Bi-O charge-reservoir layers to the CuO$_2$ superconducting planes, leading to a systematic increase in the effective CuO$_2$-plane hole concentration $δ_x$. At the same time, pressure enhances the pairing scale through the renormalization of the hopping and superexchange parameters. As a consequence, the pressure evolution of $T_c$ is governed by the competition between pressure-enhanced pairing and pressure-driven motion along the common $T_c$-$δ_x$ dome, making $T_c(P)$ highly sensitive to the initial doping state. Even samples with very similar ambient-pressure $T_c$ but slightly different initial doping can therefore display qualitatively different pressure responses. This provides a unified interpretation of a large part of the disparate high-pressure behavior reported for Bi-2212 and suggests that slightly underdoped samples are more favorable than ambient-pressure optimal samples for achieving improved superconducting performance under pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：first-principles density functional theory calculations、slave-boson mean-field method、Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless estimate）；研究对象：Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊ₓ（Bi-2212）高温超导体在静水压下的超导转变温度演化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静水压通过自掺杂效应将空穴从Bi-O电荷库层转移到CuO₂超导平面，同时增强配对能标；Tc的压力响应由压力增强配对与沿Tc-δx拱形曲线移动之间的竞争决定，因此高度依赖于初始掺杂状态，轻微欠掺杂样品比常压最优掺杂样品更有利于在压力下提升超导性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静水压通过自掺杂效应将空穴从Bi-O电荷库层转移到CuO₂超导平面，同时增强配对能标；Tc的压力响应由压力增强配对与沿Tc-δx拱形曲线移动之间的竞争决定，因此高度依赖于初始掺杂状态，轻微欠掺杂样品比常压最优掺杂样品更有利于在压力下提升超导性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与压力依赖的低能双层模型，采用奴隶玻色子平均场方法求解，并辅以Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）相相干估计。

papers.title: Multi-rotational switching in a noncollinear antiferromagnet by spin-orbit torque
papers.abstract: Spintronics has advanced through discoveries of various electrically-driven spin dynamics in nanomagnets. Here, we report a novel switching dynamics of spin systems driven by spin-orbit torque, using a noncollinear antiferromagnetic nanodot. With electric pulses spanning a wide range of durations and amplitudes, we find an unconventional insensitivity of a threshold current density to pulse duration in switch-back events. This observation is attributed to a previously unrecognized process, in which the noncollinear antiferromagnetic order undergoes multiple rotations before completing reversal, a phenomenon we term multi-rotational switching. Our theoretical analysis reveals that multi-rotational switching arises from the interplay of three key factors: current-driven coherent rotation of the noncollinear antiferromagnetic order, field-induced reorientation of the uncompensated net magnetization, and thermal fluctuations. These findings establish a microscopic mechanism governing current-induced switching in noncollinear antiferromagnets, a topic of growing interest for next-generation spintronics technologies, opening a new route to controlling antiferromagnetic order in nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时描述了实验观测（“using a noncollinear antiferromagnetic nanodot”、“we find an unconventional insensitivity”）和理论分析（“Our theoretical analysis reveals”）。；研究对象：非共线反铁磁纳米点中的自旋轨道矩驱动开关动力学，具体涉及一种新型的“多旋转开关”现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现非共线反铁磁体在自旋轨道矩驱动下存在一种新型开关机制——多旋转开关，即反铁磁序在完成翻转前经历多次旋转，导致开关回跳事件中阈值电流密度对脉冲时长表现出反常的不敏感性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现非共线反铁磁体在自旋轨道矩驱动下存在一种新型开关机制——多旋转开关，即反铁磁序在完成翻转前经历多次旋转，导致开关回跳事件中阈值电流密度对脉冲时长表现出反常的不敏感性。；创新点：首次识别并命名了“多旋转开关”这一此前未被认识到的过程，揭示了非共线反铁磁体中电流诱导开关的微观机制，为纳米器件中反铁磁序的控制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用电脉冲（宽范围时长和振幅）作用于非共线反铁磁纳米点，测量开关回跳事件中的阈值电流密度；理论上通过分析电流驱动的非共线反铁磁序相干旋转、场诱导的未补偿净磁化重取向以及热涨落三者之间的相互作用来解释多旋转开关的微观机制。

papers.title: Exact Organization of Density Matrices and Entanglement Structure in the Kitaev Spin Liquid
papers.abstract: We give an exact form of the density matrix of the spin-1/2 Kitaev spin liquid represented in terms of spin operators and study the entanglement structures of the Kitaev honeycomb model within the spin framework. We show that the density matrix is naturally organized by equivalence classes of string operators associated with the underlying gauge structure of the model. With the explicit form of the density matrix, plus the exact Gauss law of the emergent gauge theory and the exact 1-form Wilson symmetry in the Kitaev model, we demonstrate the existence of the underlying symmetry-resolved block-diagonal structure of the reduced density matrix, which gives rise to the extensive degeneracy in the entanglement spectrum. The block-diagonal structure is then proven to be responsible for the separability of the entanglement entropy into the gauge and matter parts. Furthermore, we extend the formalism to subsystems with an odd number of lattice sites, revealing a relation between the entanglement spectrum and the fermion parity that is seldom mentioned in the literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact form、gauge structure、symmetry-resolved block-diagonal structure、entanglement spectrum。；研究对象：自旋-1/2 Kitaev 量子自旋液体，具体为 Kitaev 蜂窝模型中的密度矩阵与纠缠结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 给出了 Kitaev 自旋液体密度矩阵的精确形式，揭示了约化密度矩阵具有由规范结构和1-形式Wilson对称性决定的对称性分辨块对角结构，该结构导致纠缠谱的广泛简并，并解释了纠缠熵可分离为规范部分和物质部分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：给出了 Kitaev 自旋液体密度矩阵的精确形式，揭示了约化密度矩阵具有由规范结构和1-形式Wilson对称性决定的对称性分辨块对角结构，该结构导致纠缠谱的广泛简并，并解释了纠缠熵可分离为规范部分和物质部分。；创新点：首次给出了Kitaev自旋液体密度矩阵在自旋框架下的精确形式，并严格证明了纠缠谱的块对角结构源于规范对称性，同时揭示了奇数格点子系统中纠缠谱与费米子宇称的关联（该关联在文献中鲜有提及）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，包括：基于自旋算符的密度矩阵精确表示、弦算符等价类组织、精确高斯定律、1-形式Wilson对称性、对称性分辨的块对角化分析，以及扩展到奇数格点子系统的纠缠谱与费米子宇称关系。

papers.title: $5/9-$Magnetization Plateau and Spin Supersolidity in YCu$_3$(OD)$_{7-x}$Br$_{2+x}$ under Magnetic Fields up to 120~T
papers.abstract: We performed high-precision magnetization measurements up to 120~T on three compositions of the newly discovered kagome antiferromagnet YCu$_3$(OD)$_{7-x}$Br$_{2+x}$ (YCOB), revealing a previously unobserved 5/9 fractional magnetization plateau. All YCOB samples with different Br$^-$ concentrations exhibit nearly identical magnetization curves below 60~T, whereas the 5/9 plateau appears at markedly different fields in the ultrahigh-field regime. By modeling the experimental data using tensor-network calculations, we derive the effective spin Hamiltonians for the YCOB family with three spatially anisotropic Heisenberg couplings (the 3$J$-type model), which quantitatively reproduces the measured magnetization processes and captures the composition-dependent evolution of the 5/9 plateau. Furthermore, our theoretical analysis suggests the emergence of a spin supersolid phase in the field window between the 1/3 and 5/9 plateaus, which is sensitive to spin exchange parameters and accounts for the significant variation in the critical fields of the 5/9 plateau observed among different YCOB compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。关键词：高精度磁化测量、张量网络计算、有效自旋哈密顿量建模。；研究对象：新发现的kagome反铁磁体YCu₃(OD)₇₋ₓBr₂₊ₓ（YCOB）及其不同Br⁻浓度下的磁化行为，特别是分数磁化平台和自旋超固态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YCOB中观测到此前未发现的5/9分数磁化平台，并理论预测在1/3与5/9平台之间的磁场区间存在自旋超固态相，该相敏感依赖于自旋交换参数，解释了不同组分间5/9平台临界场的显著差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YCOB中观测到此前未发现的5/9分数磁化平台，并理论预测在1/3与5/9平台之间的磁场区间存在自旋超固态相，该相敏感依赖于自旋交换参数，解释了不同组分间5/9平台临界场的显著差异。；创新点：首次在kagome反铁磁体YCOB中观测到5/9分数磁化平台，并通过理论计算揭示其与自旋超固态相的关联，阐明了不同Br⁻浓度下平台临界场变化的微观机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高达120 T的高精度磁化测量；理论上使用张量网络计算对实验数据进行建模，推导出具有三个空间各向异性海森堡耦合（3J型模型）的有效自旋哈密顿量，并定量复现磁化过程及组分依赖的5/9平台演化。

papers.title: Entropy additivity from exponential decay of correlations: a coarse-grained operator approach
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic extensivity is commonly introduced as a postulate -- the homogeneity of degree one in thermodynamic potentials. We provide a constructive derivation of this property from microscopic conditions on the pair potential, without assuming it. Working with the one- and two-particle reduced densities of the $N$-body canonical Gibbs state, we introduce a combined coarse-graining operator $\mathcal{C}$ on single-particle phase space $\mathcal{M}=Λ\times\mathbb{R}^3$, producing dimensionless mesoscopic probabilities over spatial--momentum cells $\{V_i\timesΠ_α\}$. Under three conditions on the pair potential -- stability, temperedness, and exponential cluster decomposition with correlation length $ξ$ -- we show, using the Ursell cluster expansion, that the coarse-grained entropy satisfies \[S_{\mathrm{CG}}=\sum_i S_i+O\!\left(\frac{|Λ|}{\ell^d}e^{-\ell/ξ}\right),\] where $\ell\ggξ$ is the cell diameter. The correction is exponentially suppressed per cell, making entropy additive and recovering the thermodynamic limit of Ruelle and Fisher in explicit operator language. For systems with long-range interactions, where temperedness fails, the correction does not vanish, and non-additivity is quantified through inter-cell mutual information. We further show that spatial averaging does not commute with nonlinear thermodynamic functionals such as the entropy density -- a thermodynamic analogue of the cosmological averaging problem -- and we derive the generalised Euler relation with explicit surface corrections.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“constructive derivation”、“Ursell cluster expansion”、“operator language”，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：经典统计力学中热力学广延性的微观起源，具体研究N体正则系综下基于对势的粒子系统，其熵的加和性如何从关联函数的指数衰减导出。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在满足稳定性、温和性及指数簇分解（关联长度ξ）的对势条件下，通过粗粒化算符构造的熵满足加和性，修正项随元胞直径ℓ指数衰减；对于长程相互作用系统，修正项不消失，非加和性可通过元胞间互信息量化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在满足稳定性、温和性及指数簇分解（关联长度ξ）的对势条件下，通过粗粒化算符构造的熵满足加和性，修正项随元胞直径ℓ指数衰减；对于长程相互作用系统，修正项不消失，非加和性可通过元胞间互信息量化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用单粒子相空间上的粗粒化算符C，将空间-动量元胞{V_i×Π_α}上的无量纲介观概率与Ursell集团展开结合，推导粗粒化熵的表达式，并分析空间平均与非线性热力学泛函（如熵密度）的不对易性。

papers.title: Anderson Transition and Mobility Edges in a Family of 3D Fractal Lattices
papers.abstract: Anderson localization is fundamentally controlled by dimensionality, yet the nature of the Anderson transition in continuously tunable noninteger dimensions remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce a family of three-dimensional fractal lattices with continuously tunable spectral dimension $d_s\in[2,3]$, providing a controlled platform for studying localization physics beyond integer dimensions and across the lower critical dimension $d_s=2$. Using large-scale finite-size scaling analysis, we systematically investigate the Anderson transition and identify mobility edges throughout the fractal family. The critical disorder strength evolves continuously from $0$ to $16.6$ as the spectral dimension increases from $2$ to $3$. We show that the spectral dimension predominantly governs the universality class of the transition, while the precise critical point is additionally influenced by microscopic geometric details of the underlying fractal lattice. The critical exponent exhibits an approximate inverse dependence on $d_s$, providing quantitative insight into scaling theory in noninteger dimensions. Our results establish tunable fractal lattices as a versatile framework for exploring localization and quantum critical phenomena beyond conventional integer-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“large-scale finite-size scaling analysis”（大规模有限尺寸标度分析），属于数值计算方法，并结合理论分析（scaling theory）。；研究对象：三维分形晶格家族，其谱维度 \(d_s\) 可在 \([2,3]\) 之间连续调节，研究其中的安德森局域化转变和迁移率边。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着谱维度从2增加到3，临界无序强度从0连续变化到16.6；临界指数与谱维度近似成反比，表明谱维度主导了转变的普适类，而微观几何细节影响临界点的具体数值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着谱维度从2增加到3，临界无序强度从0连续变化到16.6；临界指数与谱维度近似成反比，表明谱维度主导了转变的普适类，而微观几何细节影响临界点的具体数值。；创新点：首次在连续可调的非整数维度（谱维度）三维分形晶格中系统研究安德森转变，跨越了下临界维度 \(d_s=2\)，并揭示了谱维度对普适类的决定性作用以及微观几何细节对临界点的修正。
papers.method_zh: 大规模有限尺寸标度分析（large-scale finite-size scaling analysis），用于系统研究安德森转变并识别迁移率边。

papers.title: Graph-Theoretic Detection of Hilbert Space Fragmentation
papers.abstract: Hilbert-space fragmentation provides a mechanism for ergodicity breaking in quantum many-body systems even in the absence of disorder, leading to dynamically disconnected sectors and strong memory of initial conditions. However, identifying such structures is often challenging and typically relies on prior knowledge of conservation laws or model-specific analytical insight. Here we introduce an unbiased approach based on spectral graph theory and, within this framework, formulate the concept of nearly fragmented systems, in which perturbative processes couple otherwise fragmented sectors while preserving their dynamical imprint. By representing basis states as vertices and Hamiltonian matrix elements as edges, we map the connectivity structure of the many-body Hilbert space onto a graph and analyze it using tools such as the Laplacian spectrum, Fiedler vectors, and modularity. Exact fragmentation corresponds to disconnected graph components, while nearly fragmented systems manifest as weakly connected communities whose structure can still be resolved spectrally. Applying this framework to the one-dimensional $t$-$J$ model and its perturbations, we demonstrate that graph-theoretic diagnostics reliably identify both fragmented and nearly fragmented Hilbert-space structures and capture the hierarchy of dynamical time scales that governs the system's evolution. We further show that the method extends beyond kinetically constrained models by applying it directly to the Hubbard chain, where it reveals the emergence of nearly decoupled subspaces associated with doublon dynamics and spin configurations. Our results establish the spectral graph analysis as a general and scalable tool for diagnosing fragmentation and approximate dynamical constraints in complex quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spectral graph theory（谱图理论）、theoretical framework（理论框架）、unbiased approach（无偏方法）。；研究对象：量子多体系统中的希尔伯特空间碎裂（Hilbert space fragmentation）现象，具体应用于一维t-J模型及其微扰、Hubbard链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于谱图理论的图论诊断方法可以无偏地识别量子多体系统中的精确碎裂和近似碎裂结构，并揭示控制系统演化的动力学时间尺度层次。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于谱图理论的图论诊断方法可以无偏地识别量子多体系统中的精确碎裂和近似碎裂结构，并揭示控制系统演化的动力学时间尺度层次。；创新点：提出了一种无需预先知道守恒律或模型特定解析知识的无偏方法，并首次将“近似碎裂系统”概念形式化，展示了该方法可推广至非运动学约束模型（如Hubbard链），揭示与双子动力学和自旋构型相关的近解耦子空间。
papers.method_zh: 采用谱图理论，将多体希尔伯特空间的基矢视为图的顶点、哈密顿量矩阵元视为边，构建连通性图；利用拉普拉斯谱、Fiedler向量、模块度等图论工具分析图的结构，识别精确碎裂（对应不连通图分量）和近似碎裂（对应弱连通社区）。

papers.title: Indicators for phonon hydrodynamics from first principles predictions of thermal conductivity
papers.abstract: Hydrodynamic heat flow, where out-of-equilibrium phonons collectively drift in response to an applied temperature differential, has attracted renewed interest following its experimental observation in graphite at temperatures as high as 300 K. To accelerate discovery of material alternatives to graphite and suitable experimental conditions for realizing this non-Fourier heat flow regime, computationally efficient indicators derived from predictive first principles approaches are necessary. Here we show that the ratio of thermal conductivity ($κ$) obtained from the complete solution of the linearized Peierls-Boltzmann equation (LPBE) for phonon transport ($κ_{LPBE}$), to that from the relaxation time approximation (RTA) for phonon decay ($κ_{RTA}$), is a low cost indicator for phonon hydrodynamics. We show that collectively drifting non-equilibrium phonons amplify the ratio of $κ_{LPBE}$ to $κ_{RTA}$, while a small $κ_{LPBE}/κ_{RTA}$ correlates with predominantly diffusive phonon transport. On the other hand, we find that conventional approaches that rely only on momentum-conserving Normal and momentum-dissipating Umklapp scattering rates, such as the RTA and the Callaway approximations to the LPBE, are inadequate to predict phonon hydrodynamics. Furthermore, our study reveals that the indicator ratio - $κ_{LPBE}/κ_{RTA}$, and therefore the strength of hydrodynamic signatures, decrease with increasing Brillouin zone (BZ) sampling density for several ultrahigh-$κ$ materials at low temperatures, thus underscoring the need for careful BZ sampling convergence studies to ensure robust predictions of phonon hydrodynamics. This computationally inexpensive indicator of phonon hydrodynamics will accelerate the search for new materials that exhibit such unconventional heat flow regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：first principles predictions（第一性原理预测）、linearized Peierls-Boltzmann equation（线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程）、relaxation time approximation（弛豫时间近似）。；研究对象：声子流体动力学（phonon hydrodynamics）及其在材料热导率中的表现，具体涉及石墨等超高热导率材料在低温下的非傅里叶热流输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热导率比值 \( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \) 可作为低成本且有效的声子流体动力学指示器：该比值越大，表明集体漂移的非平衡声子效应越强（即流体动力学特征越显著）；比值越小，则对应以扩散为主的声子输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：热导率比值 \( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \) 可作为低成本且有效的声子流体动力学指示器：该比值越大，表明集体漂移的非平衡声子效应越强（即流体动力学特征越显著）；比值越小，则对应以扩散为主的声子输运。；创新点：提出了一个计算成本低的指示器（\( \kappa_{LPBE}/\kappa_{RTA} \)）来快速筛选可能表现出声子流体动力学行为的材料，并指出仅依赖Normal散射和Umklapp散射率的传统方法（如RTA和Callaway近似）不足以预测声子流体动力学。此外，揭示了BZ采样密度对流体动力学特征强度有显著影响，需谨慎收敛。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理（first principles）预测，通过完整求解线性化Peierls-Boltzmann方程（LPBE）得到热导率 \( \kappa_{LPBE} \)，并与弛豫时间近似（RTA）下的热导率 \( \kappa_{RTA} \) 进行比较。同时分析了布里渊区（BZ）采样密度对指示器比值的影响。

papers.title: Shapiro steps of superfluid Fermi gases in a ring trap across the BCS--BEC crossover
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport properties of a superfluid Fermi gas confined in a ring trap with a moving potential barrier across the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) to Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) crossover. Employing time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations, we simulate the dynamics of a Josephson junction biased by both DC and AC currents. Over a wide range of interaction strengths, we observe clear low-order Shapiro-step plateaus in the barrier-velocity--chemical-potential-diffenrence, within the phase-coherent regime, where the time-averaged chemical potential difference is quantized in units of $\hbarω/2$. This factor of $1/2$ reflects our convention of defining the chemical potential per single fermion in the BdG framework. Microscopic analysis reveals that these fundamental steps originate from synchronized phase slips mediated by periodic soliton generation at the barrier. Our findings clarify the role of interaction regimes in the nonequilibrium phase dynamics of ring-trapped fermionic superfluids and provide microscopic insights relevant to future studies of atomtronic systems with nontrivial topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Employing time-dependent Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) equations, we simulate the dynamics”。；研究对象：超流费米气体在环形势阱中通过BCS-BEC渡越区的输运性质，具体为受直流和交流电流偏置的约瑟夫森结中的Shapiro台阶现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相位相干区域内，观察到势垒速度-化学势差中清晰的低阶Shapiro台阶平台，其时间平均化学势差以ħω/2为单位量子化；这些台阶源于周期性孤子产生所介导的同步相位滑移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相位相干区域内，观察到势垒速度-化学势差中清晰的低阶Shapiro台阶平台，其时间平均化学势差以ħω/2为单位量子化；这些台阶源于周期性孤子产生所介导的同步相位滑移。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方程，数值模拟环形势阱中移动势垒偏置下的约瑟夫森结动力学。

papers.title: Geometric symmetry and size-dependent skyrmion phase transitions in magnetic nanostructures
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay of geometric symmetry, size, and external magnetic fields in regulating individual skyrmion states within magnetic nanostructures. By analyzing nanodisks, nanosquares, and nanorectangles, we demonstrate that rotational symmetry in nanodisks enables rich topological phase transitions, from ferromagnetic states to skyrmions, skyrmioniums, and multi-states, as their diameter increases. In contrast, square and rectangular structures exhibit suppressed topological complexity due to corner-induced demagnetization effects and reduced symmetries. Under perpendicular magnetic fields, nanodisks show field-driven transitions between skyrmionium and skyrmion states. By leveraging asymmetry, square and rectangular nanostructures stabilize skyrmions over a broader parameter range than nanodisks. These findings highlight geometric symmetry as a critical design parameter for tailoring skyrmion stability and functionality in spintronic applications such as multi-state memory and reconfigurable logic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We investigate”、“By analyzing”、“demonstrate”等词汇，描述了通过分析不同几何形状的纳米结构来研究拓扑相变，未提及具体的实验制备或测量手段，属于基于模型或模拟的理论计算研究。；研究对象：磁性纳米结构中的单个斯格明子（skyrmion）态。具体研究了三种几何形状：纳米圆盘（nanodisks）、纳米方块（nanosquares）和纳米矩形（nanorectangles），并探讨了其尺寸、几何对称性以及外加磁场对斯格明子态的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纳米圆盘的旋转对称性使其能够随直径增大展现出从铁磁态到斯格明子、斯格明子泡（skyrmionium）及多态等丰富的拓扑相变；而纳米方块和矩形由于角部退磁效应和对称性降低，拓扑复杂性受到抑制。此外，利用几何不对称性，方形和矩形结构能在更宽的参数范围内稳定斯格明子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纳米圆盘的旋转对称性使其能够随直径增大展现出从铁磁态到斯格明子、斯格明子泡（skyrmionium）及多态等丰富的拓扑相变；而纳米方块和矩形由于角部退磁效应和对称性降低，拓扑复杂性受到抑制。此外，利用几何不对称性，方形和矩形结构能在更宽的参数范围内稳定斯格明子。；创新点：揭示了**几何对称性**（而非仅尺寸或材料参数）作为调控磁性纳米结构中斯格明子稳定性和拓扑相变的关键设计参数，并系统比较了圆盘、方形和矩形三种几何形状对拓扑相图的影响。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的计算方法或理论框架（如微磁学模拟、蒙特卡洛方法或解析模型等），仅描述了通过“分析”（analyzing）不同几何形状的纳米结构来研究其物理行为。

papers.title: Temperature-Controlled Resonance in a Heteronuclear Quantum Gas Mixture
papers.abstract: Single-channel resonances are fundamental processes in scattering of atoms, yet their occurrence is largely incidental and lacks systematic control. In this Letter, we propose a mechanism to realize a continuously tunable single-channel resonance by controlling the temperature of the heteronuclear mixture. By extending the Casimir-like mediated interaction to finite temperature, we demonstrate that thermal smearing of the Fermi surface reshapes the effective potential between impurities, giving rise to a temperature-controlled resonance (TCR) over a wide parameter range. As a direct consequence, the resonance position shifts systematically with temperature variation, providing a clear experimental signature of this mechanism. We further investigate the quench dynamics of a Bose gas immersed in a Fermi sea and demonstrate that the observed temperature-dependent loss features in recent experiments are consistent with the TCR mechanism. Our results establish temperature as a simple and experimentally accessible control knob for single-channel resonances in ultracold quantum gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“propose a mechanism”“demonstrate”“investigate”，以及摘要中未提及实验数据或计算模拟，主要基于理论推导和机制分析。；研究对象：异核量子气体混合物中的单通道共振现象，具体为通过温度调控费米海中的杂质间有效相互作用，实现共振的可控调节。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种通过控制异核混合物温度来实现单通道共振连续可调的新机制（温度控制共振，TCR），并证明该机制可解释近期实验中观察到的温度依赖的损耗特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种通过控制异核混合物温度来实现单通道共振连续可调的新机制（温度控制共振，TCR），并证明该机制可解释近期实验中观察到的温度依赖的损耗特征。；创新点：首次提出温度可作为超冷量子气体中单通道共振的简单且实验可调的控制旋钮，突破了传统单通道共振缺乏系统调控能力的限制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：将Casimir-like介质相互作用推广至有限温度，考虑费米面热展宽对杂质间有效势的修正，并分析玻色气体浸入费米海后的淬火动力学。

papers.title: Lateral hydrodynamics in supported membranes: The Evans-Sackmann model and its extensions
papers.abstract: We review the theoretical development and modern applications of the Evans-Sackmann hydrodynamic model for lateral transport in supported fluid membranes. We first cover the original formulation, emphasizing the linear momentum decay term that captures membrane-substrate coupling mediated by a thin lubricating fluid layer. This coupling term enables quantitative interpretation of tracer diffusion measurements in supported bilayers. Building on this foundation, we survey theoretical extensions that relax standard boundary conditions at the inclusion perimeter, where inclusions refer to embedded objects such as proteins, lipid domains, or tracer particles within the membrane. We discuss the drag of a disk and a liquid domain, as well as the dynamics of membrane phase separation. We further highlight how the supported-membrane mobility tensor serves as a unifying tool for systematic treatments of correlated diffusion, polymer dynamics, phase separation kinetics, and many-body interactions in quasi-two-dimensional environments. Finally, we discuss recent extensions to active and chiral membranes, where odd viscosity provides a transverse hydrodynamic response and offers a possible route for detecting chirality in two-dimensional fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：review、theoretical development、model、extensions。；研究对象：支撑膜（supported fluid membranes）中的侧向流体动力学，具体涉及膜与基底通过薄润滑流体层耦合的Evans-Sackmann模型及其扩展，包括膜内嵌入物（如蛋白质、脂质域、示踪粒子）的拖曳动力学、相分离动力学，以及活性手性膜中的奇黏度效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Evans-Sackmann模型通过引入线性动量衰减项定量描述了支撑膜中示踪扩散测量；扩展理论通过松弛嵌入物边界条件，统一处理了关联扩散、聚合物动力学、相分离动力学及准二维环境中的多体相互作用；奇黏度提供了横向流体响应，为检测二维流体手性提供了可能途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Evans-Sackmann模型通过引入线性动量衰减项定量描述了支撑膜中示踪扩散测量；扩展理论通过松弛嵌入物边界条件，统一处理了关联扩散、聚合物动力学、相分离动力学及准二维环境中的多体相互作用；奇黏度提供了横向流体响应，为检测二维流体手性提供了可能途径。；创新点：系统综述了Evans-Sackmann模型从原始公式到现代扩展的完整发展，特别强调了支撑膜迁移率张量作为统一工具处理准二维环境中多种动力学问题，并首次将讨论延伸至活性手性膜中的奇黏度效应。摘要未突出说明具体数值或实验验证。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于连续介质流体力学和线性响应理论的Evans-Sackmann模型，包括动量衰减项、支撑膜迁移率张量、边界条件松弛（如圆盘和液滴拖曳）、以及奇黏度引入的横向流体动力学修正。

papers.title: Quantum Mpemba effect for operators in open systems
papers.abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect concerns with anomalous relaxation of quantum states that evolves either under unitary or non-unitary dynamics. In the context of open quantum systems, while most studies focus on quantum states evolving under completely positive trace-presing dynamics described by the Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad (GKSL) master equation, we demonstrate that an analogous effect can arise at the level of operators. In particular, we show that operators that evolves under the adjoint Liouvillian -- despite not being a trace-preserving map -- can still exhibit a genuine Mpemba effect. We derive general conditions under which this phenomenon can occur and validate our predictions for three different open quantum setups. Our results broaden the scope of the Mpemba effect in quantum systems and provide a framework for controlling the relaxation of physically relevant observables.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“derive general conditions”“validate our predictions”，属于理论推导与模型验证，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：开放量子系统中的算符量子Mpemba效应。具体指在非幺正动力学下，算符（而非量子态）在伴随Liouvillian演化中表现出的反常弛豫现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在开放量子系统中，算符在伴随Liouvillian演化下（尽管该映射不保迹）仍可表现出真正的Mpemba效应，即远离稳态的算符比更接近稳态的算符更快弛豫。作者推导了该现象发生的一般条件，并在三种不同开放量子体系中验证了预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在开放量子系统中，算符在伴随Liouvillian演化下（尽管该映射不保迹）仍可表现出真正的Mpemba效应，即远离稳态的算符比更接近稳态的算符更快弛豫。作者推导了该现象发生的一般条件，并在三种不同开放量子体系中验证了预测。；创新点：将量子Mpemba效应的研究从量子态扩展到算符层面，并证明在非保迹的伴随Liouvillian演化下该效应依然存在，从而拓宽了Mpemba效应在量子系统中的适用范围，并为控制可观测量弛豫提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型验证。采用Gorini-Kossakowski-Sudarshan-Lindblad（GKSL）主方程框架下的伴随Liouvillian动力学，推导算符Mpemba效应的一般条件，并通过三个开放量子系统实例进行数值或解析验证。

papers.title: Global resetting and emergent correlations: exit statistics in an interval
papers.abstract: There is considerable current interest in the emergence of statistical correlations within a population of otherwise non-interacting Brownian particles subject to a common fluctuating environment or drive. Examples include global stochastic resetting, switching confining potentials, fluctuating diffusivities, and stochastically gated boundaries. Most studies have focused on the analytical structure of the stationary joint probability density (assuming it exists). In this paper, we extend previous work on the exit statistics of multiple particles in stochastically gated domains to the case of global resetting in an interval with absorbing boundaries at both ends. First, we use a generalised Itô's lemma to derive a hierarchy of boundary value problems (BVPs) for the joint splitting probability that all particles exit from the same end of the interval. The BVPs form a nested sequence with respect to the initial number of particles $M$. We explicitly solve the BVP for a pair of particles ($M=2$) and use this to illustrate the emergence of pairwise correlations. Second, we show how the BVP for the splitting probability of $M$ Brownian particles can be mapped onto the $M$th order moment equation of a stochastic diffusion equation with resetting. We thus establish a general mathematical framework to study exit problems for globally-driven particle systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“generalised Itô's lemma”“boundary value problems (BVPs)”“stochastic diffusion equation”等理论工具，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：受全局随机重置（global stochastic resetting）影响的布朗粒子系统，具体研究粒子在两端吸收边界区间内的退出统计（exit statistics）及粒子间涌现的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于受全局随机重置的非相互作用布朗粒子群体，其联合分裂概率（所有粒子从同一端退出）满足嵌套的边界值问题层级；对于两个粒子（M=2）的情况，可显式求解并展示粒子对关联的涌现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于受全局随机重置的非相互作用布朗粒子群体，其联合分裂概率（所有粒子从同一端退出）满足嵌套的边界值问题层级；对于两个粒子（M=2）的情况，可显式求解并展示粒子对关联的涌现。；创新点：将先前针对随机门控域中多粒子退出统计的研究扩展至全局重置情形，并建立了多粒子分裂概率与随机扩散方程矩方程之间的映射关系。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义伊藤引理（generalised Itô's lemma）推导边界值问题层级；通过将分裂概率的边界值问题映射到带重置的随机扩散方程的M阶矩方程，建立全局驱动粒子系统退出问题的数学框架。

papers.title: Metal-free heteroatom doping of carbon nitride for enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen peroxide production
papers.abstract: The photocatalytic production of hydrogen peroxide (H$_2$O$_2$) from water is a promising strategy for solar-to-chemical energy conversion. Herein, we investigate the effect of metal-free heteroatom doping (B, O, P, and S) on the structural, electronic, and photocatalytic properties of graphitic carbon nitride (C$_3$N$_4$) for H$_2$O$_2$ production under simulated solar irradiation. While pristine C$_3$N$_4$ exhibits stacked nanosheets, doping induces disorder, partial exfoliation, and changes in interlayer spacing, confirming successful heteroatom incorporation and modification of the electronic and optical properties. Photocatalytic experiments reveal that H$_2$O$_2$ production strongly depends on the sacrificial agent, pH, and reactive-species scavengers. All doped catalysts show enhanced activity compared to pristine C$_3$N$_4$, with 9.6-, 14.8-, 11.0-, and 16.4-fold increases for B-, P-, O-, and S-doped C$_3$N$_4$, respectively. S-doped C$_3$N$_4$ achieved the highest H$_2$O$_2$ production rate of 3022.1 $μ$mol h$^{-1}$ g$^{-1}$ and an apparent quantum yield of 8.1\%, attributed to improved charge separation and optimized selectivity. Mechanistic studies indicate that oxygen activation mainly follows a two-electron (2e$^{-}$) pathway driven by charge-carrier modulation and reactive oxygen species dynamics, with singlet oxygen and photogenerated holes playing a dominant role. In addition, S-doped C$_3$N$_4$ retained over 95\% of its activity after five cycles. These results highlight metal-free heteroatom doping as an effective strategy for sustainable photocatalytic H$_2$O$_2$ generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“Photocatalytic experiments reveal...”、“Mechanistic studies indicate...”、“retained over 95% of its activity after five cycles”等实验表征与性能测试内容。；研究对象：金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂的石墨相氮化碳（C₃N₄）材料，用于光催化产过氧化氢（H₂O₂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有金属自由杂原子掺杂均显著提升了C₃N₄的光催化产H₂O₂性能，其中S掺杂效果最佳，产率达到3022.1 μmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，表观量子产率为8.1%，且循环稳定性优异（五次循环后活性保持>95%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有金属自由杂原子掺杂均显著提升了C₃N₄的光催化产H₂O₂性能，其中S掺杂效果最佳，产率达到3022.1 μmol h⁻¹ g⁻¹，表观量子产率为8.1%，且循环稳定性优异（五次循环后活性保持>95%）。；创新点：系统比较了多种金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂对C₃N₄光催化产H₂O₂性能的影响，并揭示了S掺杂通过改善电荷分离和优化选择性实现最高活性，同时明确了氧活化主要遵循双电子（2e⁻）路径，且单线态氧和光生空穴起主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用金属自由杂原子（B、O、P、S）掺杂合成改性C₃N₄；通过结构表征（如层间距、无序度、部分剥离等）分析掺杂效果；进行光催化产H₂O₂实验，考察牺牲剂、pH、活性物种清除剂的影响；利用电荷分离、选择性优化及活性氧物种动力学分析机制。

papers.title: Multiple Superconducting Phases in Rhombohedral Heptalayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Crystalline rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) has emerged as an ideal platform for studying unconventional superconductivity. Here, we report the observation of superconductivity in moiréless rhombohedral heptalayer graphene (RHG) at zero magnetic field. The superconducting phases emerge at low displacement electric fields (|D| < 0.2 V/nm) and are symmetrically distributed about D = 0, with one robust state exhibiting zero resistance and two weaker superconducting features. Comparisons with rhombohedral pentalayer graphene (RPG) reveal distinct perpendicular magnetic-field responses, and quantum oscillation measurements indicate that superconductivity in RHG arises from a half-metallic normal state. These results highlight the strong dependence of superconductivity on layer number and electronic structure in RMG systems and provide new insights into its microscopic origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“observation”、“measurements”、“report”。；研究对象：无摩尔超晶格的菱方七层石墨烯（Rhombohedral Heptalayer Graphene, RHG）中的超导相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零磁场下，菱方七层石墨烯（RHG）中观测到超导电性，其超导相出现在低位移电场区域，并关于零电场对称分布。与五层石墨烯（RPG）的对比表明，超导电性对层数和电子结构有强烈依赖。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零磁场下，菱方七层石墨烯（RHG）中观测到超导电性，其超导相出现在低位移电场区域，并关于零电场对称分布。与五层石墨烯（RPG）的对比表明，超导电性对层数和电子结构有强烈依赖。；创新点：首次在无摩尔超晶格的菱方七层石墨烯中观测到超导电性，并揭示了其超导相与层数的强关联性，为理解菱方多层石墨烯体系中超导的微观起源提供了新视角。摘要未突出说明与理论模型的对比。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（零电阻测量）、量子振荡测量。具体包括：通过施加位移电场（D）调控体系，测量电阻随温度、磁场的变化，并与菱方五层石墨烯（RPG）的垂直磁场响应进行对比。

papers.title: Mpemba effect in a sheared granular gas with velocity-dependent restitution
papers.abstract: We investigate the Mpemba effect in a dilute sheared granular gas with a velocity-dependent restitution coefficient. Using kinetic theory based on Grad's moment method, we analyze the relaxation dynamics following a sudden change in the shear rate. We show that, despite having a higher initial temperature, a system starting from an isotropic state can relax faster than a system prepared in a sheared steady state, demonstrating a clear Mpemba effect in the temperature evolution. We further demonstrate the emergence of a viscosity Mpemba effect, characterized by crossings in the relaxation curves of the shear viscosity. Remarkably, multiple crossings arise due to an additional intrinsic timescale introduced by the velocity dependence of the restitution coefficient, providing a minimal kinetic mechanism for multiple Mpemba effects in driven granular gases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：kinetic theory（动理学理论）、Grad's moment method（Grad矩方法）、analysis（分析）。；研究对象：稀薄剪切颗粒气体（dilute sheared granular gas），其中颗粒的恢复系数依赖于速度（velocity-dependent restitution coefficient），研究其Mpemba效应（即初始温度较高的系统反而更快冷却的现象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在剪切速率突变后，初始处于各向同性态的系统尽管温度更高，却比初始处于剪切稳态的系统更快弛豫，明确展示了温度演化中的Mpemba效应。此外，还发现了剪切粘度的Mpemba效应，且由于恢复系数的速度依赖性引入了额外本征时间尺度，导致弛豫曲线出现多次交叉，从而产生多重Mpemba效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在剪切速率突变后，初始处于各向同性态的系统尽管温度更高，却比初始处于剪切稳态的系统更快弛豫，明确展示了温度演化中的Mpemba效应。此外，还发现了剪切粘度的Mpemba效应，且由于恢复系数的速度依赖性引入了额外本征时间尺度，导致弛豫曲线出现多次交叉，从而产生多重Mpemba效应。；创新点：首次在具有速度依赖恢复系数的剪切颗粒气体中，通过动理学理论揭示了多重Mpemba效应的存在，并指出恢复系数的速度依赖性作为最小动理学机制可导致弛豫曲线的多次交叉。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grad矩方法的动理学理论（kinetic theory based on Grad's moment method），分析剪切速率突变后的弛豫动力学。

papers.title: Network analysis for steady-state current fluctuations under finite affinity: Application to Brownian computation
papers.abstract: A graph-theoretic analysis of the steady-state current noise in master equations under a finite thermodynamic force (affinity) is presented. The incidence matrix twisted by a finite affinity is not orthogonal to the standard cycle space, motivating the introduction of twisted circuit matrices to restore the orthogonality. The resulting twisted-cycle matrix yields an interference-like effect, enabling us to express the signal-to-noise ratio as a quadratic optimization problem in terms of twisted-cycle currents. We apply this framework to a Brownian computation model on a tree-like state-transition diagram with exponential backward branching, finite affinity at each step, and a single reset cycle. In the limit of an infinitely long intended computation path $\ell$, the Fano factor of the reset current undergoes a transition from noiseless to Poissonian behavior at an affinity equal to the logarithm of the number of immediate predecessors $α$. This corresponds to an easy-hard transition in the computational time complexity [K. Okajima, K. Hukushima, arXiv:2512.24728 ], which is not captured by the thermodynamic uncertainty relation. This transition point precisely characterizes the thermodynamic costs of logically irreversible computation: in the absence of affinity, the reset cost scales as $\ln \ell$, whereas reaching the transition point requires a thermodynamic force of order $\ln α$ per step to counteract backward branching.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：graph-theoretic analysis、master equations、quadratic optimization problem。；研究对象：主方程框架下有限热力学力（亲和力）驱动的稳态电流噪声，以及布朗计算模型（树状状态转移图，指数向后分支，单重置循环）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无限长计算路径极限下，重置电流的Fano因子在亲和力等于前驱数对数lnα时发生从无噪声到泊松行为的转变，对应计算时间复杂度的易-难相变，且该转变点精确刻画了逻辑不可逆计算的热力学成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无限长计算路径极限下，重置电流的Fano因子在亲和力等于前驱数对数lnα时发生从无噪声到泊松行为的转变，对应计算时间复杂度的易-难相变，且该转变点精确刻画了逻辑不可逆计算的热力学成本。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 图论分析：通过引入扭曲电路矩阵恢复有限亲和力下关联矩阵与标准循环空间的正交性，将信噪比表达为扭曲循环电流的二次优化问题，并应用于布朗计算模型。

papers.title: Coherent spectroscopy of collective excitations in superfluid helium far from equilibrium
papers.abstract: Ultrafast dynamics of collective excitations in superfluids remains largely unexplored beyond the roton regime, despite its importance for understanding nonequilibrium processes in these systems. Here, we employ ultrafast coherent control with sequences of femtosecond pulses to perform spectroscopy of multiple branches of the Landau excitation spectrum in superfluid helium far from equilibrium. By measuring the time-resolved optical birefringence, we track the nonequilibrium dynamics of maxon pairs and Pitaevskii plateau excitations alongside the previously studied roton pairs, revealing surprisingly strong binding energy of maxon pairs, their extremely short lifetime, and the influence of the quasiparticle effective mass on the phase of the coherent response. These results demonstrate the ability to extract previously inaccessible information about collective excitations in a strongly interacting quantum fluid by probing its nonequilibrium dynamics on femtosecond and picosecond timescales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：ultrafast coherent control、femtosecond pulses、time-resolved optical birefringence。；研究对象：超流氦（superfluid helium）中远离平衡态的集体激发（collective excitations），具体包括maxon对、Pitaevskii plateau激发以及roton对。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了maxon对具有出乎意料的强结合能、极短的寿命，以及准粒子有效质量对相干响应相位的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了maxon对具有出乎意料的强结合能、极短的寿命，以及准粒子有效质量对相干响应相位的影响。；创新点：将超快相干光谱学应用于超流氦中远离平衡态的集体激发，首次同时探测了maxon对和Pitaevskii plateau激发，并提取了此前无法获得的关于强相互作用量子流体中集体激发的信息。
papers.method_zh: 利用飞秒脉冲序列实现超快相干控制，通过测量时间分辨的光学双折射（time-resolved optical birefringence）来追踪超流氦中不同分支的Landau激发谱的动力学。

papers.title: Lattice Relaxation in Moiré Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: We develop an analytical theory for lattice relaxation in twisted moiré heterobilayers, accounting for lattice mismatch, twist, external biaxial heterostrain, and different elastic constants. Starting from continuum elasticity, we derive the self-consistent equations for the in-plane displacement fields and obtain simple perturbative expressions for the layer-resolved in-plane displacement fields induced by lattice relaxation. We apply our theory to graphene on hBN and representative 2H transition metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers, including MoTe$_2$/WSe$_2$ and WSe$_2$/WS$_2$. Our analytical results agree very well with full numerical solutions over experimentally relevant parameters. We further show that heterobilayers can exhibit a buckling instability near alignment, driven by compressive in-plane strain due to moiré relaxation. Our results provide a simple theoretical framework for incorporating lattice relaxation in realistic moiré heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical theory、continuum elasticity、perturbative expressions。；研究对象：扭曲莫尔异质双层中的晶格弛豫现象，具体包括石墨烯/hBN、MoTe₂/WSe₂和WSe₂/WS₂等代表性异质双层体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个解析理论，能够准确描述由晶格失配、扭转、外部双轴异质应变和不同弹性常数引起的层分辨面内位移场；并发现异质双层在接近对齐时可能因莫尔弛豫导致的压缩面内应变而出现屈曲不稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个解析理论，能够准确描述由晶格失配、扭转、外部双轴异质应变和不同弹性常数引起的层分辨面内位移场；并发现异质双层在接近对齐时可能因莫尔弛豫导致的压缩面内应变而出现屈曲不稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于连续弹性理论推导自洽方程，得到层分辨面内位移场的微扰解析表达式，并与全数值解进行对比验证。

papers.title: Anomalies in the thermal conductivity of honeycomb antiferromagnet MnPS$_{3}$
papers.abstract: Intrinsic two-dimensional magnets serve as a good platform to explore collective, charge-neutral and low-energy excitations. Distinguishing the crucial role of them in experimental aspect remains a challenge for decades. Here, we study the thermal transport in honeycomb antiferromagnet MnPS$_{3}$ with $T_N$=78 K down to very low temperatures (<0.01$T_N$). At high temperatures (>0.1$T_N$), the field dependence of the thermal Hall conductivity exhibits a linear phonon Hall effect and a peak associated with the spin-flop transition due to a strong spin-lattice coupling, well reproducing the previous report (Phys. Rev. B 110, 165147 (2024)). Notably, below 2 K, we find that the field dependence of the thermal Hall conductivity exhibits sign reversals within the spin-flop phase, at which the field dependence of the longitudinal thermal conductivity also shows multiple valleys. We suggest that these anomalies are caused by the redistribution of Berry curvature in magnon bands, demonstrating the superior performance of the thermal Hall measurements to detect the Berry curvature distributions in magnetic insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：thermal transport study、field dependence、thermal Hall conductivity measurements。；研究对象：蜂窝状反铁磁体 MnPS₃（奈尔温度 T_N=78 K）中的热输运现象，特别是极低温下（<0.01T_N）的热霍尔效应和纵向热导率异常。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极低温（<2 K）下，MnPS₃ 的热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内出现符号反转，同时纵向热导率呈现多个谷值。这些异常源于磁振子能带中贝里曲率的重新分布，表明热霍尔测量是探测磁性绝缘体中贝里曲率分布的优越手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极低温（<2 K）下，MnPS₃ 的热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内出现符号反转，同时纵向热导率呈现多个谷值。这些异常源于磁振子能带中贝里曲率的重新分布，表明热霍尔测量是探测磁性绝缘体中贝里曲率分布的优越手段。；创新点：首次在极低温（<2 K）下发现 MnPS₃ 热霍尔电导率在自旋翻转相内的符号反转现象，并将其归因于磁振子能带贝里曲率的重新分布，展示了热霍尔效应对贝里曲率分布的灵敏探测能力。
papers.method_zh: 极低温热输运测量（低至 0.01T_N 以下），包括热霍尔电导率和纵向热导率随磁场变化的测量，并与高温区（>0.1T_N）的已知结果进行对比。

papers.title: Universal interface fluctuations in absorbing-state phase transitions
papers.abstract: Despite similarities between models exhibiting absorbing phase transitions (APTs) and those showing Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) growth, the relationship between these universal fluctuations has remained elusive. We numerically study (1+1)-dimensional interfaces of (2+1)-dimensional models showing APTs of directed percolation (DP) and compact directed percolation (CDP) classes with an active boundary, finding a universal crossover from short-time APT-governed fluctuations to long-time KPZ fluctuations. Upon rescaling time and length by the APT correlation time and length, the cumulants of the interface height distributions collapse onto a single scaling function. The fluctuation properties of the discrete Domany-Kinzel model and the continuum stochastic Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov (sFKPP) equation coincide, indicating that the KPZ growth parameters are determined solely by fundamental properties of the APT. For the CDP sFKPP equation, a dimensionless parameter tunes both the critical interface distribution and the KPZ parameters, with the interface properties of the biased voter model recovered in a limiting case. These results uncover a universal crossover in which KPZ fluctuations emerge from APT fluctuations at long times, linking paradigmatic universality classes of nonequilibrium scale-invariant phenomena.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：numerically study（数值研究）、scaling function（标度函数）、continuum equation（连续方程）。；研究对象：吸收态相变（APT）中的界面涨落，具体涉及有向逾渗（DP）类和紧致有向逾渗（CDP）类模型，以及Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）生长过程之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在（2+1）维吸收态相变模型中，界面涨落存在从短时间受APT支配到长时间受KPZ支配的普适交叉行为；APT的相关时间和长度经重新标度后，界面高度分布的累积量可坍缩为单一标度函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在（2+1）维吸收态相变模型中，界面涨落存在从短时间受APT支配到长时间受KPZ支配的普适交叉行为；APT的相关时间和长度经重新标度后，界面高度分布的累积量可坍缩为单一标度函数。；创新点：揭示了APT与KPZ两类非平衡标度不变现象之间的普适交叉关系，并证明KPZ生长参数完全由APT的基本性质决定；对于CDP类sFKPP方程，发现一个无量纲参数可同时调控临界界面分布和KPZ参数。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（1+1）维界面，研究（2+1）维有向逾渗类和紧致有向逾渗类模型（包括离散的Domany-Kinzel模型和连续的随机Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piskunov（sFKPP）方程），并分析界面高度分布的累积量及KPZ生长参数。

papers.title: Thermal Transport in Defective Uranium Nitride: Effects of Point Defects, Anharmonicity, and Electronic Contributions
papers.abstract: The impact of point defects on thermal transport in uranium nitride (UN) is investigated using a MLIP combined with Green-Kubo (GK) and normal mode analysis (NMA) methods over 300-1500 K. In pristine UN, temperature-dependent calculations of lattice thermal conductivity reveal that four-phonon scattering is essential yet sufficient to accurately capture high temperature anharmonic phonon transport, as evidenced by close agreement between GK and ShengBTE calculations including three- and four-phonon processes. In defective systems, all types of point defects significantly reduce thermal conductivity at low temperature. Mode-resolved analysis further shows that interstitial defects introduce new phonon states due to a stronger local strain effect. Notably, the uranium interstitial leads to strong defect-phonon scattering over broad phonon spectrum, while the other point defects produce more selective scattering, with even reduced phonon scattering for some acoustic modes. The optical contribution to thermal conductivity remains nearly constant in the presence of IU, but decreases with increasing temperature for pristine and the other defect types. The total thermal conductivity, incorporating electron-phonon coupling and an estimated electronic contribution, yields excellent agreement with experiment in the pristine system, with electronic contributions dominating thermal transport above 600 K. Moreover, with defect-electron contribution introduced through a semiclassical electron-defect scattering model, it is found that (i) the total conductivity degradation follows IU, VU, IN, and VN in descending order, and (ii) electron-phonon coupling becomes negligible in defective systems. These results provide a unified understanding of defect-dependent thermal transport in UN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：MLIP、Green-Kubo、normal mode analysis、ShengBTE计算）；研究对象：缺陷氮化铀（UN）中的热输运现象，具体研究点缺陷（铀间隙原子IU、铀空位VU、氮间隙原子IN、氮空位VN）对热导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完整UN中，四声子散射是准确描述高温非简谐声子输运的必要条件；在缺陷体系中，铀间隙原子（IU）导致最强的缺陷-声子散射，而其他缺陷则产生更具选择性的散射。总热导率中，电子贡献在600K以上占主导，且缺陷体系中电子-声子耦合变得可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完整UN中，四声子散射是准确描述高温非简谐声子输运的必要条件；在缺陷体系中，铀间隙原子（IU）导致最强的缺陷-声子散射，而其他缺陷则产生更具选择性的散射。总热导率中，电子贡献在600K以上占主导，且缺陷体系中电子-声子耦合变得可忽略。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）结合Green-Kubo（GK）方法和简正模分析（NMA）方法，在300-1500K温度范围内进行计算。同时使用ShengBTE软件包计算包含三声子和四声子过程的晶格热导率，并通过半经典电子-缺陷散射模型引入缺陷-电子贡献。

papers.title: Ferroelectric polarization controlled orbital Hall conductivity in a higher-order topological insulator: \textit{d1T}-phase monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: The higher-order topological insulator is an extended concept of the conventional topological insulator, which obeys the generalization of the standard bulk-boundary correspondence. In our paper, we predict the monolayer \textit{d1T}-phase transition metal dichalcogenide MoS$_2$ to be a higher-order topological insulator, while also possessing intriguing ferroelectric characteristics. We explicitly demonstrate the nontrivial topological index and reveal the hallmark corner states with quantized fractional charge within the bulk band gap. Second, we show the existence of a nonzero orbital Hall conductivity plateau within the energy gap which is a signature to identify higher-order topology system. Additionally, we investigate the relationship between the ferroelectricity and the orbital Hall conductivity of \textit{d1T} MoS$_2$ and find that the direction of ferroelectric polarization can modulate the positive and negative values of the orbital Hall conductivity $σ_{\rm{OH}}^x$. Our findings provide the theory and material candidate for ferroelectricity tunable orbital Hall effect which is promising to realize the external electric field controllable orbitronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：predict、demonstrate、show、investigate（均为理论预测与计算分析，未提及实验手段）。；研究对象：单层d1T相过渡金属二硫族化合物MoS₂，以及其高阶拓扑绝缘体特性、铁电性与轨道霍尔电导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层d1T相MoS₂被预测为一种高阶拓扑绝缘体，同时具有铁电性；其铁电极化方向可调控轨道霍尔电导的正负值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层d1T相MoS₂被预测为一种高阶拓扑绝缘体，同时具有铁电性；其铁电极化方向可调控轨道霍尔电导的正负值。；创新点：首次在单层d1T相MoS₂中同时预测高阶拓扑绝缘体与铁电性，并揭示铁电极化对轨道霍尔电导的调控作用，为外电场可控的轨道电子学（orbitronics）提供了理论依据与材料候选。
papers.method_zh: 通过拓扑指标计算（nontrivial topological index）验证非平庸拓扑性质，展示体带隙内具有量子化分数电荷的角态（corner states），并计算轨道霍尔电导平台（orbital Hall conductivity plateau）以识别高阶拓扑体系。

papers.title: I-V characteristics of SNS junctions with a multivalley normal region
papers.abstract: In multivalley conductors the inter-valley relaxation time $τ_v$ and the inelastic relaxation time $τ_{in}$ may be significantly longer than the intra-valley momentum relaxation time $τ$. We show that this separation of time scales has dramatic effects on the I-V characteristics of SNS junctions with a multivalley normal region. We generalize the Larkin-Ovchinnikov equations describing superconducting kinetics to the case of multivalley superconductors. We use this generalization to obtain a kinetic description of multivalley SNS junctions. We find that at constant voltage bias $V$, the current $I(V)$ is nonmonotonic; it exhibits two peaks of similar magnitude $I_\text{max,1} \sim I_\text{max,2}$ at $V_1 \sim \hbar(eτ_{in})^{-1}$ and $V_2\sim \hbar(eτ_v)^{-1}$, which may greatly exceed the critical current $I_c(T)$. At constant current bias $I$ we find that in a wide interval, $I_c(T) < I \lesssim I_{\text{jump}}$, the nonlinear resistance of the junction is controlled by the long relaxation times and may be several orders of magnitude smaller than the normal state resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We show”、“We generalize”、“We use this generalization to obtain a kinetic description”等表述，核心是建立理论模型和推导物理结论，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：多谷正常区的超导体-正常金属-超导体（SNS）结的电流-电压（I-V）特性，特别关注谷间弛豫时间（τ_v）和非弹性弛豫时间（τ_in）远大于谷内动量弛豫时间（τ）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多谷SNS结中，由于不同弛豫时间尺度的分离，I-V特性呈现非单调行为：在恒定电压偏置下，电流在特定电压处出现两个大小相近的峰值；在恒定电流偏置下，结的非线性电阻可能比正常态电阻小几个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多谷SNS结中，由于不同弛豫时间尺度的分离，I-V特性呈现非单调行为：在恒定电压偏置下，电流在特定电压处出现两个大小相近的峰值；在恒定电流偏置下，结的非线性电阻可能比正常态电阻小几个数量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 将描述超导动力学的Larkin-Ovchinnikov方程推广到多谷超导体情形，并利用该推广建立多谷SNS结的动力学描述（kinetic description）。

papers.title: Competition and coexistence of superconducting symmetries in $p$-wave magnets
papers.abstract: We investigate the interplay between unconventional magnetism and superconductivity in a model of a $p$-wave magnet on a square lattice. Using a self-consistent Bogoliubov-de-Gennes approach, we analyze the pairing amplitudes, competition, and coexistence of spin-singlet $s$-wave and spin-triplet $p$-wave pairings in the presence of a magnetic texture with a helical structure along the $x$ direction that is repeated in the $y$ direction. We find that the magnetic helix selectively stabilizes different pairing symmetries depending on its orientation and strength. In particular, mixed-spin $p_x$-wave pairing is enhanced at intermediate magnetic couplings and equal-spin $p_y$-wave pairing is robust and insensitive to all coupling intensities. When the multiple order parameters are simultaneously considered, we find regimes of coexistence and competition. Increasing the magnetic coupling drives two quantum phase transitions. The first from dominant spin-singlet $s$-wave to mixed-spin triplet $p_x$-wave pairings in a regime of coexistence. The second from spin-singlet $s$-wave and mixed-spin triplet $p$-wave pairings with total spin projection $S_z=0$ to dominant equal-spin triplet $p_y$-wave pairings with $S_z=\pm1$ in a regime of mutually exclusive superconducting phases. Our results demonstrate that $p$-wave magnetic order does not merely diminish spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductivity but can actively promote and stabilize spin-triplet $p$-wave pairing, both intrinsically and in proximity to spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductors. These findings highlight unconventional magnets as promising materials for realizing robust triplet superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：self-consistent Bogoliubov-de-Gennes approach（自洽Bogoliubov-de-Gennes方法）、模型分析。；研究对象：在正方晶格上具有螺旋磁结构的p波磁体中的超导配对对称性，具体研究自旋单态s波与自旋三重态p波配对的竞争与共存。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: p波磁序不仅能抑制自旋单态s波超导，还能主动促进并稳定自旋三重态p波配对；随着磁耦合强度增加，系统经历两次量子相变，从s波主导到p_x波共存，再到p_y波主导的互斥超导相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：p波磁序不仅能抑制自旋单态s波超导，还能主动促进并稳定自旋三重态p波配对；随着磁耦合强度增加，系统经历两次量子相变，从s波主导到p_x波共存，再到p_y波主导的互斥超导相。；创新点：揭示了p波磁序可以主动选择性地稳定不同配对对称性（如混合自旋p_x波和等自旋p_y波），并展示了磁耦合强度驱动两次量子相变的具体机制，表明非常规磁体是实现稳健三重态超导的潜在平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽Bogoliubov-de-Gennes（BdG）方法，在正方晶格上构建p波磁体模型，分析沿x方向螺旋、沿y方向重复的磁织构下不同配对通道的振幅、竞争与共存。

papers.title: Finite-frequency anomaly-induced electromechanical response of Dirac fermions in deformed graphene
papers.abstract: A deformation of a graphene sheet changes more than the positions of the atoms. In the low-energy Dirac theory it also produces geometric electron-phonon vertices. One of these vertices acts as an emergent phonon gauge field, $\calA_μ$, which couples to the same Dirac current as the electromagnetic vector potential. This shared current vertex gives a direct route from mechanics to electronics: a moving deformation can generate a transverse electric current, and a deformation pattern with emergent phonon flux can bind electric charge. We show that the coefficient of this mixed electromechanical response is the parity-odd current-current correlator of a massive Dirac cone. For an insulating cone the coefficient is the one-cone Chern-Simons value, while for a doped cone in the local regime it is reduced by the Berry curvature factor $m/|μ|$. We apply the response to explicit deformations. A traveling flexural wave generates a transverse second-harmonic current; a static ripple mixed with a dynamic phonon generates a transverse current at the drive frequency; and two non-collinear modes can generate charge modulation through the emergent phonon flux. We keep the spin and valley sum explicit, so the paper shows when the one-cone anomaly becomes a charge current in graphene and when it instead appears in a valley, spin, or spin-valley channel. For sublattice-gapped graphene with a valley-odd deformation gauge coupling, the two valleys add rather than cancel. The experimentally sharp signature is a transverse electrical signal at twice the flexural-wave frequency, with a phase fixed by the sign of the sublattice gap and a gate dependence that crosses over from a gap plateau to a $1/|μ|$ decay. These direction, phase, frequency, and gate-voltage selection rules give clean tests of the anomaly-induced electromechanical channel in deformed graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“Dirac theory”、“show that”、“apply the response to explicit deformations”等理论推导和模型应用的表述，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：变形石墨烯中狄拉克费米子的有限频率反常诱导的机电响应。具体物理现象包括：由移动的形变（如行波）产生的横向电流，以及由静态形变与动态声子混合产生的电荷调制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，变形石墨烯中机电响应的系数由有质量狄拉克锥的奇宇称流-流关联函数决定。对于绝缘锥，该系数为单锥陈-西蒙斯值；对于掺杂锥，在局域区域内该系数被贝里曲率因子 m/|μ| 所抑制。实验上可观测的显著信号是频率为弯曲波两倍的横向电信号，其相位由子晶格能隙的符号决定，栅压依赖关系从能隙平台区过渡到 1/|μ| 衰减区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，变形石墨烯中机电响应的系数由有质量狄拉克锥的奇宇称流-流关联函数决定。对于绝缘锥，该系数为单锥陈-西蒙斯值；对于掺杂锥，在局域区域内该系数被贝里曲率因子 m/|μ| 所抑制。实验上可观测的显著信号是频率为弯曲波两倍的横向电信号，其相位由子晶格能隙的符号决定，栅压依赖关系从能隙平台区过渡到 1/|μ| 衰减区。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：1）系统计算了有限频率下由反常（量子反常）诱导的机电响应系数，并揭示了其与狄拉克锥质量、掺杂水平（化学势）的依赖关系；2）明确指出了在子晶格能隙石墨烯中，通过谷奇宇称的形变规范耦合，两个谷的贡献相加而非相消，从而产生可观测的电荷电流；3）给出了具体的、具有清晰方向、相位、频率和栅压选择规则的实验可检验信号。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为低能狄拉克理论，通过分析形变引入的几何电子-声子顶点（特别是作为涌现声子规范场 $\calA_μ$ 的顶点）与电磁矢势共享的流顶点，推导出混合机电响应的系数。论文明确保留了自旋和谷自由度的求和，以区分电荷、谷、自旋等不同通道的响应。

papers.title: Theory of melting lines with a variable enthalpy of fusion
papers.abstract: Conventional derivations of phase boundaries from the Clausius-Clapeyron (CC) relation often employ the constant latent heat approximation to maintain analytical functions of the sublimation and boiling curves. To address the complex thermodynamics of the solid-liquid transition, we develop a two-phase analytical model by modifying the CC equation to account for a variable enthalpy of fusion along the melting line (ML). Our methodology utilizes recent theoretical and experimental progress demonstrating that the isobaric heat capacity of crystalline solids near the melting point features a dominant anharmonic, volume-dependent component. Consequently, the latent heat is correlated to the specific volumes of the coexisting phases. Differentiation of this modified CC relation yields a second-order differential equation governing ML. By imposing appropriate e boundary conditions, physically acceptable approximate parabolic solutions are derived. The parameters of these analytic functions are defined exclusively by fundamental thermophysical properties, including the bulk moduli, thermal expansion coefficients, and specific volumes of the coexisting phases, as well as the isobaric heat capacity of the solid. Our derivation, rooted in solid-state anharmonicity, yields approximate parabolic scaling laws that corroborate with a recent universal model derived from the Phonon Theory of Liquids [K. Trachenko, Phys. Rev. E 109, 034122 (2024)], supporting the universal parabolic nature of melting curves from a completely distinct theoretical foundation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytical model、derivation、theoretical foundation。；研究对象：固-液相变（熔化）的相边界（熔融线），具体研究熔化过程中熔化焓随温度变化的热力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过修正克劳修斯-克拉佩龙方程以考虑可变熔化焓，推导出熔融线近似满足抛物线标度律，该结果从固体非简谐性出发，支持了近期基于液体声子理论提出的熔融曲线普适抛物线模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过修正克劳修斯-克拉佩龙方程以考虑可变熔化焓，推导出熔融线近似满足抛物线标度律，该结果从固体非简谐性出发，支持了近期基于液体声子理论提出的熔融曲线普适抛物线模型。；创新点：从固体非简谐性这一完全不同的理论出发点，推导出与液体声子理论一致的熔融线抛物线标度律，为熔融曲线的普适抛物线性质提供了新的理论支撑。
papers.method_zh: 基于修正的克劳修斯-克拉佩龙方程，结合固体在熔点附近等压热容的主要贡献来自非简谐且与体积相关的成分这一理论进展，建立两相解析模型；通过微分得到控制熔融线的二阶微分方程，并施加适当边界条件求解出近似抛物线解。

papers.title: Collective dynamics of active matter with orientation-weighted alignment
papers.abstract: We study an agent-based model of self-propelled particles with a velocity-dependent alignment rule. This interaction is orientation weighted and acts along the line connecting neighboring particles. Tuning the alignment strength produces several distinct collective regimes, including disordered gas-like motion, coherent flocking, jammed high-density states, and densely ordered moving clusters with active-crystal-like behavior. These results show that a simple local alignment rule can generate a broad range of nonequilibrium collective dynamics within a single microscopic model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“agent-based model”（基于智能体的模型）和“microscopic model”（微观模型），属于数值模拟与理论分析。；研究对象：活性物质（active matter）的集体动力学，具体为具有速度依赖对齐规则的自推进粒子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节取向加权对齐强度，单一微观模型即可产生多种非平衡集体动力学相态，包括无序气体运动、相干 flocking（群集）、堵塞高密度态以及具有活性晶体行为的有序运动团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节取向加权对齐强度，单一微观模型即可产生多种非平衡集体动力学相态，包括无序气体运动、相干 flocking（群集）、堵塞高密度态以及具有活性晶体行为的有序运动团簇。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于智能体的计算模型（agent-based model），粒子具有自推进特性，采用速度依赖的对齐规则，该规则是取向加权的，并沿相邻粒子连线方向作用。

papers.title: Iterative maps emerging from cohomological structure of primes
papers.abstract: Prime numbers appeared in contexts spanning statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics and dynamical systems. However, the mechanisms governing the irregularities observed in their sequence and linking them to physical systems remained unclear. Here, it is shown that prime gaps at different separation distances follow a function depending on that distance and can be described by an iterative map which predicts the primary growth of successive primes. On the other hand, the analysis of remaining fluctuations reveals the existence of a well-defined cohomological structure, where the deterministic functional relation holds for primes up to small decaying fluctuations. In consequence, the long-range correlations as well as local jumps in primes encode the underlying cohomological structure where prime numbers are states of a given system that becomes deterministic asymptotically. Remarkably, the solution to this cohomological equation turns out to be the logarithmic integral function.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：cohomological structure（上同调结构）、iterative map（迭代映射）、deterministic asymptotic（渐近确定性）。；研究对象：素数序列及其间隙的统计与动力学结构，探讨素数在物理系统（统计力学、量子力学、动力系统）中出现的机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 素数间隙随分离距离遵循一个函数关系，可由迭代映射描述，该映射预测了连续素数的主要增长；剩余涨落揭示了一个定义良好的上同调结构，该结构的解为对数积分函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：素数间隙随分离距离遵循一个函数关系，可由迭代映射描述，该映射预测了连续素数的主要增长；剩余涨落揭示了一个定义良好的上同调结构，该结构的解为对数积分函数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析不同分离距离下素数间隙的规律，构建迭代映射描述素数增长，并对剩余涨落进行上同调分析，最终求解上同调方程得到对数积分函数。

papers.title: Variational Boundary Fluctuations as a First-Principles Origin of Langevin Noise
papers.abstract: Stochastic forces are usually postulated or obtained by eliminating environmental degrees of freedom. Here we identify a variational origin: fluctuating endpoint data in Hamilton's principle induce fluctuations of the on-shell action. Hamilton--Jacobi propagation transports this boundary imprint, whose gradient generates an effective Langevin force inherited from boundary-action fluctuations. The resulting force is not freely specifiable: its amplitude is filtered by the Hessian of Hamilton's principal function, yielding multiplicative and state-dependent noise. Homogeneous additive Langevin forcing is recovered only as a Markovian coarse-grained limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational origin、Hamilton's principle、Hamilton–Jacobi propagation、Langevin force。；研究对象：随机力（Langevin噪声）的起源，具体为从变分原理出发，研究边界数据涨落如何导致有效随机力。
