papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过哈密顿原理中端点数据的涨落，可以自然导出有效朗之万力，该力并非自由指定，而是由哈密顿主函数的Hessian矩阵过滤，产生乘性、状态依赖的噪声；均匀加性朗之万力仅在马尔可夫粗粒化极限下恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过哈密顿原理中端点数据的涨落，可以自然导出有效朗之万力，该力并非自由指定，而是由哈密顿主函数的Hessian矩阵过滤，产生乘性、状态依赖的噪声；均匀加性朗之万力仅在马尔可夫粗粒化极限下恢复。；创新点：首次从变分原理（边界涨落）出发，为朗之万噪声提供了一个第一性原理的起源，而非传统上通过假设或消去环境自由度引入。
papers.method_zh: 基于哈密顿原理和哈密顿-雅可比理论，通过分析边界涨落对在壳作用量的影响，推导出有效随机力的形式及其统计性质。

papers.title: Finite-width adiabatic shear banding and dislocation patterning in mesoscale polycrystalline aggregates
papers.abstract: Dynamic shear banding under adiabatic conditions in a mesoscale polycrystalline aggregate is studied using a model of mesoscale dislocation mechanics and experiments. The model involves a length scale related to hardening induced by excess/polar/geometrically necessary dislocation (GND) density, and utilizes a simple classical crystal plasticity model with isotropic Voce law hardening. Simulations of statistically representative volume elements of a polycrystal determined from experimental samples are conducted. Studies in 2-d (section) and 3-d capture the experimentally observed finite-width shear bands and the formation of low-angle subgrain boundaries even in the absence of heat conduction in the model, as well as size-dependent strengthening for grain sizes from 1 to 20 $μ$m. The 2-d and large-scale 3-d simulations, the latter involving 1 million finite elements, provide access to the progressive evolution of material strength, stress state, and temperature in the course of large deformations. GND distributions accumulate at grain boundaries and form patterned structures within grain interiors, offering insight into the microstructural changes that precede failure in adiabatic shear bands. Mesh-converged, delocalized and localized plastic flow to very large deformations without softening is observed for a significant range of parameters, reflecting a competition between GND hardening and thermal softening in setting the non-softening steady state in the absence of other ductile damage mechanisms in the model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（兼有实验验证）。关键词：model、simulations、experiments。；研究对象：介观尺度多晶集合体在绝热条件下的动态剪切带行为，以及位错图案形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无热传导模型中，仍能捕捉到实验观察到的有限宽度剪切带和低角度亚晶界形成；位错分布（几何必需位错）在晶界累积并在晶粒内部形成图案结构，反映了GND硬化与热软化之间的竞争决定了非软化稳态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无热传导模型中，仍能捕捉到实验观察到的有限宽度剪切带和低角度亚晶界形成；位错分布（几何必需位错）在晶界累积并在晶粒内部形成图案结构，反映了GND硬化与热软化之间的竞争决定了非软化稳态。；创新点：在无热传导的模型中成功再现了有限宽度剪切带和亚晶界形成，并揭示了GND图案化与剪切带前失效微结构变化之间的联系；实现了网格收敛的、无软化的大变形局域与非局域流动。
papers.method_zh: 基于介观位错力学的模型，包含与几何必需位错（GND）密度相关的硬化长度尺度，采用经典晶体塑性模型（各向同性Voce律硬化）。对实验样品确定的统计代表性体积单元进行2D（截面）和3D有限元模拟（最大含100万单元）。

papers.title: A comparative first-principles investigation of bilayer NbOX2 (X=Cl, Br, I) for Photocatalytic water splitting applications
papers.abstract: Motivated by our previous work on bulk NbOX2 , where we have reported its high 1dielectric polarisation and finite piezoelectric response, this work extends to its 2D homo bilayer system to explore its potential for photocatalytic water splitting. Herein, density functional theory (DFT) were employed in probing the structural, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of 2D homo bilayer NbOX2 (X = Cl, Br, and I). Our results show that structurally, NbOCl2 and NbOBr2 prefer AC bilayer stacking,while AB stacking was preferred by NbOI2 . All the considered bilayers are dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable. From the analysis of electronic structure we have found a decreasing trend in the energy band gap as X goes down the group from Cl to I, with the position of the valence band maximum shifting upward along the high symmetry points. In terms of carrier mobility, all 2D bilayer systems possess high carrier mobility comparable to known 2D materials. It also exhibits an anisotropic carrier transfer property by which charge carriers are separated efficiently. These materials show similar trends to BiOI and PtSe2 , in which photocatalytic efficiency was increased by forming the multiple layers. The materials under investigation are suitable for photocatalytic water splitting under visible and ultraviolet regions with absorption coefficients of 105 cm-1.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory (DFT)”（密度泛函理论）、“first-principles investigation”（第一性原理研究）。；研究对象：二维同质双层NbOX₂（X = Cl, Br, I）体系，用于光催化水分解。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NbOCl₂和NbOBr₂倾向于AC双层堆叠，而NbOI₂倾向于AB堆叠；所有双层体系均具有高载流子迁移率和各向异性电荷传输特性，在可见光和紫外光区域吸收系数达10⁵ cm⁻¹，适合光催化水分解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NbOCl₂和NbOBr₂倾向于AC双层堆叠，而NbOI₂倾向于AB堆叠；所有双层体系均具有高载流子迁移率和各向异性电荷传输特性，在可见光和紫外光区域吸收系数达10⁵ cm⁻¹，适合光催化水分解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于探测结构、电子、光学和光催化性质。

papers.title: Exact solution and pair correlation functions for a generalized three-chain Ising tube with multispin interactions
papers.abstract: We obtain an exact solution for a generalized three-chain Ising tube (TCGIT) of length $L$ with toroidal boundary conditions and the most general $C_3$-invariant Hamiltonian on an elementary prism, containing 20 independent coupling constants, including an external magnetic field. Using an $8\times 8$ transfer matrix, we derive the exact partition function of the finite system and obtain the free energy, internal energy, specific heat, magnetization, magnetic susceptibility, and entropy in the thermodynamic limit $L\to\infty$. In the general case, $λ_{\max}$ is determined by a quartic equation, whereas in the principal special case with even-spin interactions (PSC) the spectrum simplifies substantially: the characteristic polynomial factorizes, and $λ_{\max}$ is given by the root of a quadratic equation. For mirror-symmetric subfamilies, we derive explicit formulas for the pair correlation functions and express the magnetization in terms of the components of the eigenvector associated with $λ_{\max}$; in the even-spin case with $h=0$, the magnetization vanishes. Important special cases include the width-three planar model with nearest-neighbor, next-nearest-neighbor, and plaquette interactions, including the entropy limit $S(T\to0^+)=(\ln 2)/3$ for $k\ge 0$ and $S(T\to0^+)=0$ for $k<0$, as well as the width-three planar triangular model with distinct nearest-neighbor couplings, three-spin interactions involving neighboring triangles, and an external field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：exact solution（精确解）、transfer matrix（转移矩阵）、partition function（配分函数）。；研究对象：广义三链伊辛管（TCGIT），即具有三链结构、环面边界条件、包含多自旋相互作用的伊辛模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在热力学极限下可精确求解，自由能等热力学量由四次方程或二次方程（特殊情形）的最大特征根决定；在镜面对称子族中，可导出配对关联函数的显式公式，且磁化强度可由最大特征根对应的本征向量分量表达。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在热力学极限下可精确求解，自由能等热力学量由四次方程或二次方程（特殊情形）的最大特征根决定；在镜面对称子族中，可导出配对关联函数的显式公式，且磁化强度可由最大特征根对应的本征向量分量表达。；创新点：该工作将三链伊辛管推广到最一般的C₃不变哈密顿量（包含20个独立耦合常数和外磁场），并给出了精确解；在偶自旋相互作用特殊情形下，特征多项式可因式分解，使求解简化为二次方程。摘要未突出说明与已有精确解模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用8×8转移矩阵方法，推导有限系统的精确配分函数，并在热力学极限下得到自由能、内能、比热、磁化强度、磁化率和熵。对于镜面对称子族，进一步推导了配对关联函数的显式表达式。

papers.title: Topological Data Analysis combined with Machine Learning for Predicting Permeability of Porous Media
papers.abstract: Flow in porous media is difficult to address using standard analytical or numerical methods due to its complexity. However, since synthetic representations of porous media are easy to produce and data from physical experiments are becoming more widely available, the problem is well-suited to studies that include machine learning (ML) techniques. We discuss a number of features that can be extracted from such data, and their utility as input variables into a standard ML algorithm. These features include structural measures describing the geometry of the porous media, topological measures describing the connectivity, and network measures obtained by modeling the porous media as simplified pore networks. These features enable the prediction of the permeability of the considered (synthetic) porous materials using ML techniques that also leverage the separately computed exact permeability (ground truth). Comparing results obtained using different input variables helps develop a better understanding of the utility of various measures for predicting permeability based on the porous media structure. We show, in particular, that topological data analysis (TDA) provides a useful set of features that can be easily combined with ML to yield meaningful results.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning (ML)、topological data analysis (TDA)、numerical methods、synthetic representations。；研究对象：多孔介质中的渗透率（permeability）预测问题，具体为合成多孔材料（synthetic porous materials）的流体输运性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）能够提供一组有效的特征，与机器学习（ML）结合后可以准确预测多孔介质的渗透率，且优于仅使用几何或网络特征的方法。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拓扑数据分析（TDA）能够提供一组有效的特征，与机器学习（ML）结合后可以准确预测多孔介质的渗透率，且优于仅使用几何或网络特征的方法。；创新点：系统比较了不同特征（几何、拓扑、网络）对渗透率预测的贡献，并特别展示了拓扑数据分析（TDA）作为一种易于与机器学习结合的特征提取工具，在预测多孔介质渗透率方面的实用价值。
papers.method_zh: 从多孔介质数据中提取三类特征：描述几何结构的结构度量、描述连通性的拓扑度量（来自TDA）、以及将多孔介质简化为孔隙网络后得到的网络度量。将这些特征作为输入变量，输入标准机器学习算法，并以单独计算得到的精确渗透率作为真实值（ground truth）进行训练和比较。

papers.title: Getting rid of the ghosts: a toy-model of membrane melting
papers.abstract: The theory of thermal fluctuations in crystalline membranes is put under scrutiny. In particular, the two critical regimes of the renormalisation group diagram, which are often left out of the discussion because of their instability in one direction, are examined in details. After studying the proper Goldstone mode counting around each of them, the properties of the fluctuations dominating the large scale spectrum are analysed. This shows that the fixed point P2 is a good candidate to describe the melting of a crystalline membrane. The properties of the melted membrane are then compared to the known properties of fluid membranes. As a byproduct of this analysis, we show that the generation of a fluid membrane by melting a bidimensional crystal allows to formulate its correlation functions without being plagued by the ghosts that inevitably show up in the usual Canham-Helfrich action relying on the Monge parametrisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theory of thermal fluctuations、renormalisation group、Goldstone mode counting、fixed point analysis。；研究对象：晶体膜的热涨落理论，特别是膜熔化（melting）过程中的临界行为，以及熔化后形成的流体膜与经典Canham-Helfrich理论中流体膜的比较。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 重正化群图中的固定点P2是描述晶体膜熔化的良好候选；通过熔化二维晶体生成流体膜，可以避免在通常基于Monge参数化的Canham-Helfrich作用量中出现的“鬼模”（ghosts）问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：重正化群图中的固定点P2是描述晶体膜熔化的良好候选；通过熔化二维晶体生成流体膜，可以避免在通常基于Monge参数化的Canham-Helfrich作用量中出现的“鬼模”（ghosts）问题。；创新点：详细研究了重正化群图中通常因单向不稳定性而被忽略的两个临界区域，并指出通过晶体膜熔化途径构造流体膜可以规避标准Canham-Helfrich理论中固有的鬼模问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，包括：重正化群（renormalisation group）固定点分析、Goldstone模式计数、大尺度涨落谱分析，以及将熔化膜的性质与已知流体膜性质进行对比。

papers.title: Microstructure evolution during rapid solidification of hypoeutectic Al-Ag alloys near absolute stability
papers.abstract: Microsegregation-free microstructures can form by solidifying at velocities beyond the absolute stability limit ($V_{\text{abs}}$), where solute partitioning is suppressed by a stable, planar solid-liquid interface. Producing such microstructures is of considerable practical interest; however, $V_{\text{abs}}$ typically exceeds the ${\sim}1$ m/s growth rates encountered in additive manufacturing (AM). Here we demonstrate the absolute stability limit can be reached in sufficiently concentrated hypoeutectic Al-Ag alloys at growth rates well below the 1~m/s typically encountered in additive manufacturing. Dynamic Transmission Electron Microscopy (DTEM) of rapid solidification front evolution -- following laser spot melting of Al-Ag thin films -- combined with postmortem microstructural characterization, enables detailed quantitative comparison with both phase-field (PF) simulations and a sharp-interface linear stability analysis that uses a non-equilibrium, velocity-dependent phase diagram extracted from the PF model. The analysis predicts that $V_{\text{abs}}$ follows a trend similar to that of the miscibility gap, first increasing and then decreasing with Ag concentration. Predicted values of $V_{\text{abs}}$ are in good quantitative agreement with PF simulations over the entire hypoeutectic concentration range and with experiments for three concentrated alloys. These results inform the prediction and control of microstructural development in concentrated alloys near the absolute stability limit under AM conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：关键词包括“Dynamic Transmission Electron Microscopy (DTEM)”（实验手段）、“phase-field (PF) simulations”（计算模拟）、“sharp-interface linear stability analysis”（理论分析）。；研究对象：亚共晶Al-Ag合金在接近绝对稳定性极限条件下的快速凝固过程中的微观结构演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在足够浓度的亚共晶Al-Ag合金中，绝对稳定性极限可以在远低于增材制造典型生长速率（~1 m/s）的条件下达到，且绝对稳定性速度随Ag浓度先增加后减小，与混溶间隙趋势相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在足够浓度的亚共晶Al-Ag合金中，绝对稳定性极限可以在远低于增材制造典型生长速率（~1 m/s）的条件下达到，且绝对稳定性速度随Ag浓度先增加后减小，与混溶间隙趋势相似。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态透射电子显微镜（DTEM）实时观察激光点熔化Al-Ag薄膜后的快速凝固前沿演化，结合凝固后微观结构表征；同时进行相场（PF）模拟，并利用从PF模型提取的非平衡、速度依赖相图进行尖锐界面线性稳定性分析。

papers.title: Anomalous thermal and elastic properties of an epitaxial NiTi film exhibiting R-phase
papers.abstract: Shape memory alloys like NiTi are at the core of emerging thermal management applications, including elastocaloric refrigeration, thermoelastic harvesting, and latent heat storage. Most of these applications benefit from a small scale due to the accelerated heat exchange, but obtaining precise functional properties of films is challenging. Here we demonstrate that transient grating spectroscopy (TGS) enables characterization of elastic coefficients and thermal diffusivity of a 3 $μ$m thick epitaxial NiTi film during a thermally induced phase transformation. The in-situ measurement of a complete austenite$\rightarrow$R-phase$\rightarrow$martensite$\rightarrow$austenite temperature cycle reveals that the elastic properties exhibit a crossover of the shear moduli (from $c^\prime < c_{44}$ in austenite to $c^\prime > c_{44}$ in martensite) and that the thermal diffusivity changes by 450 $\%$ between the R-phase and austenite. This dramatic change, together with the absence of hysteresis between the R-phase and austenite, makes NiTi a promising material candidate for thermal switches. The results indicate that the change in thermal diffusivity originates from an anomalous heat capacity of the R-phase. Furthermore, our TGS study provides temperature-dependent thermal and elastic properties required for simulating thermal management microsystems using this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：transient grating spectroscopy (TGS)、in-situ measurement、characterization。；研究对象：外延生长的3微米厚NiTi形状记忆合金薄膜，及其在热致相变（奥氏体→R相→马氏体→奥氏体）过程中的热学和弹性性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相变过程中，弹性性质出现剪切模量交叉（从奥氏体的c′ < c44变为马氏体的c′ > c44）；热扩散率在R相与奥氏体之间变化高达450%，且该变化无滞后，使NiTi成为热开关的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相变过程中，弹性性质出现剪切模量交叉（从奥氏体的c′ < c44变为马氏体的c′ > c44）；热扩散率在R相与奥氏体之间变化高达450%，且该变化无滞后，使NiTi成为热开关的候选材料。；创新点：首次利用TGS在完整温度循环中同时表征NiTi薄膜的弹性与热学性质，并发现R相与奥氏体之间热扩散率的巨大无滞后变化，指出该异常变化源于R相的异常热容。
papers.method_zh: 瞬态光栅光谱（TGS）技术，用于原位测量薄膜的弹性系数和热扩散率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Structure of the twist-bend nematic phase with respect to the orientational molecular order of the thioether-linked dimers
papers.abstract: An analysis of the IR absorbance for the segmented functional groups of liquid crystal dimers: mesogen and linker, enabled the orientation order to be determined and information about the dipole interactions in the nematic and twist-bend nematic phases to be obtained. The long axis orientational order increases as the temperature decreases in the nematic phase, although much more slowly than for the classical nematics, and then reverses this trend in the twist-bend nematic phase due to the tilt of the molecules. In the nematic phase, the short axis of the molecule performs an isotropic uniform rotation and has a uniaxial alignment. In the twist-bend nematic phase, however, biaxial ordering occurs and grows significantly in accordance with the helical deformation of the director. Changes in the mean absorbance in the twist-bend nematic phase were observed: a decrease for the longitudinal dipole at the nematic-twist-bend nematic phase transition, thus emphasizing the antiparallel axial interaction of the dipoles, while the absorbance of the transverse dipoles remains unchanged up to 340 K, and then the latter become parallelly correlated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“IR absorbance”（红外吸收光谱）、“analysis”、“determined”、“observed”。；研究对象：硫醚连接的二聚体液晶分子（thioether-linked dimers）在扭曲-弯曲向列相（twist-bend nematic phase）中的取向分子有序性，具体涉及介晶基团和连接基团的取向行为及偶极相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭曲-弯曲向列相中，分子长轴取向序随温度降低而反转（先增后减），分子短轴出现显著的双轴有序性，且纵向偶极子在相变点处呈现反平行轴向相互作用，而横向偶极子在高温下转为平行关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭曲-弯曲向列相中，分子长轴取向序随温度降低而反转（先增后减），分子短轴出现显著的双轴有序性，且纵向偶极子在相变点处呈现反平行轴向相互作用，而横向偶极子在高温下转为平行关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 红外吸收光谱（IR absorbance）分析，通过分段功能基团（介晶基团和连接基团）的吸光度测量，确定取向序参数并获取偶极相互作用信息。

papers.title: Enhanced $s^\pm$-wave superconductivity in electron-doped La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
papers.abstract: In cuprates, electron doping yields a much lower superconducting $T_c$ than hole doping. For recently discovered nickelate superconductors, the analogous doping strategies become more challenging. Consequently, while hole-doped Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates have been extensively studied, electron-doped RP nickelates remain rarely explored both experimentally and theoretically. Here we fill this gap by systematically investigating the two-orbital bilayer model for three representative systems: bulk La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ at ambient pressure and 15\,GPa, and a heterostructure La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$:La$_3$Al$_2$O$_7$ that provides a feasible experimental route to electron doping. Using first-principle calculations and large-scale dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we find that electron doping generically enhances $s^\pm$-wave pairing superconductivity (SC) in all three cases, with the heterostructure showing the highest $T_c$ in the underdoped regime. Furthermore, our results suggest an inter-orbital cooperative mechanism that the pairing on the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ orbital, induced by that on the $d_{z^2}$ orbital, plays vital role in the SC. This work provides the first theoretical prediction of enhanced SC in electron-doped RP nickelates and calls for future experimental verification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：first-principle calculations, large-scale dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：电子掺杂的Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）型镍酸盐超导体La₃Ni₂O₇，包括常压、15 GPa下的块体以及La₃Ni₂O₇:La₃Al₂O₇异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子掺杂普遍增强了La₃Ni₂O₇的s±波配对超导电性，其中异质结构在欠掺杂区域具有最高的超导转变温度（Tc）。该超导增强源于d_z²轨道诱导的d_x²-y²轨道上的配对协同机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子掺杂普遍增强了La₃Ni₂O₇的s±波配对超导电性，其中异质结构在欠掺杂区域具有最高的超导转变温度（Tc）。该超导增强源于d_z²轨道诱导的d_x²-y²轨道上的配对协同机制。；创新点：首次从理论上预测了电子掺杂RP型镍酸盐中超导电性的增强，填补了该体系在电子掺杂方向实验与理论研究的空白，并提出了可行的异质结构实验实现路径。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT）结合大规模动力学团簇量子蒙特卡洛模拟（dynamical cluster quantum Monte Carlo）。

papers.title: Partial Kondo Screening Solves the Mystery of Rare Earth Tetraborides
papers.abstract: We invoke a new mechanism to account for multiple magnetization plateaus observed in rare-earth tetraborides. Using a combination of hybrid and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations of the Kondo lattice model (KLM) on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice (SSL), we find robust magnetization plateaus at fractions 1/6, 2/9, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3 and 3/4 of the saturation magnetization. We find that most of the plateau states are partially Kondo screened and emerge from the field-tuning of a complex three-way competition between the kinetic energy, the Kondo coupling, and the magnetic frustration. Most remarkably, the unusual magneto-transport reported in ErB$_4$ and TmB$_4$ admits an unexpectedly simple explanation within our mechanism. This work not only provides an elegant and simple solution to the long-standing puzzle of metamagnetism and anomalous magnetotransport in RB$_4$, but also introduces a novel mechanism to predict and discover new correlated phases in frustrated Kondo lattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations of the Kondo lattice model (KLM)”，属于数值模拟与理论建模。；研究对象：稀土四硼化物（rare-earth tetraborides，如 ErB₄ 和 TmB₄）中的多磁化平台（magnetization plateaus）现象，以及相关的变磁性与反常磁输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的 Kondo 晶格模型中，通过磁场调控动能、Kondo 耦合与磁阻挫之间的三方竞争，可以产生多个分数磁化平台（如 1/6、2/9、1/4、1/3、1/2、2/3、3/4），且大部分平台态处于部分 Kondo 屏蔽（partial Kondo screening）状态。该机制能简洁解释 ErB₄ 和 TmB₄ 中观测到的反常磁输运现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上的 Kondo 晶格模型中，通过磁场调控动能、Kondo 耦合与磁阻挫之间的三方竞争，可以产生多个分数磁化平台（如 1/6、2/9、1/4、1/3、1/2、2/3、3/4），且大部分平台态处于部分 Kondo 屏蔽（partial Kondo screening）状态。该机制能简洁解释 ErB₄ 和 TmB₄ 中观测到的反常磁输运现象。；创新点：首次提出“部分 Kondo 屏蔽”作为稀土四硼化物中多磁化平台和反常磁输运的统一机制，为长期悬而未决的变磁性谜题提供了简洁的物理解释，并引入了一种预测阻挫 Kondo 晶格中新型关联相的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用混合蒙特卡洛（hybrid Monte Carlo）和半经典蒙特卡洛（semiclassical Monte Carlo）模拟，在 Shastry-Sutherland 晶格上求解 Kondo 晶格模型（KLM）。

papers.title: Geometry-Driven Nonlinear Orbital Magnetoelectric Effect
papers.abstract: We propose a nonlinear orbital magnetoelectric effect, which generates orbital magnetization quadratically in centrosymmetric materials where the linear orbital magnetoelectric effect is strictly forbidden. Using extended semiclassical formulation, we derive a gauge-invariant microscopic theory that separates intrinsic and extrinsic contributions and establishes their distinct dependence on the relaxation time, providing an experimental discriminator. In two-dimensional systems the nonlinear response is far less constrained by out-of-plane rotational symmetries than the linear orbital magnetoelectric effect, substantially enlarging the materials platform. Microscopically, the dominant contributions are governed by a Hermitian-connection structure. Finally, we estimate that the magnitude of the nonlinear orbital magnetoelectric effect lies within the sensitivity of state-of-the-art magneto-optical Kerr measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“提出”“推导”“建立”“估计”等理论工作常用动词，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：中心对称材料中的非线性轨道磁电效应。具体现象为：在禁止线性轨道磁电效应的中心对称材料中，轨道磁化强度随电场二次方增长。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称材料中，非线性轨道磁电效应可以产生轨道磁化强度的二次响应，且其微观主导贡献由一种厄米联络结构控制。该效应的量级处于当前最先进磁光克尔测量的灵敏度范围内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称材料中，非线性轨道磁电效应可以产生轨道磁化强度的二次响应，且其微观主导贡献由一种厄米联络结构控制。该效应的量级处于当前最先进磁光克尔测量的灵敏度范围内。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断：首次提出并系统建立了中心对称材料中非线性轨道磁电效应的微观理论，揭示了其与线性效应在对称性约束和材料平台广度上的本质差异。
papers.method_zh: 扩展半经典公式（extended semiclassical formulation）。通过该理论框架推导出规范不变的微观理论，将本征贡献与外禀贡献分离，并建立它们对弛豫时间的不同依赖关系。

papers.title: Specific heat and susceptibility of S=1/2 antiferromagnets on square, triangular, and kagome lattices
papers.abstract: We study the temperature dependence of the thermodynamic properties of spin-1/2 antiferromagnets on two-dimensional lattices. Our analysis employs the sine-square deformation (SSD), in which a real-space envelope function is applied to the Hamiltonian so that the local energy scale is smoothly reduced to zero at the system boundaries. The quantum eigenstates of the SSD Hamiltonian exhibit bulk-like behavior near the system center, effectively mimicking the thermodynamic limit even in small finite-size calculations. Using these fictitious bulk states, we compute the energy density, specific heat, and magnetic susceptibility as functions of temperature. We find that both the triangular- and kagome-lattice antiferromagnets show either a shoulder or a pronounced double-peak structure in the low-temperature specific heat, whereas the kagome case particularly shows a strong enhancement of magnetic susceptibility down to the lowest temperature range. These direct comparisons, together with the square-lattice and one-dimensional cases, reveal that although both frustrated systems retain a substantial amount of entropy, the low-energy excitations below ~ 0.5J of the kagome lattice are predominantly governed by the magnetic excited states, whereas not much for the triangular lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：sine-square deformation (SSD)、quantum eigenstates、finite-size calculations。；研究对象：自旋1/2反铁磁体在二维晶格（正方、三角、kagome晶格）上的热力学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角晶格和kagome晶格反铁磁体在低温比热中均表现出肩峰或明显的双峰结构；其中kagome晶格在极低温下磁化率显著增强，表明其低能激发主要由磁性激发态主导，而三角晶格则不然。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角晶格和kagome晶格反铁磁体在低温比热中均表现出肩峰或明显的双峰结构；其中kagome晶格在极低温下磁化率显著增强，表明其低能激发主要由磁性激发态主导，而三角晶格则不然。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用正弦平方变形（SSD）方法，对哈密顿量施加实空间包络函数，使局域能量尺度在边界处平滑降为零。利用SSD哈密顿量的量子本征态模拟热力学极限下的体态行为，计算能量密度、比热和磁化率随温度的变化。

papers.title: Enhancement of superconductivity by polarization of magnetic impurities in disordered films
papers.abstract: Dirty superconducting films with magnetic impurities can exhibit nontrivial behavior in a magnetic field that polarizes the impurity spins. As predicted by Kharitonov and Feigelman (KF) [JETP Lett. 82, 421 (2005)], this polarization reduces the exchange scattering rate. Consequently, a parallel magnetic field can enhance the critical temperature $T_c$ when magnetic-field pair breaking is weak, as realized for strong spin-orbit scattering and small film thickness. Recently, Llanos et al. [Nat. Phys. (2026)] observed a pronounced enhancement of $T_c$ consistent with the KF theory. The same experiment also reported an enhancement of the perpendicular upper critical field $H_{c2}^{\perp}$ and a suppression of the London penetration depth $λ_L$ by a parallel magnetic field. These quantities were not considered in the original KF theory. To address this gap, we develop a theoretical framework based on Gor'kov's diagrammatic technique for dirty superconductors. We extend the KF theory in two experimentally relevant directions: (i) to arbitrary temperatures $T<T_c$ and several superconducting observables, and (ii) to arbitrary magnetic-field orientations. As a result, we demonstrate theoretically the suppression of $λ_L$ and the enhancement of $H_{c2}^{\perp}$ by a parallel magnetic field, in agreement with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a theoretical framework based on Gor'kov's diagrammatic technique”，并扩展了已有理论（KF理论），未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：含磁杂质的无序超导薄膜，具体研究平行磁场对超导临界温度 \(T_c\)、垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\) 和伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 平行磁场通过极化磁杂质自旋，可抑制伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 并增强垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\)，与近期实验观测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：平行磁场通过极化磁杂质自旋，可抑制伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 并增强垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\)，与近期实验观测一致。；创新点：将原有仅关注临界温度 \(T_c\) 的KF理论，推广至对伦敦穿透深度 \(\lambda_L\) 和垂直上临界场 \(H_{c2}^{\perp}\) 的理论描述，并考虑了任意磁场取向，填补了原理论在这些可观测量上的空白。
papers.method_zh: 基于Gor'kov图解法（diagrammatic technique）处理脏超导体，扩展了Kharitonov和Feigelman（KF）理论，使其适用于任意温度 \(T<T_c\)、多种超导可观测量以及任意磁场方向。

papers.title: Durable Enhancement of $\mathbf{MoS_2}$ Single-Layer Photoluminescence by Ultraviolet Laser Treatment Under Ambient Conditions
papers.abstract: Single-layer molybdenum disulfide ($MoS_2$) possesses significant potential for nanoscale optoelectronics, but achieving high-intensity, long-term-stable photoluminescence (PL) emission remains a challenge. In this work, we demonstrate a remarkably robust, more than 8-fold maximum enhancement in the PL intensity of exfoliated and CVD-grown single-layer $MoS_2$ via a non-destructive ultraviolet (UV) laser treatment method. This substantial increase in radiative efficiency is accompanied by a trion-to-neutral exciton transition in the PL signal and a corresponding blue shift of the Raman $E_{2g}^1$ and $A_{1g}$ vibrational modes, signaling successful electron depletion (p-doping) and formation of Mo-O bonds, respectively. Furthermore, we demonstrate precise spatial control over PL properties by confining PL treatment exclusively to the UV laser-treated area. Crucially, the enhanced PL performance shows exceptional longevity; the CVD sample and the exfoliated sample remained stable for the entire monitoring period (72 and 32 days, respectively) under ambient conditions. We further investigated UV laser treatment in a controlled-environment chamber under argon, nitrogen, and oxygen atmospheres, distinguishing the influence of oxygen as the PL treatment agent. These findings establish a reliable pathway for the permanent treatment of single-layer $MoS_2$ PL properties, an essential step toward practical, high-performance nanophotonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（UV laser treatment）、样品制备（exfoliated and CVD-grown）、表征手段（PL信号、Raman光谱）及环境控制实验（controlled-environment chamber）。；研究对象：单层二硫化钼（MoS₂）的光致发光（PL）特性，具体为通过紫外激光处理实现PL增强及稳定性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在环境条件下，通过非破坏性紫外激光处理，可将单层MoS₂的PL强度提升超过8倍，且增强效果在CVD样品和剥离样品中分别稳定保持至少72天和32天。PL增强源于电子耗尽（p型掺杂）和Mo-O键形成，并伴随激子从带电激子（trion）向中性激子转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在环境条件下，通过非破坏性紫外激光处理，可将单层MoS₂的PL强度提升超过8倍，且增强效果在CVD样品和剥离样品中分别稳定保持至少72天和32天。PL增强源于电子耗尽（p型掺杂）和Mo-O键形成，并伴随激子从带电激子（trion）向中性激子转变。；创新点：首次在环境条件下实现单层MoS₂ PL性能的持久增强（超过8倍），并证明该增强在环境空气中可稳定数月；同时实现了对PL特性的空间精确控制（仅限紫外激光处理区域）。摘要未突出说明与已有紫外处理方法的区别。
papers.method_zh: 使用紫外激光处理（UV laser treatment）对机械剥离和CVD生长的单层MoS₂进行非破坏性处理；通过光致发光（PL）光谱和拉曼（Raman）光谱（E₂g¹和A₁g模）表征电子结构和化学键变化；在可控气氛（氩气、氮气、氧气）下进行对比实验以区分氧气的作用。

papers.title: Global space correlations of polarization, charge density, and electric field in electrolytes under the fixed-potential condition
papers.abstract: We examine the thermal fluctuations of the polarization $p$, the charge density $ρ$, and the electric field $E$ in dilute electrolytes inserted between pararell metallic electrodes, where we fix the applied potential difference $Φ_a$ between the two electrodes. If the film thickness $H$ is shorter than the Debye screening length $κ^{-1}$, the space correlation of the polarization $p_z$ and the electric field $E_z$ along the surface normal (in the $z$ direction) acuire global components inversely proportional to the film volume $V$, which vary slowly along the $z$ axis and are homogeneous in the $xy$ plane. The areal charge density on each electrode surface also has a component homogeneous on the surface, which produces the global electric fluctuations. On the other hand, if $H$ much exceeds $κ^{-1}$, the global correlations of $p_z$ and $ρ$ become small in the bulk region outside the electric double layers, but that of $E_z$ remains almost unchanged by ions in the whole cell at fixed $Φ_a$. The dielectric constant $ε_{\rm eff}$ depends on $H$ and $κ$ and is expressed in terms of the fluctuation variances of $p_z$ and $ρ$ and that of the noblocal surface charge density at fixed $Φ_a$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“We examine”“is expressed in terms of”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：稀释电解质在平行金属电极之间的热涨落行为，具体研究极化、电荷密度和电场在固定电势差条件下的空间关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当电解质膜厚度小于德拜屏蔽长度时，极化与电场沿法向的空间关联出现与膜体积成反比的全局分量；当膜厚度远大于德拜屏蔽长度时，极化与电荷密度的全局关联在双电层外体相区域变小，但电场的全局关联几乎不受离子影响。有效介电常数依赖于膜厚度和德拜长度，可由涨落方差表达。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当电解质膜厚度小于德拜屏蔽长度时，极化与电场沿法向的空间关联出现与膜体积成反比的全局分量；当膜厚度远大于德拜屏蔽长度时，极化与电荷密度的全局关联在双电层外体相区域变小，但电场的全局关联几乎不受离子影响。有效介电常数依赖于膜厚度和德拜长度，可由涨落方差表达。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于固定电势差边界条件，推导极化、电荷密度、电场及电极表面电荷密度的热涨落空间关联函数，并分析其与膜厚度、德拜屏蔽长度的依赖关系。

papers.title: At Most Two Infinite Blue Clusters in the CMR Representation of the Edwards-Anderson Spin Glass
papers.abstract: The two-replica Chayes-Machta-Redner (CMR) representation is one of the main proposed geometric signatures of spin-glass order in the short-range Edwards-Anderson model. Mean-field arguments and recent numerics suggest that the low-temperature phase should exhibit two macroscopic blue clusters carrying opposite overlap signs. We prove a rigorous structural constraint in this direction. For any translation-invariant joint Gibbs measure on disorder, two spin replicas, and CMR bond variables on Z^d, the blue subgraph contains at most two infinite connected components; if two exist, then they lie in a common infinite grey cluster and belong to opposite overlap-parity classes. The main obstacle is that the blue-bond process is neither insertion-tolerant nor positively associated, so the usual Burton-Keane and random-cluster arguments do not apply. We circumvent this by working in the full joint measure and using a finite-box merge operation together with the mass-transport bound on ends of translation-invariant subgraphs. As auxiliary input, we establish finite energy and a percolation transition for the grey subgraph via Bayesian resampling of couplings and a parity-based Peierls estimate. These results do not prove the existence of infinite blue clusters or a spin-glass phase transition, but they give a rigorous upper bound compatible with the two-cluster picture for short-range spin glasses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“prove a rigorous structural constraint”“mass-transport bound”“Peierls estimate”等数学物理证明方法，属于严格理论分析。；研究对象：短程Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃模型中的Chayes-Machta-Redner（CMR）表示，具体研究该表示中“蓝色团簇”（blue clusters）的无限连通分量数量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在任意平移不变的联合Gibbs测度下，蓝色子图最多包含两个无限连通分量；若存在两个，则它们位于同一个无限灰色团簇中且属于相反的overlap奇偶类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在任意平移不变的联合Gibbs测度下，蓝色子图最多包含两个无限连通分量；若存在两个，则它们位于同一个无限灰色团簇中且属于相反的overlap奇偶类。；创新点：克服了蓝色键过程既非插入容忍也非正关联的困难（因此标准Burton-Keane和随机团簇论证不适用），通过联合测度与质量输运方法给出了与两团簇图像相容的严格上界。摘要未突出说明该结果是否首次严格证明该上界。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格数学物理证明方法：利用联合测度框架、有限盒子合并操作、平移不变子图端点的质量输运界；辅助使用贝叶斯重采样耦合和基于奇偶性的Peierls估计来建立灰色子图的有限能量性质和渗流转变。

papers.title: Observation of a Mott quantum spin Hall insulator in twisted WSe2
papers.abstract: Quantum spin Hall (QSH) insulators and Mott insulators are conventionally regarded as distinct insulating phases, arising from band topology and strong Coulomb interactions, respectively. Here, we report the observation of QSH edge transport in a magnetic-field-stabilized Mott insulating state at half filling of the second moire band in a 2.29 degree twisted WSe2 device. This state exhibits a resistance plateau identical to that of the single-particle QSH state at full filling of the first moire valence band, indicating the same number of helical edge channels. Electrical transport measurements reveal nearly quantized resistance that is insensitive to vertical electric field, out-of-plane magnetic field, and temperature below 5 K. Pronounced nonlocal transport and strong negative in-plane magnetoconductance further support helical edge conduction, establishing robust edge transport in the strongly correlated regime. Temperature-dependent Hall measurements reveal a characteristic temperature scale of approximately 10 K, corresponding to an energy scale of about 1 meV. Our results demonstrate that spin-conserved QSH edge states can persist in a half filled, strongly correlated insulating phase and under external magnetic field, opening a route toward interaction-resilient topological transport in moire quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“report the observation”、“Electrical transport measurements”、“Temperature-dependent Hall measurements”等实验关键词。；研究对象：2.29度扭转双层二硒化钨（twisted WSe2）器件中第二莫尔能带半填充时，由磁场稳定的Mott绝缘态中的量子自旋霍尔（QSH）边缘输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强关联的Mott绝缘态中观测到了与单粒子QSH态相同的边缘输运行为，证明自旋守恒的QSH边缘态可以在半填充的强关联绝缘相及外加磁场下稳定存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强关联的Mott绝缘态中观测到了与单粒子QSH态相同的边缘输运行为，证明自旋守恒的QSH边缘态可以在半填充的强关联绝缘相及外加磁场下稳定存在。；创新点：首次在莫尔量子材料中，于强关联Mott绝缘态（而非传统单粒子能带绝缘态）中观测到量子自旋霍尔边缘输运，揭示了拓扑边缘态在强关联体系中的鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 电输运测量（电阻平台、非局域输运、面内负磁电导）、温度依赖的霍尔测量、垂直电场与面外磁场调控实验。

papers.title: Causal Anomaly Detection for Lithium-Ion Battery Degradation
papers.abstract: Reliable early detection of lithium-ion battery degradation requires health indicators that are physically interpretable and computable from routine cycler telemetry without access to the degradation region. We introduce \textsc{CausalHealth}, a framework that applies causal graph discovery and $k$-nearest-neighbour transfer entropy to per-cycle voltage, current, temperature, and resistance time series, and organises twelve resulting anomaly scores into three signal-class bundles (Magnitude-shift, Predictive-residual, Complexity-entropy) -- with Isolation Forest reported separately as it falls below the bundle reliability threshold -- to characterise detection sensitivity across ten commissioning fractions (5--30\,\%). The Magnitude-shift class achieves 100\,\% detection across all seven tested cells spanning LFP (MIT--Stanford MATR) and LCO (NASA PCoE, CALCE CS2) chemistries, with a lead time of up to 402 cycles before conventional capacity-threshold failure on gradual-fade cells. A Reliability-Weighted Master Health Index (RWMHI) -- a cross-bundle fusion of five high-reliability detectors weighted by inverse coefficient of variation -- improves lead time by 15--52 cycles over the class median on long-lived cells while maintaining 100\,\% detection. Validation against electrochemical impedance spectroscopy on an NMC prismatic cell provides independent physical grounding: transfer entropy $\mathrm{TE}(R \!\to\! V)$ correlates with charge-transfer resistance $R_{\mathrm{ct}}$ (pooled $r = +0.990$; temperature-controlled partial $r = +0.898$), and an Arrhenius analysis of both quantities yields an activation energy consistent with published NMC charge-transfer kinetics. These results are evaluated on seven cells across three benchmark datasets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数据分析）。判断依据：使用了实验电池循环数据（来自MATR、NASA PCoE、CALCE CS2等公开数据集），并应用因果图发现、k近邻传递熵等计算框架进行异常检测分析。；研究对象：锂离子电池退化过程中的早期异常检测。具体涉及LFP（磷酸铁锂）、LCO（钴酸锂）和NMC（镍锰钴三元）三种化学体系的电池。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于因果异常检测框架CausalHealth，利用电压、电流、温度和电阻时间序列构建的“幅度偏移”信号类，可在所有测试电池（LFP和LCO）中实现100%的早期退化检测，领先传统容量阈值失效最多402个循环。传递熵TE(R→V)与电荷转移电阻Rct高度相关（r=+0.990），且两者的Arrhenius活化能与已发表的NMC电荷转移动力学一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于因果异常检测框架CausalHealth，利用电压、电流、温度和电阻时间序列构建的“幅度偏移”信号类，可在所有测试电池（LFP和LCO）中实现100%的早期退化检测，领先传统容量阈值失效最多402个循环。传递熵TE(R→V)与电荷转移电阻Rct高度相关（r=+0.990），且两者的Arrhenius活化能与已发表的NMC电荷转移动力学一致。；创新点：提出了一个无需访问退化区域、仅基于常规循环遥测数据的因果异常检测框架CausalHealth，将12个异常评分组织为三个信号类束（幅度偏移、预测残差、复杂度熵），并通过跨束融合的可靠性加权主健康指数（RWMHI）在长寿命电池上进一步提升了15-52个循环的提前检测时间。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 因果图发现（causal graph discovery）、k近邻传递熵（k-nearest-neighbour transfer entropy）、隔离森林（Isolation Forest）、可靠性加权主健康指数（RWMHI，基于逆变异系数的跨束融合）、电化学阻抗谱（EIS）验证、Arrhenius分析。

papers.title: Frequency renormalization and its effects in nonlinear phononics with $Q_RQ_{IR}^{2}$-type coupling
papers.abstract: A two-phonon system with lowest-order coupling of form $Q_RQ_{IR}^2$ is studied by perturbation method, and analytic results for both phonon displacements and frequencies are obtained. The frequency renormalization of infrared (IR) active mode brings the rectification of Raman mode to saturate at high pump field. For degenerate IR mode with coupling of form $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$, the frequency of IR mode will split when resonantly pumped by elliptically or linearly polarized ultrashort mid-IR pulse, realizing Raman rectification and magnetization simultaneously. Our results reveal a dynamical effect of nonlinear phononics not captured by first-principles calculation, extend the dynamical multiferroicity to systems with coupling $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$, and the method can be readily applied to higher-order couplings. The amplitude saturation under strong pump field stimulates future researches to overcome this nonlinear effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“perturbation method”（微扰方法）、“analytic results”（解析结果）。；研究对象：具有 $Q_RQ_{IR}^2$ 型最低阶耦合的双声子系统，具体包括非简并红外（IR）声子与拉曼（Raman）声子的耦合，以及简并红外声子与拉曼声子的耦合（形式为 $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 红外声子的频率重整化导致拉曼声子的整流效应在高泵浦场下趋于饱和；对于简并红外声子，椭圆或线偏振超短中红外脉冲的共振泵浦会导致红外声子频率分裂，同时实现拉曼整流和磁化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：红外声子的频率重整化导致拉曼声子的整流效应在高泵浦场下趋于饱和；对于简并红外声子，椭圆或线偏振超短中红外脉冲的共振泵浦会导致红外声子频率分裂，同时实现拉曼整流和磁化。；创新点：揭示了第一性原理计算未能捕捉到的非线性声子学的动力学效应；将动力学多铁性（dynamical multiferroicity）推广到具有 $Q_R(Q_{IR,x}^2-Q_{IR,y}^2)$ 型耦合的系统；所采用的方法可推广至更高阶耦合。摘要未明确说明与具体实验或材料的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰方法对双声子系统的运动方程进行解析求解，得到声子位移和频率的解析结果。

papers.title: Disorder effect on the superfluid density and the origin of the pseudogap end point in the cuprate superconductors
papers.abstract: A major puzzle in the study of the cuprate superconductivity is the origin of the pseudogap end point. Intriguingly, such a critical doping is also where the superfluid density of the system reaches its maximum. A non-monotonic doping dependence of the superfluid density is rather unusual since the Drude weight of the cuprate system is found to increase monotonically with the doping concentration. It is generally believed that such a peculiar behavior should be attributed to both the strongly correlated nature of the cuprate system and the disorder effect. In this work, we develop a variational theory for the zero temperature superfluid density of the disordered $t-J$ model. This is achieved in two steps. First, we perform an unrestricted variational optimization of an RVB variational ground state for the disordered $t-J$ model. Second, we construct the variational state that describes the paramagnetic current response on such an RVB state. The zero temperature superfluid density $ρ_{s}(0)$ is then extracted from the curvature of the variational ground state energy of the system as a function of the external electromagnetic field. We find that $ρ_{s}(0)$ computed in this way is remarkably robust against the disorder effect. More specifically, we find that $ρ_{s}(0)$ is a monotonically increasing function of doping concentration $x$ and scales linearly with the total optical weight. This is consistent with the observation in the underdoped cuprates but is strongly at odd with the behavior in the overdoped cuprates. The strong contrast between the disorder effect in the underdoped and the overdoped regime lends strong support to our previous proposal that there exist a Mott transition between a doped-Mott-insulating metal in the underdoped regime and a fermi-liquid-like metal in the overdoped regime around the pseudogap end point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：variational theory（变分理论）、RVB variational ground state（RVB变分基态）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体中的超流密度与赝能隙终点（pseudogap end point）的起源，具体研究无序效应对超流密度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过变分理论计算发现，零温超流密度ρ_s(0)对无序效应具有显著的鲁棒性，随掺杂浓度x单调增加并与总光学权重呈线性关系；欠掺杂区与过掺杂区无序效应的强烈对比支持了赝能隙终点附近存在从掺杂莫特绝缘体金属到费米液体金属的莫特转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过变分理论计算发现，零温超流密度ρ_s(0)对无序效应具有显著的鲁棒性，随掺杂浓度x单调增加并与总光学权重呈线性关系；欠掺杂区与过掺杂区无序效应的强烈对比支持了赝能隙终点附近存在从掺杂莫特绝缘体金属到费米液体金属的莫特转变。；创新点：首次在无序t-J模型框架下，通过变分方法系统计算了零温超流密度对无序的响应，并揭示了欠掺杂与过掺杂区无序效应的显著差异，为赝能隙终点附近的莫特转变假说提供了理论支持。
papers.method_zh: 基于无序t-J模型，分两步构建变分理论：1）对无序t-J模型进行无限制变分优化，得到RVB变分基态；2）构建描述顺磁电流响应的变分态，通过系统基态能量对外部电磁场的曲率提取零温超流密度ρ_s(0)。

papers.title: On-chip detection of anisotropic thermopolarization in quartz
papers.abstract: Temperature gradients are widely used to drive and probe transport phenomena in solids, forming the basis of heat-to-charge conversion processes. In typical experiments, local heating is introduced to generate a temperature gradient, and the resulting electrical response is detected by separate electrodes. Such measurements usually regard heating purely as a source of thermal excitation. Here, we show that heating inherently generates mechanical stress through thermal expansion, which in turn produces measurable electrical signals via electromechanical coupling. Using quartz as a model piezoelectric system, we demonstrate that heat can be converted to electrical currents via thermally generated stress. The on-chip device used in our experiment enables us to probe the anisotropy of the piezoelectric tensor through the thermally generated current, exhibiting twofold and threefold responses for X-cut and Z-cut crystals, respectively. We further show that the response can be detected in both current and voltage modes. These results reveal a thermomechanical pathway for heat-to-charge conversion and establish a general platform for electrically probing thermomechanical responses in insulating materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述了实验装置（on-chip device）和测量模式（current and voltage modes），并展示了具体晶体（X-cut和Z-cut石英）的测量结果。；研究对象：石英（quartz）中的热电各向异性现象，具体研究热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，进而通过压电效应转化为电信号的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，该应力在压电材料（石英）中可产生可测量的电信号，且该信号能反映压电张量的各向异性（X-cut晶体呈现二重响应，Z-cut晶体呈现三重响应）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，该应力在压电材料（石英）中可产生可测量的电信号，且该信号能反映压电张量的各向异性（X-cut晶体呈现二重响应，Z-cut晶体呈现三重响应）。；创新点：传统热电实验将加热仅视为热激发源，而本工作揭示加热通过热膨胀产生机械应力，进而通过压电耦合产生电信号，建立了一种热-力-电转换的新物理路径，并为绝缘材料中热机械响应的电学探测提供了通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 使用片上（on-chip）器件进行实验，通过局部加热产生温度梯度，同时检测热致电流和热致电压信号，利用不同切向（X-cut和Z-cut）的石英晶体探测压电响应的各向异性。

papers.title: Observation of universal thermopolarization effect in insulators
papers.abstract: Heat-to-charge conversion has traditionally been realized via the Seebeck effect in conductors and pyroelectricity in polar insulators. Here, we demonstrate that temperature gradients generate electrical polarization, namely thermopolarization, in a wide range of insulators through a thermomechanical pathway. We identify a mechanism where thermal expansion under a temperature gradient produces strain gradients that induce polarization via the flexoelectric effect. Using a device with an on-chip heater, we detect the heat-induced polarization in crystalline, polymeric, and amorphous systems, including MgO, Al$_2$O$_3$, MnO, mica, PET, PEN, polyimide, and soda-lime glass. The magnitude of the response exhibits a robust scaling with the coefficient of thermal expansion, which is reproduced by finite-element simulations. Furthermore, we identify two routes to enhance the response: reducing the sample thickness and exploiting structural instabilities such as glass and antiferromagnetic phase transitions, where more than an order-of-magnitude enhancement is observed. These results establish a symmetry-independent route for heat-to-charge conversion in insulators and provide a device-compatible platform for electrically probing lattice responses, with potential for enhancement in nanoscale systems such as two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、detect、measurement、device、finite-element simulations）；研究对象：绝缘体中的热致极化现象（thermopolarization），具体材料包括MgO、Al₂O₃、MnO、云母、PET、PEN、聚酰亚胺、钠钙玻璃等晶体、聚合物和非晶体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在多种绝缘体中，温度梯度可通过热机械路径（热膨胀产生应变梯度，再通过挠曲电效应）诱导出电极化，且响应大小与热膨胀系数呈普适标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在多种绝缘体中，温度梯度可通过热机械路径（热膨胀产生应变梯度，再通过挠曲电效应）诱导出电极化，且响应大小与热膨胀系数呈普适标度关系。；创新点：发现了一种与对称性无关的绝缘体热-电转换新机制（热极化效应），不同于传统的塞贝克效应（导体）和热释电效应（极性绝缘体），并展示了在纳米尺度（如二维材料）中增强的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 使用片上加热器装置检测热诱导极化；结合有限元模拟验证标度关系；通过改变样品厚度和利用结构不稳定性（玻璃转变、反铁磁相变）来增强响应。

papers.title: Structure of Molten FeCl2 and FeCl3
papers.abstract: Molten iron chlorides are central to emerging energy technologies, including electrochemical iron production and redox flow batteries. Optimizing their electrochemical performance and transport properties requires atomic-scale structural understanding, yet detailed data for molten FeCl2 and its differences from FeCl3 remain scarce. Here, we determined the structures of molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 using High Energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD), Empirical Potential Structure Refinement (EPSR), and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). HEXRD measurements provided structure factors and total radial distribution functions (RDFs), which were quantitatively reproduced through EPSR refinement directly constrained by experimental data. MD simulations using MACE foundation and fine-tuned models reproduced experimental structure factors as well as total and partial RDFs, capturing key structural differences between the melts. The models resolved the octahedral to tetrahedral coordination transition of Fe upon melting in FeCl3 and predicted a similar transition in FeCl2. Analysis of MD trajectories quantified coordination environments, bridging Cl populations, bond-angle distributions, and connectivity patterns, revealing distinct degrees of polymerization and local geometry. Polymer chain statistics further showed that, contrary to prior reports, both liquids predominantly consist of extended chains containing six or more Fe centers rather than discrete Fe2Cl6 units. Finally, diffusion coefficients of the two melts calculated from the MACE-MD simulations were compared. Together, these results establish atomic-scale structural benchmarks for molten FeCl2 and FeCl3 and demonstrate the reliability of MACE-based MLIPs for predictive modeling of high-temperature molten salts, while providing practical guidance for MLIP development in complex ionic liquids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：使用了High Energy X-ray diffraction (HEXRD)实验测量，并结合Empirical Potential Structure Refinement (EPSR)和分子动力学（MD）模拟（含机器学习势MLIPs）进行结构解析。；研究对象：熔融态氯化亚铁（FeCl2）和氯化铁（FeCl3）的原子尺度结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的原子级结构，发现两者均主要由包含六个或更多Fe中心的长链构成，而非此前报道的离散Fe2Cl6单元；同时解析了FeCl3熔化时从八面体到四面体配位的转变，并预测FeCl2中存在类似转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的原子级结构，发现两者均主要由包含六个或更多Fe中心的长链构成，而非此前报道的离散Fe2Cl6单元；同时解析了FeCl3熔化时从八面体到四面体配位的转变，并预测FeCl2中存在类似转变。；创新点：首次通过实验与计算结合，系统揭示了熔融FeCl2和FeCl3的详细原子结构差异（如配位环境、桥接Cl分布、键角分布、聚合度等），并纠正了此前关于熔体主要由离散Fe2Cl6单元组成的错误认知。同时验证了基于MACE的机器学习势在高温熔盐预测建模中的可靠性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用高能X射线衍射（HEXRD）测量结构因子和总径向分布函数（RDFs）；计算上使用经验势结构精修（EPSR）直接约束于实验数据，以及基于MACE基础模型和微调模型的分子动力学（MD）模拟。

papers.title: Optical, vibrational, and electronic properties of semiconducting YbN
papers.abstract: We investigate the vibrational, optical, and electronic properties of insulating YbN thin films using Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and electrical transport measurements, supported by density functional theory. Raman spectra reveal the LO($Γ$) phonon and a cation-vacancy mode, while the optical conductivity identifies the TO phonon and an absorption edge corresponding to a 1.7 eV N 2p{$\rightarrow$}Yb 5d transition. The films exhibit thermally activated resistivity consistent with an insulating ground state. An additional defect induced absorption tail below the intrinsic band gap is observed, which in combination with the electrical measurements indicates the Fermi energy resides in a disordered conduction band minimum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以理论计算）。判断依据：Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, electrical transport measurements（实验手段），density functional theory（理论计算）。；研究对象：绝缘态YbN薄膜的光学、振动和电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YbN薄膜具有绝缘基态，其光学吸收边对应1.7 eV的N 2p→Yb 5d跃迁，且费米能级位于无序的导带底中，导致带隙以下存在缺陷诱导的吸收尾。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YbN薄膜具有绝缘基态，其光学吸收边对应1.7 eV的N 2p→Yb 5d跃迁，且费米能级位于无序的导带底中，导致带隙以下存在缺陷诱导的吸收尾。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、电输运测量，以及密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Spatial statistics for screening molecular structures
papers.abstract: The dominant paradigm in computational materials discovery relies on heavily parameterized deep architectures, including message-passing graph networks and equivariant models, that require millions of DFT-labeled training structures and produce non-convex latent representations that complicate continuous optimization for inverse design. These architectures are impractical in data-scarce regimes, which is the typical case in molecular screening, and exhibit well-documented limitations in capturing chemically disordered configurations and chiral geometries. This review presents feature engineering based on spatial statistics as a physically rigorous and immediately deployable alternative. Molecular structures are encoded as voxelized scalar fields, and two-point auto- and cross-correlations are evaluated deterministically via Fast Fourier Transforms, explicitly transferring the burden of spatial pattern recognition from the learning algorithm to a closed-form, physics-informed operation. Principal component analysis of the resulting correlation maps yields low-dimensional, strictly convex representations that support lean neural networks (<100k trainable parameters) and non-parametric surrogate models, achieving sub-2% prediction error with as few as 10 training samples. Demonstrated across periodic crystals, chemically disordered high-entropy alloys, and non-periodic organic molecules, this framework enables Bayesian active learning and zero-shot extrapolation on commodity hardware, which current large-scale architectures cannot replicate at equivalent data budgets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“feature engineering”、“spatial statistics”、“Fast Fourier Transforms”、“principal component analysis”、“neural networks”、“surrogate models”。；研究对象：分子与材料的结构筛选，具体涵盖周期性晶体、化学无序高熵合金以及非周期性有机分子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于空间统计学的特征工程方法（通过快速傅里叶变换计算两点自相关与互相关）能够生成低维、严格凸的表示，从而在极少量训练样本（如10个）下实现亚2%的预测误差，并支持贝叶斯主动学习与零样本外推。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于空间统计学的特征工程方法（通过快速傅里叶变换计算两点自相关与互相关）能够生成低维、严格凸的表示，从而在极少量训练样本（如10个）下实现亚2%的预测误差，并支持贝叶斯主动学习与零样本外推。；创新点：将空间模式识别的负担从学习算法显式转移到封闭形式的、物理信息驱动的操作（FFT相关计算），从而在数据稀缺场景下替代传统需要数百万DFT标记样本的深度架构（如消息传递图网络和等变模型），并克服了后者在捕捉化学无序构型和手性几何方面的局限性。
papers.method_zh: 采用空间统计学方法：将分子结构体素化为标量场，通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）确定性计算两点自相关与互相关图；随后对相关图进行主成分分析（PCA）得到低维凸表示；最后使用轻量级神经网络（<10万可训练参数）或非参数代理模型进行预测。

papers.title: Path-Extrema Upper Bounds on Mean Entropy Production
papers.abstract: Fluctuation relations imply the second-law inequality $\langleΣ_T\rangle\ge0$, but path extrema can also constrain how large the mean entropy production can be. For steady-state processes with entropy-production martingale $M_t=e^{-Σ_t}$, we show that knowing only the positive running maximum of $Σ_t$ gives no improvement over the trivial endpoint bound: rare negative entropy-production excursions can still carry the exponential weight required by the fluctuation relation. Using the running extrema $L_T=\inf M_t$ and $H_T=\sup M_t$, we derive a path-extrema upper envelope $\mathcal{U}_{\rm ext}$. The relaxed envelope problem ranks realized intervals by the entropy gain per martingale cost, $\ln(H_T/L_T)/(H_T-L_T)$, giving a continuous knapsack problem. The actual mean satisfies the exact identity $\langleΣ_T\rangle=\mathcal{U}_{\rm ext}-\mathcal{A}-\mathcal{C}$, where $\mathcal{A}$ is an allocation gap across realized envelopes and $\mathcal{C}$ is a curvature gap within each envelope. Thus path extrema set the upper envelope, while the two gaps quantify how actual dynamics allocate terminal outcomes across envelope classes and place terminal values within each realized envelope. This turns path-extrema information into a quantitative upper-bound theory for entropy production, complementary to the usual lower-bound role of fluctuation relations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：fluctuation relations（涨落关系）、martingale（鞅）、upper-bound theory（上界理论）。；研究对象：稳态过程中平均熵产生（mean entropy production）的上界问题，属于非平衡统计物理中的随机热力学体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 路径极值（path extrema）可以给出平均熵产生的上界包络线，而实际平均熵产生等于该上界减去分配间隙和曲率间隙，从而将路径极值信息转化为熵产生的定量上界理论。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：路径极值（path extrema）可以给出平均熵产生的上界包络线，而实际平均熵产生等于该上界减去分配间隙和曲率间隙，从而将路径极值信息转化为熵产生的定量上界理论。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于熵产生鞅 \( M_t = e^{-\Sigma_t} \) 的数学性质，利用运行极值 \( L_T = \inf M_t \) 和 \( H_T = \sup M_t \) 推导路径极值上包络 \( \mathcal{U}_{\text{ext}} \)，并通过连续背包问题（continuous knapsack problem）分析熵增益与鞅成本的比值 \( \ln(H_T/L_T)/(H_T-L_T) \)。

papers.title: Dynamic Many-Body Theory: The dynamics of atomic impurities in $^4$He
papers.abstract: We implement manifestly microscopic many-body methods to study the dynamics of atomic impurities in a host quantum fluid, specifically $^4$He. Our investigations are motivated by experiments of muonium atoms within $^4$He with the goal of testing the universality of free fall by neutral bound states using unstable particles. Structure calculations are performed using standard semi-analytic methods; we extend here the calculations of our previos work (Journal of Low Temperature Physics {\bf 93}, 415-449 (1993)) to muonic \he4, antiprotonic \he4 and mounium atoms within \he4. We find that the muonium impurity probes, due to its large zero-point motion, the atomic interaction at rather short distances. Its chemical potential is estimated to be about 19 meV. Antiprotonic \he4 has, on the other hand, a negative chemical potential. Dynamics is treated by making all correlation functions time-dependent. In analogy to the derivation of the dynamics of the background liquid, we derive a working formula for the impurity self-energy that includes the most relevant physical effects. Results for the effective mass of \he3 and hydrogen atoms agree well with available experiments. The dispersion relations of muonic \he4 and antiprotonic \he4 pass through under the roton minimum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：manifestly microscopic many-body methods、semi-analytic methods、self-energy、dispersion relations。；研究对象：在量子流体⁴He中作为杂质的原子（具体包括：muonic ⁴He、antiprotonic ⁴He、muonium原子，以及作为验证的³He和氢原子）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Muonium杂质因具有较大的零点运动，探测到原子间短程相互作用，其化学势约为19 meV；而antiprotonic ⁴He的化学势为负。muonic ⁴He和antiprotonic ⁴He的色散关系均穿过旋子极小值下方。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Muonium杂质因具有较大的零点运动，探测到原子间短程相互作用，其化学势约为19 meV；而antiprotonic ⁴He的化学势为负。muonic ⁴He和antiprotonic ⁴He的色散关系均穿过旋子极小值下方。；创新点：将之前工作中对⁴He中杂质结构计算的方法扩展到muonic ⁴He、antiprotonic ⁴He和muonium原子体系，并首次推导了包含最相关物理效应的杂质自能工作公式，用于处理杂质动力学。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用显式微观多体方法：结构计算使用标准半解析方法（扩展自作者1993年工作）；动力学处理通过使所有关联函数含时，并类比背景液体的动力学推导出杂质自能的实用公式。

papers.title: Supercurrent spin Hall effect enabled nanopillar Josephson diodes
papers.abstract: In the recent years it has been possible to achieve diode-like, non-reciprocal current-voltage response in Josephson junctions, despite the intrinsic symmetry of the Josephson effect itself. This is typically achieved by incorporating Rashba spin-orbit coupling into the Josephson junction as a strong inversion symmetry breaking component, and external magnetic field as a tuneable time-reversal symmetry breaking component. However, the efficiencies of the external field tuneable Josephson-diodes have remained limited to less than 10 \%, often measured below 100 mK temperature. In this work we take a new approach where non-reciprocity is induced by intrinsic SOC in a heavy metal Josephson barrier via the predicted supercurrent spin-Hall effect. By measuring a series of Nb-Pt-Nb nanopillar junctions we demonstrated field tuneable Josephson diode efficiencies as high as 17\%, measured above liquid Helium temperature. This was possible by the realization of a net non-equilibrium spin segregation in the Pt barrier, due to the supercurrent spin-Hall effect in the Pt barrier, analogous to the normal spin-Hall effect. As the direction of the induced spin moment is determined by the bias current, an external magnetic field causes the associated phases to add with opposite signs for opposite current directions, resulting in a nonreciprocal supercurrent across the junction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了测量过程（“By measuring a series of Nb-Pt-Nb nanopillar junctions”），并给出了具体的实验数据（“demonstrated field tuneable Josephson diode efficiencies as high as 17%”）。；研究对象：基于超流自旋霍尔效应的纳米柱约瑟夫森二极管。具体体系为Nb-Pt-Nb（铌-铂-铌）纳米柱结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在重金属（Pt）约瑟夫森势垒中利用超流自旋霍尔效应，实现了效率高达17%的场可调约瑟夫森二极管效应，且该效率在液氦温度以上测得。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在重金属（Pt）约瑟夫森势垒中利用超流自旋霍尔效应，实现了效率高达17%的场可调约瑟夫森二极管效应，且该效率在液氦温度以上测得。；创新点：不同于以往依赖Rashba自旋轨道耦合和外磁场来打破对称性的方法，本工作首次利用重金属势垒中固有的自旋轨道耦合（通过超流自旋霍尔效应）来诱导约瑟夫森二极管的非互易性，并在更高温度（液氦温度以上）下实现了更高的二极管效率（17%）。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了Nb-Pt-Nb纳米柱结的输运性质。通过构建纳米柱结，利用Pt势垒中的超流自旋霍尔效应产生非平衡自旋积累，并施加外磁场来打破时间反演对称性，从而实现对超流非互易性的调控。

papers.title: Bogoliubov sum rules and the Knight-shift ellipsoid in noncentrosymmetric superconductors
papers.abstract: We show that the residual $T=0$ Knight shift of a noncentrosymmetric superconductor in the strong-locking regime is completely determined by a single Fermi-surface average -- the projector $Π_{μν}=\langle\hat n_μ\hat n_ν\rangle_{\rm FS}$ of the spin-locking direction $\hat n_{\mathbf{k}}$ -- giving the tensor identity $χ_{μν}(0)=χ_{N}[δ_{μν}-Π_{μν}]$ independently of pairing symmetry, gap magnitude, and Fermi-surface shape. Because $\mathrm{Tr}\,Π=1$, the three principal Knight shifts at $T=0$ lie on a two-dimensional simplex of locking textures, the \emph{Knight-shift ellipsoid}, whose vertices, edges, and interior classify every canonical pairing class. The identity follows from a Bogoliubov sum rule, $\sum|M_{ph,O}|^{2}+\sum|M_{pp,O}|^{2}=\mathrm{Tr}_{s}(O^{2})$, valid at every momentum for every Hermitian single-particle operator $O$ as the BdG-doubled form of unitary invariance. Around the central theorem we develop controlled departures (a closed-form $s$-wave SOC interpolation, a finite-field strong-locking identity), a dynamical counterpart (a spin Ferrell--Glover--Tinkham sum rule and a rigorous vanishing-projection theorem for $1/T_{1}$), and a decoupled-pocket multiband baseline, packaged into six experimental protocols. Applied to the $^{75}$As NMR data on K$_{2}$Cr$_{3}$As$_{3}$, the observed ellipsoid sits at the oblate-axial vertex $(0,0,1)$ and saturates the trace bound; the decoupled-pocket SOC-texture baseline is excluded by $\sim 0.5$ in normalized units, requiring a common $\hat c$-axis locking on all three pockets, and the suppression of $1/T_{1}\parallel\hat c$ is identified, via the vanishing-projection theorem, as a fingerprint of finite-$\mathbf{q}$ ferromagnetic spin-fluctuation gap formation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Bogoliubov sum rule、理论推导、张量恒等式、实验协议）；研究对象：非中心对称超导体的Knight位移（核磁共振谱移）及其与自旋锁定方向的关系，具体应用于K₂Cr₃As₃的⁷⁵As核磁共振数据。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强锁定（strong-locking）机制下，非中心对称超导体在零温下的残余Knight位移完全由自旋锁定方向在费米面上的投影张量Π_{μν}决定，与配对对称性、能隙大小和费米面形状无关，并由此定义了“Knight位移椭球”分类所有正则配对类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强锁定（strong-locking）机制下，非中心对称超导体在零温下的残余Knight位移完全由自旋锁定方向在费米面上的投影张量Π_{μν}决定，与配对对称性、能隙大小和费米面形状无关，并由此定义了“Knight位移椭球”分类所有正则配对类。；创新点：首次证明残余Knight位移与配对对称性无关的普适张量形式，并引入“Knight位移椭球”作为分类工具；通过求和规则将自旋-晶格弛豫率1/T₁的抑制归因于有限波矢铁磁自旋涨落能隙的形成。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用Bogoliubov求和规则（∑|M_{ph,O}|²+∑|M_{pp,O}|²=Trₛ(O²)）导出张量恒等式；构建有限场强锁定恒等式、动力学Ferrell–Glover–Tinkham求和规则、1/T₁的严格零投影定理；提出六项实验协议；结合K₂Cr₃As₃的⁷⁵As NMR数据进行对比分析。

papers.title: Model of Simplicial Complexes with dimension-wise preferential attachment
papers.abstract: Network science is a powerful framework allowing to model complex systems, it is capable to describe and take into account the intricate web of connections existing among the constituting basic element of the system. Recently scholars have brought to the fore the relevance of higher-order networks, namely structures allowing to encode for many-body interaction, differently from the pairwise case handled by networks. This novel research field opens new avenues of research with applications ranging from neurosciences to social sciences; there is thus a need for generative models of higher-order network capable to reproduce features present in empirical data. In this work we present a model for growing simplicial complex rooted on a preferential attachment process acting dimension-wise, i.e., returning a power law distribution for the generalized degree of simplexes of different dimension.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“present a model”（提出模型）、“generative models”（生成模型）、“preferential attachment process”（优先连接过程），属于理论建模工作。；研究对象：高阶网络（higher-order networks）中的单纯复形（simplicial complexes），特别是能够编码多体相互作用的网络结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于维度优先连接（dimension-wise preferential attachment）的单纯复形生长模型，该模型能够使不同维度的单纯形（simplexes）的广义度（generalized degree）服从幂律分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于维度优先连接（dimension-wise preferential attachment）的单纯复形生长模型，该模型能够使不同维度的单纯形（simplexes）的广义度（generalized degree）服从幂律分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：基于优先连接过程的单纯复形生长模型，其中优先连接机制按维度分别作用（dimension-wise），以生成具有幂律度分布的高阶网络结构。

papers.title: Incommensurate Antiferromagnetic Order in the Fe-substituted Bi-2201 Cuprate in the Heavily Overdoped Regime
papers.abstract: Elastic neutron scattering experiments showed incommensurate antiferromagnetic peaks in 5% Fe-substituted Bi-2201 cuprate in the non-superconducting heavily overdoped regime. The incommensurability delta~0.21 is comparable to that observed in Fe-substituted Bi-2201 in the overdoped regime. [Hiraka et al., Phys. Rev. B 81, 144501 (2010).] The magnetic correlation length is comparable between the overdoped and non-superconducting heavily overdoped regimes. It is plausible that incommensurate antiferromagnetic order is induced and stabilized by Fe in the heavily overdoped regime, which suggests a robust antiferromagnetic correlation beyond the superconducting dome in the phase diagram.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“Elastic neutron scattering experiments”（弹性中子散射实验）。；研究对象：Fe替代的Bi-2201铜氧化物超导体在重过掺杂非超导区域中的非公度反铁磁序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在重过掺杂非超导区域，5% Fe替代的Bi-2201铜氧化物中观测到非公度反铁磁峰，其非公度性δ~0.21与过掺杂区域相当，且磁关联长度在过掺杂与重过掺杂区域相近。这表明Fe在重过掺杂区域诱导并稳定了非公度反铁磁序，暗示在超导穹顶之外仍存在稳健的反铁磁关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在重过掺杂非超导区域，5% Fe替代的Bi-2201铜氧化物中观测到非公度反铁磁峰，其非公度性δ~0.21与过掺杂区域相当，且磁关联长度在过掺杂与重过掺杂区域相近。这表明Fe在重过掺杂区域诱导并稳定了非公度反铁磁序，暗示在超导穹顶之外仍存在稳健的反铁磁关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 弹性中子散射实验。

papers.title: Percolation transition of strongly connected clusters in finite dimensions and on complete graphs
papers.abstract: We study the percolation of strongly connected clusters (SCCs), in which sites are mutually reachable through directed paths, in systems with randomly oriented bonds by extensive simulations on hypercubic lattices from dimension $d=2$ to $7$ and complete graphs. Below the upper critical dimension $d_u=6$, the critical SCCs exhibit nontrivial fractal dimension $d_{\rm SCC}$, and the size distribution scales as $\sim s^{-τ_{\rm SCC}}$ with the hyperscaling relation $τ_{\rm SCC}=1+d/d_{\rm SCC}$. For $d \ge d_u$, mean-field behavior is recovered with $d_{\rm SCC}/d=1/3$, consistent with complete-graph results. However, in contrast to hypercubic lattices, complete graphs exhibit a double-scaling structure in the SCC size distribution: large SCCs are governed by mean-field value $τ_{\rm SCC}=4$, while small SCCs follow a distinct power law with exponent $τ'=1$. At criticality, the giant in- and out-clusters are also fractal, sharing the same dimension as standard percolation clusters. These results show that critical SCCs remain well-defined fractal objects across dimensions, while their approach to the mean-field limit involves nontrivial changes in cluster statistics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词“extensive simulations”、“hypercubic lattices”、“complete graphs”、“mean-field behavior”。；研究对象：随机取向键系统中强连通簇（SCC）的逾渗转变，具体研究维度从d=2到7的超立方晶格以及完全图上的SCC临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低于上临界维度d_u=6时，临界SCC具有非平凡的分形维数d_SCC，并满足超标度关系τ_SCC=1+d/d_SCC；在d≥6时恢复平均场行为，SCC分形维数与完全图结果一致，但完全图上的SCC尺寸分布呈现双标度结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低于上临界维度d_u=6时，临界SCC具有非平凡的分形维数d_SCC，并满足超标度关系τ_SCC=1+d/d_SCC；在d≥6时恢复平均场行为，SCC分形维数与完全图结果一致，但完全图上的SCC尺寸分布呈现双标度结构。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过大规模数值模拟，在d=2到7的超立方晶格和完全图上进行随机取向键系统的逾渗模拟，分析强连通簇的尺寸分布、分形维数及临界标度关系。

papers.title: First-principles calculations of electrical conductivities of edge-modified graphene nanoribbons: strain effect
papers.abstract: We investigate the influence of strain on the electrical properties of graphene nanoribbons that have potential applications in making sensors and other optoelectronic devices. In particular, we chose pristine armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH), boron doped armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH-B) and armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges that have one carbon atom vacancy (7aGNRsH-V). Based on first-principles calculations, results show that pristine unstrained 7aGNRsH is electrically nonconductive but turns to be electrically conductive in a wide range of energy spectrum, e.g., from IR to visible to UV, due to the application of strain engineering. In metallic unstrained and strained 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V, non-vanishing electrical conductivity in the IR, visible and UV energy spectrum regimes are observed. We also investigate the influence of strain on the Berry curvature of 7aGNRsH, 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V nanoribbons. The results show that fermions are spread through out the Brillion zone in the reciprocal space for semiconducting unstrained 7aGNRsH but localized near the $Γ$-point for strained 7aGNRsH that have out-of-plane deformations due to strain engineering. For metallics 7aGNRsH-B and 7aGNRsH-V, Berry curvature plots show that fermions are localized far away from the $Γ$-point. In two atom boron doped p-type armchair graphene nanoribbons with 7 zigzag edges (7aGNRsH-2B), large peaks in electrical conductivity at IR energy spectrum regimes can be observed. These peaks of electrical conductivities in 7aGNRSH-2B may be detectable in experimentally synthesized structure in Reference, JACS 137, 8872 (2016).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“First-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：边缘修饰的扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带（armchair graphene nanoribbons, aGNRs），具体包括：纯7-zigzag边缘的aGNR（7aGNRsH）、硼掺杂的7aGNRsH（7aGNRsH-B）、含一个碳原子空位的7aGNRsH（7aGNRsH-V），以及双硼掺杂的7aGNRsH（7aGNRsH-2B）。研究重点是应变对这些材料电导率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变工程可使原本不导电的纯7aGNRsH在红外到紫外宽光谱范围内转变为导电态；对于金属性的掺杂/缺陷体系，应变下仍保持非零电导率。此外，双硼掺杂体系（7aGNRsH-2B）在红外波段出现显著的电导率峰。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变工程可使原本不导电的纯7aGNRsH在红外到紫外宽光谱范围内转变为导电态；对于金属性的掺杂/缺陷体系，应变下仍保持非零电导率。此外，双硼掺杂体系（7aGNRsH-2B）在红外波段出现显著的电导率峰。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations），具体计算了电导率（electrical conductivities）和贝里曲率（Berry curvature），并分析了应变（strain）对能带和费米子分布的影响。

papers.title: An Efficient Approach for Calculating Free Energy in Molecular Dynamics: Demineralization of Hydroxyapatite as a Case Study
papers.abstract: Despite the strength of Molecular Dynamics simulations in providing insights into the microscopic details of phenomenon in many fields in materials science, physics and biology, the biggest barrier is its limited timescale which is several orders of magnitude lower than the timescale of the real-world processes and phenomena being modeled. Free energy calculations are designed as a remedy to this problem that in theory can overcome this barrier. This is particularly relevant for biomineralisation processes such as tooth mineral formation and dissolution, while reflecting a broader challenge in accurately modelling rare events and long-timescale phenomena across complex molecular systems. However, due to the novelty of the field, a number of questions remain outstanding pertaining to the best practice of applying this method. The non-equilibrium work approach based on the Jarzynski equation is one of the most promising free energy calculation methods. However, the biggest challenge for the broader use of this method is the question of how many simulations are required for an accurate free energy estimation. Comparing the free energy results with very long reversible pulling simulations of atom clusters from the surface, each taking 75 days on the 48-core Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 CPUs, in this study we showed that this question is irrelevant and higher quality and better equilibrated initial structures is the proper approach than simply based on the number of simulations. We designed a new adaptive free energy calculation methodology which combines high quality, high computational cost free energy values with lower quality, lower cost values to build up the entire free energy profile. In the best case scenario this method lowers manifold the computational cost required for the non-equilibrium work free energy calculations compared to both the regular method and the reversible simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Molecular Dynamics simulations、Free energy calculations、non-equilibrium work approach、Jarzynski equation。；研究对象：羟基磷灰石（Hydroxyapatite）的脱矿过程（demineralization），属于生物矿化（biomineralisation）中的罕见事件和长时标现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于基于Jarzynski方程的非平衡功自由能计算方法，提高初始结构质量并使其更好平衡，比单纯增加模拟次数更能准确估算自由能；新提出的自适应方法可大幅降低计算成本。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于基于Jarzynski方程的非平衡功自由能计算方法，提高初始结构质量并使其更好平衡，比单纯增加模拟次数更能准确估算自由能；新提出的自适应方法可大幅降低计算成本。；创新点：提出“初始结构质量比模拟次数更重要”的观点，并设计了一种自适应自由能计算方法，在最佳情况下可大幅降低非平衡功自由能计算的计算成本（相比常规方法和可逆模拟）。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（Molecular Dynamics）模拟，采用非平衡功方法（基于Jarzynski方程）进行自由能计算，并与极长可逆拉动模拟（在48核Intel Xeon Platinum 8268 CPU上每次耗时75天）的结果进行对比；设计了结合高质量/高成本与低质量/低成本自由能值的自适应自由能计算方法。

papers.title: New Source of Spin-hot spot in displaced silicon double quantum dots
papers.abstract: Controlling electron spins in double quantum dots allows individual electrons to be trapped and manipulated for next-generation solid-state qubit devices. In this paper, the study analyzes spin relaxation due to deformation potentials of acoustic phonon in single and double quantum dots under in-plane and out-of-plane magnetic fields, showing that in single quantum dots the relaxation rate is highly sensitive to low in-plane magnetic fields ($<1T$) but converges near a spin-hot-spot region. In a single quantum dot, the spin-hot spot arises from well-understood level crossings between singlet and triplet states. In double quantum dots, a new and unusual spin-hot spot appears as the dots are pulled apart from the origin, with spin-relaxation rates three orders of magnitude lower than conventional single quantum dots. In displaced quantum dots dominated by magnetic confinement, two distinct spin-hot spots appear at different in-plane magnetic field strengths, where spin-relaxation time varies from millisecond to picosecond. When quantum dots are separated by about 60 nm, calculations predict oscillations in spin-hot spots as the in-plane magnetic field changes. These unusual spin-hot spot oscillations occur at low magnetic fields ($<1T$), resulting in spin-relaxation rates about four orders of magnitude lower than those of conventional high-field spin-hot spots ($\approx 4.5T$). The extremely low spin-relaxation rate at the spin-hot spot enables the preparation of qubit superposition states for quantum computing and information processing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“study analyzes”（分析研究）、“calculations predict”（计算预测），未提及任何实验手段或数据。；研究对象：硅双量子点中的电子自旋弛豫现象，特别是由声子形变势引起的自旋热斑（spin-hot spot）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在分离的硅双量子点中，发现了一种新型的自旋热斑，其自旋弛豫率比传统单量子点中的自旋热斑低约三个数量级。当量子点间距约为60纳米时，在低磁场（<1T）下还预测了自旋热斑的振荡行为，其弛豫率比传统高场自旋热斑（约4.5T）低约四个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在分离的硅双量子点中，发现了一种新型的自旋热斑，其自旋弛豫率比传统单量子点中的自旋热斑低约三个数量级。当量子点间距约为60纳米时，在低磁场（<1T）下还预测了自旋热斑的振荡行为，其弛豫率比传统高场自旋热斑（约4.5T）低约四个数量级。；创新点：发现了在分离的双量子点中，由磁约束主导时出现的一种全新的、不同于传统单量子点中单态-三重态能级交叉机制的自旋热斑。摘要未突出说明该工作与之前理论模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体为：基于声子形变势模型，计算了单量子点和双量子点在面内和面外磁场下的自旋弛豫率。通过分析能级交叉（单态与三重态）来识别自旋热斑的位置。

papers.title: Reprogrammable magnonic logic in a multiferroic heterostructure via magnetoelectric coupling
papers.abstract: The realization of fully reconfigurable, voltage-controlled, and programmable on-chip magnonic devices is essential to fully harness the potential of spin waves for signal processing, logic and neuromorphic computing. Yet, existing demonstrations of electrical tuning of magnonic responses are either volatile, current-driven and thus energy-inefficient, or rely on local strain modification limiting their scalability for wafer-scale integration. Here, we address this challenge using a BiFeO3/La0.67Sr0.33MnO3 multiferroic thin film heterostructure. We show that ferroelectric domain engineering in BiFeO3 enables deterministic tuning of the magnon dispersion of La0.67Sr0.33MnO3, producing frequency shifts up to $\sim 150 MHz$ and allowing reconfigurable waveguiding. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering directly images these effects, revealing electrically defined magnonic waveguides and spatially programmable dispersion. Compared to conventional approaches, this method provides non-volatile and reversible control. Furthermore, using an inverse-design simulation code, we demonstrate the capability of our platform to perform advanced magnonic functions such as frequency demultiplexing. Our results open a new avenue for using magnetoelectric heterostructures for magnonic logic, with further applicability to reservoir and neuromorphic computing and AI driven magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：thin film heterostructure、micro-focused Brillouin light scattering、imaging、demonstrate）；研究对象：BiFeO₃/La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃ 多铁异质结中的磁振子（自旋波）行为，特别是通过磁电耦合实现可编程磁振子逻辑。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过BiFeO₃中的铁电畴工程，可确定性调控La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃的磁振子色散，实现高达约150 MHz的频率移动，并构建可重构的磁振子波导。该平台还具备执行频率解复用等高级磁振子功能的能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过BiFeO₃中的铁电畴工程，可确定性调控La₀.₆₇Sr₀.₃₃MnO₃的磁振子色散，实现高达约150 MHz的频率移动，并构建可重构的磁振子波导。该平台还具备执行频率解复用等高级磁振子功能的能力。；创新点：实现了非易失性、可逆、电压控制的磁振子响应调控，克服了现有方法（如电流驱动、局部应变修饰）在能效和晶圆级可扩展性方面的局限，为全可编程磁振子逻辑器件提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用微聚焦布里渊光散射（micro-focused Brillouin light scattering）直接成像磁振子色散和波导效应；理论上结合逆设计模拟代码（inverse-design simulation code）演示频率解复用等高级功能。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal impurity scattering as a probe for pairing symmetries in kagome superconductors
papers.abstract: The superconducting (SC) pairing symmetry and its link to time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) in the vanadium-based kagome superconductors remain unresolved, with ambiguities stemming from sublattice interference and charge-density-wave (CDW) entanglement with superconductivity. Using two representative SC pairings, i.e., the conventional on-site $s$-wave and the TRSB $d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}$-wave, as a model study, we theoretically show that while single magnetic impurity yield qualitatively identical spectral behavior of local density of states (LDOS) for these two symmetries, two magnetic impurities give rise to distinct LDOS patterns. For the conventional on-site $s$-wave pairing, time-reversal symmetry (TRS) enforces equivalent forward and backward scattering between two impurities across all impurity configurations, leading to near disappearance of a Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) state pair along the line connecting the two impurities. However, for the TRSB $d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}$-wave pairing, this scattering equivalence holds only for inversion-symmetric impurity configurations, with a pair of YSR disappearance restricted to this case. These distinct spectral features are resolvable in scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) experiments, providing a direct avenue to discriminate TRSB and non-TRSB SC pairing symmetries in kagome superconductors and an alternative method to probe SC nonreciprocity that circumvents the ambiguities of conventional critical current-based techniques.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically show”、“model study”、“provide a direct avenue”。；研究对象：钒基笼目超导体（kagome superconductors）中的超导配对对称性，特别是时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）与非TRSB配对之间的区分问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于笼目超导体，单个磁性杂质产生的局域态密度（LDOS）谱在常规s波和TRSB d+id波配对下定性相同，但两个磁性杂质会因非互易散射效应产生截然不同的LDOS图案：s波配对下，时间反演对称性迫使两杂质间的前向与后向散射等价，导致沿连线方向的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）态对几乎消失；而d+id波配对下，该等价性仅对反演对称的杂质构型成立，YSR态消失仅发生在该特定情形。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于笼目超导体，单个磁性杂质产生的局域态密度（LDOS）谱在常规s波和TRSB d+id波配对下定性相同，但两个磁性杂质会因非互易散射效应产生截然不同的LDOS图案：s波配对下，时间反演对称性迫使两杂质间的前向与后向散射等价，导致沿连线方向的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）态对几乎消失；而d+id波配对下，该等价性仅对反演对称的杂质构型成立，YSR态消失仅发生在该特定情形。；创新点：提出利用两个磁性杂质引起的非互易散射效应（而非传统临界电流测量）来区分笼目超导体中是否具有时间反演对称性破缺的配对对称性，从而规避了电荷密度波（CDW）与超导纠缠带来的歧义。
papers.method_zh: 基于两种代表性超导配对（常规在位s波和TRSB d_{x^2-y^2}+id_{xy}波）的模型计算，分析单个和两个磁性杂质对局域态密度（LDOS）的影响，并与扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实验可观测的谱特征进行对比。

papers.title: Interface engineering of the anomalous Hall effect in Ni-based heterostructures
papers.abstract: Using a combined experimental and first-principles theoretical approach, we demonstrate interface engineering of the anomalous Hall effect in Ni-based epitaxial thin-film heterostructures. Ferromagnetic Ni thin films are grown on (001)-oriented single-crystal LaAlO$_3$, SrTiO$_3$, and MgO substrates, which impose different biaxial tensile strains of 0.3%, 0.6%, and 0.8%, respectively. Our room-temperature Hall transport measurements reveal a pronounced substrate-dependent modulation of the anomalous Hall conductivity. Interestingly, our calculations show that strain alone cannot account for the experimentally observed trends. Instead, we identify interfacial inversion-symmetry breaking, which induces Rashba spin-orbit interaction, as the key mechanism governing the anomalous Hall conductivity across different interfaces.
