Building on this understanding, we further demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally that the anomalous Hall conductivity can be continuously tuned by an external electric field. These findings establish the critical role of substrate-induced interfacial effects in controlling the anomalous Hall effect in engineered heterostructures and provide a viable pathway toward electrically tunable room-temperature spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental and first-principles theoretical approach”，包含实验生长、输运测量和理论计算。；研究对象：Ni基外延薄膜异质结中的反常霍尔效应（Anomalous Hall Effect），具体为Ni薄膜生长在LaAlO₃、SrTiO₃和MgO单晶衬底上形成的异质结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面反演对称性破缺诱导的Rashba自旋-轨道相互作用是调控反常霍尔电导率的关键机制，而非单纯应变效应；并且反常霍尔电导率可通过外加电场连续调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面反演对称性破缺诱导的Rashba自旋-轨道相互作用是调控反常霍尔电导率的关键机制，而非单纯应变效应；并且反常霍尔电导率可通过外加电场连续调谐。；创新点：揭示了衬底诱导的界面效应（而非单纯应变）在调控反常霍尔效应中的主导作用，并首次在Ni基异质结中实现了电场对反常霍尔电导率的连续调控。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：分子束外延（MBE）生长Ni薄膜于(001)取向的LaAlO₃、SrTiO₃和MgO衬底上；室温霍尔输运测量。理论方面：第一性原理计算（具体方法如DFT，摘要未进一步说明）。

papers.title: Finite-Temperature Spin Exchange-Correlation Kernel of the Uniform Electron Gas
papers.abstract: The finite-temperature spin response of the uniform electron gas (UEG) is a fundamental reference for spin-polarized and magnetized electron liquids, including warm dense matter (WDM), yet it remains far less constrained than charge response. Using variational diagrammatic Monte Carlo, we compute the static spin exchange--correlation (XC) kernel $K_{xc}(q;T)$ of the unpolarized UEG at metallic densities across the quantum-degenerate, warm-dense, and classical regimes. The kernel connects smoothly to zero-temperature spin-response parametrizations at low temperature, while heating suppresses the Fermi-surface-scale spin-correlation structure and weakens the XC-driven Stoner enhancement. Its long-wavelength limit provides a direct response test of the spin stiffness implied by thermal local-spin-density-approximation (LSDA) parametrizations, showing low-temperature consistency while exposing a resolved warm-dense residual in current LSDA parametrizations. In the classical regime, the spin XC kernel becomes nearly local on the Fermi-momentum scale, in sharp contrast to the corresponding charge XC kernel. These results provide a first-principles basis for finite-temperature spin-response theory and magnetized WDM modeling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用“variational diagrammatic Monte Carlo”（变分图解蒙特卡洛）计算方法，并构建理论模型（spin exchange-correlation kernel）。；研究对象：均匀电子气（UEG）在有限温度下的自旋响应，特别是其静态自旋交换关联核（$K_{xc}(q;T)$）。该体系是研究自旋极化及磁化电子液体（包括温稠密物质）的基础参考。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 计算揭示了均匀电子气自旋交换关联核从低温到经典极限的完整演化：低温下与零温结果平滑连接，升温会抑制费米面尺度的自旋关联结构并削弱Stoner增强效应；在经典极限下，自旋交换关联核在费米动量尺度上变得近乎局域，与电荷交换关联核的行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：计算揭示了均匀电子气自旋交换关联核从低温到经典极限的完整演化：低温下与零温结果平滑连接，升温会抑制费米面尺度的自旋关联结构并削弱Stoner增强效应；在经典极限下，自旋交换关联核在费米动量尺度上变得近乎局域，与电荷交换关联核的行为形成鲜明对比。；创新点：首次系统地计算并提供了均匀电子气在有限温度下、从低温到经典极限的完整自旋交换关联核，为有限温度自旋响应理论和磁化温稠密物质建模提供了第一性原理基础。同时，该工作直接检验了热局域自旋密度近似（LSDA）参数化中的自旋刚度，并揭示了当前LSDA参数化在温稠密区域存在的残余误差。
papers.method_zh: 变分图解蒙特卡洛（Variational Diagrammatic Monte Carlo）方法。该方法用于计算非极化均匀电子气在金属密度下、跨越量子简并、温稠密和经典三个温区的静态自旋交换关联核。

papers.title: Learning inelastic constitutive models from stress-strain data under hard thermodynamic constraints
papers.abstract: Machine learning approaches informed by physics have offered new insights into the discovery of constitutive models from data, helping overcome some limitations of traditional constitutive modelling while reducing the cost of otherwise computationally intensive simulations. Yet, most existing approaches only partially enforce the requirements of physics and thermodynamics, leaving open questions about their consistency across a broad range of material behaviours and their ability to generalise robustly to unseen loading paths when only limited measurements are available. This work establishes a thermodynamics-constrained learning framework whose architecture embeds the principles of non-equilibrium thermodynamics, objectivity and stability as hard, scalable constraints to learn constitutive models from standard macroscopic data. Analytical benchmarks involving stress-strain loading paths demonstrate that the method learns thermodynamically consistent and robust constitutive models for a range of inelastic materials of increasing complexity. At inference, the resulting models generalise to more demanding, unobserved paths and can autonomously recover interpretable internal variables that capture path-dependent evolution. The framework is then applied to granular media, prototypical heterogeneous and history-dependent materials for which constitutive modelling remains challenging. Trained on numerically simulated experiments based on the discrete element method, the model discovers the underlying constitutive equations and predicts responses under cyclic loading, including the emergence of hysteresis absent from the training data, relying solely on macroscopic stress-strain histories. The findings indicate that enforcing non-equilibrium thermodynamics through hard constraints represents a principled route to robust, consistent, and scalable data-driven discovery of constitutive models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine learning、thermodynamics-constrained learning framework、numerically simulated experiments。；研究对象：非弹性本构模型（inelastic constitutive models），具体应用于颗粒介质（granular media）等异质性和历史依赖性材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将非平衡热力学、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束嵌入机器学习架构，可以从宏观应力-应变数据中学习到热力学一致且鲁棒的本构模型，并能在未见加载路径下泛化，自主恢复可解释的内变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将非平衡热力学、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束嵌入机器学习架构，可以从宏观应力-应变数据中学习到热力学一致且鲁棒的本构模型，并能在未见加载路径下泛化，自主恢复可解释的内变量。；创新点：现有方法仅部分满足物理和热力学要求，而本工作首次将非平衡热力学作为硬约束（而非软约束）嵌入学习架构，实现了可扩展、一致且鲁棒的本构模型数据驱动发现，并在颗粒介质中展示了从训练数据中未出现的滞回现象的涌现。
papers.method_zh: 采用热力学约束学习框架（thermodynamics-constrained learning framework），其架构将非平衡热力学原理、客观性和稳定性作为硬约束（hard constraints）嵌入。训练数据来自基于离散元方法（discrete element method, DEM）的数值模拟实验，仅使用宏观应力-应变历史进行训练。

papers.title: Relativistic theory for coupled orbital and spin angular momentum dynamics in magnetic systems
papers.abstract: We develop a complete relativistic theory to describe the dynamics of electronic angular momentum including both spin (S) and orbital (L) contributions in magnetic systems. We start with the relativistic Dirac-Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian under the influence of an electromagnetic field and apply a unitary transformation to formulate the extended Pauli Hamiltonian. Using the transformed semirelativistic Hamiltonian, we derive the angular momentum dynamics for the orbital and spin angular momenta. Thereby, we formulate the coupled dynamics of orbital and spin moments consistent with the relativistic Dirac framework. Considering especially the conservation of the total angular momentum, J = S +L, we show first that J is conserved in the absence of a spin-polarized Kohn-Sham exchange field, but is no longer conserved under the application of an electromagnetic field, e.g., laser pulse, THz field, etc. Second, considering magnetic systems with atomic spin and orbital momenta, we derive the coupled equations of motion of angular momenta dynamics whilst making the atomistic Heisenberg approximation for the exchange interaction. Our results suggest that, under these assumptions, the total angular momentum remains conserved, even with electromagnetic field, but atomic spin and orbital angular momenta individually are not conserved.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a complete relativistic theory”、“derive”、“formulate”。；研究对象：磁性系统中电子自旋角动量（S）与轨道角动量（L）的耦合动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无自旋极化的Kohn-Sham交换场时，总角动量J=S+L守恒，但在外加电磁场（如激光脉冲、太赫兹场）下不再守恒；而在原子尺度Heisenberg近似下，即使存在电磁场，总角动量仍守恒，但自旋和轨道角动量各自不守恒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无自旋极化的Kohn-Sham交换场时，总角动量J=S+L守恒，但在外加电磁场（如激光脉冲、太赫兹场）下不再守恒；而在原子尺度Heisenberg近似下，即使存在电磁场，总角动量仍守恒，但自旋和轨道角动量各自不守恒。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于相对论Dirac-Kohn-Sham哈密顿量，通过幺正变换得到扩展的Pauli哈密顿量，进而推导自旋与轨道角动量的运动方程，并采用原子尺度的Heisenberg交换相互作用近似。

papers.title: Emergent impedance due to antiferromagnetic domain wall dynamics
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate emergent impedance induced by domain-wall dynamics in antiferromagnets. Emergent impedance, arising from a combined action of spin-transfer torque and spinmotive force, was previously predicted and observed in spiral magnets. Here we develop a formalism for the electrical response of an antiferromagnetic domain wall under ac currents, and obtain analytical expressions for the resulting emergent impedance. We find that two dynamical modes play separate roles in the emergent impedance: Translational motion of the domain-wall center generates a contribution proportional to its velocity, analogous to that arising from the corresponding motion of a spiral magnet. Another contribution, unique to antiferromagnetic domain walls, originates from the time-dependent canting of the sublattice magnetizations localized within the moving domain wall, whose magnitude is inversely proportional to the antiferromagnetic exchange coupling constant. The competition between these two distinct contributions determines the sign and magnitude of the imaginary part of the emergent impedance at sub-resonant frequencies. Our results provide a fundamental insight into electron transport in antiferromagnets, and open avenues for novel antiferromagnet-based spintronics devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“develop a formalism”、“obtain analytical expressions”。；研究对象：反铁磁体中由畴壁动力学引发的“涌现阻抗”（emergent impedance）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下会产生涌现阻抗，其来源包括两种不同的动力学模式：畴壁中心的平移运动（类似螺旋磁体）和畴壁内亚晶格磁化的时变倾斜（反铁磁体特有）。这两种贡献的竞争决定了亚共振频率下涌现阻抗虚部的符号和大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下会产生涌现阻抗，其来源包括两种不同的动力学模式：畴壁中心的平移运动（类似螺旋磁体）和畴壁内亚晶格磁化的时变倾斜（反铁磁体特有）。这两种贡献的竞争决定了亚共振频率下涌现阻抗虚部的符号和大小。；创新点：首次在理论上揭示了反铁磁畴壁中存在一种独特的涌现阻抗贡献，该贡献源于畴壁内部亚晶格磁化的时变倾斜，其大小与反铁磁交换耦合常数成反比，这是螺旋磁体中所没有的。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋转移矩（spin-transfer torque）和自旋动电力（spinmotive force）的联合作用，建立了反铁磁畴壁在交流电流下的电响应理论形式，并推导出涌现阻抗的解析表达式。

papers.title: Systematic dynamical mean-field theory study of 3d perovskite oxides with uniform Coulomb interactions
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated transition-metal perovskite oxides pose a fundamental challenge for electronic-structure theory and for large-scale, data-driven materials discovery. While DFT+DMFT provides a quantitatively accurate description of such systems, its high-throughput application is hindered by the need to determine material-specific Coulomb interaction parameters ($U$). First-principles approaches such as the cRPA predict a highly nonlinear and non-transferable evolution of the interaction strength across chemically similar ABO$_3$ perovskites. Here we show that this paradigm does not extend to the large-energy-window eDMFT, which employs highly localized orbitals and treats electronic correlations and screening self-consistently within the same many-body framework. As a result, spectral properties are governed primarily by the dynamical self-energy rather than by static interaction-induced energy shifts. Recent constrained-eDMFT calculations demonstrated that, for broad classes of $3d$ transition-metal oxides, the self-consistently screened Coulomb interactions naturally fall within relatively narrow ranges for correlated metals and insulators. Motivated by these findings, we implement a high-throughput eDMFT framework employing physically derived interaction values of $U=6$ eV for metals and $U=10$ eV for insulators together with $exact$ double counting. We test this framework using systematic high-throughput eDMFT calculations for ABO$_3$ compounds (A = Ca, Sr, La; B = V--Ni) and benchmark the resulting spectral functions against photoemission experiments, where we find overall excellent agreement. Our results establish that charge self-consistent eDMFT enables robust, parameter-tuning-free high-throughput many-body calculations for correlated oxides, opening a practical pathway toward predictive electronic-structure databases for strongly correlated materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT+DMFT、eDMFT、high-throughput calculations。；研究对象：3d过渡金属钙钛矿氧化物ABO₃（A = Ca, Sr, La; B = V–Ni）的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在采用高度局域化轨道并自洽处理电子关联与屏蔽的eDMFT框架下，光谱性质主要由动态自能而非静态相互作用能移决定；对于3d过渡金属氧化物，自洽屏蔽的库仑相互作用在金属和绝缘体中分别落在较窄范围内（金属U=6 eV，绝缘体U=10 eV），从而无需材料特定的参数调优即可实现高通量计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在采用高度局域化轨道并自洽处理电子关联与屏蔽的eDMFT框架下，光谱性质主要由动态自能而非静态相互作用能移决定；对于3d过渡金属氧化物，自洽屏蔽的库仑相互作用在金属和绝缘体中分别落在较窄范围内（金属U=6 eV，绝缘体U=10 eV），从而无需材料特定的参数调优即可实现高通量计算。；创新点：证明了在eDMFT框架下，库仑相互作用参数U可以统一设定为仅依赖材料导电类型（金属/绝缘体）的固定值，从而避免了传统DFT+DMFT中需要逐个材料确定U的瓶颈，实现了无需参数调优的高通量强关联电子结构计算。
papers.method_zh: 采用电荷自洽的扩展动力学平均场理论（eDMFT）框架，结合物理推导的相互作用参数（金属U=6 eV，绝缘体U=10 eV）以及精确的双计数方案，对ABO₃化合物进行系统的高通量eDMFT计算，并将谱函数与光电子能谱实验进行对比验证。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic cascade drives tumbling in sheared colloidal rod suspensions
papers.abstract: Modeling the dynamics of colloidal rods remains a central challenge in soft-matter physics due to the anisotropic and long-ranged nature of their interactions. Hydrodynamic interactions in rods suspensions are often assumed to be screened or too week to play any role in semi-dilute regimes, yet we find here these assumptions to break down at shear rates and concentrations that are often attained in experiments. Using particle-based simulations and scaling analysis, we uncover a cascade of tumbling events driven by hydrodynamic coupling among neighboring rods. This collective dynamics disrupts flow alignment and leads to a pronounced increase in viscosity and normal stress differences, in qualitative agreement with recent experiments. The discovery of this hydrodynamically-promoted cascade effect calls for a revision of existing constitutive models for colloidal rods and highlights hydrodynamic coupling as a key mechanism governing collective dynamics in highly anisotropic suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：particle-based simulations（基于粒子的模拟）、scaling analysis（标度分析）。；研究对象：剪切流动下胶体棒状颗粒悬浮液中的动力学行为，具体为半稀薄浓度下由流体动力学相互作用驱动的翻滚级联现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在实验常见的剪切速率和浓度下，相邻棒状颗粒之间的流体动力学耦合会触发一种翻滚级联效应，该集体动力学破坏了流动取向，并导致粘度与法向应力差显著增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在实验常见的剪切速率和浓度下，相邻棒状颗粒之间的流体动力学耦合会触发一种翻滚级联效应，该集体动力学破坏了流动取向，并导致粘度与法向应力差显著增大。；创新点：推翻了半稀薄胶体棒悬浮液中流体动力学相互作用通常被屏蔽或可忽略的常见假设，首次揭示了流体动力学耦合驱动的翻滚级联效应，并指出现有本构模型需要据此进行修正。摘要未突出说明与具体实验技术的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于粒子的模拟（particle-based simulations）和标度分析（scaling analysis）。

papers.title: Euler-Maruyama method for non-Wiener processes
papers.abstract: Descriptions of complex physical or biological systems often include stochastic contributions, and these are commonly simulated using Wiener processes. In many cases however, non-Gaussian fluctuations may originate from non-Wiener processes which remain less explored. The Euler-Maruyama method of discretising stochastic differential equations to non-Wiener processes is generalised. Non-Gaussian noise generated from a subset of Lévy processes can be used simply and often with more physical justification, for both additive and multiplicative noise. An example of this is provided that gives superior physical results compared to using geometric Brownian motion. Finally the results of the additive noise are shown to be equivalent to a derived master equation via the Kramers-Moyal expansion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generalised、derived、Kramers-Moyal expansion。；研究对象：非Wiener过程（非高斯噪声）驱动的随机微分方程，以及其在复杂物理或生物系统描述中的应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将Euler-Maruyama方法推广至非Wiener过程，使得来自Lévy过程子集的非高斯噪声可被简单且物理上更合理地用于加性和乘性噪声模拟，并给出了优于几何布朗运动的物理实例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将Euler-Maruyama方法推广至非Wiener过程，使得来自Lévy过程子集的非高斯噪声可被简单且物理上更合理地用于加性和乘性噪声模拟，并给出了优于几何布朗运动的物理实例。；创新点：将经典的Euler-Maruyama数值方法从Wiener过程扩展到非Wiener过程（特别是Lévy过程子集），为非高斯涨落的模拟提供了更简便且物理上更合理的途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论推广：将离散化随机微分方程的Euler-Maruyama方法推广到非Wiener过程；通过Kramers-Moyal展开推导了加性噪声情形下的主方程。

papers.title: Non-linear diffusion and inhomogeneity of the magnetic field in single-turn coils: Insights from 3D multiphysics modeling
papers.abstract: The single-turn coil method is a destructive pulsed magnet for generating over 100 T with a few $μ$-second pulse duration, and it inevitably causes the coil to explode. The temporal and spatial distributions of the electric current and magnetic field are highly inhomogeneous, arising from the skin effect, rapid temperature rise, and coil deformation. To grasp the dynamic phenomena in the single-turn coil, we conducted a finite element analysis using multiphysics simulation. We employed finite element method calculations using a fully 3D model of the single-turn coil with broken cylindrical symmetry. The calculated result revealed highly nonlinear diffusion of electric current, temperature, and magnetic fields, which are the sources of the inhomogeneous magnetic fields inside the single-turn coil in time and space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite element analysis（有限元分析）、multiphysics simulation（多物理场模拟）、3D model（三维模型）。；研究对象：单匝线圈（single-turn coil）在脉冲强磁场产生过程中的非线性扩散行为及磁场不均匀性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三维多物理场有限元模拟，揭示了单匝线圈中电流、温度和磁场的强非线性扩散过程，这些过程是导致线圈内部磁场在时间和空间上高度不均匀的根本原因。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三维多物理场有限元模拟，揭示了单匝线圈中电流、温度和磁场的强非线性扩散过程，这些过程是导致线圈内部磁场在时间和空间上高度不均匀的根本原因。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元方法（FEM）对破坏圆柱对称性的单匝线圈进行全三维多物理场建模与仿真计算。

papers.title: Berry-phase in a periodically driven single molecule magnet transistor
papers.abstract: We consider the electron transport through a single molecule magnet transistor in the presence of a local transverse magnetic field and ac-driven gate voltage. We calculate the conductance as a function of the electron energy and transverse magnetic field by using the Floquet and Landauer formalism. We show that the time periodic potential causes zero transmission resonances that oscillate as a function of the transverse magnetic field due to the Berry phase interference associated with two quantum tunneling paths. We find that these Berry phase oscillations can be detected in the conductance as a function of the transverse magnetic field for an incoming electron with a specific energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Floquet formalism、Landauer formalism、Berry phase interference。；研究对象：单分子磁体晶体管（single molecule magnet transistor）在局域横向磁场和交流驱动栅压下的电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间周期势（交流驱动栅压）会导致零透射共振，该共振随横向磁场振荡，其振荡源于与两个量子隧穿路径相关的贝里相位干涉。这种贝里相位振荡可在特定能量入射电子的电导随横向磁场的变化中被探测到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：时间周期势（交流驱动栅压）会导致零透射共振，该共振随横向磁场振荡，其振荡源于与两个量子隧穿路径相关的贝里相位干涉。这种贝里相位振荡可在特定能量入射电子的电导随横向磁场的变化中被探测到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet理论和Landauer公式计算电导作为电子能量和横向磁场的函数。

papers.title: Bipolaronic High-Temperature Superconductivity from Phonon-Modulated Hopping: A Perspective
papers.abstract: Phonon-mediated superconductivity is conventionally thought to be capped at a transition temperature $T_{\mathrm{c}}$ no larger than roughly one-tenth of the phonon frequency $Ω$, a bound rooted in the breakdown of Migdal-Eliashberg theory at intermediate coupling and in the heaviness of bipolarons formed in standard models with phonons that couple to the electron density. In this review I describe a route to phonon-mediated high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity that bypasses this bound. The key ingredient is a class of electron-phonon couplings in which lattice distortions modulate the electron hopping and therefore its kinetic energy rather than its potential energy, known as the Peierls model (also known as Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model). In these models phonon exchange generates an interaction that binds two electrons into a small but unusually light bipolaron. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a bond-Peierls model on the square and cubic lattices, my collaborators and I have shown that a dilute liquid of such bipolarons forms an $s$-wave superconductor with a $T_{\mathrm{c}}/Ω$ that significantly exceeds the conventional bound, that this conclusion is robust against screened Coulomb repulsion, and that $T_{\mathrm{c}}/Ω$ -- despite being reduced -- remains above bound in presence of strong long-range Coulomb repulsion. A semi-classical instanton analysis explains why, at strong coupling, bipolarons in models with phonon-modulated hopping are lighter than their density-coupled (Holstein) counterparts. I close with a discussion of materials in which this physics may be operative, in particular the iron-based pnictide superconductors, and of design principles that follow from it.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“review”、“sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations”、“semi-classical instanton analysis”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：声子调制的电子跳跃（Peierls模型/Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型）中的双极化子及其形成的高温超导机制。具体体系包括正方晶格和立方晶格上的键-Peierls模型，并讨论了铁基砷化物超导体等可能实现该物理的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在声子调制电子跳跃（而非电子密度）的模型中，双极化子异常轻，其稀液体可形成s波超导体，且超导转变温度与声子频率之比（T_c/Ω）显著超过传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论所认为的上限（约0.1），该结论在考虑屏蔽和非屏蔽库仑排斥后依然成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在声子调制电子跳跃（而非电子密度）的模型中，双极化子异常轻，其稀液体可形成s波超导体，且超导转变温度与声子频率之比（T_c/Ω）显著超过传统Migdal-Eliashberg理论所认为的上限（约0.1），该结论在考虑屏蔽和非屏蔽库仑排斥后依然成立。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统研究的对比细节，但明确指出该工作绕过传统声子超导的T_c上限，关键在于引入声子调制跳跃（Peierls型）而非密度型（Holstein型）的电子-声子耦合，并系统论证了其抗库仑排斥的鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 使用无符号问题的量子蒙特卡洛模拟（sign-problem-free QMC）对正方和立方晶格上的键-Peierls模型进行数值计算；采用半经典瞬子（instanton）分析解释强耦合下双极化子比Holstein模型更轻的机制。

papers.title: Machine Learning Approaches to Point Defects in Non-Metallic Materials: A Review of Methods
papers.abstract: We review recent machine-learning (ML) approaches for point defects in non-metallic materials, with an emphasis on defect formation energies. Existing studies largely fall into two categories: direct ML models that predict defect energetics from local structural representations, and machine-learning potentials (MLPs) that approximate the defect-containing potential energy surface. We summarize key achievements as well as persistent bottlenecks, emphasizing that dataset quality often dominates practical model performance. We further identify charged-defect formation energies as a central frontier, where Fermi-level alignment, finite-size corrections, and long-range electrostatics must be handled carefully and consistently to enable meaningful comparisons and transferable predictions across different materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据：标题中明确标注“A Review of Methods”，摘要中系统总结了已有研究分类和瓶颈。；研究对象：非金属材料中的点缺陷（point defects），重点聚焦缺陷形成能（defect formation energies）的机器学习预测。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有机器学习方法主要分为两类：基于局部结构表示直接预测缺陷能量的模型，以及近似含缺陷势能面的机器学习势函数。数据集质量是决定模型实际性能的关键瓶颈；带电缺陷形成能是当前前沿挑战，需谨慎处理费米能级对齐、有限尺寸修正和长程静电相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有机器学习方法主要分为两类：基于局部结构表示直接预测缺陷能量的模型，以及近似含缺陷势能面的机器学习势函数。数据集质量是决定模型实际性能的关键瓶颈；带电缺陷形成能是当前前沿挑战，需谨慎处理费米能级对齐、有限尺寸修正和长程静电相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但综述系统梳理了非金属材料点缺陷机器学习研究的分类、成就与瓶颈，并明确指出带电缺陷形成能作为前沿方向所需的关键技术挑战。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习方法，具体包括：直接机器学习模型（direct ML models）和机器学习势函数（machine-learning potentials, MLPs）。摘要未提及具体第一性原理方法（如DFT）或实验手段。

papers.title: Crystal growth and characterization of the ultra-high temperature substrate $\mathrm{Ta_{1-x}Hf_{x}C_{0.5}}$
papers.abstract: Incorporation of $\mathrm{Al_{y}Ga_{1-y}N}$ (AGN) semiconductors into high power electronics offers efficiency improvements in power transmission, generation, and use, if approaches to eliminate the defects arising from film-lattice mismatch can be established. Here, we report the optical floating zone crystal growth of $\mathrm{Ta_{1-x}Hf_{x}C_{0.5}}$ (x = 0.2), a new metallic substrate material family lattice matched to the ultra-wide-band-gap, Al-rich side (y = 0.91) of the AGN solid solution. Laue diffraction demonstrates large single crystal domains in the as-grown boule. Single crystal x-ray diffraction at T = 213 K in conjunction with first principles calculations shows that the material adopts a layered crystal structure with AA-type stacking of (Ta/Hf)-C-(Ta/Hf) trilayers described in the trigonal space group P-3m1 (#164), with a = 3.1168(4) Å, c = 4.9644(4) Å, and $β$ = 120.0°. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) measurements show the Hf:Ta ratio to be close to the nominal value of 0.8:0.2 in the grown crystal. Density Functional Theory calculations reveal that this structure is stabilized by the low energy of carbon-vacancy formation of a hypothetical $\mathrm{(Ta/Hf)_{1}C_{1}}$ anti-NiAs structure type, and imply flexibility in interface structure with an overlayer nitride film. A surface preparation/polishing procedure is developed that reduces root mean square (RMS) surface roughness from as-cut 130 nm to 7 nm as measured by atomic force microscopy. Scanning electron microscopy shows the presence of a native surface oxide, removed by polishing, along with carbon-rich pits. Time-domain thermoreflectance measurements show a room temperature thermal conductivity of $κ$ = 18.1(4) W m-1 K-1. These results provide key first steps for utilizing metallic, lattice matched, substrates for the growth of Al-rich AGN semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：crystal growth, characterization, X-ray diffraction, XPS, AFM, SEM, thermal conductivity measurement）；研究对象：新型金属衬底材料 Ta₁₋ₓHfₓC₀.₅（x=0.2），用于与富铝 AlGaN 半导体晶格匹配的超高温衬底。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ta₀.₈Hf₀.₂C₀.₅ 具有层状晶体结构（空间群 P-3m1），与 Al₀.₉₁Ga₀.₀₉N 晶格匹配，室温热导率为 18.1 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，为富铝 AlGaN 半导体提供了潜在的金属衬底方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ta₀.₈Hf₀.₂C₀.₅ 具有层状晶体结构（空间群 P-3m1），与 Al₀.₉₁Ga₀.₀₉N 晶格匹配，室温热导率为 18.1 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，为富铝 AlGaN 半导体提供了潜在的金属衬底方案。；创新点：首次报道了与富铝 AlGaN（y=0.91）晶格匹配的金属衬底 Ta₁₋ₓHfₓC₀.₅ 的晶体生长与全面表征，并揭示了其由碳空位稳定化的层状结构及与氮化物薄膜的界面灵活性。
papers.method_zh: 光学浮区法晶体生长、劳厄衍射、单晶 X 射线衍射（T=213 K）、X 射线光电子能谱（XPS）、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、时域热反射法（TDTR）测量热导率、第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Revealing Hund superdispersion with tunneling spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In cuprate superconductors, electron-electron repulsion results in characteristic spectroscopic features known as `waterfalls', where the sharp quasiparticle dispersion transitions into broad Hubbard bands. However, in multi-orbital systems, the additional Hund coupling results in behavior that defies the conventional Mott--Hubbard paradigm, creating qualitatively distinct `superdispersive' features in the spectral function. Here, we use tunneling spectroscopy to reveal this signature of Hund physics in Sr$_2$RuO$_4$. By combining density functional theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and continuum local density of states calculations, we show that the experimental features are in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions and intimately linked to the non-monotonous energy dependence of the real part of the self-energy in a Hund metal. Our results provide direct experimental evidence for Hund-induced spectroscopic features and open a new route to probing correlation effects in quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用隧穿谱实验”（tunneling spectroscopy），并结合了“密度泛函理论（DFT）、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）以及连续局域态密度计算”。；研究对象：多轨道 Hund 金属 Sr₂RuO₄ 中的“超色散”（superdispersion）光谱特征，以及 Hund 耦合导致的非传统 Mott-Hubbard 行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Sr₂RuO₄ 中，隧穿谱实验观测到的光谱特征与理论预测的 Hund 金属“超色散”特征高度吻合，该特征源于 Hund 金属自能实部的非单调能量依赖关系，为 Hund 耦合诱导的谱学特征提供了直接实验证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Sr₂RuO₄ 中，隧穿谱实验观测到的光谱特征与理论预测的 Hund 金属“超色散”特征高度吻合，该特征源于 Hund 金属自能实部的非单调能量依赖关系，为 Hund 耦合诱导的谱学特征提供了直接实验证据。；创新点：首次通过隧穿谱实验直接揭示了 Hund 金属中由 Hund 耦合产生的“超色散”谱学特征，突破了传统 Mott-Hubbard 图像对多轨道体系的理解，为探测量子材料中的关联效应提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用隧穿谱（tunneling spectroscopy）；理论上结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）以及连续局域态密度（continuum local density of states）计算。

papers.title: Data-driven analysis of metastability in a stochastic bistable system
papers.abstract: We study the metastability properties of a simple prototypical bistable system using the formalism of the Koopman operator. Instead of studying noise-induced transitions by following the trajectories of the system, we track them by studying the time evolution and the decay rate of the subdominant mode of the Koopman operator, thus in a geometry-agnostic framework. We find agreement with the predictions - both the exponential and subexponential ones - of large deviation theory in the weak-noise limit for the statistics of escape time, both in equilibrium and nonequilibrium conditions. The subdominant Koopman mode also allows for an accurate reconstruction of the competing basins of attraction. Going deeper in the Koopman spectrum, we are able to recognise modes that are associated with intrawell variability as well as with the escape of trajectories from the saddle towards the attractor, both in the equilibrium and nonequilibrium case. Our methodology, being grounded in purely data-driven techniques, could be helpful for studying high-dimensional metastable systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Koopman operator formalism”（Koopman算子形式）、“data-driven techniques”（数据驱动技术）、“large deviation theory”（大偏差理论）。；研究对象：一个简单的随机双稳系统的亚稳态性质。具体物理现象为噪声诱导的亚稳态跃迁。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用Koopman算子的次主导模式，可以在与几何无关的框架下，准确追踪噪声诱导的跃迁过程，其逃逸时间统计在弱噪声极限下与大偏差理论的指数和次指数预测一致。该方法还能精确重构吸引域，并识别与势阱内动力学及从鞍点到吸引子逃逸相关的模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用Koopman算子的次主导模式，可以在与几何无关的框架下，准确追踪噪声诱导的跃迁过程，其逃逸时间统计在弱噪声极限下与大偏差理论的指数和次指数预测一致。该方法还能精确重构吸引域，并识别与势阱内动力学及从鞍点到吸引子逃逸相关的模式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但该方法的核心新意在于：1）使用几何无关的Koopman算子框架来研究亚稳态，而非直接追踪系统轨迹；2）该方法完全基于数据驱动，有望应用于高维亚稳态系统。
papers.method_zh: 采用Koopman算子形式论，通过纯数据驱动的方法分析系统的亚稳态。具体通过研究Koopman算子次主导模式的时间演化和衰减率来追踪噪声诱导的跃迁，并与大偏差理论的预测进行对比。

papers.title: Ultrasonic determination of crystallographic texture by transmitted field fitting regardless of medium dispersivity
papers.abstract: The determination of crystallographic texture through elastic wave propagation offers a cost-effective, nondestructive means of obtaining through-thickness information with minimal sample preparation. Existing ultrasonic approaches rely on either bulk-wave or guided-wave velocity measurements for texture inversion. These strategies impose geometric constraints: bulk-wave methods become impractical for thin specimens, whereas guided-wave techniques are limited to relatively small thicknesses. Furthermore, many formulations assume orthotropic symmetry of the aggregate, thereby restricting their applicability to materials with higher anisotropy. In this work, a full-field wave fitting strategy is developed in which the transmitted ultrasonic field is simulated and directly compared to experimental measurements. Because the approach does not rely on bulk-wave or plate-wave approximations, it remains applicable across a broad range of specimen thicknesses. Furthermore, no macroscopic symmetry assumptions are imposed on the aggregate, enabling the characterization of generally anisotropic materials. The effective elastic response is computed using a Hashin-Shtrikman homogenization framework, which provides tighter bounds than classical Voigt-Reuss-Hill averages and constrains the admissible search space during optimization, thereby improving convergence. The nonlinear inverse problem is solved using a GPU-accelerated optimization scheme. The methodology is validated on materials with hexagonal and cubic crystal symmetry over a range of specimen thicknesses. The inferred texture coefficients show consistent agreement with independent diffraction measurements. Additionally, textures with weak elastic anisotropy are successfully recovered, demonstrating the robustness and versatility of the proposed method. Complete measurement and inversion are achieved within approximately 10 minutes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与实验混合类型。关键词：实验测量（transmitted ultrasonic field）、数值模拟（full-field wave fitting）、反演优化（GPU-accelerated optimization scheme）、验证（validated on materials）。；研究对象：多晶材料的晶体学织构（crystallographic texture）。具体体系包括具有六方和立方晶体对称性的材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于透射超声全场拟合的织构测定方法，该方法不依赖体波或板波近似，适用于任意厚度和任意各向异性程度的样品，且能在约10分钟内完成测量与反演。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于透射超声全场拟合的织构测定方法，该方法不依赖体波或板波近似，适用于任意厚度和任意各向异性程度的样品，且能在约10分钟内完成测量与反演。；创新点：1. 突破了传统超声方法对样品厚度的限制（体波法不适用于薄样品，导波法限于小厚度）。2. 不假设多晶集合体具有正交对称性，因此可表征一般各向异性材料。3. 采用Hashin-Shtrikman均匀化框架替代传统平均方法，提高了反演收敛性。
papers.method_zh: 1. 实验手段：透射超声全场测量（transmitted ultrasonic field）。2. 计算方法：全场波拟合策略（full-field wave fitting），将模拟的透射超声场与实验测量直接比较。3. 理论框架：Hashin-Shtrikman均匀化框架计算有效弹性响应，替代经典的Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均，提供更紧的上下界以约束优化搜索空间。4. 反演算法：GPU加速的非线性优化方案求解逆问题。

papers.title: Correlation-Driven Spin Reorientation via Competing Anisotropy Channels in CrPS4
papers.abstract: We identify a correlation-driven mechanism for the temperature-induced spin reorientation in the quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals antiferromagnet CrPS4. Magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) analysis resolves the local spin direction and shows that ferromagnetic intrachain correlations persist far above TN. Combining these correlations with a DFT-derived spin Hamiltonian reveals competing single-ion and exchange-anisotropy channels, with single-ion anisotropy remaining local while exchange anisotropy is renormalized as intersite correlations decay. This differential renormalization rotates the effective easy axis and captures the ordered-state canting. Above TN, the continued rotation beyond the model prediction delineates the limits of the dominant-chain approximation. These results establish mPDF-derived correlations as direct inputs to microscopic Hamiltonians and show how low-dimensional correlations can control magnetic anisotropy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。关键词：mPDF分析、DFT-derived spin Hamiltonian、实验与理论结合。；研究对象：准一维范德华反铁磁体CrPS₄中的温度诱导自旋重取向现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种关联驱动的自旋重取向机制：单离子各向异性保持局域性，而交换各向异性随层间关联衰减发生重整化，这种差异化的重整化导致有效易轴旋转，并解释了有序态的自旋倾斜。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种关联驱动的自旋重取向机制：单离子各向异性保持局域性，而交换各向异性随层间关联衰减发生重整化，这种差异化的重整化导致有效易轴旋转，并解释了有序态的自旋倾斜。；创新点：首次将mPDF导出的磁关联作为微观哈密顿量的直接输入，揭示了低维关联如何控制磁各向异性，并指出在TN以上温度，主导链近似失效的界限。
papers.method_zh: 磁对分布函数（mPDF）分析解析局域自旋方向；结合DFT推导的自旋哈密顿量，分析单离子各向异性和交换各向异性通道的竞争。

papers.title: From bulk to interface dynamics, in and out of equilibrium
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of weakly deformed interfaces separating two stable phases, starting from the fluctuating hydrodynamics of the phase-separating fields. Using a well-chosen definition for the interface and the dynamical-action formalism to represent path probabilities, we derive the linear relaxation of the interface and the fluctuations around it for a large class of models. Our method applies to equilibrium dynamics, where it recovers and complements existing results, but also extends to their non-equilibrium counterparts. We explain how non-linear terms can be systematically computed and illustrate their derivations in the case of (active) model A. We highlight the danger of a popular ansatz used to derive interface dynamics, which was rigorously established in equilibrium but is uncontrolled for active field theories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“fluctuating hydrodynamics”“dynamical-action formalism”“derive the linear relaxation”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验或数值计算。；研究对象：弱形变界面（weakly deformed interfaces）的动力学行为，特别是分离两稳定相的界面在平衡态与非平衡态下的弛豫与涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义合适的界面和路径概率的动力学作用量形式，推导出一大类模型中界面的线性弛豫及其周围涨落，并指出在活性场理论中一个流行的界面动力学假设（在平衡态中严格成立）在非平衡态下不可控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义合适的界面和路径概率的动力学作用量形式，推导出一大类模型中界面的线性弛豫及其周围涨落，并指出在活性场理论中一个流行的界面动力学假设（在平衡态中严格成立）在非平衡态下不可控。；创新点：该方法不仅适用于平衡态动力学（可复现并补充已有结果），还推广到非平衡体系；同时揭示了在活性场理论中广泛使用的界面动力学假设在非平衡下缺乏控制性。
papers.method_zh: 采用涨落流体力学（fluctuating hydrodynamics）描述相分离场，结合动力学作用量形式（dynamical-action formalism）表示路径概率，系统推导界面线性弛豫与涨落，并说明如何系统计算非线性项，以（活性）模型A为例进行演示。

papers.title: Universal dynamics from a single-particle dark state
papers.abstract: Open quantum systems can host dark or subradiant states whose decay is highly suppressed. While these states have been extensively studied in the few-excitation regime, their impact on the many-body dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we study a spin chain subject to correlated dissipation on neighboring sites, which admits a single-particle dark state at zero momentum. We show that the single-particle dark state qualitatively alters the many-body dynamics at long times, and identify its distinct universal behavior. While the zero-momentum mode is dark at the single-particle level, it decays slowly as $1/\log t$ as it becomes dressed by other modes through a dissipation-induced nonlinearity. We demonstrate that the momentum distribution takes a universal scaling form in $k\sqrt{t}$, and the total density decays as $1/\sqrt{t}\log t$. Our results further elucidate the origin of the conflicting results in recent works. Finally, we corroborate the analytics with matrix product state simulations and show that the same universal behavior persists for soft-core interactions, underscoring the universality of the emergent dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：open quantum systems, many-body dynamics, analytics, matrix product state simulations）；研究对象：受关联耗散作用的自旋链体系，具体关注其中单粒子暗态对多体动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单粒子暗态在耗散诱导的非线性作用下会被其他模式“修饰”，导致其缓慢衰减（1/log t），并产生普适的标度行为：动量分布呈k√t的标度形式，总密度按1/√t log t衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单粒子暗态在耗散诱导的非线性作用下会被其他模式“修饰”，导致其缓慢衰减（1/log t），并产生普适的标度行为：动量分布呈k√t的标度形式，总密度按1/√t log t衰减。；创新点：揭示了单粒子暗态在多体长时动力学中产生普适行为的机制，并澄清了近期工作中相互矛盾的结果的起源。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（耗散诱导非线性、标度理论）结合矩阵乘积态（MPS）数值模拟，并考虑软核相互作用验证普适性。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and statistical properties of a multifractional modified dispersion relation via the grand-canonical ensemble
papers.abstract: We study the thermodynamic and statistical properties of a gas governed by a multifractional modified dispersion relation of the form $ω^{2}=k^{2}+4E_{*}^{-1/2}k^{5/2}$, where $E_{*}$ sets the characteristic scale of the multifractional correction. Working within the grand-canonical ensemble, we derive the modified density of states, the grand potential, the partition function, and the main thermodynamic quantities for both bosonic and fermionic sectors. The deformation changes the available phase-space distribution and produces nonstandard thermal scalings controlled by the ratio $T/E_{*}$. In the infrared regime, the usual relativistic gas behavior is recovered with leading corrections proportional to powers of $(T/E_{*})^{1/2}$. In the ultraviolet regime, the density of states scales as $\varrho(ω)\propto ω^{7/5}$, corresponding to an effective density-of-states dimension $d_{\mathrm{eff}}=12/5$. As a consequence, the Stefan-Boltzmann law is deformed from $u\propto T^{4}$ to $u\propto E_{*}^{3/5}T^{17/5}$, while the equation-of-state parameter approaches $w=5/12$ instead of the standard radiation value $w=1/3$. We also analyze thermal stability, particle number and energy fluctuations, Bose-Einstein condensation, and the degenerate Fermi gas limit. The multifractional correction increases the critical temperature of a conserved bosonic gas and modifies the Fermi energy, pressure, sound speed, and low-temperature heat capacity of degenerate fermions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：grand-canonical ensemble（巨正则系综）、modified dispersion relation（修正色散关系）、thermodynamic and statistical properties（热力学与统计性质）。；研究对象：受一种多分形修正色散关系（形式为 ω² = k² + 4Eₓ⁻¹/² k⁵/²）支配的气体系统，其中 Eₓ 为多分形修正的特征能标。研究涵盖玻色子和费米子两种统计情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多分形修正改变了态密度标度，导致红外区恢复相对论气体行为但带有 (T/Eₓ)¹/² 幂次修正；紫外区态密度标度为 ϱ(ω) ∝ ω⁷/⁵，有效态密度维度 d_eff = 12/5，从而将 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律从 u ∝ T⁴ 变形为 u ∝ Eₓ³/⁵ T¹⁷/⁵，状态方程参数从标准辐射值 w=1/3 变为 w=5/12。此外，该修正提高了守恒玻色气体的临界温度，并改变了简并费米气体的费米能、压强、声速及低温热容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多分形修正改变了态密度标度，导致红外区恢复相对论气体行为但带有 (T/Eₓ)¹/² 幂次修正；紫外区态密度标度为 ϱ(ω) ∝ ω⁷/⁵，有效态密度维度 d_eff = 12/5，从而将 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律从 u ∝ T⁴ 变形为 u ∝ Eₓ³/⁵ T¹⁷/⁵，状态方程参数从标准辐射值 w=1/3 变为 w=5/12。此外，该修正提高了守恒玻色气体的临界温度，并改变了简并费米气体的费米能、压强、声速及低温热容。；创新点：将多分形修正色散关系（包含非整数幂次项）系统地引入统计力学分析，揭示了其导致的非标准热力学标度律（如有效维度、变形 Stefan-Boltzmann 定律和状态方程参数），并全面评估了其对玻色和费米子系统关键性质的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用巨正则系综理论框架，推导了修正色散关系下的态密度、巨势、配分函数以及主要热力学量，并分析了热稳定性、粒子数与能量涨落、玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚和简并费米气体极限。

papers.title: The problem of relaxation to equilibrium
papers.abstract: When a thermodynamic system is released from any constraint, after some time its evolution will render it into an equilibrium state. Although the description of this relaxation to thermodynamic equilibrium has been attempted through both classical (Hamilton's equations) or quantum (Schrödinger equation) approaches, no success has been achieved without recurring to additional hypotheses. The present work demonstrates the possibility of reaching equilibrium states in a simple classical gaseous system, by imposing non-strict boundary conditions, in the sense that all interactions with the container walls must occur according to Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：经典气体系统、哈密顿方程、海森堡不确定性原理、非严格边界条件。；研究对象：经典气体系统从非平衡态向热力学平衡态的弛豫过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入基于海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件（即气体与容器壁的相互作用必须遵循该原理），可以在经典气体系统中实现向平衡态的弛豫，而无需额外假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入基于海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件（即气体与容器壁的相互作用必须遵循该原理），可以在经典气体系统中实现向平衡态的弛豫，而无需额外假设。；创新点：提出并论证了通过非严格边界条件（而非传统严格边界条件）实现经典系统向热力学平衡态弛豫的可能性，避免了以往理论中需要引入额外假设的问题。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与分析。采用经典力学框架（哈密顿方程），但将容器壁的相互作用条件修改为符合海森堡不确定性原理的非严格边界条件。

papers.title: Irreversibility from Self-Reference: Gradient Flow and an H-Theorem for a Self-Referential Statistical Operator Framework
papers.abstract: This paper is a direct companion to arXiv:2605.06705, where the self-referential operator Omega was introduced and the Tsallis index q = alpha + beta was derived as a fixed-point condition within the local kernel approximation (LKA). Here we address four aspects deferred from the previous work. First, we carry out the first-order perturbative expansion of Omega beyond the LKA and demonstrate structural stability of q = alpha + beta at leading order in (xi/L)^2. Second, we define the iterative dynamical scheme Psi_(n+1) = Omega[Psi_n] and analyze convergence via Frechet spectral radius. Third, and centrally, we establish an H-theorem rigorously within the LKA for both the discrete iteration and the continuous gradient flow: we compute dF/dtau explicitly along the flow, identify the negative semi-definite dissipation term, establish the result rigorously in the LKA using strict convexity of F proved in the companion paper, and provide numerical evidence showing monotone decrease of F[Psi_n] across 53 iterations on an N = 80 discrete system. Fourth, we characterize the non-perturbative role of the self-coupling parameter kappa, identifying a re-entrant disordered phase at kappa > kappa* approximately 0.50 +/- 0.05. The paper is explicit about what is proved, what is established numerically, and what open problems remain for a complete analytical proof beyond the LKA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：self-referential statistical operator framework、H-theorem、gradient flow、perturbative expansion、numerical evidence。；研究对象：自指统计算子框架（self-referential statistical operator framework）中的不可逆性、迭代动力学与相变行为，具体涉及Tsallis指数q的稳定性、自由能单调递减（H定理）以及自耦合参数κ导致的再入无序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域核近似（LKA）内严格证明了离散迭代与连续梯度流下的H定理（自由能单调递减），并发现自耦合参数κ超过约0.50±0.05时系统出现再入无序相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域核近似（LKA）内严格证明了离散迭代与连续梯度流下的H定理（自由能单调递减），并发现自耦合参数κ超过约0.50±0.05时系统出现再入无序相。；创新点：首次在自指统计算子框架内建立严格的H定理（LKA内），并揭示自耦合参数κ的非微扰作用——再入无序相。摘要未突出说明与已有非平衡统计框架（如标准熵产生理论）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值计算相结合。具体包括：一阶微扰展开（超越LKA）、Frechet谱半径分析收敛性、LKA内严格凸性证明H定理、53次迭代（N=80离散系统）的数值验证。

papers.title: Long Spin Relaxation Times in CVD-Grown Nanodiamonds
papers.abstract: Currently, the primary applications of fluorescent nanodiamonds (FNDs) are in the area of biosensing, by using photoluminescence or spin properties of colour centres, mainly represented by the Nitrogen Vacancy (NV) point defect. The sensitivity of NV-FNDs to external fields is, however, limited by crystallographic defects, which influence their key quantum state characteristics - the spin longitudinal (\textit{T$_1$}) and spin transversal (\textit{T$_2$}) relaxation and coherence times, respectively. We report on utilising an advanced FND growth technique consisting of heterogeneous nucleation on pre-engineered sites to create FNDs averaging around 60 nm in size, with mean longitudinal coherence times of 800 $μ$s and a maximum over 1.8 ms, close to bulk theoretical values. This is a major, nearly ten-fold improvement over commercially available nanodiamonds for the same size range of 50 to 150 nm. Heavy-N doped nanodiamond shells, important for sensing events in nm proximity to the diamond surface, are fabricated and discussed in terms of re-nucleation and twinning on \{111\} crystal facets. We also discuss scalability issues in order to enable the production of FND volumes matching the needs of sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了利用先进生长技术制备纳米金刚石，并测量其自旋弛豫时间等实验数据。；研究对象：化学气相沉积（CVD）生长的荧光纳米金刚石（FNDs），具体研究其氮空位（NV）色心的自旋纵向弛豫时间（T₁）和自旋横向弛豫时间（T₂）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过异质成核于预设计位点的先进生长技术，制备出平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石，其平均纵向相干时间（T₁）达到800 μs，最大值超过1.8 ms，接近块体理论值，比同等尺寸范围的商用纳米金刚石提高了近十倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过异质成核于预设计位点的先进生长技术，制备出平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石，其平均纵向相干时间（T₁）达到800 μs，最大值超过1.8 ms，接近块体理论值，比同等尺寸范围的商用纳米金刚石提高了近十倍。；创新点：实现了纳米金刚石自旋弛豫时间（T₁）近十倍的提升，接近块体理论值，并讨论了重氮掺杂壳层在近表面传感中的应用及规模化生产问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用先进CVD生长技术，具体为在预设计位点上进行异质成核，制备平均尺寸约60 nm的纳米金刚石；同时制备了重氮掺杂的纳米金刚石壳层，并利用{111}晶面上的再成核和孪晶现象进行讨论。

papers.title: A Unified Critical Scaling Theory for Macroscopic Lightning and Quantum Avalanches: From Three-Dimensional Directed Percolation to Testable Predictions
papers.abstract: Lightning, the most colossal discharge in nature, and flux avalanches in quantum superconductors--phenomena separated by twenty orders of magnitude in scale--display striking fractal similarity. We demonstrate that this is no mere analogy but reveals a deep physical unity. Here, we establish a universal theoretical framework that connects them. By mapping both onto the same three-dimensional reaction-diffusion-advection equation grounded in non-equilibrium statistical physics, we show they belong to the same critical universality class. We demonstrate that both systems belong to the three-dimensional Directed Percolation (3D-DP) universality class near their critical point, sharing a unified set of universal critical exponents (e.g., avalanche size distribution exponent $τ\approx 1.41$ , fractal dimension $D_f \approx 2.5$). Furthermore, by incorporating the anisotropy and turbulence coupling intrinsic to real thunderstorm environments, we predict novel effects such as anisotropic fractality of lightning channels and the systematic shift of critical exponents by turbulence. The core theoretical breakthrough lies in proposing a geometric correspondence of quantum phase information: through a rigorous mapping, the microscopic quantum phase coherence of superconductors is translated into the curvature and torsion distributions of macroscopic lightning channels, revealing a quantum statistical fingerprint emergent in classical geometry. This framework not only provides a unified paradigm for understanding dissipative structures across scales but also, via seven testable predictions, opens avenues for simulating natural lightning with laboratory quantum systems and developing novel physical early-warning methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“建立统一理论框架”、“映射到同一反应-扩散-平流方程”、“提出几何对应”等理论推导和预测，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：宏观闪电（自然界最大放电现象）与量子超导体中的磁通雪崩（尺度相差20个数量级）的临界现象统一性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 闪电与量子雪崩属于同一临界普适类——三维有向渗流（3D-DP），共享统一的临界指数（如雪崩尺寸分布指数τ≈1.41，分形维数D_f≈2.5），并可通过量子相位信息的几何对应将超导微观量子相干性映射为闪电通道的曲率与挠率分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：闪电与量子雪崩属于同一临界普适类——三维有向渗流（3D-DP），共享统一的临界指数（如雪崩尺寸分布指数τ≈1.41，分形维数D_f≈2.5），并可通过量子相位信息的几何对应将超导微观量子相干性映射为闪电通道的曲率与挠率分布。；创新点：首次将宏观闪电与微观量子雪崩统一到三维有向渗流普适类，并建立量子相位信息与经典几何结构（曲率、挠率）之间的严格对应关系，揭示经典几何中涌现的量子统计指纹。摘要未突出说明与已有分形类比研究的区别。
papers.method_zh: 基于非平衡统计物理的三维反应-扩散-平流方程，将两种现象映射到同一理论框架；通过引入真实雷暴环境中的各向异性与湍流耦合，预测各向异性分形及临界指数系统性偏移；提出量子相位信息的几何对应映射。

papers.title: Nonlinear Ohmic electromagnetic response
papers.abstract: We systematically investigate nonlinear Ohmic responses in second-harmonic generation and bilinear magnetoelectric effects within the Matsubara Green's function formalism. The optical nonlinear Ohmic conductivity is shown to consist of a nonlinear Drude-like part and an intrinsic term determined by the fully symmetrized normalized quantum metric dipole. Notably, we predict a previously unrecognized intrinsic Ohmic conductivity arising from band geometry in the bilinear magnetoelectric response, which exhibits transverse behavior similar to its optical counterpart. Using a two-dimensional Dirac model, we demonstrate that this geometrically induced nonlinear Ohmic response is observable in materials with high Fermi velocity and narrow band gaps. Our work provides a systematic quantum field-theoretic framework for describing nonlinear Ohmic transport in condensed matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Matsubara Green's function formalism、quantum field-theoretic framework、systematically investigate。；研究对象：凝聚态体系中非线性欧姆响应的物理现象，具体包括二次谐波产生（second-harmonic generation）和双线性磁电效应（bilinear magnetoelectric effects）中的非线性输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现非线性欧姆电导率由非线性类Drude部分和由完全对称归一化量子度量偶极子决定的本征项组成；在双线性磁电响应中预测了一种此前未被认识到的、源于能带几何的本征欧姆电导率，其横向行为与光学对应物类似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现非线性欧姆电导率由非线性类Drude部分和由完全对称归一化量子度量偶极子决定的本征项组成；在双线性磁电响应中预测了一种此前未被认识到的、源于能带几何的本征欧姆电导率，其横向行为与光学对应物类似。；创新点：首次在双线性磁电效应中识别出由能带几何（量子度量）诱导的本征欧姆电导率，并建立了描述非线性欧姆输运的系统量子场论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用Matsubara Green's function形式论进行系统理论分析，并利用二维狄拉克模型进行数值演示。

papers.title: Anomalous Diffusion as Structural Memory: An Extended Structural Dynamics Approach
papers.abstract: Sub-diffusion in biological systems is conventionally treated as anomalous, requiring fractional derivatives, heavy-tailed waiting times, or fitted memory kernels. We argue that this anomaly is an artifact of an incomplete phase space. Standard frameworks model diffusing particles as points. Biological molecules are not points. They are three-dimensional deformable entities whose position, orientation, and internal structure are irreducible physical properties, not modeling conveniences appended to a point mass. Within the Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) framework, each particle is a primitive structured entity with translational, orientational, and deformational degrees of freedom. When dynamics on this full phase space are projected onto the translational subspace alone, a memory kernel emerges from the projection without phenomenological postulate. The subdiffusion exponent is determined by the internal mode spectrum, independently measurable from B-factors, NMR order parameters, or molecular dynamics simulations, without fitting to transport data. Four falsifiable predictions follow: subdiffusion strength correlates with molecular flexibility; temperature drives crossover to normal diffusion at a characteristic energy scale set by internal mode frequencies; a non-zero rotation-translation cross-correlation spectrum encodes internal dynamics, identically zero in point-particle models; and memory timescales scale as the square of particle size. Quantitative consistency with experimental observations for proteins in crowded media is demonstrated using independently estimated structural parameters. What appears anomalous from the point-particle perspective is the expected behavior of structured matter projected onto an impoverished description. The anomaly is not in the physics. It is in the phase space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) framework”理论框架，进行数学推导和预测，未提及实验或计算模拟的具体实施。；研究对象：生物大分子（如蛋白质）在拥挤介质中的亚扩散（sub-diffusion）输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统观点视为反常的亚扩散，实际上是点粒子模型忽略分子内部结构自由度（平动、转动、形变）导致的投影假象。当在完整相空间（Extended Structural Dynamics框架）中考虑分子的三维可变形实体属性时，亚扩散指数可由内部模式谱独立确定，无需拟合输运数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统观点视为反常的亚扩散，实际上是点粒子模型忽略分子内部结构自由度（平动、转动、形变）导致的投影假象。当在完整相空间（Extended Structural Dynamics框架）中考虑分子的三维可变形实体属性时，亚扩散指数可由内部模式谱独立确定，无需拟合输运数据。；创新点：首次将生物分子亚扩散归因于相空间不完整（而非引入分数阶导数或重尾等待时间等唯象假设），并提出亚扩散强度与分子柔性相关、温度驱动交叉扩散、非零旋转-平动交叉相关谱、记忆时间尺度与粒子尺寸平方成正比等四个可证伪预测，且用独立结构参数定量验证了实验观测。
papers.method_zh: Extended Structural Dynamics (ESD) 理论框架：将每个粒子视为具有平动、转动和形变自由度的原始结构化实体，通过将完整相空间动力学投影到平动子空间，自然导出记忆核，并利用B因子、NMR序参数或分子动力学模拟独立获取内部模式谱。

papers.title: Resonant two-cluster scattering in a quasi-one-dimensional Bose gas
papers.abstract: We investigate two-cluster scattering in a quasi-one-dimensional Bose gas. We focus on the effective three-body interaction induced by transverse confinement, which is the leading term for breaking integrability in the quasi-one-dimensional setting. Exploiting the Lüscher formula and the integrability of the Lieb-Liniger Bose gas, we find a finite and positive scattering length for elastic two-cluster scattering. The resulting scattering lengths indicate the emergence of a resonance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate（研究）、exploiting the Lüscher formula（利用Lüscher公式）、integrability（可积性）。；研究对象：准一维玻色气体中的两团簇散射过程，特别是由横向约束诱导的有效三体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弹性两团簇散射的散射长度是有限且为正的，并且该散射长度表明存在一个共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弹性两团簇散射的散射长度是有限且为正的，并且该散射长度表明存在一个共振。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用Lüscher公式以及Lieb-Liniger玻色气体的可积性进行理论分析。

papers.title: Field Theory Models for a Holographic Superconductor in Two Dimensions
papers.abstract: We investigate field theory models of holographic superconductors in which the condensation of the order parameter is induced by a Robin boundary condition. Assuming large-$c$ factorization, we study the phase diagram of a two-dimensional CFT deformed by a relevant double-trace perturbation. Using modular invariance, we relate the high- and low-temperature phases, reproducing analytically the results for the zero-winding sector of the holographic model. Moreover, we match the near-critical behaviour of the condensate with an effective Ginzburg--Landau field theory description. Another important feature of the holographic superconductor is the presence of vortices that carry fractional magnetic flux. We investigate a field theory toy model with similar properties and interpret it as a fractional Little--Parks effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：field theory models、holographic superconductor、modular invariance、Ginzburg--Landau field theory。；研究对象：二维全息超导体的场论模型，重点研究由Robin边界条件诱导的序参量凝聚、双迹形变下的二维CFT相图、以及携带分数磁通涡旋的分数Little–Parks效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过模不变性解析地关联了高温与低温相，再现了全息模型中零绕数扇区的结果；同时发现凝聚体的近临界行为可用有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述，并提出了一个具有类似性质的场论玩具模型来解释分数磁通涡旋现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过模不变性解析地关联了高温与低温相，再现了全息模型中零绕数扇区的结果；同时发现凝聚体的近临界行为可用有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述，并提出了一个具有类似性质的场论玩具模型来解释分数磁通涡旋现象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用大c因子化假设下的二维CFT双迹形变理论，利用模不变性分析相图；结合有效Ginzburg–Landau场论描述近临界行为；构建场论玩具模型模拟分数Little–Parks效应。

papers.title: Pointwise Generalization in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We address the fundamental question of why deep neural networks generalize by establishing a pointwise generalization theory for fully connected networks. This framework resolves long-standing barriers to characterizing the rich nonlinear feature-learning regime and builds a new statistical foundation for representation learning. For each trained model, we characterize the hypothesis via a pointwise Riemannian Dimension, derived from the eigenvalues of the learned feature representations across layers. This establishes a principled framework for deriving hypothesis-dependent, representation-aware generalization bounds. These bounds offer a systematic upgrade over approaches based on model size, products of norms, and infinite-width linearizations, yielding guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter in both theory and experiment. Analytically, we identify the structural properties and mathematical principles that explain the tractability of deep networks. Empirically, the pointwise Riemannian Dimension exhibits substantial feature compression, decreases with increased over-parameterization, and captures the implicit bias of optimizers. Taken together, our results indicate that deep networks are mathematically tractable in practical regimes and that their generalization is sharply explained by pointwise, feature-spectrum-aware complexity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：generalization theory, statistical foundation, analytical identification）；研究对象：深度神经网络（全连接网络）的泛化能力，属于机器学习理论范畴，非传统凝聚态物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了深度神经网络的逐点泛化理论，指出网络的泛化能力可由一个基于逐点黎曼维数的复杂度度量来精确解释，该度量在理论和实验上都比传统方法（如基于模型大小或范数乘积）的界限紧多个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了深度神经网络的逐点泛化理论，指出网络的泛化能力可由一个基于逐点黎曼维数的复杂度度量来精确解释，该度量在理论和实验上都比传统方法（如基于模型大小或范数乘积）的界限紧多个数量级。；创新点：1）首次建立了能够刻画深度神经网络丰富非线性特征学习机制的逐点泛化理论框架；2）提出了一个全新的、基于特征谱的复杂度度量（逐点黎曼维数），替代了传统的基于模型尺寸或无限宽线性化的方法，从而获得了更紧的泛化保证；3）揭示了深度网络在实用场景下是数学上可处理的，并阐明了其泛化能力由逐点、特征谱感知的复杂度决定。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体包括：1）通过分析各层学习到的特征表示的特征值，定义了逐点黎曼维数；2）基于此维数推导了假设依赖、表示感知的泛化界限；3）通过理论推导和数值实验验证了该界限的有效性。

papers.title: Krylov complexity and fidelity susceptibility in two-band Hamiltonians
papers.abstract: We investigate Krylov spread complexity for the ground state of two-band Hamiltonians, where the reference state is a generic state on the Bloch sphere. The spread complexity is obtained by using a purely geometric formulation in terms of Bloch sphere data without constructing the circuit Hamiltonian. For generic reference states, the derivative of the spread complexity is logarithmically divergent at the topological phase transition in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. We demonstrate that the derivative of the spread complexity is bounded by fidelity susceptibility for general two-band models, indicating the sensitivity of the spread complexity to any gap closing (topological or trivial). This is illustrated in the massive Dirac Hamiltonian with a trivial gap closing. Finally, we introduce a non-unitary duality in the SSH model between the topological and trivial phases, which manifests itself in the spread complexity and fidelity susceptibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：几何公式、非幺正对偶性、模型分析（无实验或计算模拟描述）。；研究对象：两带哈密顿量（如Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型、大质量狄拉克哈密顿量）中的基态Krylov扩展复杂度与保真度磁化率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在SSH模型拓扑相变处，扩展复杂度的导数呈对数发散；对于一般两带模型，扩展复杂度的导数受保真度磁化率上界约束，表明其对任何能隙闭合（拓扑或平庸）均敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在SSH模型拓扑相变处，扩展复杂度的导数呈对数发散；对于一般两带模型，扩展复杂度的导数受保真度磁化率上界约束，表明其对任何能隙闭合（拓扑或平庸）均敏感。；创新点：建立了扩展复杂度与保真度磁化率之间的解析界限关系，并发现SSH模型中拓扑相与平庸相之间的非幺正对偶性在扩展复杂度和保真度磁化率中的体现。
papers.method_zh: 基于布洛赫球数据的纯几何公式推导Krylov扩展复杂度，无需构造电路哈密顿量；通过SSH模型和大质量狄拉克哈密顿量进行理论验证。

papers.title: A Practical Noise2Noise Denoising Pipeline for High-Throughput Raman Spectroscopy
papers.abstract: A lightweight and reproducible denoising pipeline for high-throughput Raman spectroscopy is presented. The approach relies on a one-dimensional convolutional autoencoder trained using a Noise2Noise strategy, requiring neither external spectral libraries nor high signal-to-noise reference spectra for training. From a reduced training subset composed of repeated short-exposure acquisitions, the model learns to reconstruct Raman spectra while efficiently suppressing stochastic noise. The method is evaluated on a heterogeneous mineral sample, using both quantitative spectral fidelity metrics (RMSE, SNR, SSIM) and task-oriented criteria based on unsupervised K-means classification. Results demonstrate that integration times as short as 5 ms per spectrum, which are typically insufficient for reliable interpretation, yield denoised spectra with high fidelity to the reference data while preserving chemically coherent maps. This work provides a practical trade-off between spectral quality and acquisition speed, enabling fast, adaptable Raman workflows compatible with routine laboratory use. It also offers a transferable framework for other one-dimensional spectroscopic modalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：denoising pipeline、Raman spectroscopy、experimental evaluation on mineral sample）；研究对象：高吞吐量拉曼光谱数据，具体以异质矿物样品为测试对象，研究如何从短时间采集的低信噪比光谱中恢复高质量光谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用Noise2Noise策略训练的一维卷积自编码器，能够将每光谱仅5毫秒积分时间的原始数据去噪至与参考数据高度一致的光谱，同时保持化学分布图的准确性，实现了光谱质量与采集速度之间的实用平衡。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用Noise2Noise策略训练的一维卷积自编码器，能够将每光谱仅5毫秒积分时间的原始数据去噪至与参考数据高度一致的光谱，同时保持化学分布图的准确性，实现了光谱质量与采集速度之间的实用平衡。；创新点：提出了一种轻量级、可复现的去噪流程，专门针对高吞吐量拉曼光谱，无需高信噪比参考数据即可训练，显著缩短了所需积分时间（低至5 ms），并展示了该方法对其他一维光谱模态的可迁移性。
papers.method_zh: 使用一维卷积自编码器，基于Noise2Noise训练策略（无需外部光谱库或高信噪比参考谱），仅利用重复短曝光采集的子集进行训练；通过定量指标（RMSE、SNR、SSIM）和基于无监督K-means分类的任务导向标准进行评价。

papers.title: Quantum Emitters at Telecommunication Wavelengths based on Carbon Defects in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional materials have emerged as promising hosts for quantum emitters, whose emission typically arises from either strain-induced band bending or defect-induced two-level systems. Among these materials, transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers have attracted particular attention; however, their performance is limited by strong photoluminescence (PL) quenching at room temperature. As TMDs transition from a direct to an indirect bandgap when moving from monolayers to multilayers, we herein propose a strategy to overcome this quenching limitation by exploiting the indirect bandgap of TMD bilayers in combination with a point defect doping. The indirect gap suppresses excitonic PL, while specific defects enable robust defect-mediated quantum emission. Using hybrid-functional density functional theory, we investigate substitutional carbon defects at chalcogen sites (S and Se) in WS2, WSe2, MoS2, and MoSe2 bilayers and comprehensively characterize their optical properties. Both neutral and singly negative charge states are found to be thermodynamically stable. Neutral defects exhibit singlet configurations with emission in the O- and C-band telecommunication windows, whereas negatively charged defects adopt doublet configurations featuring spin-selective transitions and near-infrared emission. The electron-phonon coupling strength, radiative lifetime, and dipole orientation are found to depend sensitively on both the host material and defect site, providing distinct fingerprints for experimental identification. Our findings, therefore, establish carbon-doped TMD bilayers as promising platforms for room-temperature defect-based quantum emitters operating at telecommunication wavelengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“hybrid-functional density functional theory”（杂化泛函密度泛函理论）、“investigate”、“comprehensively characterize their optical properties”。；研究对象：过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）双层中的替代性碳缺陷（位于硫族元素S和Se位点），具体材料包括WS₂、WSe₂、MoS₂和MoSe₂的双层体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碳掺杂的TMD双层材料中，中性缺陷在O波段和C波段电信窗口发射，带负电缺陷具有自旋选择性跃迁和近红外发射，且电子-声子耦合强度、辐射寿命和偶极取向对宿主材料和缺陷位点敏感，为室温电信波长量子发射器提供了可行平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碳掺杂的TMD双层材料中，中性缺陷在O波段和C波段电信窗口发射，带负电缺陷具有自旋选择性跃迁和近红外发射，且电子-声子耦合强度、辐射寿命和偶极取向对宿主材料和缺陷位点敏感，为室温电信波长量子发射器提供了可行平台。；创新点：提出利用TMD双层材料的间接带隙特性（抑制激子发光）结合点缺陷掺杂（实现缺陷介导的量子发射）的策略，克服了单层TMD在室温下光致发光淬灭的限制，并首次系统表征了碳缺陷在多种TMD双层中的电信波段发射特性。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函密度泛函理论（hybrid-functional DFT）计算，系统研究了碳缺陷的电子结构、光学性质（包括发射波长、自旋态、电子-声子耦合、辐射寿命和偶极取向）。

papers.title: Quantum magic of strongly correlated fermions $-$ the Hubbard dimer
papers.abstract: We study the non-stabilizerness (quantum magic) content of the Hubbard dimer, an analytically solvable, yet completely non-trivial, model of strongly correlated fermions. We can access zero- and finite-temperature properties as well as the time evolution in a quantum quench protocol. We evaluate local and nonlocal non-stabilizerness using both the robustness of magic and the stabilizer Renyi entropy, demonstrating how the latter often fails in detecting the mixed stabilizer states that are typically found in this kind of systems. Finally, we compare the non-stabilizerness with other genuine resources of quantum-state complexity, i.e., the fermionic non-Gaussianity and the superselected two-site entanglement. Our findings corroborate the notion of non-stabilizerness as a fundamentally different quantum resource, able to give profound insights that are missed by more traditional information-theoretic quantities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically solvable（可解析求解）、quantum quench protocol（量子淬火协议）、evaluate（评估）。；研究对象：Hubbard dimer（哈伯德二聚体），一个可解析求解但非平凡的强关联费米子模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文揭示了强关联费米子体系中非稳定化子（quantum magic）与费米子非高斯性、超选择两体纠缠等量子态复杂性资源本质不同，且稳定化子Rényi熵在检测混合稳定化子态时常常失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文揭示了强关联费米子体系中非稳定化子（quantum magic）与费米子非高斯性、超选择两体纠缠等量子态复杂性资源本质不同，且稳定化子Rényi熵在检测混合稳定化子态时常常失效。；创新点：系统比较了非稳定化子与费米子非高斯性、超选择两体纠缠等不同量子资源，指出非稳定化子能提供传统信息论量所遗漏的深刻物理洞察。
papers.method_zh: 利用Hubbard二聚体的可解析性，计算零温和有限温性质以及量子淬火动力学；采用鲁棒性（robustness of magic）和稳定化子Rényi熵两种度量来评估局域和非局域的非稳定化子含量。

papers.title: Topologically protected long-range correlations in steady states of driven-dissipative bosonic chains
papers.abstract: Driven-dissipative quantum systems can exhibit robust transport and amplification in topological regimes, yet the connection between topology and the extent of correlations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we develop a general framework that links topological phases in driven-dissipative systems to bosonic correlations via the singular value decomposition (SVD). In essence, we claim that non-Hermitian topology in quadratic Liouvillians is directly encoded in steady-state correlations, providing an intrinsic characterization of topology without external probes. We show that topological amplification induces disorder-robust long-range order (LRO) in steady-state correlations at fixed frequency, establishing frequency-resolved correlations as direct signatures of non-Hermitian topological phases. We introduce a vector-valued topological invariant that captures the total number of singular-value gap closings across the frequency axis, extending the concept of adiabatic deformation from topological insulators to the case of topological phases of quadratic Liouvillians. Within this framework, we further demonstrate that the spatial structure of equal-time correlations encodes global topological information, manifested as a Gaussian spatial decay with distance in the topological phase, in contrast to the exponential decay characteristic of trivial phases. These findings open new avenues for quantum sensing and correlation engineering in non-Hermitian systems, with feasible implementations in platforms such as trapped ions and superconducting circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a general framework、claim、introduce、demonstrate。；研究对象：驱动-耗散玻色子链的稳态，具体研究非厄米拓扑相与玻色子关联函数之间的联系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米拓扑性直接编码在稳态关联函数中，拓扑放大效应可在固定频率下产生受无序保护的稳态长程有序；等时关联函数的空间结构在拓扑相中呈现高斯衰减，而平庸相中为指数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米拓扑性直接编码在稳态关联函数中，拓扑放大效应可在固定频率下产生受无序保护的稳态长程有序；等时关联函数的空间结构在拓扑相中呈现高斯衰减，而平庸相中为指数衰减。；创新点：首次将非厄米拓扑相与稳态关联函数直接关联，提出无需外部探针即可通过稳态关联函数内禀表征拓扑性质；引入频率分辨关联作为非厄米拓扑相的直接实验可观测信号。
papers.method_zh: 基于二次Liouvillian算符的奇异值分解（SVD）理论框架，引入向量值拓扑不变量来刻画频率轴上的奇异值能隙闭合次数，并推广了拓扑绝缘体中的绝热形变概念。

papers.title: A single multi-configuration Direct Electron Detector for various electron imaging and diffraction-based techniques in SEM
papers.abstract: Addressing the need for efficient and integrated multiscale crystallographic and defect analyses of advanced materials, this paper presents the implementation of a new multi-configuration detection system, integrating a single Timepix3-based direct electron detector (DED) in a scanning electron microscope (SEM). By combining precise translation and rotation movements, this system enables, for the first time, the use of the same detector to realize all principal diffraction geometries. These include conventional Electron BackScatter Diffraction (EBSD), off-axis Reflexion Kikuchi Diffraction (RKD), and Transmission Kikuchi Diffraction (TKD) in on-, off- and near-axis configurations. Furthermore, transitions between all these geometries are accomplished without hardware modification. On the other hand, this work presents efficient reconstruction of electron images using the detector data-driven feature, extending thus its applicability to BackScattered Electron imaging (BSE), Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging (ECCI) and Scanning Transmission Electron Imaging in SEM (STEM-in-SEM) characterizations. High-quality Kikuchi patterns easily indexable were acquired across all geometries as well as micrographs of dislocations in both reflection and transmission modes. This is achieved thanks to the flexibility of the implemented detector, the optimizations made in acquisition parameters, such as energy filtering settings, and the efficiency of the developed custom approach used for electron data post-processing. Through this work, it is demonstrated that with a single DED assisted by an orientable support, it is possible to perform multiple advanced microstructural characterizations of both bulk samples and thin foils in the same SEM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：implementation（实现）、acquired（采集）、demonstrated（演示）。；研究对象：扫描电子显微镜（SEM）中用于多尺度晶体学和缺陷分析的多构型直接电子探测器（DED）系统，涉及块体样品和薄箔的多种电子成像与衍射技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单个基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器配合可定向支撑，首次在同一SEM中实现了所有主要衍射几何（包括EBSD、RKD、TKD的多种构型）以及多种电子成像模式（BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM）的集成，无需硬件修改即可切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单个基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器配合可定向支撑，首次在同一SEM中实现了所有主要衍射几何（包括EBSD、RKD、TKD的多种构型）以及多种电子成像模式（BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM）的集成，无需硬件修改即可切换。；创新点：首次使用同一探测器实现所有主要衍射几何（EBSD、RKD、TKD的多种构型）的无硬件修改切换，并同时兼容多种电子成像模式，实现了单探测器对块体和薄箔样品进行多尺度微结构表征的集成化方案。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：在SEM中集成基于Timepix3的直接电子探测器，结合精确平移和旋转运动实现多构型切换；优化采集参数（如能量过滤设置）；开发自定义电子数据后处理方法。具体技术包括：EBSD、离轴RKD、TKD（同轴、离轴、近轴）、BSE、ECCI、STEM-in-SEM。

papers.title: Physics in the Public Square: University Extension as a Strategy for Integrating Physics Education and Science Communication
papers.abstract: University extension activities play a fundamental role in bridging the gap between academia and society by fostering the socialization of scientific knowledge. This study reports and analyzes an outreach activity conducted in a public space, involving undergraduate students enrolled in Physics I, Physics III, and Physics IV courses within the Physics Teacher Education Program at the State University of the Tocantina Region of Maranhao (UEMASUL). The activity was developed through the design and presentation of didactic experiments using low-cost materials. Its main objectives were to disseminate fundamental physics concepts to the community, stimulate public interest in science, and provide pre-service teachers with a formative experience integrating theory, practice, and social responsibility. Data were collected from questionnaires adminisvelopment of communication skills, and the strengthening of the university's social role, while also fostering scientific curitered to visitors (n = 52). The results indicate that the activity significantly contributed to student learning, the deosity among participants.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（教育实践与科学传播研究）。关键词：outreach activity（外展活动）、questionnaires（问卷调查）、analysis（分析）。；研究对象：大学物理教育中的科学传播活动，具体为巴西马拉尼昂州托坎廷纳地区州立大学（UEMASUL）物理教师教育项目中本科生在公共空间开展的物理教学实验展示。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该外展活动显著促进了本科生的学习、沟通技能发展以及大学社会角色的强化，同时提升了参与者的科学好奇心。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该外展活动显著促进了本科生的学习、沟通技能发展以及大学社会角色的强化，同时提升了参与者的科学好奇心。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过设计并使用低成本材料制作教学实验，在公共空间进行展示；采用问卷调查（n=52）收集数据，对活动效果进行定量与定性分析。

papers.title: Dissipation-assisted preparation of Floquet-Laughlin states in superconducting circuits
papers.abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are lattice analogs of fractional quantum Hall systems, where the interplay of strong interactions with a frustrated tunnelling kinetics leads to the emergence of a gapped ground state with long-range entanglement and anyonic excitations. The highly correlated nature of such systems makes their adiabatic preparation challenging already beyond the minimal system size of two particles. Considering Floquet implementations of the bosonic Harper-Hofstadter-Hubbard model of few photons in superconducting circuits, we design protocols for the driven-dissipative stabilization of its FCI ground state at half filling via quantum bath engineering. Dissipation control is achieved through the coupling to driven leaky cavity modes, which realize a tuneable artificial environment having the Floquet-FCI as its approximate fixed point. For systems of two, three and six particles, we show numerically how the flexibility of the control scheme further allows for the detection of fractional quantum Hall signatures in the stabilized steady states, including bulk incompressibility, Hall response and the trapping of fractional charges. Our results provide a concrete pathway to dissipation-assisted preparation of strongly correlated states in quantum simulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：设计协议、数值展示、量子浴工程。；研究对象：超导电路中的Floquet-Laughlin态（即分数陈绝缘体态），具体为玻色子Harper-Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中的少光子（2、3、6个粒子）系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过量子浴工程，利用驱动耗散腔模实现可控人工环境，可以稳定地制备出半填充的Floquet分数陈绝缘体基态，并在稳态中观测到体不可压缩性、霍尔响应和分数电荷俘获等分数量子霍尔效应特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过量子浴工程，利用驱动耗散腔模实现可控人工环境，可以稳定地制备出半填充的Floquet分数陈绝缘体基态，并在稳态中观测到体不可压缩性、霍尔响应和分数电荷俘获等分数量子霍尔效应特征。；创新点：提出并数值验证了一种通过受控耗散（而非绝热演化）来制备和稳定Floquet分数陈绝缘体态的具体方案，克服了强关联系统绝热制备的困难，并展示了利用该方案直接探测分数量子霍尔效应特征的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 理论设计与数值模拟。具体包括：1）基于Floquet理论实现玻色子Harper-Hofstadter-Hubbard模型；2）通过将系统耦合到驱动且有损耗的腔模来设计耗散，实现量子浴工程；3）利用数值方法（摘要未明确说明具体算法，如主方程或量子轨迹法）模拟2、3、6粒子系统的稳态性质。

papers.title: Localization of a quantum particle in a classical one-component plasma. Fluctuation-induced random potential and the Coulomb logarithm
papers.abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of disorder-induced localization for a quantum particle moving in a fully ionized classical one-component plasma, within the static-fluctuation approximation. The random potential acting on the particle originates from equilibrium thermal fluctuations of the ionic charge density, described within the random phase approximation (RPA). The resulting potential correlation function exhibits an unscreened $1/r$ tail at large distances, leading to a logarithmic divergence of the integrated disorder strength. Using the Feynman path-integral representation of the retarded Green's function and performing the Gaussian average over the fluctuations exactly, we obtain closed-form expressions for the length scale $\ell(k)$ that characterizes the exponential decay of the disorder-averaged Green's function, with Planck's constant fully restored. In the weak-disorder (high-energy) regime, $\ell(k) = \hbar^4 k^2 / [m^2 k_B T q_0^2 \ln(κL)]$; in the strong-disorder (low-energy) limit, $\ell = \frac{4\sqrt[3]{2}}{3} \big( \hbar^4 / [m^2 k_B T q_0^2 \ln(κL)] \big)^{1/3}$. Both limits contain the Coulomb logarithm $\ln(κL)$, providing a direct link between quantum localization and classical plasma kinetic theory. We also discuss the limitations of the static-disorder approximation and the role of dynamic screening in real plasmas.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：微观理论、静态涨落近似、费曼路径积分、高斯平均。；研究对象：经典单组分等离子体中运动的量子粒子的无序诱导局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在静态涨落近似下，由离子电荷密度热涨落产生的随机势在长程具有未屏蔽的1/r尾部，导致无序强度积分出现对数发散；量子局域化长度在弱无序（高能）和强无序（低能）极限下均包含库仑对数ln(κL)，建立了量子局域化与经典等离子体动理论之间的直接联系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在静态涨落近似下，由离子电荷密度热涨落产生的随机势在长程具有未屏蔽的1/r尾部，导致无序强度积分出现对数发散；量子局域化长度在弱无序（高能）和强无序（低能）极限下均包含库仑对数ln(κL)，建立了量子局域化与经典等离子体动理论之间的直接联系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用静态涨落近似，利用随机相位近似（RPA）描述离子电荷密度的平衡热涨落；通过费曼路径积分表示推迟格林函数，并对高斯涨落进行精确平均，得到描述无序平均格林函数指数衰减的长度尺度ℓ(k)的闭式表达式。

papers.title: Where solitons are in a KdV soliton gas
papers.abstract: The Korteweg-De Vries (KdV) equation is a paradigmatic model of integrable classical fields, admitting solitoning solutions. When many solitons are near to each other, their shapes are modified, and it is not manifest, from the KdV field, where they are. This is a key problem in the analysis of a soliton gas, as its main object, the density of states, is a number of solitons per unit length. How to define solitons' positions at finite densities in the macroscopic limit? A sensible criterium is that, projecting out solitons lying outside a mesoscopic region, the KdV field is unchanged in this region, and the result is a multi-soliton field supported there. In the context of emergent hydrodynamics, this is referred to as a fluid-cell projection. In this paper we solve this problem. We define solitons' positions and a fluid-cell projection, and show that it has these properties, without introducing radiative corrections. We show that the weak limit of conserved densities can be evaluated using the density of states. On large scales the solitons' positions satisfy the semi-classical Bethe equations introduced in the context Generalised Hydrodynamics, that accounts for the two-body scattering shift and encodes factorised scattering. A non-rigorous derivation reproduces the kinetic equation of the KdV soliton gas, first proposed by Gennady El in 2003 using Witham modulation theory from finite-gap solutions. The results hold under simple conditions on spectral parameters, and certain physically natural conditions on impact parameters. No randomness is required. Our proof is based on a novel tau function for the multi-soliton KdV field, which also allows us to obtain new bounds on the growth of the multi-soliton support and on the supremum of the field and its derivatives. We believe the methods are generalisable to other solitonic models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：KdV方程、可积系统、孤子气体、流体元投影、半经典Bethe方程、广义流体动力学。；研究对象：KdV孤子气体中孤子的位置定义问题，具体研究在有限密度下如何从KdV场中确定孤子的位置，以及密度与状态数的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需引入辐射修正的孤子位置定义和流体元投影方法，证明该定义下孤子位置在大尺度上满足半经典Bethe方程，并由此推导出KdV孤子气体的动力学方程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需引入辐射修正的孤子位置定义和流体元投影方法，证明该定义下孤子位置在大尺度上满足半经典Bethe方程，并由此推导出KdV孤子气体的动力学方程。；创新点：首次严格解决了KdV孤子气体中孤子位置的定义问题，并证明了无需随机性假设即可从该定义出发推导出El于2003年提出的孤子气体动力学方程。摘要未突出说明该方法与其他定义（如基于相位或质心）的具体比较。
papers.method_zh: 基于多孤子KdV场的全新tau函数，结合流体元投影方法，在宏观极限下分析孤子位置与守恒密度弱极限的关系，并利用半经典Bethe方程描述两体散射位移。

papers.title: Chern classes of Laughlin bundles on the quasihole moduli space
papers.abstract: We study fractional quantum Hall states with quasihole excitations, on Riemann surfaces of arbitrary genus. For configurations with $m$ quasiholes we construct a vector bundle above the $m$-th symmetric power of the curve so that the fiber at a point $\lbrace w_1,\dots,w_m \rbrace$ corresponds to the state with quasiholes localized at these positions. We determine the Chern character of this bundle via the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem and show that in the completely filled state, i.e. when the number of particles is maximal, the vector bundle is compatible with the condition of projective flatness. Furthermore, we obtain a generalization of this result to the case of multiple layers and multiple quasihole types. In genus zero and one, we construct explicit wave-functions and verify that the curvature of the associated Chern connection reproduces the predicted Chern classes. The Chern classes obtained match, term by term, the predicted decomposition of the Berry phase under quasihole exchange, into an extensive Aharonov--Bohm contribution and a fractional statistical contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“construct a vector bundle”“determine the Chern character via the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem”“construct explicit wave-functions”等理论构造与数学推导方法。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应中的准空穴激发态，特别是定义在任意亏格黎曼曲面上的Laughlin态及其对应的向量丛。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理确定了准空穴模空间上向量丛的陈特征，并证明在完全填充态（粒子数最大）下该向量丛满足射影平坦性条件；所得陈类逐项匹配准空穴交换下Berry相位分解为广延Aharonov-Bohm贡献与分数统计贡献的预言。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理确定了准空穴模空间上向量丛的陈特征，并证明在完全填充态（粒子数最大）下该向量丛满足射影平坦性条件；所得陈类逐项匹配准空穴交换下Berry相位分解为广延Aharonov-Bohm贡献与分数统计贡献的预言。；创新点：将准空穴模空间上的向量丛构造推广到任意亏格黎曼曲面，并进一步推广到多层及多类准空穴情形；在低亏格下通过显式波函数验证了陈类与Berry相位分解的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 利用代数几何中的Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch定理计算向量丛的陈特征；在亏格0和1情形下构造显式波函数，并验证相应Chern联络的曲率与预言陈类一致。

papers.title: Parameterized 4-Qubit EWL Quantum Game Circuits with Dirac-Solow-Swan Hamiltonian Integration for Quadruple Helix Disruptive Innovation Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: We present a novel parameterized 4-qubit Eisert-Wilkens-Lewenstein (EWL) quantum game circuit for recommender systems in quadruple helix innovation ecosystems (academia, industry, government, and civil society).
