papers.title: Biophysical Considerations for Rational Antibody and ADC Design
papers.abstract: Antibody-based therapeutics-including antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), bispecific antibodies, and novel formats-are reshaping oncology, yet key determinants of efficacy, safety, and manufacturability frequently emerge after conjugation and formulation. We argue that computational biophysics provides an underexploited framework to address this gap by connecting molecular interactions to biological outcomes. We highlight how molecular dynamics, coarse-grained simulations, and free energy calculations reveal how conjugation site, linker chemistry, and drug-antibody ratio reshape conformational landscapes. We emphasize structural coupling between antibody, linker, and payload, with implications for antigen binding, internalization, and developability. We propose that integrating physics-based modeling into development pipelines-alongside experimental validation-can reduce empirical iteration and de-risk translation. As force fields, and hybrid physics-machine-learning methods improve, this field is poised to become a central driver of next-generation ADC design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“computational biophysics”、“molecular dynamics”、“coarse-grained simulations”、“free energy calculations”以及“physics-based modeling”。；研究对象：抗体药物（包括抗体偶联药物ADC、双特异性抗体等）的分子设计。具体物理现象包括：抗体与连接子（linker）、药物（payload）之间的构象耦合，以及这些相互作用对抗原结合、内化过程和药物可开发性（developability）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 计算生物物理学（如分子动力学、粗粒化模拟）能够揭示抗体偶联位点、连接子化学性质和药物-抗体比率如何重塑抗体分子的构象景观，从而将分子层面的相互作用与生物疗效和安全性的关键决定因素联系起来。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：计算生物物理学（如分子动力学、粗粒化模拟）能够揭示抗体偶联位点、连接子化学性质和药物-抗体比率如何重塑抗体分子的构象景观，从而将分子层面的相互作用与生物疗效和安全性的关键决定因素联系起来。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体的创新点，但整体上主张将计算生物物理学（特别是基于物理的建模）作为现有实验流程的补充，以减少经验性迭代并降低转化风险，这为下一代ADC设计提供了一个未被充分利用的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟、粗粒化（CG）模拟、自由能计算。摘要还提到了力场（force fields）和混合物理-机器学习方法。

papers.title: In-situ correlative SEM/KPFM for semiconductor devices and 2D heterostructures
papers.abstract: Correlative nanoscale surface characterization benefits from simultaneously measuring electronic and structural properties in the same environment, a capability that is essential for modern-day materials science and semiconductor failure analysis. In-situ AFM-SEM measurements facilitated by self-sensing cantilevers offer great potential here; however, they are limited due to their inherent capacitive crosstalk. Here, we demonstrate for the first time the in-situ implementation of single-pass heterodyne Kelvin probe force microscopy inside a scanning electron microscope, using piezo-resistive cantilevers. We overcome the capacitive crosstalk prevalent in piezo-resistive cantilevers by demodulating excitation and detection to simultaneously map surface topography and contact potential difference for correlation with compositional analysis. We systematically compare different operational modes of this heterodyne technique, elucidating their spatial resolution, signal sensitivity, and signal-to-noise ratio. The integrated approach yields exceptional signal quality and reveals how electron beam scan parameters can directly influence surface potential contrast. We demonstrate this correlative analysis workflow on two-dimensional heterostructures and semiconductor circuits. This work establishes a robust and versatile correlative imaging mode for in-situ Kelvin force and topography imaging inside a scanning electron microscope for next-generation semiconductor device analysis and materials science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：in-situ implementation、demonstrate、measurements、experimental workflow。；研究对象：半导体器件与二维异质结的表面电子与结构性质，具体包括表面形貌、接触电势差（contact potential difference）及其与成分分析的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）内实现了基于自感悬臂梁的单次扫描外差开尔文探针力显微镜（heterodyne KPFM），克服了压阻悬臂梁固有的电容串扰问题，并揭示了电子束扫描参数可直接影响表面电势对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在扫描电子显微镜（SEM）内实现了基于自感悬臂梁的单次扫描外差开尔文探针力显微镜（heterodyne KPFM），克服了压阻悬臂梁固有的电容串扰问题，并揭示了电子束扫描参数可直接影响表面电势对比度。；创新点：首次在SEM内部实现单次扫描外差KPFM的原位集成，解决了压阻悬臂梁中电容串扰这一长期限制，建立了稳健的关联成像模式，用于同时进行开尔文力成像与形貌成像。
papers.method_zh: 采用压阻悬臂梁（piezo-resistive cantilevers）实现原位AFM-SEM测量，通过解调激发与检测信号来同时映射表面形貌和接触电势差，系统比较了外差技术的不同操作模式（空间分辨率、信号灵敏度、信噪比），并应用于二维异质结和半导体电路。

papers.title: Transport signatures of valley polarization in graphene multilayers: In-plane linear magnetoconductivity vs anomalous Hall effect
papers.abstract: In two-dimensional materials where interacting Fermi pockets occur in valleys related by time-reversal symmetry, a spontaneous valley imbalance results in a novel state known as an orbital magnet. Due to the breaking of time-reversal symmetry, this state can be probed in transport experiments by the violation of Onsager relations, most often done through the anomalous Hall effect (AHE). Here we propose that odd-in-field, in-plane linear magnetoconductivity (LMC) is an alternative probe of valley polarization which can occur even when the AHE vanishes. In multilayer structures, the effect originates from in-plane orbital moments and Berry curvatures enabled by interlayer tunneling and dominates over the spin response. After a classification of many recently studied multilayers, we focus on two valley polarized examples: twisted bilayer graphene, where LMC is finite but the AHE vanishes unless additional symmetry breaking from the substrate is present, and rhombohedral graphene multilayers, where LMC and AHE both track valley polarization because they have the same symmetry. Using self-consistent Hartree-Fock and semiclassical transport calculations, we present detailed predictions of LMR for these two examples and analyze the implications for recent experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“self-consistent Hartree-Fock and semiclassical transport calculations”（自洽哈特里-福克和半经典输运计算）进行理论预测和分析。；研究对象：石墨烯多层体系中的谷极化态及其输运特征。具体包括：扭曲双层石墨烯和菱面体石墨烯多层膜。核心物理现象是面内线性磁导率（LMC）与反常霍尔效应（AHE）作为谷极化的探测手段。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出奇数阶磁场依赖的面内线性磁导率（LMC）可以作为谷极化的替代探测手段，即使当反常霍尔效应（AHE）为零时，LMC仍然可以存在。在多层结构中，该效应源于层间隧穿产生的面内轨道磁矩和贝里曲率，并主导自旋响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出奇数阶磁场依赖的面内线性磁导率（LMC）可以作为谷极化的替代探测手段，即使当反常霍尔效应（AHE）为零时，LMC仍然可以存在。在多层结构中，该效应源于层间隧穿产生的面内轨道磁矩和贝里曲率，并主导自旋响应。；创新点：首次提出在多层石墨烯体系中，面内线性磁导率（LMC）可作为谷极化的有效探针，特别是在反常霍尔效应（AHE）因对称性而消失的情况下（如无衬底对称性破缺的扭曲双层石墨烯），LMC仍能提供谷极化信号。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽哈特里-福克（self-consistent Hartree-Fock）方法处理电子相互作用，并结合半经典输运理论（semiclassical transport calculations）计算LMC和AHE。此外，还对多种多层石墨烯结构进行了对称性分类。

papers.title: Spherically symmetric approaches in the theoretical study of low-dimensional magnets
papers.abstract: The main ideas and some of the most important results of the spherically symmetric self-consistent approach and a number of related theoretical algorithms are presented. These methods make it possible to study low-dimensional Heisenberg-type spin models, including frustrated ones, with careful consideration of the theoretic (Mermin-Wagner and Marshall) theorems, as well as the site spin constraint. Thus, the difficulties that may arise in the traditional analysis of low-dimensional magnetic systems are avoided. The approach can also be applied to the spin-pseudospin model, and is also embedded in more complex constructions when considering spin models with free carriers, such as the basic and three-band Hubbard models, t-J and s-d models, and the Kondo lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical study、self-consistent approach、theoretical algorithms。；研究对象：低维磁性系统，包括受挫海森堡型自旋模型、自旋-赝自旋模型，以及包含自由载流子的自旋模型（如 Hubbard 模型、t-J 模型、s-d 模型、Kondo 晶格模型）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 球对称自洽方法及相关理论算法能够严格考虑 Mermin-Wagner 定理、Marshall 定理以及局域自旋约束，从而有效避免传统分析低维磁性系统时遇到的困难。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：球对称自洽方法及相关理论算法能够严格考虑 Mermin-Wagner 定理、Marshall 定理以及局域自旋约束，从而有效避免传统分析低维磁性系统时遇到的困难。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 球对称自洽方法（spherically symmetric self-consistent approach）及一系列相关理论算法。

papers.title: Fuzzy band structure of quantum dots by Bloch Orbital Expansion, unconventional insights into geometry-electronic structure relations
papers.abstract: The extension of ab-initio methods like density functional theory (DFT) to quantum dot (QD) geometries has enabled researchers to explore relationships between QD surface termination and electronic structure. However, fully utilizing the data from DFT requires novel classification methods for QD orbitals. Here, we identify relationships between QD geometry and electronic structure by transforming real-space QD orbitals into momentum-space using Bloch orbital expansion (BOE), yielding a fuzzy QD band structure. Comparing with bulk band structures, we show that truncated, unpassivated facets in III-V and II-VI QDs produce mid-gap orbitals derived from bulk surface orbitals; an identification challenging in real space. QDs with reconstructed facets, however, feature delocalized orbitals formed by superposition of bulk Bloch orbitals. Moreover, we prepare for the first time atomistic core/shell QD models and by the BOE expansion we can clearly identify the core/shell band alignment not possible in real space. These findings emphasize BOE as a vital tool for connecting computational and experimental insights in nanocrystal research.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：ab-initio methods、density functional theory (DFT)、Bloch orbital expansion (BOE)。；研究对象：量子点（quantum dots, QDs），具体包括III-V族和II-VI族量子点，以及首次制备的原子级核/壳量子点模型（core/shell QD models）。研究重点是量子点几何结构与电子结构之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）将实空间量子点轨道变换到动量空间，得到模糊的量子点能带结构，从而识别出：截断且未钝化的量子点面会产生源自体材料表面轨道的带隙中间轨道；而具有重构面的量子点则出现由体布洛赫轨道叠加形成的离域轨道。此外，BOE能清晰识别核/壳量子点的能带对齐，这在实空间中无法实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）将实空间量子点轨道变换到动量空间，得到模糊的量子点能带结构，从而识别出：截断且未钝化的量子点面会产生源自体材料表面轨道的带隙中间轨道；而具有重构面的量子点则出现由体布洛赫轨道叠加形成的离域轨道。此外，BOE能清晰识别核/壳量子点的能带对齐，这在实空间中无法实现。；创新点：首次将布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）应用于量子点体系，实现了对量子点轨道在动量空间中的分类，从而揭示了实空间难以识别的几何-电子结构关联，并首次制备了原子级核/壳量子点模型，通过BOE成功识别其能带对齐类型。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，结合布洛赫轨道展开（BOE）方法，将实空间量子点轨道投影到动量空间，并与体材料能带结构进行对比分析。

papers.title: A practical Laser-Heated Diamond Anvil Cell synthesis technique and recovery workflow for metastable MnSb2 and YbZn2 phases
papers.abstract: The creation and exploration of new materials under extreme pressure-temperature conditions has become increasingly reliant on laser-heated diamond anvil cell (LHDAC) techniques, which provide direct access to previously unexplored regions of multinary phase diagrams. Whereas numerous high-pressure phases have been identified in situ, systematic recovery and post-synthesis physical property characterization of these materials remain significant challenges. In this work, we present the development of an integrated LHDAC synthesis and demonstrate a practical LHDAC-based synthesis workflow that enables stabilization and recovery of metastable intermetallic phases for subsequent structural and transport studies. Using this approach, we successfully achieved LHDAC synthesis of high-pressure MnSb2 and YbZn2 phases under moderate pressures. Synchrotron X-ray diffraction and spatial mapping confirm dominant formation of the targeted phases, whereas laboratory-based refinement quantifies phase fractions despite intrinsic microstrain and minor secondary phases. High-pressure transport measurements on recovered samples reveal tunable by pressure electronic instabilities in both systems. In MnSb2, pressure suppresses two high-temperature magnetic ordering anomalies, observed in transport, by 5 GPa and for higher pressures induces a new low-temperature feature that increases with further pressure increase. In hexagonal high-pressure YbZn2, an electronic reconstruction emerges at ~11 GPa, characterized by semiconducting-like behavior from ~ 30 K to 300 K and a broad low-temperature coherence crossover near 30 K. Our results establish LHDAC synthesis not only as a structural discovery tool, but also as an experimental platform for investigating correlated quantum states stabilized far from equilibrium thermodynamic conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了LHDAC合成、同步辐射X射线衍射、实验室精修、高压输运测量等实验手段。；研究对象：高压亚稳态金属间化合物MnSb₂和YbZn₂的合成、回收及物理性质表征，重点关注其压力诱导的电子不稳定性与量子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过集成化LHDAC合成与回收流程，成功稳定并回收了高压亚稳态MnSb₂和YbZn₂相；输运测量揭示MnSb₂中压力抑制高温磁有序并诱导低温新特征，YbZn₂中在~11 GPa出现电子重构，表现为类半导体行为与低温相干交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过集成化LHDAC合成与回收流程，成功稳定并回收了高压亚稳态MnSb₂和YbZn₂相；输运测量揭示MnSb₂中压力抑制高温磁有序并诱导低温新特征，YbZn₂中在~11 GPa出现电子重构，表现为类半导体行为与低温相干交叉。；创新点：建立了从LHDAC合成到样品回收、再到后续结构与输运性质表征的实用化工作流程，将LHDAC从单纯的结构发现工具拓展为研究远离平衡热力学条件下稳定化的关联量子态的实验平台。
papers.method_zh: 激光加热金刚石对顶砧（LHDAC）合成技术；同步辐射X射线衍射与空间映射进行物相确认；实验室X射线衍射精修量化相分数；高压输运测量（电阻率随温度与压力变化）。

papers.title: Interfacial Reconstructions and Engineering in III-V@II-VI Core-Shell Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: In core/shell quantum dots (QDs), the interface between semiconductors of different chemical character largely determines their optoelectronic properties. In III-V/II-VI systems, this boundary involves pronounced chemical and electronic discontinuities that can generate trap states even under complete surface passivation. Using density functional theory on atomistic models of InAs/CdSe QDs, we systematically reconstruct atomic arrangements at the surface and interface to evaluate how local coordination and interfacial dipoles influence the electronic structure. Abrupt interfaces induce charge imbalance and band-gap collapse, whereas introducing an alloyed interlayer that mixes core and shell atoms and vacancies restores energetic alignment and yields delocalized band-edge states, consistent with experimental findings. We also introduce a charge-flow analysis that quantifies charge redistribution across the QD, providing a framework for realistic modeling of interlayer formation and predictive design of defect-free interfaces in core@shell architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“density functional theory”（密度泛函理论）、“atomistic models”（原子模型）、“systematically reconstruct”（系统重构）等关键词，主要基于理论计算和建模分析。；研究对象：III-V@II-VI 核壳量子点，具体为 InAs/CdSe 核壳量子点。研究聚焦于核与壳之间界面的原子重构及其对电子结构的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 InAs/CdSe 核壳量子点中，突变的（abrupt）界面会导致电荷失衡和带隙坍塌；而引入由核、壳原子和空位混合组成的合金化中间层，可以恢复能级对齐，产生离域的带边态，这与实验结果一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 InAs/CdSe 核壳量子点中，突变的（abrupt）界面会导致电荷失衡和带隙坍塌；而引入由核、壳原子和空位混合组成的合金化中间层，可以恢复能级对齐，产生离域的带边态，这与实验结果一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但主要新意在于：1）系统性地研究了 III-V/II-VI 核壳量子点中不同界面结构（突变 vs. 合金化）对电子结构的影响；2）提出了一种新的“电荷流分析”方法，为中间层形成的真实建模和无缺陷界面的预测性设计提供了理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。具体包括：对 InAs/CdSe 量子点的原子模型进行表面和界面的原子重构，分析局域配位和界面偶极子对电子结构的影响。此外，还引入了一种电荷流分析（charge-flow analysis）方法来量化量子点内的电荷重新分布。

papers.title: Benchmarking empirical and machine-learned interatomic potentials using phase diagram predictions for Lead
papers.abstract: We compare the predicted phase behaviour of lead (Pb) using three different interatomic potential models, including an embedded atom method (EAM), a modified embedded atom method (MEAM), and a neural network-based machine-learned model in the form of an ephemeral data-derived potential (EDDP). Using nested sampling and replica-exchange nested sampling simulations, we computed thermodynamic and structural properties at pressures up to 60 GPa, mapping both melting behaviour and solid-phase stability. Both the EAM and MEAM models predict the face-centred cubic (FCC) phase to remain stable up to approximately 60 GPa. In contrast, the EDDP model captures the experimentally-observed FCC-to-hexagonal close-packed (HCP) transition at around 15 GPa. These results highlight the importance of training data and model flexibility in accurately describing high-pressure phase behaviour, and demonstrate the effectiveness of nested sampling as a robust framework for exploring phase stability in materials. Particularly, the combination of nested sampling with modern machine-learned interatomic potentials - delivering near ab initio accuracy at tractable cost - opens the door to truly predictive and exhaustive exploration. EDDPs trained on diverse, out-of-equilibrium configurations appear particularly well suited to this task, offering a robust and transferable framework for unbiased phase discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：interatomic potential models、nested sampling、simulations、phase diagram predictions。；研究对象：铅（Pb）在高压下的相行为，包括熔化行为和固相稳定性，具体涉及面心立方（FCC）相与六方密堆积（HCP）相之间的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统嵌入原子法（EAM）和改进嵌入原子法（MEAM）势模型错误地预测FCC相在高达约60 GPa时仍稳定，而基于神经网络的机器学习势模型（EDDP）成功捕捉到实验上观测到的FCC到HCP相变（约15 GPa），表明训练数据和模型灵活性对准确描述高压相行为至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统嵌入原子法（EAM）和改进嵌入原子法（MEAM）势模型错误地预测FCC相在高达约60 GPa时仍稳定，而基于神经网络的机器学习势模型（EDDP）成功捕捉到实验上观测到的FCC到HCP相变（约15 GPa），表明训练数据和模型灵活性对准确描述高压相行为至关重要。；创新点：首次将嵌套采样这一稳健的相空间探索框架与现代机器学习原子间势（EDDP）相结合，用于无偏预测材料相图，并展示了EDDP在非平衡构型上训练后对高压相变的良好可迁移性。
papers.method_zh: 采用嵌套采样（nested sampling）和副本交换嵌套采样（replica-exchange nested sampling）模拟，计算了铅在60 GPa压力下的热力学和结构性质。使用了三种原子间势模型：嵌入原子法（EAM）、改进嵌入原子法（MEAM）以及基于神经网络的瞬态数据衍生势（EDDP）。

papers.title: Charge-sensitive vibrational modes in BEDT-TTF salts: Signatures of charge ordering and site charge
papers.abstract: BEDT-TTF-based organic conductors host a number of ground states, tuned by electron repulsion from Mott and charge ordered insulators to superconductors. Knowing charge distribution on the molecular sites in the insulating state of these materials is a key to understanding the origin of these ground states. We survey and discuss the C=C stretching modes in BEDT-TTF based molecular conductors. These molecular vibrations are extremely crucial in characterization of charge-ordered insulators, and are recently linked to superconductivity in some compounds. Focusing on the known examples of BEDT-TTF$^{+0.5}$ salts, we analyse the reliability of the C=C stretching modes for the determination of charge ordering and absolute site charge. Considering the charge-ordered states, a prominent shift in frequency of 141 cm$^{-1}$ per elementary charge $e$ for $ν_{27}(b_{1u})$ and 98 cm$^{-1}$$e$ for $ν_2$($a_g$) can be clearly realised, however, the distribution resulting from different compounds span over 20 cm$^{-1}$. For nominal BEDT-TTF$^{+0.5}$ compounds, the distribution of the resonance also extends around 20 cm$^{-1}$, yielding an unexpected large uncertainty of $Δρ~\approx~(~\pm~0.045)e$, which is presumably due to the influence of small differences in the structure. This highlights the limitations of charge-frequency relations to detect small deviations in absolute charge values on molecular lattice sites, and emphasises on the use of the relations to estimate charge-ordering, rather than absolute site charge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：survey、discuss、analyse、known examples、C=C stretching modes）；研究对象：基于BEDT-TTF的有机导体，特别是其电荷有序绝缘体中的C=C伸缩振动模式，以及这些振动与电荷分布、电荷有序和超导电性的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BEDT-TTF盐中，C=C伸缩振动频率随分子电荷变化呈现明确的线性关系（ν₂₇(b₁u)为141 cm⁻¹/e，ν₂(a_g)为98 cm⁻¹/e），但不同化合物间的频率分布存在约20 cm⁻¹的弥散，导致绝对电荷值的不确定度高达Δρ≈(±0.045)e，表明该关系更适合用于判断电荷有序而非精确测定绝对位点电荷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BEDT-TTF盐中，C=C伸缩振动频率随分子电荷变化呈现明确的线性关系（ν₂₇(b₁u)为141 cm⁻¹/e，ν₂(a_g)为98 cm⁻¹/e），但不同化合物间的频率分布存在约20 cm⁻¹的弥散，导致绝对电荷值的不确定度高达Δρ≈(±0.045)e，表明该关系更适合用于判断电荷有序而非精确测定绝对位点电荷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 对已知BEDT-TTF⁺⁰·⁵盐的C=C伸缩振动模式（ν₂₇(b₁u)和ν₂(a_g)）进行系统调查与讨论，分析其频率与电荷之间的经验关系，并评估其可靠性。

papers.title: Large-$N$ scaling of Tan's contact for the harmonically trapped Tonks--Girardeau gas at finite temperature
papers.abstract: We derive the canonical-ensemble scaling of Tan's contact for $N$ harmonically trapped Tonks--Girardeau bosons at finite temperature in the large-$N$ limit. The leading scaling coefficient reproduces the local-density-approximation result and is obtained from a contour-integral representation of the canonical partition function followed by a saddle-point reduction to a phase-space integral with a self-consistent scaled chemical potential. The subleading coefficient is the central new object of this work: it admits an explicit representation in terms of universal phase-space integrals of the Fermi factor, has closed-form Sommerfeld and virial limits, and is identified with the canonical-versus-grand-canonical ensemble difference at fixed mean particle number. In the high-temperature Boltzmann regime the ratio of subleading to leading coefficients collapses to a universal value, traceable to the Poissonian particle-number statistics of the dilute grand-canonical gas. We construct Padé approximants for both scaling functions that interpolate uniformly between the low-temperature Sommerfeld and high-temperature virial regimes; for the subleading coefficient we report a form that is uniformly accurate on our working range of temperatures and asymptotically correct beyond. The scaling law is verified against canonical contour-integration data across the full temperature range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive（推导）、canonical-ensemble scaling（正则系综标度）、contour-integral representation（围道积分表示）、saddle-point reduction（鞍点约化）。；研究对象：有限温度下简谐势阱中Tonks–Girardeau（TG）气体的Tan接触（Tan's contact），即一维强相互作用玻色子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了有限温度下大N极限时TG气体Tan接触的正则系综标度律，其中次领头标度系数是全新结果，可表示为费米因子的普适相空间积分，并对应于固定平均粒子数下正则系综与巨正则系综的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了有限温度下大N极限时TG气体Tan接触的正则系综标度律，其中次领头标度系数是全新结果，可表示为费米因子的普适相空间积分，并对应于固定平均粒子数下正则系综与巨正则系综的差异。；创新点：首次给出有限温度下TG气体Tan接触的次领头标度系数，并揭示其与正则-巨正则系综差异的等价性；在高温玻尔兹曼区，次领头与领头系数之比坍缩至普适值，可归因于稀薄巨正则气体的泊松粒子数统计。
papers.method_zh: 采用围道积分表示正则配分函数，通过鞍点约化得到自洽标度化学势下的相空间积分；利用Sommerfeld展开和维里展开得到闭式极限；构造Padé近似在低温Sommerfeld与高温维里区间均匀插值；通过正则围道积分数据在全温度范围验证标度律。

papers.title: Orbital Angular Momentum Textures and Currents in a Discrete Helix: Equilibrium and Linear Response
papers.abstract: Recently, nonequilibrium orbital angular momentum in low-dimensional systems has attracted renewed attention. Here we introduce a minimal three-orbital tight-binding model for a single helical chain and show that chirality alone generates a momentum-dependent orbital-angular-momentum texture through Slater--Koster hybridization in the local basis $(p_r,p_φ,p_z)$, without requiring atomic spin--orbit coupling. In the single-helix geometry, the radial orbital texture vanishes identically, while the azimuthal and longitudinal components remain finite and arise from the odd-in-momentum $(p_z,p_r)$ and $(p_r,p_φ)$ sectors. As a result, the equilibrium average orbital texture vanishes by parity, although persistent-like orbital angular momentum currents may still exist and imply chirality-dependent end magnetization in a finite helix. Under an applied longitudinal electric field, the system develops a finite orbital Edelstein response, whereas the projected longitudinal orbital-current conductivity vanishes in the linear regime by parity. When spin degrees of freedom are included, the orbital texture acts as a source of spin polarization through orbital-to-spin transduction. The resulting spin response is controlled by orbital overlap scales much larger than the bare relativistic spin--orbit scale, making it a stronger candidate for spin injection than the conventional spin Edelstein mechanism. These results identify chirality as the minimal microscopic ingredient for generating orbital angular momentum response in one-dimensional systems and support an orbital route to spin selectivity in chiral conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：tight-binding model（紧束缚模型）、linear response（线性响应）、理论推导。；研究对象：单螺旋链（single helical chain）中的轨道角动量（Orbital Angular Momentum）纹理与电流，以及相关的轨道Edelstein效应和自旋极化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅凭手性（chirality）即可在无自旋-轨道耦合的情况下，通过Slater-Koster杂化在局域基组中产生动量依赖的轨道角动量纹理；在纵向电场下系统产生有限轨道Edelstein响应，且轨道纹理可通过轨道-自旋转导产生比传统自旋Edelstein机制更强的自旋极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅凭手性（chirality）即可在无自旋-轨道耦合的情况下，通过Slater-Koster杂化在局域基组中产生动量依赖的轨道角动量纹理；在纵向电场下系统产生有限轨道Edelstein响应，且轨道纹理可通过轨道-自旋转导产生比传统自旋Edelstein机制更强的自旋极化。；创新点：指出手性本身（而非原子自旋-轨道耦合）是产生一维系统中轨道角动量响应的最小微观要素，并揭示了轨道纹理作为自旋极化源的新机制，其自旋响应尺度远大于相对论自旋-轨道耦合尺度。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小三轨道紧束缚模型（three-orbital tight-binding model），在局域基组(p_r, p_φ, p_z)下分析轨道角动量纹理的动量依赖结构，并计算平衡态与线性响应下的轨道电流及自旋响应。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis constraints for hyperbolic lattices
papers.abstract: The Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem and its higher-dimensional extensions forbid the existence of a unique, symmetric, and gapped ground state at fractional fillings in quantum many-body systems with a conserved particle number (or spin angular momentum) and the conventional translation symmetry of Euclidean lattices. In this work, we propose a generalization of the LSM theorem to quantum many-body systems on hyperbolic lattices, i.e., regular tessellations of two-dimensional negatively curved space. By leveraging concepts from hyperbolic band theory in a many-body setting, we adapt Oshikawa's flux-threading argument to periodic hyperbolic lattices with a non-Euclidean (Fuchsian) translation symmetry and compute a lower-bound to the ground-state degeneracy as a function of filling and lattice geometry. We explore the consequences of LSM constraints for gapped phases of hyperbolic quantum matter and suggest frustrated spin models on hyperbolic analogs of the square and triangular lattices as promising platforms for realizing symmetric spin liquids in hyperbolic space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a generalization、adapt Oshikawa's flux-threading argument、compute a lower-bound。；研究对象：双曲晶格（hyperbolic lattices）上的量子多体系统，具体为二维负曲率空间中的规则镶嵌（regular tessellations），以及双曲空间中的平方晶格和三角晶格类似物上的阻挫自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）定理推广到双曲晶格，证明在分数填充下，具有非欧几里得（Fuchsian）平移对称性的双曲晶格系统同样无法存在唯一、对称、有能隙的基态，并给出了基态简并度的下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将Lieb-Schultz-Mattis（LSM）定理推广到双曲晶格，证明在分数填充下，具有非欧几里得（Fuchsian）平移对称性的双曲晶格系统同样无法存在唯一、对称、有能隙的基态，并给出了基态简并度的下界。；创新点：首次将LSM约束从欧几里得晶格推广到双曲晶格，揭示了非欧几何中对称性保护拓扑相的新限制，并指出双曲空间中的阻挫自旋模型是实现对称自旋液体的潜在平台。
papers.method_zh: 利用多体框架下的双曲能带理论（hyperbolic band theory），将Oshikawa的通量穿入论证（flux-threading argument）适配到具有Fuchsian平移对称性的周期性双曲晶格上，通过填充因子和晶格几何计算基态简并度的下界。

papers.title: Tunable Crossed Andreev Reflection in Bipolar Magnetic Semiconductors
papers.abstract: Crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is a nonlocal quantum transport phenomenon that arises at the interface between a superconductor and two spatially separated metals. In this process, an electron incident from one metal combines with another electron originating from the other metal to form a Cooper pair in the superconductor. As a consequence, a hole is emitted into the second metal, establishing a nonlocal electron-hole conversion process. In contrast to local Andreev reflection -- where electron-to-hole conversion occurs within the same region -- CAR intrinsically links two spatially separated carriers, giving rise to nonlocal correlations and quantum entanglement. In bipolar magnetic semiconductors (BMSs), the conduction and valence bands possess opposite spin polarizations. We propose to achieve tunable control of CAR by independently adjusting the chemical potentials of the two regions. By engineering the alignment of spin-polarized bands in the two BMS leads, CAR can be selectively enhanced or suppressed. This tunability enables precise manipulation of nonlocal transport, and correlated electron dynamics, offering promising prospects for spintronic and superconducting device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提出“propose to achieve tunable control of CAR”，并基于能带对齐进行理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：交叉安德烈夫反射（CAR）在双极磁性半导体（BMS）中的可调谐实现。具体体系为超导体与两个空间分离的BMS电极构成的异质结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过独立调节两个BMS区域的化学势，可以控制自旋极化导带和价带的相对对齐，从而选择性地增强或抑制交叉安德烈夫反射，实现非局域输运的精确调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过独立调节两个BMS区域的化学势，可以控制自旋极化导带和价带的相对对齐，从而选择性地增强或抑制交叉安德烈夫反射，实现非局域输运的精确调控。；创新点：首次提出利用双极磁性半导体的自旋极化能带特性，通过化学势独立调控实现交叉安德烈夫反射的可调谐控制，为自旋电子学和超导器件中的非局域关联与量子纠缠操控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于双极磁性半导体的能带特性（导带和价带具有相反自旋极化），通过调节化学势来工程化两个BMS电极中自旋极化能带的相对排列，从而调控CAR过程。

papers.title: Bak--Tang--Wiesenfeld model for various topologies and ranges of interaction
papers.abstract: In this paper, the Bak--Tang--Wiesenfeld model for various substrate topologies and a variety of neighborhoods is reconsidered. With computer simulation, we study the distribution of avalanche sizes. Using the Z-score we confirm that independently of the substrate topology and the range of neighborhood, the exponent that governs the power law of the probability distribution of the size of avalanches is the same and approximately equal 1.208(39). However, this requires a smartly chosen number of deposited grains in relation to the linear size of the system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computer simulation、distribution of avalanche sizes、Z-score）；研究对象：Bak–Tang–Wiesenfeld（BTW）沙堆模型在不同基底拓扑结构和不同相互作用范围下的雪崩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无论基底拓扑和邻域范围如何，雪崩尺寸的概率分布均服从同一幂律指数，约为1.208(39)，但该结果依赖于沉积颗粒数与系统线性尺寸之间的巧妙比例关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无论基底拓扑和邻域范围如何，雪崩尺寸的概率分布均服从同一幂律指数，约为1.208(39)，但该结果依赖于沉积颗粒数与系统线性尺寸之间的巧妙比例关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过计算机模拟研究雪崩尺寸分布，并使用Z-score统计量验证幂律指数的普适性。

papers.title: The Directed Abelian Sandpile Model on Cylinders
papers.abstract: We study the abelian sandpile model in two dimensions on a directed cylindrical lattice with periodic transverse boundary conditions in the transverse direction and dissipation at one boundary. Recurrent configurations form a finite abelian group, and repeated grain addition at a specific site generates deterministic dynamics on this group. Using Dhar's formulation, the sandpile group is identified with the co-kernel of the reduced directed Laplacian. We show that the group structure admits an exact reduction to a transverse problem, allowing complete determination of its cyclic decomposition. Our results establish a direct connection between the algebraic structure of the sandpile group and the periodicity of the driven dynamics, establishing the manner in which the underlying algebraic structure governs both deterministic and stochastic evolution in directed sandpile.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“Using Dhar's formulation”“We show”等表述，核心内容为数学推导与群论分析，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：二维有向圆柱晶格上的阿贝尔沙堆模型（directed abelian sandpile model），具有横向周期性边界条件及一端耗散边界条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 沙堆群的代数结构可精确约化为一个横向问题，从而完整确定其循环分解；该代数结构直接决定了驱动动力学的周期性，并同时控制确定性演化与随机演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：沙堆群的代数结构可精确约化为一个横向问题，从而完整确定其循环分解；该代数结构直接决定了驱动动力学的周期性，并同时控制确定性演化与随机演化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Dhar的沙堆群形式化方法，将沙堆群等同于约化有向拉普拉斯算子的余核（co-kernel），通过群论约化将二维问题降维至横向一维问题，进而解析求解群的循环分解。

papers.title: Actin cross-linking organizes basal body patterning through anomalous diffusion transitions
papers.abstract: Subcellular protein complexes and organelles exhibit diverse dynamic behaviors that reflect the mechanical constraints and organization of the intracellular environment. Although some structures follow classical Brownian motion, many display anomalous dynamics. The transitions between these regimes are increasingly recognized as critical for subcellular organization, yet how they influence pattern formation remains unclear. Here, we investigate the spatial arrangement of cilia on the apical surface of multiciliated cells (MCCs) in developing Xenopus laevis embryos, where coordinated ciliary beating depends on the precise organization of hundreds of centriole-derived basal bodies (BBs). Using quantitative confocal, high-resolution and high-speed TIRF imaging together with theoretical modeling, we show that BB trajectories undergo time-resolved transitions between diffusive and anomalous motion, with distinct regimes that correlate with apical surface expansion. During the early stages, actin remodeling facilitates the dispersal of BBs by providing a permissive, low-confinement environment. As development progresses, the actin network becomes increasingly cross-linked that constrains BB movement and promotes uniform spacing across the apical domain. Disruption of $α$-actinin-1, a major actin cross-linking protein, impairs the integrity of the apical actin meshwork, weakens BB confinement, and disrupts regular spatial patterning, ultimately compromising the arrangement of BBs required for proper cilia alignment. Together, we show that progressive apical actin cross-linking coordinates BB positioning and regulates their dynamic state, guiding the shift from diffusive to confined motion. This transition in dynamics enables the emergence of a uniform BB pattern, which in turn ensures the aligned deployment of motile cilia necessary for effective directional fluid flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：quantitative confocal, high-resolution and high-speed TIRF imaging, theoretical modeling）；研究对象：多纤毛细胞（MCCs）顶端表面中心粒衍生基体（basal bodies, BBs）的空间排列及其动力学行为，具体以非洲爪蟾（Xenopus laevis）胚胎为模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基体（BB）的扩散运动经历从正常扩散到反常受限运动的时变转变，这一转变由肌动蛋白网络的逐步交联（cross-linking）驱动，最终实现基体的均匀空间排布，为纤毛协调摆动和定向液体流动奠定基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基体（BB）的扩散运动经历从正常扩散到反常受限运动的时变转变，这一转变由肌动蛋白网络的逐步交联（cross-linking）驱动，最终实现基体的均匀空间排布，为纤毛协调摆动和定向液体流动奠定基础。；创新点：首次揭示了肌动蛋白交联程度的时间演化如何通过调控基体从扩散到受限运动的动力学转变，进而控制亚细胞模式形成（pattern formation）的机制。
papers.method_zh: 定量共聚焦显微镜、高分辨率与高速全内反射荧光（TIRF）成像，结合理论建模分析基体轨迹的扩散行为；通过破坏α-辅肌动蛋白-1（α-actinin-1）进行功能验证。

papers.title: Active Model B$^-$ from Mass-Conserving Reaction-Diffusion Systems
papers.abstract: We show that the late-time dynamics of a minimal three-component mass-conserving reaction--diffusion system reduce to a scalar active field theory, Active Model B$^-$ (AMB$^-$), in which a density-dependent interfacial coefficient $κ(φ)$ turns negative at high density. This drives a finite-wavelength instability and stabilises microphase-separated patterns, in contrast to the unbounded coarsening of two-component mass-conserving systems. Unlike Active Model B$^+$, AMB$^-$ retains a chemical potential that remains a state function, inherited from the underlying conservation law, but admits no equation of state for the pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show that... reduce to a scalar active field theory（通过理论推导将多组分反应扩散系统约化为活性场论模型）。；研究对象：质量守恒反应-扩散系统中的微相分离现象，具体为三组分活性模型B⁻（Active Model B⁻）的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三组分质量守恒反应-扩散系统的晚期动力学可约化为标量活性场论模型AMB⁻，其中密度依赖的界面系数κ(φ)在高密度下变为负值，驱动有限波长不稳定性并稳定微相分离图案，与双组分系统的无界粗化行为形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三组分质量守恒反应-扩散系统的晚期动力学可约化为标量活性场论模型AMB⁻，其中密度依赖的界面系数κ(φ)在高密度下变为负值，驱动有限波长不稳定性并稳定微相分离图案，与双组分系统的无界粗化行为形成对比。；创新点：揭示了AMB⁻与已知活性模型B⁺的关键区别：AMB⁻保留化学势作为状态函数（源于底层守恒律），但不存在压力状态方程，这为理解活性物质中微相分离的物理机制提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与约化：从最小三组分质量守恒反应-扩散方程出发，通过绝热消除快变量等方法将其约化为单标量场活性模型B⁻，并分析其界面系数符号变化导致的相分离动力学。

papers.title: Solving Classical and Quantum Spin Glasses with Deep Boltzmann Quantum States
papers.abstract: Variational neural network models have achieved remarkable success in solving ground-state problems of quantum many-body systems. However, addressing classical and quantum spin glasses remains challenging, as disorder and energy frustration give rise to an exponentially large number of local energy minima separated by high-energy barriers, hindering the efficiency of conventional Metropolis-based Monte Carlo methods. To bridge this gap, we introduce Deep Boltzmann Quantum States, a class of neural quantum states inspired by deep Boltzmann machines that inherit efficient block Gibbs sampling. We also propose two key advances in the training algorithm. Firstly, we combine natural-gradient updates with state-of-the-art stochastic optimizers. Secondly, we gradually tune the hardness of the problem Hamiltonian by interpolating from an easy to a hard regime, without the need to closely approximate the instantaneous adiabatic state at intermediate times. We match the exact solution or the best available estimate for several instances of classical and quantum Ising spin-glass models with infinite-range interactions and hundreds of spins. We also solve instances of the NP-hard Job Shop Scheduling Problem exceeding the current limitations of quantum annealing hardware. To summarize, deep neural architectures with efficient global update rules and trained within an annealing-like scheme, provide a powerful framework for solving real-world hard combinatorial optimization and for investigating disordered quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：variational neural network models、training algorithm、solving ground-state problems。；研究对象：经典和量子自旋玻璃模型（Ising自旋玻璃模型，具有无限范围相互作用），以及NP-hard的作业车间调度问题（Job Shop Scheduling Problem）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为“深度玻尔兹曼量子态”（Deep Boltzmann Quantum States）的神经网络变分方法，结合自然梯度更新与退火式训练策略，能够精确求解数百个自旋的经典和量子自旋玻璃基态问题，并解决超出当前量子退火硬件能力的作业车间调度问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为“深度玻尔兹曼量子态”（Deep Boltzmann Quantum States）的神经网络变分方法，结合自然梯度更新与退火式训练策略，能够精确求解数百个自旋的经典和量子自旋玻璃基态问题，并解决超出当前量子退火硬件能力的作业车间调度问题。；创新点：将深度玻尔兹曼机架构引入神经量子态，并设计了结合自然梯度与退火式插值的训练算法，从而有效克服了自旋玻璃中由无序和能量阻挫导致的指数级局部极小值障碍。
papers.method_zh: 基于深度玻尔兹曼机（deep Boltzmann machines）的神经量子态（neural quantum states），采用高效的块吉布斯采样（block Gibbs sampling）进行变分优化。训练算法包含两个关键进展：1）将自然梯度更新（natural-gradient updates）与最先进的随机优化器结合；2）通过从易到难插值问题哈密顿量的硬度（退火式方案），无需精确逼近中间时刻的瞬时绝热态。

papers.title: Cycle affinity and winding localize eigenvalues of Markov generators
papers.abstract: The complex eigenvalues of Markov generators govern oscillatory properties of relaxation, autocorrelation, and linear response. Here we show that these eigenvalues are localized by nonequilibrium cycles of the generator, thus revealing a fundamental tradeoff between thermodynamic driving, oscillation, and decay of eigenmodes. Specifically, we prove that each complex eigenvalue is confined to a region determined by the cycle affinity and the eigenvector ``winding number'' of some nonequilibrium cycle. In unicyclic systems, we also demonstrate that the winding number coincides with the ordered eigenvalue index, yielding new thermodynamic bounds on the slowest and fastest relaxation modes. In multicyclic systems, our approach unifies and extends several previous inequalities and proves the Uhl--Seifert ellipse conjecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“prove”、“theorem”、“bounds”、“conjecture”，属于数学物理理论推导。；研究对象：马尔可夫生成器（Markov generators）的复本征值，具体研究非平衡循环（nonequilibrium cycles）如何影响这些本征值的局域化，以及热力学驱动力（thermodynamic driving）与振荡、衰减模式之间的权衡。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了马尔可夫生成器的每个复本征值都被限制在一个由循环亲和力（cycle affinity）和本征矢“缠绕数”（winding number）决定的区域内，揭示了热力学驱动力与振荡、衰减之间的基本权衡关系。在单循环系统中，缠绕数与有序本征值指标一致，给出了最慢和最快弛豫模式的新热力学界；在多循环系统中，统一并推广了多个先前的不等式，并证明了Uhl-Seifert椭圆猜想。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了马尔可夫生成器的每个复本征值都被限制在一个由循环亲和力（cycle affinity）和本征矢“缠绕数”（winding number）决定的区域内，揭示了热力学驱动力与振荡、衰减之间的基本权衡关系。在单循环系统中，缠绕数与有序本征值指标一致，给出了最慢和最快弛豫模式的新热力学界；在多循环系统中，统一并推广了多个先前的不等式，并证明了Uhl-Seifert椭圆猜想。；创新点：首次将循环亲和力与本征矢缠绕数联系起来，建立了非平衡循环驱动下复本征值局域化的普适理论框架，并证明了此前悬而未决的Uhl-Seifert椭圆猜想。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数学证明。具体使用了循环亲和力、本征矢缠绕数等概念，对单循环和多循环马尔可夫生成器进行谱分析，推导出本征值局域化的几何边界。

papers.title: Stable magnetic nanodomains engineered via Ga+-ion irradiation for deterministic sequential switching
papers.abstract: Precise control of magnetic domain formation at the nanoscale remains constrained by stochastic defect-mediated and unstable pinning, limiting scalability and reproducibility in spintronic architectures. Here we demonstrate that spatially engineered anisotropy gradients provide a deterministic alternative. Using focused Ga+-ion irradiation, we pattern magnetic energy landscapes containing nanoscale "anisotropy wells" that confine magnetic domain walls and enable bidirectional sequential switching without reliance on difficult-to-control material disorder. An analytical framework describing domain-wall energetics in graded anisotropy profiles yields predictive design rules for depinning and stability, which are supported by micromagnetic simulations and experiments. We realize programmable multi-domain configurations in continuous ferromagnetic films and demonstrate robust, reproducible switching of 750 nm regions, while first results for 100 nm are shown, approaching the theoretical limit set by the domain-wall width. By replacing unstable pinning with engineered energy landscapes, this anisotropy landscape establishes a scalable materials strategy for deterministic magnetic-state programming and opens a pathway toward dense, energy-efficient spintronic and reconfigurable magnetic nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 理论 + 模拟）。判断依据：摘要中提及“micromagnetic simulations and experiments”、“analytical framework”以及“experiments”。；研究对象：通过Ga⁺离子辐照在连续铁磁薄膜中工程化构建的纳米尺度“各向异性势阱”及其对磁畴壁的钉扎与可控翻转行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过空间工程化的各向异性梯度（而非依赖材料无序缺陷），可以实现纳米磁畴的确定性、可重复的双向顺序翻转，并成功在750 nm区域实现稳定编程，100 nm区域也展示了初步结果，接近畴壁宽度的理论极限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过空间工程化的各向异性梯度（而非依赖材料无序缺陷），可以实现纳米磁畴的确定性、可重复的双向顺序翻转，并成功在750 nm区域实现稳定编程，100 nm区域也展示了初步结果，接近畴壁宽度的理论极限。；创新点：用工程化的各向异性能量景观替代传统依赖随机缺陷或不可控钉扎的磁畴控制方法，实现了可预测、可扩展的确定性磁态编程策略。
papers.method_zh: 聚焦Ga⁺离子辐照技术（用于图案化各向异性能量景观）、解析理论框架（描述梯度各向异性剖面中畴壁的钉扎与稳定性）、微磁学模拟（micromagnetic simulations）以及实验验证。

papers.title: Critical quench dynamics of Wegner's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge model: a geometric perspective
papers.abstract: Wegner's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge model is the earliest formulation of pure lattice gauge theory and predicts the topological nature of the confinement-deconfinement transition. In three dimensions ($D=3$), the equilibrium critical behavior of the model is understood in terms of geometrically defined objects, namely loop excitations and Fortuin-Kasteleyn (FK) clusters. This work investigates the critical quench dynamics of this model from a geometric perspective, following quenches from both a high-temperature percolation phase and the zero-temperature ground state. Using time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis, we find that the critical non-equilibrium relaxation of the percolation order parameter is governed by a dynamical exponent $z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$, consistent with that associated with the energy density, $z_{\rm c}$. Importantly, the value of $z_{\rm p}$ is robust with respect to the initial quench condition and the choice of geometrical objects. Furthermore, we provide a detailed characterization of the kinetics of different geometrical objects during the evolution from the percolation phase. Notably, we observe that the quench dynamics obeys dynamic scaling in terms of a growing lengthscale, $ξ_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$, despite the absence of a local order parameter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：geometric perspective、time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis、dynamic scaling。；研究对象：Wegner的$\mathbb{Z}_2$规范模型（纯格点规范理论）在三维（$D=3$）中的临界淬火动力学，特别是从几何对象（环激发和Fortuin-Kasteleyn团簇）角度研究禁闭-退禁闭相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 临界非平衡弛豫由动力学指数$z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$支配，该指数与能量密度的动力学指数$z_{\rm c}$一致，且对初始淬火条件和几何对象的选择具有鲁棒性；尽管缺乏局域序参量，淬火动力学仍遵循以增长长度尺度$\xi_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$为特征的动态标度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：临界非平衡弛豫由动力学指数$z_{\rm p} \simeq 2.6$支配，该指数与能量密度的动力学指数$z_{\rm c}$一致，且对初始淬火条件和几何对象的选择具有鲁棒性；尽管缺乏局域序参量，淬火动力学仍遵循以增长长度尺度$\xi_{\rm p}(t) \sim t^{1/z_{\rm p}}$为特征的动态标度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 时间依赖的有限尺寸标度分析（time-dependent finite-size scaling analysis），从高温渗流相和零温基态两种初始条件进行淬火，并分析不同几何对象（环激发、FK团簇）的动力学。

papers.title: Effective increase of a superconducting critical temperature in a high-entropy electron mixture
papers.abstract: We show theoretically that a superconducting critical temperature can be effectively increased in a high-entropy mixture of electrons belonging to conduction and valence bands. In order to employ the entropy of mixing into the superconducting phase dynamics, we suggest to use a metallic trap that removes quasiparticle excitations from the superconductor. This makes the concentration of Cooper pairs a dynamic variable of the entropy of mixing, and thus affects the Ginzburg-Landau functional of the superconductor effectively reducing the first expansion coefficient or, in other words, increasing the critical temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We show theoretically”（理论展示）、“suggest to use”（建议使用）、“affects the Ginzburg-Landau functional”（影响金兹堡-朗道泛函），属于纯理论推导。；研究对象：高熵电子混合物中的超导临界温度。具体体系为导带和价带电子构成的高熵混合态，以及用于调控准粒子浓度的金属陷阱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在高熵电子混合物中引入金属陷阱移除准粒子激发，使库珀对浓度成为混合熵的动态变量，从而有效降低金兹堡-朗道泛函的第一展开系数，即等效提高超导临界温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在高熵电子混合物中引入金属陷阱移除准粒子激发，使库珀对浓度成为混合熵的动态变量，从而有效降低金兹堡-朗道泛函的第一展开系数，即等效提高超导临界温度。；创新点：首次提出将混合熵（来自导带和价带电子的高熵混合）引入超导相变动力学，并通过金属陷阱实现准粒子移除，使库珀对浓度成为可调动态变量，从而在不改变材料本征性质的情况下有效提升临界温度。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于金兹堡-朗道（Ginzburg-Landau）理论框架，引入混合熵对超导相动力学的影响，通过调节库珀对浓度作为动态变量来重新推导超导自由能泛函。

papers.title: Thermodynamic signatures of a field-induced ordered intermediate phase in Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$
papers.abstract: The honeycomb cobaltate Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$ has recently been proposed as a candidate material for hosting field-induced quantum spin liquid (QSL) behavior. Here, we present a comprehensive thermodynamic study of its low-temperature, high-field phase diagram using magnetization, specific heat, and magnetocaloric-effect measurements down to 1 K. In zero field, we observe a weak residual moment that provides further insight into the nature of the magnetic ground state. For in-plane magnetic fields ($B \parallel a^*$), we identify three field-induced transitions at $B_{c1} \simeq 6$ T, $B_{c2} \simeq 7.8$ T, and $B_{c3} \simeq 10.4$ T. The magnetic Grüneisen parameter and specific heat reveal clear thermodynamic signatures of these successive phase transitions enclosing two intermediate phases. Contrary to expectations for a field-induced QSL, the phase between $B_{c2}$ and $B_{c3}$ lacks enhanced magnetic entropy but instead shows behavior consistent with a distinct ordered state. Above $B_{c3}$, the absence of additional anomalies indicates a crossover to a conventional spin-polarized regime. Our results place stringent thermodynamic constraints on the proposed QSL scenario in Na$_2$Co$_2$TeO$_6$, calling for further microscopic investigations to establish the precise nature of the field-induced phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用磁化率、比热和磁热效应测量”等实验手段。；研究对象：蜂窝状钴氧化物 Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在磁场诱导下的低温相图，特别是其可能存在的量子自旋液体（QSL）行为及中间有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在面内磁场下，Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在 Bc1≈6 T、Bc2≈7.8 T 和 Bc3≈10.4 T 处发生三次场致相变，形成两个中间相。其中 Bc2 至 Bc3 之间的相并非预期的场致量子自旋液体，而是一个具有明确有序特征的相；高于 Bc3 后体系进入常规的自旋极化态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在面内磁场下，Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在 Bc1≈6 T、Bc2≈7.8 T 和 Bc3≈10.4 T 处发生三次场致相变，形成两个中间相。其中 Bc2 至 Bc3 之间的相并非预期的场致量子自旋液体，而是一个具有明确有序特征的相；高于 Bc3 后体系进入常规的自旋极化态。；创新点：通过磁格吕奈森参数和比热等热力学手段，首次明确揭示了 Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 在场致相图中存在多个中间相，并指出其中间相（Bc2–Bc3）并非量子自旋液体，而是有序态，从而对先前提出的场致 QSL 假说提出了严格的热力学约束。
papers.method_zh: 综合热力学测量：磁化率、比热和磁热效应（MCE）测量，温度低至 1 K，磁场沿面内 a* 方向。

papers.title: Layer-dependent Landé $g$-factors of electrons, holes, and excitons in two-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper lead halide perovskites
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper lead halide perovskites provide a valuable platform for tailoring charge and spin properties through quantum confinement and reduced symmetry. While the electron and hole Landé $g$-factors in bulk lead halide perovskites exhibit a universal dependence on the band gap energy, their evolution in two-dimensional perovskites has remained largely unexplored. Here, the Zeeman splittings of electrons and holes in (PEA)$_2$MA$_{n-1}$Pb$_n$I$_{3n+1}$ perovskites with the number of inorganic layers ovarying in the range $n=1,...,8$ are measured by means of the spin-flip Raman scattering and time-resolved Kerr rotation magneto-optical techniques. A systematic evolution of the electron and hole $g$-factors with decreasing layer thickness, which deviates from the universal bulk behavior and reveals confinement-driven trends similar to those observed in perovskite nanocrystals, is found. The experimental results are in good qualitative agreement with empirical tight-binding calculations. The exciton $g$-factors are evaluated from the Zeeman splittings of the exciton resonances in reflectivity measured in pulsed magnetic fields up to 55~T. These results provide comprehensive insight into the spin properties of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites and establish them as a tunable platform for engineering spin-dependent phenomena in quantum-confined semiconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“measured by means of the spin-flip Raman scattering and time-resolved Kerr rotation magneto-optical techniques”，以及“experimental results are in good qualitative agreement with empirical tight-binding calculations”。；研究对象：二维Ruddlesden-Popper铅卤钙钛矿（(PEA)₂MAₙ₋₁PbₙI₃ₙ₊₁，无机层数n=1至8）中电子、空穴和激子的Landé g因子及其随层厚的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子和空穴的g因子随层厚减小呈现系统性演化，偏离了块体铅卤钙钛矿中g因子与带隙能量的普适关系，展现出与钙钛矿纳米晶中类似的量子限域驱动趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子和空穴的g因子随层厚减小呈现系统性演化，偏离了块体铅卤钙钛矿中g因子与带隙能量的普适关系，展现出与钙钛矿纳米晶中类似的量子限域驱动趋势。；创新点：首次系统揭示了二维Ruddlesden-Popper铅卤钙钛矿中电子、空穴和激子g因子随无机层数（n=1至8）的演化规律，并发现其偏离块体普适行为，建立了量子限域调控自旋特性的可调平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用自旋翻转拉曼散射和时间分辨Kerr旋转磁光技术测量电子和空穴的塞曼分裂；利用高达55 T脉冲磁场下的反射光谱测量激子共振的塞曼分裂。理论上采用经验紧束缚计算进行定性对比。

papers.title: Markov State Model for the forced unfolding of a small peptide
papers.abstract: In typical single-molecule force spectroscopy experiments the mechanical unfolding of molecular complexes or biomolecules is studied applying a force ramp to one end of the system while the other end is kept fixed in space. The computational counterpart of this type of experiments can routinely be performed using molecular dynamics simulations with atomistic resolution. However, due to the large difference in time scales often coarse graining procedures are applied in the simulations. Most of the applied techniques do not allow to follow the atomistic details of the relevant conformational transitions due to the structural simplifications used to speed up the simulations. Here, we apply an earlier developed dynamic coarse graining technique based on Markov state modeling to a model peptidic system that does not unfold in a simple two-state manner. Using the donor-acceptor distances of the helical hydrogen bonds as collective variables and performing a dimension reduction technique allows us to construct a Markov model of the unfolding process that correctly represents the microscopic behavior of the system. The chosen example shows that the method can be used to mimick the mechanical unfolding process of systems for which the end-to-end distance does not provide a sufficient order parameter and that do not unfold in a simple cooperative manner.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：Markov state modeling、molecular dynamics simulations、dynamic coarse graining technique。；研究对象：一个小肽（model peptidic system）在机械力作用下的非协同解折叠过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于马尔可夫状态模型的动态粗粒化方法，可以正确模拟那些末端距离不足以作为序参量、且解折叠过程非简单两态行为的体系的机械解折叠过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于马尔可夫状态模型的动态粗粒化方法，可以正确模拟那些末端距离不足以作为序参量、且解折叠过程非简单两态行为的体系的机械解折叠过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 马尔可夫状态模型（Markov state modeling）、分子动力学模拟（atomistic resolution）、动态粗粒化技术（dynamic coarse graining）、维度约简技术（dimension reduction），以螺旋氢键的给体-受体距离作为集体变量。

papers.title: Equidistant resonance jumps in superconducting coplanar resonators driven by Abrikosov vortices
papers.abstract: Superconducting coplanar resonators are key building blocks of cryogenic microwave circuits, yet their performance in perpendicular magnetic fields is ultimately limited by Abrikosov vortices. In this work we investigate the dependence of the transmission parameter $S_{21}$ of niobium quarter-wave coplanar resonators on perpendicular magnetic fields up to 40 Oe and at temperatures between 18 mK and 5 K. Beyond the reversible Meissner regime, the entire resonance peak exhibits abrupt, staircase-like jumps as a function of magnetic field. Upon reversal of the field sweep, these jumps form an almost equidistant series with spacing 1.7-1.8 Oe, which, in agreement with theoretical estimates, we interpret as signatures of multiple-vortex entry and exit events. Additionally, we observe the non-proportional responses of the resonant frequency and the internal quality factor that indicate a complex contribution of vortex and antivortex configurations. We believe that our results will stimulate further studies of large vortex-antivortex systems, explicitly accounting for their discrete nature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：investigate、dependence、transmission parameter、measurements、observed。；研究对象：超导共面谐振器（niobium quarter-wave coplanar resonators）在垂直磁场中受Abrikosov涡旋驱动的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在可逆Meissner区之外，谐振峰随磁场出现阶梯状跳跃，且磁场回扫时跳跃间距几乎等距（1.7-1.8 Oe），被解释为多涡旋进入和退出事件的标志。同时，谐振频率与内品质因数的非比例响应表明涡旋与反涡旋构型存在复杂贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在可逆Meissner区之外，谐振峰随磁场出现阶梯状跳跃，且磁场回扫时跳跃间距几乎等距（1.7-1.8 Oe），被解释为多涡旋进入和退出事件的标志。同时，谐振频率与内品质因数的非比例响应表明涡旋与反涡旋构型存在复杂贡献。；创新点：首次在超导共面谐振器中观察到由多涡旋进入/退出事件引起的等距谐振跳跃，并指出涡旋-反涡旋系统的离散性质对谐振器响应的复杂贡献。
papers.method_zh: 测量了铌四分之一波长共面谐振器的传输参数S21随垂直磁场（最高40 Oe）和温度（18 mK至5 K）的变化关系。

papers.title: Short-time critical dynamics in the classical cubic dimer model
papers.abstract: The classical dimer model on the cubic lattice hosts a columnar ordered phase and a disordered Coulomb phase, separated by a continuous phase transition that lies beyond the conventional Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm. While its equilibrium critical properties have been extensively studied, the nonequilibrium critical dynamics of this model--particularly in the short-time regime--remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the short-time critical dynamics near the transition using large-scale Monte Carlo simulations. By quenching the system from both ordered and disordered initial states with vanishing initial correlation length, we analyze the scaling behaviors of the order parameter and its time correlation function in the short-time stage. From these scaling behaviors, we accurately determine the critical temperature $T_c = 0.672(1)$ and the static critical exponent $β/ν= 0.581(5)$ according to the scaling theory of the short-time dynamics. These results are in excellent agreement with previous equilibrium studies. Moreover, we extract the dynamic critical exponent $z = 1.92(1)$ and, notably, find a negative critical initial slip exponent $θ= -1.052(5)$. This unusual negative value contrasts sharply with the positive $θ$ typically observed in conventional critical dynamics. We attribute this anomalous behavior to the combined effects of the emergent SO(5) symmetry at criticality and the local U(1) gauge constraint (Gauss law), which enforces a conserved diffusive dynamics and enhances fluctuations in the short-time regime. Our results provide the first comprehensive characterization of nonequilibrium short-time criticality in the three-dimensional dimer model, shedding new light on the universal dynamical features of phase transitions beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：large-scale Monte Carlo simulations、scaling theory、dynamic critical exponent）；研究对象：三维立方晶格上的经典二聚体模型（classical dimer model on the cubic lattice），具体研究其从柱状有序相到无序库仑相的连续相变附近的非平衡短时临界动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 精确确定了临界温度Tc=0.672(1)和静态临界指数β/ν=0.581(5)，并首次提取出动力学临界指数z=1.92(1)以及负的临界初始滑移指数θ=-1.052(5)。这一负的θ值与传统临界动力学中正的θ截然不同，归因于临界点涌现的SO(5)对称性和局域U(1)规范约束（高斯定律）的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：精确确定了临界温度Tc=0.672(1)和静态临界指数β/ν=0.581(5)，并首次提取出动力学临界指数z=1.92(1)以及负的临界初始滑移指数θ=-1.052(5)。这一负的θ值与传统临界动力学中正的θ截然不同，归因于临界点涌现的SO(5)对称性和局域U(1)规范约束（高斯定律）的共同作用。；创新点：首次全面刻画了三维二聚体模型中的非平衡短时临界性，发现了反常的负临界初始滑移指数，揭示了超越Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson框架的相变中新的普适动力学特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用大规模蒙特卡洛模拟，通过从有序和无序初始态（初始关联长度为零）淬火系统，分析短时阶段序参量及其时间关联函数的标度行为，并基于短时动力学标度理论提取临界参数。

papers.title: Observation of flat-bottom U-shaped energy gap in high-Tc nickelate (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 thin films
papers.abstract: The discovery of high transition temperature (high-Tc) superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper (R-P) bilayer nickelates under high pressure has stimulated extensive work to understand the underlying mechanism and search for superconductors with higher Tc. The recent realization of superconductivity in R-P bilayer nickelate thin films with onset Tc above 40 K at ambient-pressure enables the use of a wide array of powerful experimental tools to investigate the unconventional high-Tc superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. Here, using ultra-low temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/S) and electrical transport study, we report the first successful observation of an energy-symmetric, flat-bottom U-shaped gap with zero residual density of states around the Fermi level in the high-Tc nickelate (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 thin film grown on SrLaAlO4 substrate. Before and after STM/S studies, transport measurements on the same sample reveal consistent superconducting behaviors showing zero resistance, with an onset Tc above 40 K and zero resistance Tc above 20 K. The tunneling spectra exhibit highly unconventional temperature evolution, characterized by a rapid filling of the U-shaped energy gap to a V-shaped gap as the temperature increases. Furthermore, the U-shaped energy gap is reduced under a c-axis magnetic field of 14 T. The energy-symmetric U-shaped gap, taken together with its dependence on magnetic field and temperature, is consistent with the behavior of a superconducting gap, suggesting a nodeless gap function at ultra-low temperatures. Our findings shed new lights on the nature of high-Tc superconductivity and provide an encouraging and thought-provoking hint for a local superconductivity with Tc above liquid nitrogen boiling temperature in nickelate superconductors at ambient or zero pressure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“ultra-low temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/S) and electrical transport study”等实验手段。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper (R-P) 双层镍酸盐薄膜 (La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇，具体研究其高温超导能隙的形貌与性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在常压下的高温超导镍酸盐薄膜中观测到能量对称、平底U形超导能隙，且该能隙在零残余态密度、磁场和温度依赖行为上支持无节点超导能隙函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在常压下的高温超导镍酸盐薄膜中观测到能量对称、平底U形超导能隙，且该能隙在零残余态密度、磁场和温度依赖行为上支持无节点超导能隙函数。；创新点：首次在常压下的 R-P 双层镍酸盐薄膜中直接观测到平底U形超导能隙，并揭示其随温度和磁场的演化行为，为理解该体系的高温超导机制提供了关键实验证据。摘要未突出说明与其他镍酸盐超导体的能隙对比。
papers.method_zh: 超低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱学（STM/S）以及电输运测量，样品生长在 SrLaAlO₄ 衬底上。

papers.title: A Finite-State Gibbs Construction from a Recognition Cost
papers.abstract: On a finite outcome space, the canonical Gibbs distribution is usually obtained by maximizing Shannon entropy at fixed mean of an externally supplied energy functional. This paper studies the finite-state consequences of a ratio-cost construction instead: after adopting the normalized d'Alembert degree-two closure called the Recognition Composition Law (RCL), with unit log-curvature calibration at the reference ratio, the continuous nontrivial positive branch is $J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1$. Given the induced cost vector $X_ω=J(r_ω)$, multinomial counting and convex duality recover the finite-state Gibbs weights and the identity $F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p)$; the entropy-maximization steps are classical once the cost is fixed. New technical content includes a non-asymptotic Stirling bound and soft-shell constrained-type theorems for real-valued costs. A three-state example compares the Gibbs law to squared-log, affinity-as-energy, and Tsallis alternatives at the same cost vector and mean-cost constraint, with sample-size power calculations at fixed RCL ground truth. The framework is conditional on axioms (A1)--(A3) and restricted to finite outcome spaces with strictly positive weights; it does not derive the composition law from a more primitive principle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Gibbs分布、熵最大化、凸对偶、非渐近Stirling界。；研究对象：有限状态空间上的统计物理系统，具体研究基于比率代价（ratio-cost）构造的Gibbs分布，而非传统能量泛函。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用归一化的d’Alembert二次闭包（Recognition Composition Law, RCL）并校准单位对数曲率后，连续非平凡正分支为 \( J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1 \)。由此诱导的代价向量 \( X_\omega=J(r_\omega) \) 通过多项计数和凸对偶恢复有限状态Gibbs权重，并得到恒等式 \( F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p) \)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用归一化的d’Alembert二次闭包（Recognition Composition Law, RCL）并校准单位对数曲率后，连续非平凡正分支为 \( J(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1=\cosh(\log x)-1 \)。由此诱导的代价向量 \( X_\omega=J(r_\omega) \) 通过多项计数和凸对偶恢复有限状态Gibbs权重，并得到恒等式 \( F_{\mathrm{R}}(q)-F_{\mathrm{R}}(p)=T_{\mathrm{R}}\,D_{\mathrm{KL}}(q\Vert p) \)。；创新点：提出了一种基于比率代价（而非传统能量泛函）的有限状态Gibbs分布构造方法，并建立了其与KL散度之间的显式恒等式。摘要未突出说明与已有Gibbs构造方法的更广泛对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：采用RCL作为比率代价构造，结合多项计数、凸对偶、熵最大化步骤；并给出非渐近Stirling界和实值代价的软壳约束型定理。三态示例比较了Gibbs律与平方对数、亲和性作为能量、Tsallis替代方案在相同代价向量和平均代价约束下的表现，并基于固定RCL真值进行了样本量功效计算。

papers.title: Topological property of graphene with triangular array of nanoholes
papers.abstract: The nontrivial band topology for graphene with regular arrays of nanoholes with $C_{6v}$ symmetry is investigated theoretically. For the case of $3\sqrt{3} \times 3\sqrt{3}$ triangular array of nanoholes, we find an energy gap at $Γ$ point around the Fermi level associated with a band inversion which induces change in parity indices, whereas deep below the Fermi level there are a bunch of valence bands characterized as obstructed atomic limit (OAL) which also accommodate imbalance in parity indices. This band structure renders the gap at the Fermi level topologically trivial and carrying no edge states, while the nontrivial band topology of the OAL manifests in two flat bands in the ribbon structure associated with localized electronic states at ribbon edges. The present results exhibit rich topological behaviors in graphene derivatives waiting for explorations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“theoretically investigated”、“band inversion”、“parity indices”、“ribbon structure”。；研究对象：具有C₆v对称性、三角排列纳米孔的石墨烯体系，具体研究3√3 × 3√3三角排列纳米孔的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在费米能级附近的Γ点处存在能隙，该能隙因能带反转导致宇称指数变化，但拓扑平庸且无边缘态；而费米能级深处的一组价带表现为受阻原子极限（OAL），其非平庸拓扑性质在纳米带结构中表现为两条平带，对应局域在带边缘的电子态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在费米能级附近的Γ点处存在能隙，该能隙因能带反转导致宇称指数变化，但拓扑平庸且无边缘态；而费米能级深处的一组价带表现为受阻原子极限（OAL），其非平庸拓扑性质在纳米带结构中表现为两条平带，对应局域在带边缘的电子态。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析能带拓扑性质，包括计算宇称指数、分析能带反转、构建纳米带结构并计算边缘态。

papers.title: Non-Relativistic Spin-Orbit Interaction in Triplet Superconductors: Edelstein Effect and Spin Pumping by Electric Fields
papers.abstract: Non-relativistic momentum-dependent spin splitting, as observed in collinear altermagnets and non-collinear $p$-wave magnets, provides exciting avenues for controlling spin dynamics. Here, we reveal a distinct form of non-relativistic ``spin-orbit coupling" in triplet superconductors by demonstrating that the triplet order parameter induces a wave-vector-dependent spin texture of Bogoliubov quasiparticles, thereby entangling their orbital and spin motions. Even in the absence of relativistic spin-orbit coupling, this intertwining of spin and orbital motion allows an electric field to generate spin polarization in a $p$-wave superconductor -- that is, an Edelstein effect. Building on this mechanism, we propose an efficient scheme for the nonlinear generation of a DC spin current via electric near fields, driven by AC spin polarization and electron velocity. This general principle offers a powerful route for generating and manipulating spin currents in unconventional superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“demonstrating”、“propose”、“offers”等理论推导和方案提出的关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：三重态超导体中的非相对论性自旋-轨道耦合效应，具体涉及p波超导体中的Edelstein效应和电场驱动的自旋泵浦。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三重态超导体的序参量会诱导Bogoliubov准粒子的波矢依赖自旋织构，从而在无相对论自旋-轨道耦合的情况下实现轨道与自旋运动的纠缠，进而产生电场驱动的自旋极化（Edelstein效应）和非线性直流自旋电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三重态超导体的序参量会诱导Bogoliubov准粒子的波矢依赖自旋织构，从而在无相对论自旋-轨道耦合的情况下实现轨道与自旋运动的纠缠，进而产生电场驱动的自旋极化（Edelstein效应）和非线性直流自旋电流。；创新点：揭示了三重态超导体中一种不同于传统相对论自旋-轨道耦合的非相对论性“自旋-轨道耦合”形式，并基于此提出了一种在非常规超导体中无需相对论自旋-轨道耦合即可高效产生和操控自旋电流的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于三重态超导体的序参量对称性推导准粒子自旋织构，并利用该机制提出通过交流自旋极化和电子速度实现非线性直流自旋电流的方案。

papers.title: Local distortions as a source of piezoelectric/stiffness decoupling in B-doped AlScN
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles analysis of the wurtzite pseudo-ternary (Al,Sc,B)N to elucidate the structural origin of a decoupling between stiffness $C_{33}$ and piezoelectric response $e_{33}$ upon boron incorporation, using DFT-relaxed 100-atom special quasirandom structures across a broad composition range. Pair distribution function analysis reveals interstitial threefold-coordinated boron atoms that have displaced from the tetrahedral cation site. Direct structural analysis establishes their preferential orientation along the $c$-axis and identifies a scandium-activated creation mechanism. The vertical coordination asymmetry of each cation is quantified through a site-specific axial asymmetry ratio (AAR), showing that boron incorporation progressively symmetrizes the Sc environment. Correlation with Born effective charges demonstrates that this symmetrization is the mechanism behind the piezoelectric enhancement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles analysis”、“DFT-relaxed”、“special quasirandom structures”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是wurtzite伪三元(Al,Sc,B)N体系，物理现象是硼（B）掺杂对刚度C33与压电响应e33之间解耦（decoupling）的结构起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硼原子掺入后形成偏离四面体阳离子位点的间隙三配位结构，并优先沿c轴取向；硼的引入使Sc周围环境逐渐对称化，这种对称化是压电增强的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硼原子掺入后形成偏离四面体阳离子位点的间隙三配位结构，并优先沿c轴取向；硼的引入使Sc周围环境逐渐对称化，这种对称化是压电增强的机制。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的第一性原理计算，使用100原子特殊准随机结构（SQS）模型，并结合对分布函数（PDF）分析、直接结构分析以及Born有效电荷计算。

papers.title: p-Wave Orbital Angular Momentum Texture in a Chiral Crystal
papers.abstract: The spin and orbital angular momentum (SAM and OAM) are conceptually analogous, yet their roles in condensed matter systems have not been often treated on equal footing. While SAM has been extensively explored, OAM has long been regarded as quenched in crystalline environments and thus largely overlooked. Recent experimental and theoretical advances, however, have demonstrated that OAM can drive a variety of novel electronic phenomena, highlighting the importance of probing OAM textures in the electronic band structure. Here, we investigate the momentum-space OAM texture of (TaSe4)2I, a one-dimensional chiral crystal. Using circular-dichroism angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (CD-ARPES), we uncover a p-wave OAM texture accompanied by OAM dipole structures. This orbital p-wave texture is intimately connected to, and thus controllable by the chirality of the host lattice. Complementary spin-resolved ARPES measurements and first-principles calculations reveal that the OAM polarization overwhelmingly dominates the low-energy electronic properties of (TaSe4)2I, far exceeding the SAM polarization. These observations represent the experimental verification of a new type of OAM texture in crystalline materials. Most importantly, these findings underscore a promising material platform for spinless orbitronics applications and lay the foundation for realizing multipolar OAM textures-orbital counterparts of the spin texture in unconventional magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“circular-dichroism angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (CD-ARPES)”、“spin-resolved ARPES measurements”和“first-principles calculations”。；研究对象：一维手性晶体(TaSe4)2I中的动量空间轨道角动量（OAM）纹理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在手性晶体(TaSe4)2I中发现了p波轨道角动量纹理，并伴随有OAM偶极结构；该OAM极化在低能电子性质中远超过自旋角动量（SAM）极化，且与晶体的手性紧密相关并可被其调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在手性晶体(TaSe4)2I中发现了p波轨道角动量纹理，并伴随有OAM偶极结构；该OAM极化在低能电子性质中远超过自旋角动量（SAM）极化，且与晶体的手性紧密相关并可被其调控。；创新点：实验验证了晶体材料中一种新型的OAM纹理（p波OAM纹理），并揭示了OAM极化在低能电子性质中压倒性地超过SAM极化，为无自旋轨道电子学（spinless orbitronics）提供了有前景的材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 圆二色性角分辨光电子能谱（CD-ARPES）探测OAM纹理；自旋分辨ARPES测量自旋极化；第一性原理计算进行理论验证。

papers.title: Quantum Geometry-Driven Nonlinear Spin Currents in Floquet Non-Hermitian Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are rapidly emerging as a highly promising platform for spintronics, yet dynamically controlling their spin responses remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we demonstrate that introducing periodic optical driving and non-Hermiticity provides a powerful route to achieve tunable control over these systems. We derive a general analytical expression for nonlinear spin currents in non-Hermitian phases with a spectral line gap, revealing that the intrinsic response cleanly separates into quantum metric, Berry curvature, and Berry connection dipole contributions. Applying this formalism to a Floquet non-Hermitian $d$-wave altermagnet, we uncover that the nonlinear spin conductivity is overwhelmingly dominated by the bare quantum metric. Furthermore, we show that the optical field's polarization can actively tune -- and even strictly reverse -- the direction of both longitudinal and transverse spin currents. Our work establishes a quantum geometric framework for the optical manipulation of nonlinear spin transport in advanced magnetic materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derive a general analytical expression、formalism、quantum geometric framework。；研究对象：Floquet非厄米d波交变磁体（altermagnet）中的非线性自旋电流，以及周期性光驱动和非厄米性对自旋响应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性自旋电导率主要由量子度量（quantum metric）主导，且光场的偏振方向可以有效调控甚至严格反转纵向和横向自旋电流的方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性自旋电导率主要由量子度量（quantum metric）主导，且光场的偏振方向可以有效调控甚至严格反转纵向和横向自旋电流的方向。；创新点：建立了用于光学操控先进磁性材料中非线性自旋输运的量子几何框架，揭示了量子度量在非厄米交变磁体非线性自旋响应中的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 推导了具有谱线间隙的非厄米相中非线性自旋电流的通用解析表达式，并将该形式应用于Floquet非厄米d波交变磁体模型，分析了量子度量、贝里曲率和贝里连接偶极子对响应的贡献。

papers.title: Entropy Production from Spin--Vibrational Coupling in Endohedral-Fullerene Qubits Encapsulated in Suspended Carbon Nanotubes
papers.abstract: Hybrid carbon nanotube-fullerene architectures provide a controllable platform for studying irreversibility and information flow in structured quantum environments. We analyze entropy generation in a system where paramagnetic endohedral fullerenes, such as N@C$_{60}$ and P@C$_{60}$, are encapsulated inside a suspended carbon nanotube (CNT) resonator, with selected multi-level fullerene spin states forming an effective qubit coupled to quantized CNT flexural modes. Building on prior work on fullerene-filled CNTs, spin-phonon control in suspended nanotubes, and phase-space propagators for damped driven oscillators, we develop a hybrid open-system model combining driven quantum Brownian motion of the CNT with an effective Jaynes-Cummings spin-vibrational interaction. The resonator dynamics are represented by a Wigner function whose evolution is written analytically in terms of the initial Wigner distribution and a Gaussian propagator. This phase-space description separates drive-induced displacement, diffusion, and damping, and connects these processes directly to entropy flow. The coupled spin-mechanical dynamics are embedded in a Lindblad master equation including mechanical damping, spin relaxation, pure dephasing, and thermally activated excitation. Within this framework we derive the entropy balance, identify entropy flux and non-negative entropy production, and examine how spin-vibrational hybridization redistributes irreversibility between coherent exchange and dissipative channels. We show that magnetic-gradient-enhanced spin-phonon coupling, resonant driving, and moderate thermal occupation produce crossovers between oscillator-dominated and spin-dominated entropy-production regimes. The framework provides a basis for using CNT-PEF hybrids as nanoscale platforms to study nonequilibrium quantum thermodynamics, decoherence, and information loss in vibrational environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：hybrid open-system model、Lindblad master equation、phase-space propagators、entropy balance。；研究对象：内嵌富勒烯（如N@C₆₀和P@C₆₀）封装在悬浮碳纳米管谐振腔中形成的混合体系，具体研究自旋-振动耦合导致的熵产生与不可逆性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋-振动杂化会在相干交换通道与耗散通道之间重新分配不可逆性；通过磁梯度增强的自旋-声子耦合、共振驱动以及适度的热占据，可以实现从振荡器主导到自旋主导的熵产生机制之间的交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋-振动杂化会在相干交换通道与耗散通道之间重新分配不可逆性；通过磁梯度增强的自旋-声子耦合、共振驱动以及适度的热占据，可以实现从振荡器主导到自旋主导的熵产生机制之间的交叉。；创新点：将碳纳米管-内嵌富勒烯混合体系作为可控平台，系统建立了自旋-振动耦合下熵产生与信息流的理论框架，并定量分析了不同耗散通道对不可逆性的贡献。
papers.method_zh: 混合开放系统模型：将驱动量子布朗运动（碳纳米管谐振腔）与有效Jaynes-Cummings自旋-振动相互作用相结合；利用Wigner函数及其高斯传播子解析描述谐振腔动力学；采用包含机械阻尼、自旋弛豫、纯退相和热激活激发的Lindblad主方程推导熵平衡方程。

papers.title: Itinerant antiferromagnetism in the antagonistic pair compound Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag
papers.abstract: Low dimensional crystallographic motifs have long been associated with desirable physical properties. The confinement of electrons to low dimensions is thought to enhance quantum fluctuations and may promote correlated phenomena. Here, using the antagonistic pair concept, we add Y to the immiscible Co-Ag pair to discover Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag. This compound adopts a monoclinic $I$2/$m$ structure consisting of Y channels that are filled by one-dimensional zigzag and hexagonal Co chains, which extend along the crystallographic $b$-axis with no nearest neighbor contacts between Co and Ag atoms. Transport, magnetic, and specific heat measurements reveal that Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag orders antiferromagnetically at $T_N=14.9$ K with an effective magnetic moment $μ_{\text{eff}}$ = 1.4 $μ_{\text{B}}$/Co. Specific heat measurements show only a small entropy loss on the order of $0.1\,R\ln2$ associated with magnetic order, and magnetization isotherms, in DC fields up to 70 kOe at 1.8 K and in pulsed fields up to 600 kOe at 500 mK, indicate a small ordered moment of less than 0.2 $μ_B$/Co. Taken together, our results imply the presence of small, itinerant moments and strong fluctuations in Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag, suggesting that Y$_4$Co$_3$Ag may be a promising candidate material to investigate itinerant magnetic interactions in a quasi-one dimensional system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：transport, magnetic, specific heat measurements（输运、磁化、比热测量）。；研究对象：新型化合物Y₄Co₃Ag，一种由互不相溶的Co-Ag对通过添加Y元素合成的准一维反铁磁材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Y₄Co₃Ag在TN=14.9 K处发生反铁磁有序，但有效磁矩（1.4 μB/Co）与有序矩（<0.2 μB/Co）差异显著，且磁有序熵损失仅约0.1 R ln2，表明该体系具有小巡游磁矩和强涨落，是研究准一维巡游磁相互作用的候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Y₄Co₃Ag在TN=14.9 K处发生反铁磁有序，但有效磁矩（1.4 μB/Co）与有序矩（<0.2 μB/Co）差异显著，且磁有序熵损失仅约0.1 R ln2，表明该体系具有小巡游磁矩和强涨落，是研究准一维巡游磁相互作用的候选材料。；创新点：首次合成并表征了Y₄Co₃Ag这一由互不相溶Co-Ag对衍生的化合物，揭示了其准一维Co链结构中的巡游反铁磁行为。摘要未突出说明与已有准一维磁性材料的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 单晶合成（基于“拮抗对”概念添加Y元素）；输运测量、磁化率测量、比热测量；直流磁场（70 kOe，1.8 K）和脉冲磁场（600 kOe，500 mK）下的磁化等温线。

papers.title: Multifractal and Ergodic Properties of Conductance Fluctuations under Strong Disorder
papers.abstract: Understanding the stochastic properties of conductance fluctuations in disordered mesoscopic systems is fundamental to quantum transport. In this work, we investigate the multifractal and ergodic properties of the fictitious time series of conductance in two-dimensional tight-binding models under varying Anderson disorder. Using standard multifractal analysis, we show that conductance fluctuations exhibit a transition from non-ergodic to ergodic behavior as the disorder strength increases, as evidenced by the decay of the conductance correlation function. Remarkably, multifractality persists in both regimes; however, it becomes insensitive to shuffling in the strong-disorder (ergodic) regime, suggesting that distributional effects dominate temporal organization. On the contrary, in the weakly disordered (non-ergodic) regime, long-range correlations play a significant role. These findings are robust against changes in lead geometry (asymmetric vs. symmetric). Our results provide new insights into the interplay between ergodicity, multifractality, and rare events in disordered quantum transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：multifractal analysis、tight-binding models、fictitious time series。；研究对象：二维紧束缚模型在安德森无序下的电导涨落，具体研究其多重分形与遍历性性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着无序强度增加，电导涨落从非遍历行为转变为遍历行为；多重分形性在两个区域均存在，但在强无序（遍历）区域对打乱不敏感，表明分布效应主导时间组织，而弱无序（非遍历）区域长程关联起重要作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着无序强度增加，电导涨落从非遍历行为转变为遍历行为；多重分形性在两个区域均存在，但在强无序（遍历）区域对打乱不敏感，表明分布效应主导时间组织，而弱无序（非遍历）区域长程关联起重要作用。；创新点：揭示了电导涨落中遍历性与多重分形性之间的相互作用，并指出在强无序区域分布效应（而非时间关联）主导多重分形特征，这一发现对铅几何结构（非对称与对称）具有鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准多重分形分析（multifractal analysis）对二维紧束缚模型在变强度安德森无序下的电导虚构时间序列进行分析，并通过电导关联函数的衰减判断遍历性转变。

papers.title: Strong universality class in disordered systems
papers.abstract: Disordered systems are very rich laboratories for exploring complex systems. In particular, disordered magnetic systems have been extremely important in the last five decades for understanding a wide range of phenomena. In this work, we use the Edwards-Anderson Hamiltonian to obtain the thermodynamic properties of disordered magnetic systems. In this way, we conduct a systematic investigation of magnetization, correlation functions, order parameter, and fractal dimensions, in function of disorder. In this context, the autocorrelation function for order--parameter fluctuations, introduced by Fisher ( Journal of Mathematical Physics 5, 944322 (1964)), provides an important mathematical framework for understanding the second-order phase transition at equilibrium. However, his analysis is restricted to a Euclidean space of dimension $d$, and an exponent $η$ is introduced to correct the spatial behavior of the correlation function at $T=T_c$. In recent work, Lima et al ( Phys. Rev. E 110, L062107 (2024)) demonstrated that at $T_c$ a fractal analysis is necessary for a complete description of the correlation function. We use Monte Carlo simulations to validate analytical results and to show how disorder alters critical exponents , giving rise to different universality classes. On the other hand, there is a subgroup of critical exponents and fractal dimensions that are invariant with disorder. This subgroup heralds a strong universality class.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用Edwards-Anderson哈密顿量”、“Monte Carlo模拟”以及“分析临界指数和分形维数”，属于理论推导与数值计算结合的研究。；研究对象：无序磁性系统，具体为基于Edwards-Anderson哈密顿量描述的自旋玻璃或无序磁体，研究其在平衡态下的二级相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 无序系统中存在一组对无序不敏感的临界指数和分形维数，这标志着一种“强普适类”的存在，即某些临界行为在无序变化下保持稳定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：无序系统中存在一组对无序不敏感的临界指数和分形维数，这标志着一种“强普适类”的存在，即某些临界行为在无序变化下保持稳定。；创新点：在Fisher经典理论（限于欧几里得空间）和Lima等人近期工作（引入分形分析）的基础上，首次通过数值模拟揭示无序系统中存在一组对无序不变的临界指数和分形维数，从而提出“强普适类”这一新概念。
papers.method_zh: 采用Edwards-Anderson哈密顿量进行理论建模，利用Fisher提出的序参量涨落自关联函数作为数学框架，并通过Monte Carlo模拟验证解析结果，分析无序对临界指数的影响。

papers.title: Radio-frequency reflectometry in silicon carbide large-area transistors
papers.abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) reflectometry is widely used for high-bandwidth readout of semiconductor quantum devices at cryogenic temperatures, but its application has mainly been limited to nanoscale structures with relatively small capacitances. Here, we investigate RF readout in a different regime by applying gate-based reflectometry to a large-area silicon carbide transistor with parasitic capacitances orders of magnitude larger than those of typical quantum devices, conditions normally expected to hinder RF readout. We observe a gate-dependent RF response which degrades and eventually vanishes as temperature is lowered, although MOSFET operation in DC transport is maintained down to deep cryogenic temperatures. We attribute this behaviour to impedance changes introduced by carrier freeze-out in the transistor drift region, and propose a modified circuit configuration designed to restore sensitivity under these conditions. These results establish how parasitic pathways and device geometry can limit RF readout, providing insight into the design of scalable cryogenic-CMOS quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观测（“We observe a gate-dependent RF response”）和提出的电路配置修改方案。；研究对象：大面积碳化硅（SiC）晶体管，具体研究其在高寄生电容（比典型量子器件大数个数量级）条件下的射频反射测量（RF reflectometry）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大面积SiC晶体管中，射频反射测量信号在低温下会退化并最终消失，尽管器件的直流MOSFET输运特性在深低温下依然保持。该现象归因于晶体管漂移区中载流子冻结导致的阻抗变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大面积SiC晶体管中，射频反射测量信号在低温下会退化并最终消失，尽管器件的直流MOSFET输运特性在深低温下依然保持。该现象归因于晶体管漂移区中载流子冻结导致的阻抗变化。；创新点：将射频反射测量技术从通常应用于小电容的纳米尺度量子器件，拓展到具有极大寄生电容的大面积晶体管这一新领域。揭示了寄生路径和器件几何结构如何限制射频读出，为可扩展的低温CMOS量子系统设计提供了见解。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法为门控反射测量（gate-based reflectometry），这是一种射频反射测量技术。通过测量大面积SiC晶体管的栅极依赖的射频响应，并结合直流输运特性进行对比分析。此外，还提出了修改电路配置的方案。

papers.title: Reversible nanoscale patterning of WTe$_2$ with a scanning tunneling microscope
papers.abstract: Manipulating the lattice structure of ferroelectric quantum materials enables their use in low-power electronic devices, including field-effect transistors. WTe$_2$ is a Weyl-semimetal candidate and ferroelectric, both properties arising from the reduced crystal symmetry of its T$_\mathrm{d}$ ground state.
