These topological excitations are classified by $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $, enforced by the nonorientability of the Klein-bottle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、formulate、theory、classified。；研究对象：各向异性自旋相互作用模型中的对称性，具体涉及自旋-空间群（SSG）对称性的扭曲及其拓扑激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 各向异性自旋相互作用并非简单地破坏自旋-空间群对称性，而是通过上同调不变量将其扭曲，产生超出O(3)×Isom(ℝ³)子群的对称类；基于此，在自旋-1模型中发现了定义在自旋布里渊区克莱因瓶（而非传统环面）上的拓扑四极激发，其拓扑性质由ℤ₂分类。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：各向异性自旋相互作用并非简单地破坏自旋-空间群对称性，而是通过上同调不变量将其扭曲，产生超出O(3)×Isom(ℝ³)子群的对称类；基于此，在自旋-1模型中发现了定义在自旋布里渊区克莱因瓶（而非传统环面）上的拓扑四极激发，其拓扑性质由ℤ₂分类。；创新点：首次提出各向异性自旋相互作用通过上同调不变量扭曲对称性，而非简单破缺，并据此构建了tSSG理论框架；揭示了自旋激发可在非可定向的克莱因瓶布里渊区上定义，并得到ℤ₂拓扑分类。
papers.method_zh: 采用扭曲自旋-空间群（tSSG）理论重新定义自旋-only群S₀，并利用线性味波理论（linear flavor wave theory）分析具有tSSG对称性的自旋-1模型，通过玻色子BdG哈密顿量的滑移反射缝合关系以及能带谱中的莫比乌斯边界态进行表征。

papers.title: Image Force Effects on Tunneling Currents in an STM -- I `Point charge in the Barrier Region' - Model
papers.abstract: In a Scanning Tunneling Microscope (STM), when a tunneling electron treated as a point charge enters the barrier region between the tip and the sample, it induces image charges on the conducting surfaces, which modifies the shape of the potential barrier it sees. In this paper, the effect of the modification in the barrier potential due to these induced charges on the tunneling current density and currents in an STM,is studied as a function of the tip-sample distance $d$ and the Bias Potential $eV_b$. The image potential is found to reduce the height and the effective width of the potential barrier, leading to a huge increase in the tunneling current densities. This huge increase (by several order of magnitudes) is however unreasonable, prompting a revisit of the assumption that the electron in the barrier region is a point particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“模型”（Model）、“研究”（studied）、“假设”（assumption）等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：扫描隧道显微镜（STM）中隧穿电子在针尖与样品之间的势垒区域内的行为，具体研究点电荷模型下镜像力对隧穿势垒形状及隧穿电流的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 镜像势会降低势垒的高度和有效宽度，导致隧穿电流密度出现几个数量级的巨大增加，但这种不合理的大幅增加表明将势垒区电子视为点粒子的假设需要重新审视。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：镜像势会降低势垒的高度和有效宽度，导致隧穿电流密度出现几个数量级的巨大增加，但这种不合理的大幅增加表明将势垒区电子视为点粒子的假设需要重新审视。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用点电荷模型，通过引入镜像电荷修正势垒形状，并基于修正后的势垒计算隧穿电流密度和电流随针尖-样品距离 \(d\) 及偏压 \(eV_b\) 的变化关系。

papers.title: Resonant optical cooling of nuclear spins in case of strong Knight field of photoexcited electrons
papers.abstract: Resonant cooling of the nuclear spin system of a semiconductor by spin-polarized charge carriers under pumping with helicity-modulated polarized light is considered theoretically. It is shown that in the case of strong Knight field of charge carriers, exceeding local fields of the dipole-dipole interaction of nuclear spins, the Overhauser field arising as a result of resonant cooling can considerably modify the overall shape of magnetic-field dependences of charge carrier spin polarization, experimentally observed as the Hanle effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：considered theoretically、theoretical。；研究对象：半导体中核自旋系统的共振冷却，具体涉及光激发电子的强Knight场与核自旋偶极-偶极相互作用的竞争，以及由此产生的Overhauser场对Hanle效应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光激发电子的Knight场强于核自旋偶极-偶极相互作用的局域场时，共振冷却产生的Overhauser场会显著改变载流子自旋极化随磁场变化的整体形状（即Hanle效应曲线）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光激发电子的Knight场强于核自旋偶极-偶极相互作用的局域场时，共振冷却产生的Overhauser场会显著改变载流子自旋极化随磁场变化的整体形状（即Hanle效应曲线）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于自旋极化载流子与核自旋系统在螺旋度调制偏振光泵浦下的共振冷却模型，考虑了强Knight场条件。

papers.title: From Chaos to Synchrony in Recurrent Excitatory-Inhibitory Networks with Target-Specific Inhibition
papers.abstract: Biological neural networks can operate in qualitatively distinct dynamical regimes, and transitions between these regimes are thought to underlie changes in computation and behavior. The seminal work of Sompolinsky, Crisanti, and Sommers (SCS) showed that random recurrent networks undergo a transition from quiescence to asynchronous chaos, establishing a paradigmatic link between random connectivity, dynamical instability, and internally generated fluctuations in neural circuits. Here, we extend this framework to two-population firing-rate networks with segregated excitatory and inhibitory neurons and target-specific inhibitory couplings that break excitation--inhibition balance. Using dynamical mean-field theory, we derive self-consistent equations for the macroscopic mean activities and autocorrelations, together with stability criteria distinguishing mean-driven and fluctuation-driven instabilities. We show that target-specific inhibition organizes the phase diagram into three qualitative classes: inhibition-dominated or strictly balanced networks display only quiescent activity and asynchronous chaos; excitation-dominated networks display persistent activity together with either synchronous chaos with non-vanishing mean activity or coherent oscillations, depending on the stability-matrix eigenvalues. Crucially, coherent oscillations do not coexist with chaotic fluctuations around the periodic mean trajectory; rather, their onset suppresses the chaotic component, reminiscent of input-induced suppression of chaos. These results generalize SCS theory to recurrent networks with explicit excitatory--inhibitory structure and identify target-specific inhibition as a key control parameter for large-scale neural dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：dynamical mean-field theory（动力学平均场理论）、self-consistent equations（自洽方程）、stability criteria（稳定性判据）。；研究对象：具有靶向特异性抑制的兴奋-抑制双群体发放率神经网络中的动力学相变，具体包括从静息态到异步混沌、再到同步混沌或相干振荡的转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 靶向特异性抑制可将网络的相图组织为三类：抑制主导或严格平衡的网络仅出现静息态和异步混沌；兴奋主导的网络则出现持续活动，并伴随同步混沌或相干振荡，且相干振荡的出现会抑制混沌涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：靶向特异性抑制可将网络的相图组织为三类：抑制主导或严格平衡的网络仅出现静息态和异步混沌；兴奋主导的网络则出现持续活动，并伴随同步混沌或相干振荡，且相干振荡的出现会抑制混沌涨落。；创新点：将Sompolinsky、Crisanti和Sommers（SCS）的经典随机网络理论推广至具有明确兴奋-抑制结构的两群体网络，并识别出靶向特异性抑制作为调控大规模神经动力学的关键参数。摘要未突出说明与实验或具体生物数据的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用动力学平均场理论，推导了宏观平均活动和自相关的自洽方程，并结合稳定性判据区分平均驱动与涨落驱动的不稳定性。

papers.title: FKPP fronts in quenched random media
papers.abstract: We study numerically the evolution of one-dimensional FKPP fronts initiated from steep initial conditions in the presence of a quenched random growth rate. Compared to both the homogeneous case (with velocity $v_0$) and deterministic disorder, quenched randomness increases the average propagation speed. We show that the velocity shift relative to the homogeneous case scales linearly with the disorder variance $σ^2$, with a universal prefactor -- independent of the specific distribution of the disorder -- such that $v = v_0 + a σ^2$, with $a \approx 0.02432 \pm 0.00002$. Moreover, the front position exhibits diffusive fluctuations across disorder realizations. The corresponding effective diffusion coefficient scales quadratically with $σ$, $D = \frac{b^2 σ^2}{2}$, with $b \approx 0.223 \pm 0.002$. These results suggest a universal statistical response of FKPP fronts to quenched heterogeneity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerically study（数值研究）、scales linearly（线性标度）、effective diffusion coefficient（有效扩散系数）。；研究对象：一维FKPP（Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovsky-Piscounov）锋面在淬火随机介质中的演化，具体为存在淬火随机生长率的一维反应-扩散系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 淬火随机性使FKPP锋面的平均传播速度相对于均匀情形增加，速度偏移与无序方差σ²呈线性关系，且具有与无序具体分布无关的普适前因子；锋面位置在不同无序实现间表现出扩散型涨落，有效扩散系数与σ²呈二次标度关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：淬火随机性使FKPP锋面的平均传播速度相对于均匀情形增加，速度偏移与无序方差σ²呈线性关系，且具有与无序具体分布无关的普适前因子；锋面位置在不同无序实现间表现出扩散型涨落，有效扩散系数与σ²呈二次标度关系。；创新点：发现了淬火随机介质中FKPP锋面速度偏移和扩散系数的普适标度律（速度偏移系数a≈0.02432，扩散系数系数b≈0.223），且前因子与无序分布的具体形式无关，揭示了淬火无序对FKPP锋面统计响应的普适性。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerical study），从陡峭初始条件出发演化一维FKPP方程，引入淬火随机生长率，通过统计平均提取速度偏移和扩散系数标度关系。

papers.title: Revealing Hidden Correlations in a Fermi-Hubbard system via Interaction Ramps
papers.abstract: We observe an enhanced visibility of charge-density-wave correlations in a cold-atom realization of the attractive Hubbard model following a rapid boost of the interaction strength. The interaction boost associates nonlocal pairs into doublons which mark the center of mass of the original pairs. The enhancement is largest in the strongly correlated regime where pairing is nonlocal. We distinguish the unpaired Fermi liquid from the pseudogap phase of preformed pairs by analyzing atom-resolved spin-charge correlations after the ramp. The technique we establish here may facilitate the observation of exotic forms of pair order in spin-imbalanced systems, and of stripe order in the dual case of the doped repulsive Hubbard model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“We observe”、“cold-atom realization”、“analyzing atom-resolved spin-charge correlations”。；研究对象：冷原子实现的吸引型Hubbard模型中的电荷密度波关联，以及相互作用强度快速提升（interaction ramp）对关联可见度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过快速提升相互作用强度，将非局域配对转化为双占据（doublons），从而显著增强了电荷密度波关联的可见度；在强关联预配对（pseudogap）相中增强效果最大，并可通过原子分辨的自旋-电荷关联区分未配对的费米液体与预配对相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过快速提升相互作用强度，将非局域配对转化为双占据（doublons），从而显著增强了电荷密度波关联的可见度；在强关联预配对（pseudogap）相中增强效果最大，并可通过原子分辨的自旋-电荷关联区分未配对的费米液体与预配对相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 冷原子实验实现吸引型Hubbard模型，通过快速相互作用提升（interaction ramp）将非局域配对转化为双占据，并利用原子分辨的自旋-电荷关联分析进行探测。

papers.title: Generative reconstruction of 2D and 3D polycrystalline microstructures using symmetrized hyperspherical harmonics
papers.abstract: Establishing structure-property linkages in polycrystalline materials requires representative two- (2D) and three- (3D) dimensional microstructural inputs for full-field simulations. A core objective of microstructure characterization and reconstruction is the generative synthesis of 2D and 3D microstructures that reflect a target statistical ensemble using limited 2D data as a reference. This work introduces an orientation-based differentiable microstructure characterization and reconstruction framework, implemented in MCRpy, to perform reconstructions of voxelized images. Unit quaternions in combination with symmetrized hyperspherical harmonics are utilized to derive a continuous, symmetry-invariant representation of crystallographic orientations to overcome the numerical singularities and discontinuities associated with traditional Euler-based methods. The descriptor-based reconstructions are driven by a set combining two-point spatial correlations, a novel hybrid three-point variogram, and a mean variation regularizer to capture both global texture and local interfacial topology. The framework's efficiency is demonstrated by reconstructing 3D realizations from 2D orientation data of an aluminum alloy after thermo-mechanical processing, successfully recovering both morphological features and crystallographic distribution. Systematic benchmarking indicates that second-order gradient-based optimization, utilizing the L-BFGS-B algorithm, effectively navigates the complex loss landscape to generate high-fidelity realizations with minimal residuals. This methodology provides a versatile, open-source framework for the digital synthesis of polycrystalline representative volume elements to facilitate the rapid development of microstructure-informed materials design workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：generative reconstruction（生成式重建）、differentiable framework（可微框架）、optimization（优化）、open-source framework（开源框架）。；研究对象：多晶材料的微观结构，具体为2D和3D的体素化图像，并以热机械加工后的铝合金为例进行验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于取向的可微微观结构表征与重建框架，利用对称化超球谐函数克服了传统欧拉角方法在表示晶体取向时的数值奇点和不连续性问题，能够从有限的2D取向数据成功重建出3D多晶微观结构，并恢复其形态特征和晶体学分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于取向的可微微观结构表征与重建框架，利用对称化超球谐函数克服了传统欧拉角方法在表示晶体取向时的数值奇点和不连续性问题，能够从有限的2D取向数据成功重建出3D多晶微观结构，并恢复其形态特征和晶体学分布。；创新点：1. 引入对称化超球谐函数来表示晶体取向，解决了传统欧拉角方法的数值问题。2. 提出了一种混合三点变差函数作为新的描述符，以更好地捕捉局部界面拓扑。3. 提供了一个开源、通用的框架，用于从2D数据生成3D多晶代表性体积单元。
papers.method_zh: 1. 使用单位四元数结合对称化超球谐函数，构建晶体取向的连续、对称不变表示。2. 采用描述符驱动的重建方法，结合两点空间相关性、一种新型混合三点变差函数和平均变化正则化器。3. 使用基于二阶梯度的L-BFGS-B优化算法，在MCRpy开源框架中实现体素化图像的重建。

papers.title: Lévy-like flights and fractal geometry of finite point sets
papers.abstract: We study Lévy-like and truncated Lévy-like flights with step probability distribution of the form $r^{-1+ν}$ for negative, positive, and zero $ν$, focusing on the appearance of fractal geometry characteristics in the generated point sets. Forming ensembles of such point sets with fixed multiplicity, we develop simulation techniques leading to the desired value of correlation dimension in a vast continuous interval of scales. In particular, we demonstrate the possibility to produce ensembles of data sets with a low number of points with the needed properties. Furthermore, we show that the positive $ν$ distributions, apart from a region near the upper scale limit, show fractal behaviour that extends to infinitesimally low scales. As an example, we apply our findings to producing simulations relevant to the search for critical fluctuations, related to QCD critical endpoint, in heavy-ion collision experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：simulation techniques、probability distribution、fractal geometry）；研究对象：有限点集的Lévy类飞行与截断Lévy类飞行，以及由此生成的点集所呈现的分形几何特征；应用背景为重离子碰撞实验中与QCD临界端点相关的临界涨落搜索。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于正ν的步长概率分布，除靠近上限尺度区域外，点集在极低尺度上仍表现出分形行为；并证明了可生成具有所需相关维数且点数较少的点集系综。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于正ν的步长概率分布，除靠近上限尺度区域外，点集在极低尺度上仍表现出分形行为；并证明了可生成具有所需相关维数且点数较少的点集系综。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过模拟技术生成具有固定多重性的点集系综，控制步长概率分布形式为r^{-1+ν}（ν为负、正或零），并测量点集的相关维数。

papers.title: Transient superionic state in ultrafast-irradiated post-transition metal oxides
papers.abstract: Matter under irradiation may enter unusual transient states, outside of its equilibrium phase diagram. One of such states is a superionic-like state, in which one sublattice of a compound liquifies, whereas another one remains solid. Here, we study theoretically post-transition metal oxides under ultrafast excitation of its electronic system, identifying which compounds produce such a superionic state. It is shown that oxides with sufficiently sparce metallic sublattices (e.g. corundum structure) generally form transient superionic states via nonthermal phase transition. More closely packed lattices (such as the zinc-blend structure in ZnO and CdO) do not exhibit superionicity. Tl and Pb oxides only enter thermally-produced superionic states (induced by the atomic heating via electron-phonon coupling), but not nonthermal ones. Sn and Bi oxides demonstrate states that cannot be clearly classified, in which oxygen subsystem diffuses significantly more and faster than the metallic one, but the metallic one is not stable as it would be in a truly superionic state.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study theoretically、nonthermal phase transition、electron-phonon coupling。；研究对象：后过渡金属氧化物（如Sn、Bi、Tl、Pb、Zn、Cd的氧化物）在超快辐照下的瞬态超离子态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 具有足够稀疏金属亚晶格的氧化物（如刚玉结构）可通过非热相变形成瞬态超离子态；而密堆积结构（如ZnO和CdO的闪锌矿结构）则不表现超离子性。Tl和Pb氧化物仅通过电子-声子耦合加热产生热致超离子态，Sn和Bi氧化物则呈现难以明确分类的中间态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：具有足够稀疏金属亚晶格的氧化物（如刚玉结构）可通过非热相变形成瞬态超离子态；而密堆积结构（如ZnO和CdO的闪锌矿结构）则不表现超离子性。Tl和Pb氧化物仅通过电子-声子耦合加热产生热致超离子态，Sn和Bi氧化物则呈现难以明确分类的中间态。；创新点：系统性地识别了哪些后过渡金属氧化物在超快辐照下能产生非热超离子态，并区分了非热与热致超离子态的机制差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于电子系统超快激发后的非平衡态动力学，通过比较不同金属亚晶格密度和结构（如刚玉、闪锌矿）来识别超离子态的形成条件。

papers.title: T-E formulation-based modeling of thin HTS shell magnetization
papers.abstract: Numerical methods for modeling thin-film magnetization are primarily focused on computing the current density distribution. The highly nonlinear current-voltage characteristic of type-II superconductors significantly complicates the accurate computation of the electric field. The T-E formulation-based mixed finite element method, previously derived for flat superconducting films, enables the simultaneous, accurate determination of both variables. Another advantage of this method is that the computational domain is limited to the film itself: no meshing of the surrounding space is required. The thin-shell approximation reduces the problem to a two-dimensional one. This work extends the T-E formulation and numerical method to non-flat superconducting shells with a metal substrate. We validate the method with several test examples, including modeling the magnetization of a sphere. The method is then applied to a realistic model of a cylindrical magnetic dynamo pump, and the generated open-circuit voltage is computed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：numerical methods、modeling、mixed finite element method、computed。；研究对象：薄高温超导壳体的磁化过程，具体包括非平坦超导壳（如球壳）以及带有金属衬底的超导结构，并应用于圆柱形磁动力泵模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将基于T-E公式的混合有限元方法从平坦超导薄膜推广至非平坦超导壳，成功模拟了其磁化行为，并计算了圆柱形磁动力泵的开路电压。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将基于T-E公式的混合有限元方法从平坦超导薄膜推广至非平坦超导壳，成功模拟了其磁化行为，并计算了圆柱形磁动力泵的开路电压。；创新点：将原本适用于平坦超导薄膜的T-E公式混合有限元方法扩展至非平坦超导壳（如球壳），并考虑了金属衬底的影响，同时验证了该方法在复杂几何结构（如磁动力泵）中的实用性。
papers.method_zh: 采用T-E公式（电流矢量势T与电场E）的混合有限元方法，结合薄壳近似将三维问题降为二维，计算域仅限超导壳本身，无需对周围空间进行网格划分。

papers.title: Atomically resolved intrinsic superconducting gap in (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films
papers.abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper bilayer nickelates provide an emerging platform for studying high-temperature superconductivity, yet the superconducting pairing symmetry remains under debate. Here, we use atomic-resolution scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy to investigate superconducting 1.5-unit-cell (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films grown on SrLaAlO4. A cryogenic ultrahigh-vacuum (UHV) sample transfer preserves an ordered sqrt(2) * sqrt(2) surface and yields reproducible U-shaped spectra with two gap scales of ~14 and ~20 meV and extended flat zero-conductance bottoms. By contrast, samples exposed for a longer time in UHV without cooling during transfer show V-shaped spectra despite retaining the surface reconstruction and a transport superconducting transition onset above 40 K. Wide-energy-range spectra indicate that oxygen loss can mix density-wave-related spectral weight. Our measurements provide an atomic-scale observation of the intrinsic nodeless superconducting gap in bilayer nickelate ultrathin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy（扫描隧道显微镜和光谱学）、atomic-resolution（原子分辨率）、cryogenic ultrahigh-vacuum sample transfer（低温超高真空样品传输）。；研究对象：(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜的超导配对对称性，具体为生长在SrLaAlO₄衬底上的1.5个单胞厚度的双层镍酸盐超导薄膜。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子级分辨的扫描隧道谱，在(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中观测到两个能隙尺度（约14 meV和20 meV）且具有平坦零电导底部的U形谱，表明其本征超导能隙为无节点（nodeless）类型，而非V形谱所对应的节点型能隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子级分辨的扫描隧道谱，在(La,Pr)₃Ni₂O₇薄膜中观测到两个能隙尺度（约14 meV和20 meV）且具有平坦零电导底部的U形谱，表明其本征超导能隙为无节点（nodeless）类型，而非V形谱所对应的节点型能隙。；创新点：首次在原子尺度上直接观测到双层镍酸盐超导薄膜的本征无节点超导能隙，并通过对比不同真空暴露条件的样品，区分了本征超导信号与氧缺失导致的密度波相关谱权重混合效应。
papers.method_zh: 原子分辨率扫描隧道显微镜和扫描隧道谱（STM/STS），结合低温超高真空原位样品传输技术，以及输运测量（确认超导转变起始温度高于40 K）。

papers.title: Melting Behavior and Phase Stability of CaO from Neural Network Potentials: a Molecular Dynamics Study
papers.abstract: We investigate the melting behavior of calcium oxide (CaO) under extreme conditions, a problem that remains poorly constrained due to experimental limitations despite its relevance for geophysical and technological applications. We develop a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP) for CaO with PANNA 2.0 and the LATTE descriptor, training it on a dataset of $\sim$12,000 configurations including solid, liquid, interfacial, and void-containing structures, extracted from ab-initio molecular dynamics data employing PBEsol exchange-correlation functional. We perform large-scale molecular dynamics simulations to compute the melting temperature at ambient pressure using both the void-nucleated melting (VNM) and two-phase coexistence (TPC) methods, obtaining $T_m=3055\pm11$ K and $T_m=2847\pm15$ K, respectively.\\ We calculate an enthalpy of fusion of $ΔH_f\sim73$ kJ/mol, in agreement with thermodynamic assessments and ab initio calculations. We also reproduce the thermal expansion and obtain a volume increase of $\sim$29% at Tm, consistent with the corresponding decrease in density extracted from spatially resolved number density profiles. Finally, we calculate the high-pressure melting curve of CaO up to 20 GPa, providing one of the very few computational determinations of this quantity to date. The results confirm that the overheating ratio $η$ is not constant under pressure, increasing from 17% at ambient pressure to 24% at 20 GPa, confirming previous findings and ruling out the assumption of a fixed overheating ratio. Our results establish MLIP-based simulations as a robust and efficient framework for investigating phase stability in ionic oxides and provide new insight into the melting behavior of CaO under extreme conditions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP)”、“molecular dynamics simulations”、“ab-initio molecular dynamics data”。；研究对象：氧化钙（CaO）在极端条件下的熔化行为与相稳定性，包括常压熔点、熔化焓、热膨胀以及高压熔化曲线（最高20 GPa）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用神经网络势函数进行分子动力学模拟，得到CaO在常压下的熔点为2847–3055 K（取决于方法），并发现过热比（overheating ratio）随压力增加而增大（从常压的17%升至20 GPa时的24%），否定了固定过热比的假设。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用神经网络势函数进行分子动力学模拟，得到CaO在常压下的熔点为2847–3055 K（取决于方法），并发现过热比（overheating ratio）随压力增加而增大（从常压的17%升至20 GPa时的24%），否定了固定过热比的假设。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用PANNA 2.0和LATTE描述符构建机器学习原子间势（MLIP），训练数据集来自约12,000个包含固、液、界面及含空洞结构的构型（基于PBEsol交换关联泛函的从头算分子动力学数据）。使用空洞成核熔化法（VNM）和两相共存法（TPC）进行大规模分子动力学模拟计算熔点。

papers.title: Thermal expansion of FeWO$_4$ (Ferberite) and FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$ (7:1): a comparative X-ray and neutron diffraction study
papers.abstract: The thermal expansion of natural FeWO$_4$ (ferberite) and synthetic FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$ (7:1) was investigated over the 2-1123 K temperature range combining single-crystal and powder X-ray diffraction together with neutron powder diffraction. High-precision lattice parameters were obtained for both samples. The temperature dependence of the unit-cell volume was analysed using physically based thermodynamic models, including the Kroll and Berman approaches as implemented in EoSFit7. All datasets are well reproduced within their respective temperature intervals. However, significant differences are observed between the behavior of ferberite and FeWO$_4$:Fe$_2$WO$_6$, which has a \~40% smaller thermal expansion coefficient and a reduced reference volume. Possible origins, including microstructural and phase-coexistence effects, are discussed. The results provide a comprehensive description of the thermal expansion behavior of FeWO$_4$ across a wide temperature range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：结合单晶和粉末X射线衍射、中子粉末衍射等实验手段。；研究对象：天然FeWO₄（铁钨矿，ferberite）与合成FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆（7:1）的热膨胀行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 两种样品在2-1123 K宽温区内的热膨胀行为存在显著差异：FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆的热膨胀系数比天然FeWO₄小约40%，且参考体积更小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：两种样品在2-1123 K宽温区内的热膨胀行为存在显著差异：FeWO₄:Fe₂WO₆的热膨胀系数比天然FeWO₄小约40%，且参考体积更小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射、粉末X射线衍射、中子粉末衍射；采用基于物理的热力学模型（Kroll和Berman方法，通过EoSFit7软件实现）分析晶胞体积的温度依赖性。

papers.title: Optimizing strong light-matter coupling of plasmonic lattices and monolayer semiconductors
papers.abstract: Exciton-polaritons provide a versatile platform for the study of a wide range of phenomena, including polariton lasers, topological polaritons, and bosonic condensation. Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers host excitons with large oscillator strength and binding energies constituting a robust matter constituent that forms polaritons from cryogenic to room temperature when embedded in optical microcavities. Plasmonic nanoparticles arranged in lattice geometries offer strong field-confinement and high quality factors. However, the high sensitivity of monolayer excitons to strain and dielectric disorder necessitates encapsulation in atomically flat hBN to ensure a high optical quality, rendering plasmonics more challenging. Here, we employ our recently developed fabrication method for embedding gold nanodisk arrays into van der Waals heterostructures and compare two samples with opposite layer order. We observe that strain and etching-induced surface contamination can reduce the exciton quality and thus the light-matter interaction strength significantly. Our fabrication approach reduces interfacial irregularities and enables homogeneous large-area polariton lattices for a wide range of applications, such as polarization-control or topological polaritonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了“fabrication method”、“embedding gold nanodisk arrays”、“compare two samples”等实验操作和样品对比。；研究对象：等离激元晶格（金纳米盘阵列）与单层过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）半导体构成的强光-物质耦合体系，具体研究激子-极化激元。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 应变和刻蚀引起的表面污染会显著降低单层激子的光学质量，从而削弱光-物质相互作用强度；通过优化样品层序和封装工艺（嵌入hBN），可实现均匀的大面积极化激元晶格。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：应变和刻蚀引起的表面污染会显著降低单层激子的光学质量，从而削弱光-物质相互作用强度；通过优化样品层序和封装工艺（嵌入hBN），可实现均匀的大面积极化激元晶格。；创新点：提出了一种减少界面不平整和表面污染的制备策略，使得在等离激元体系中实现高质量、大面积的极化激元晶格成为可能，为偏振控制和拓扑极化激元学等应用铺平道路。
papers.method_zh: 采用将金纳米盘阵列嵌入范德华异质结的制备方法，对比两种不同层序的样品，通过观察激子质量变化来评估光-物质相互作用强度。

papers.title: Functional and Density-Driven Errors in Density Functional Theory: Quantum Monte Carlo Benchmarks for Solids
papers.abstract: We introduce a systematic analysis of density functional approximation errors in solids by separating functional-driven from density-driven contributions using quantum Monte Carlo densities of silicon, sodium chloride, and copper as reference. Typically, functional errors dominate, but we identify important exceptions where density-driven errors exceed functional errors by factors of 2-3, notably for SOGGA11 and τ-HCTH in the semiconductor and the insulator. Material dependence is striking: 63% of functionals show error cancellation in silicon versus 18% in copper, and only five functionals surpass LDA accuracy for metallic copper even with exact densities. For silicon and sodium chloride, GILL or BECKE exchange combined with PBE, PW91, or P86 correlation achieves near-exact xc energies on QMC densities, while copper requires specialized functionals like PBEsol or PBELYP. High-quality densities consistently reduce density-driven errors across all systems. Historical analysis reveals that 1990s GGA functionals outperform many modern meta-GGAs, contradicting expectations of systematic improvement along Jacob's ladder. These results provide practical guidance for functional selection and highlight implications for machine learning potential development, where material-dependent error cancellation may compromise transferability.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“quantum Monte Carlo benchmarks”、“density functional approximation errors”、“functional-driven and density-driven contributions”。；研究对象：固体材料中的密度泛函理论（DFT）近似误差，具体以硅（半导体）、氯化钠（绝缘体）和铜（金属）为基准体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通常泛函误差占主导，但存在重要例外：在半导体和绝缘体中，SOGGA11和τ-HCTH等泛函的密度驱动误差比泛函误差大2-3倍。材料依赖性显著：63%的泛函在硅中表现出误差抵消，而在铜中仅为18%；即使使用精确密度，也只有5种泛函在金属铜上超越LDA精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通常泛函误差占主导，但存在重要例外：在半导体和绝缘体中，SOGGA11和τ-HCTH等泛函的密度驱动误差比泛函误差大2-3倍。材料依赖性显著：63%的泛函在硅中表现出误差抵消，而在铜中仅为18%；即使使用精确密度，也只有5种泛函在金属铜上超越LDA精度。；创新点：首次通过QMC参考密度系统分离并量化固体中DFT的泛函驱动与密度驱动误差，揭示了材料依赖的误差抵消现象及其对机器学习势函数可迁移性的潜在影响。
papers.method_zh: 使用量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）方法计算硅、氯化钠和铜的精确电子密度作为参考，将DFT近似误差分解为泛函驱动误差和密度驱动误差两部分进行系统分析。

papers.title: Anisotropic Surface Spin Waves as Signature of A-type Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets have attracted intense interest because they have the advantages of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. However, their experimental identification remains challenging, in particular for the A-type altermagnets that account for a large group of material candidates. Here, we discover a kind of anisotropic surface spin waves in A-type altermagnets, which is absent in ferromagnets and conventional antiferromagnets. The anisotropic surface spin waves arise directly from the nature of altermagnets, i.e., the spin-opposite sublattices cannot be related by translation or inversion, which breaks the combined spatial-inversion and time-reversal symmetry, leading to the anisotropic surface spin waves with two properties, the chirality-dependent top-bottom positions and chiral split constant frequency contours. We further show that these two properties can be measured experimentally from the stray field and by resonance absorption spectrum, respectively. Our results provide a signature for detecting altermagnets and will inspire spin-based logic and information-storage devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段或计算模拟，主要基于理论推导和性质分析（如“发现”“源于”“导致”等理论论证词汇）。；研究对象：A型交变磁体（A-type altermagnets）中的表面自旋波（surface spin waves）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在A型交变磁体中发现了各向异性的表面自旋波，该现象在铁磁体和常规反铁磁体中不存在，可作为识别A型交变磁体的特征信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在A型交变磁体中发现了各向异性的表面自旋波，该现象在铁磁体和常规反铁磁体中不存在，可作为识别A型交变磁体的特征信号。；创新点：首次提出各向异性表面自旋波作为A型交变磁体的独特指纹，并揭示了其手性依赖的上下表面位置差异和手性分裂的恒定频率等高线这两个可实验观测的特性。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。基于交变磁体的本质特性（自旋相反的子晶格不能通过平移或反演操作关联，破坏空间反演与时间反演联合对称性），推导出表面自旋波的各向异性性质，并建议通过杂散场测量和共振吸收谱进行实验验证。

papers.title: Telecom-Wavelength-Compatible Quantum Information Transcription Using Nitrogen-Vacancy Centers
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are a leading platform for solid-state quantum sensing and quantum information processing. While most optical studies rely on the visible fluorescence associated with the triplet transitions, the infrared singlet transition near $1042$ nm, which is typically considered dark within the singlet manifold of the NV optical cycle, provides an alternative optical channel. Here, we report wavelength-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) measurements of this infrared emission. We directly observe ODMR contrast in the $1042$ nm emission and analyze its dependence on the magnetic field. The field-dependent spectral dispersion of the ODMR signal demonstrates that the spin-state information encoded in the NV center is transcribed to the infrared singlet emission through the spin-selective intersystem crossing, in close analogy to the visible fluorescence readout. These results establish infrared ODMR as a high-fidelity optical readout pathway. Crucially, by extending spin-state transcription directly into the $1300-1600$ nm range, this work demonstrates a direct, conversion-free interface between diamond spin-qubits and standard telecommunication infrastructure, bypassing the efficiency bottlenecks of active frequency conversion and benefiting from the already well-developed technologies in this range of the electromagnetic spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：wavelength-resolved optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) measurements、directly observe、analyze。；研究对象：金刚石中的氮-空位（NV）色心，特别是其近红外单重态跃迁（约1042 nm）以及该发射与自旋态信息的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，直接观察到NV色心在1042 nm红外发射中的ODMR对比度，证明自旋态信息通过自旋选择性的系间穿越被转录到红外单重态发射中，从而建立了红外ODMR作为高保真度光学读出路径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，直接观察到NV色心在1042 nm红外发射中的ODMR对比度，证明自旋态信息通过自旋选择性的系间穿越被转录到红外单重态发射中，从而建立了红外ODMR作为高保真度光学读出路径。；创新点：将自旋态信息的光学读出直接扩展到1300-1600 nm电信波段，实现了金刚石自旋量子比特与标准电信基础设施的直接、无频率转换的接口，避免了主动频率转换的效率瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 波长分辨的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量，分析1042 nm红外发射的ODMR信号及其随磁场的变化。

papers.title: Compositional and Magnetic Characterisation of Oblique Co and Fe Nanowire Structures Fabricated Using Focused Electron Beam Induced Deposition
papers.abstract: Focused electron beam induced deposition (FEBID) is an additive manufacturing technique uniquely suited for fabricating nanoscale 3D prototypes for a range of applications, including spintronic devices. However, the variation of growth dynamics associated with electron beam translation and sample interaction volumes results in structures with non-uniform composition when fabricating intricate 3D geometries. Herein, we measure changes in atomic composition and corresponding changes in magnetic induction in 3D ferromagnetic nanostructures with overhanging elements, e.g. bridges or arches. To investigate the effects of electron beam translation, we fabricated 41 Co and Fe nanowire (NW) structures with growth angle relative to the optic axis varying from 0° to 90°. The (scanning) transmission electron microscopy techniques of electron energy loss spectroscopy and off-axis electron holography were performed to map the NW elemental composition and magnetic induction as a function of NW growth angle. Comparison of the results reveals a reduction in metal content with increased oblique growth angle in FEBID NWs. The magnitude of metal content reduction can be tuned by controlling electron beam parameters, and ferromagnetic NWs with approximately equal metal content at growth angles from 0° to 60° were fabricated by using the lowest viable electron beam voltage and the highest viable beam current to reduce the interaction volume and increase the metal content, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：FEBID（聚焦电子束诱导沉积）、TEM（透射电子显微镜）、EELS（电子能量损失谱）、离轴电子全息术。；研究对象：利用聚焦电子束诱导沉积（FEBID）技术制备的钴（Co）和铁（Fe）纳米线结构，特别是具有倾斜生长角度的三维铁磁纳米结构（如桥或拱形悬空结构）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在FEBID制备的纳米线中，随着生长角度相对于光轴增大（从0°到90°），金属含量会降低；通过调节电子束参数（使用最低可行电压和最高可行电流），可以在0°至60°的生长角度范围内制备出金属含量近似相等的铁磁纳米线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在FEBID制备的纳米线中，随着生长角度相对于光轴增大（从0°到90°），金属含量会降低；通过调节电子束参数（使用最低可行电压和最高可行电流），可以在0°至60°的生长角度范围内制备出金属含量近似相等的铁磁纳米线。；创新点：系统定量地测量了FEBID三维铁磁纳米结构中因电子束平移导致的成分非均匀性及其对磁感应强度的影响，并提出了通过优化电子束参数（电压和电流）来调控金属含量随生长角度变化的策略。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：聚焦电子束诱导沉积（FEBID）制备样品；表征手段：（扫描）透射电子显微镜（STEM/TEM）结合电子能量损失谱（EELS）进行元素成分分析，以及离轴电子全息术（off-axis electron holography）进行磁感应强度（磁通量）映射。

papers.title: Agentic Design of Compositional Descriptors via Autoresearch for Materials Science Applications
papers.abstract: Autoresearch offers a flexible paradigm for automating scientific tasks, in which an AI agent proposes, implements, evaluates, and refines candidate solutions against a quantitative objective. Here, we use composition-based materials-property prediction to test whether such agents can perform a task beyond model selection and hyperparameter optimization: the design of input descriptors. We introduce Automat, an autoresearch framework where a coding agent based on a large language model generates composition-only descriptors for chemical compounds and evaluates them using a random forest workflow. The agent is restricted to information derivable from chemical formulas and iteratively proposes, implements, and tests chemically motivated descriptor strategies. We apply Automat, with OpenAI Codex using GPT-5.5 as the coding agent, to the prediction of experimental band gaps in inorganic materials and Curie temperatures in ferromagnetic compounds. In both tasks, Automat improves over fractional-composition, Magpie, and combined fractional-composition/Magpie baselines, while producing descriptor families that are chemically interpretable. These results provide a demonstration that autoresearch agents can generate competitive, task-specific materials descriptors without manual feature engineering during the run. They also reveal current limitations, including descriptor redundancy, sensitivity to greedy feature expansion, and the need for explicit complexity control, descriptor pruning, and more sophisticated search strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“autoresearch framework”、“coding agent”、“random forest workflow”、“prediction”。；研究对象：论文研究的具体体系是**无机材料的实验带隙**和**铁磁化合物的居里温度**。这是一个材料科学中的**成分-性质预测**问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Autoresearch框架（Automat）能够自动设计出具有化学可解释性的、任务特定的成分描述符，其性能优于传统的分数成分、Magpie及其组合基线，证明了AI代理可以超越模型选择和超参数优化，完成输入描述符的设计任务。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Autoresearch框架（Automat）能够自动设计出具有化学可解释性的、任务特定的成分描述符，其性能优于传统的分数成分、Magpie及其组合基线，证明了AI代理可以超越模型选择和超参数优化，完成输入描述符的设计任务。；创新点：本文的创新点在于将Autoresearch范式应用于**输入描述符的自动设计**，而非传统的模型选择或超参数优化。它展示了AI代理能够自主生成具有竞争力的、任务特定的材料描述符，从而避免了手动特征工程。摘要未突出说明与以往自动特征生成方法（如SISSO）的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用了**Autoresearch框架（Automat）**，该框架基于**大型语言模型（GPT-5.5，通过OpenAI Codex）** 作为编码代理。代理被限制使用仅从化学式推导的信息，通过迭代提出、实现、评估和优化候选描述符策略，并使用**随机森林（Random Forest）** 工作流进行性能评估。

papers.title: N-Graphdiyne as a Tunable Platform for Stabilizing Light Metals toward High-Capacity Reversible Hydrogen Storage
papers.abstract: Hydrogen (H2) is a promising carbon-neutral energy carrier. However, its deployment is limited by the lack of lightweight, reversible storage media that operate under practical conditions. Here, we establish nitrogen-doped graphdiyne (N-GDY) as a programmable two-dimensional platform for stabilizing dispersed light-metal dopants and enabling high-capacity physisorption of molecular H2. The computational package involves density functional theory (DFT) combined with ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) and Langmuir-based statistical thermodynamic modeling. The results revealed that N-sites of N-GDY bind up to five Li, Na, K, and Ca atoms per primitive cell with binding energies of -2.27, -1.57, -1.80, and -2.13 eV, respectively, exceeding their respective bulk cohesive energies. AIMD simulations at 400 K further confirm the structural robustness of the decorated frameworks and the absence of metal aggregation. The polarised metal centres activate reversible H2 adsorption through electrostatic and dispersion interactions, with average adsorption energies falling within the optimal window (-0.15 to -0.35 eV per H2). Sequential adsorption analysis reveals uptake of up to 25 H2 molecules per primitive cell, achieving intrinsic gravimetric capacities of 13.08, 10.82, 9.23, and 9.15 wt% for Li-, Na-, K-, and Ca-functionalized systems, respectively. Thermodynamic analysis indicates favorable adsorption-desorption behavior under near-ambient conditions, with Li- and Ca-functionalized systems exceeding the 6.5 wt% U.S. Department of Energy's ultimate system-level target when considering intrinsic material capacity. These results identify N-GDY as a chemically tunable scaffold for dispersing lightweight metals and provide a mechanistic design strategy for achieving high-capacity, reversible hydrogen storage in porous two-dimensional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：density functional theory (DFT), ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD), Langmuir-based statistical thermodynamic modeling）；研究对象：氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）作为一种可调控的二维平台，用于稳定分散轻金属（Li, Na, K, Ca）并实现可逆的分子氢（H₂）高容量物理吸附。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）上的氮位点能够稳定结合多达5个轻金属原子（Li, Na, K, Ca），这些金属化后的体系通过静电和色散相互作用，实现了在近环境条件下可逆的、高容量（最高13.08 wt%）的分子氢存储。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）上的氮位点能够稳定结合多达5个轻金属原子（Li, Na, K, Ca），这些金属化后的体系通过静电和色散相互作用，实现了在近环境条件下可逆的、高容量（最高13.08 wt%）的分子氢存储。；创新点：将氮掺杂石墨二炔（N-GDY）确立为一个可编程的二维平台，通过化学掺杂氮原子来稳定分散轻金属掺杂剂，从而克服金属团聚问题，并实现高容量的分子氢物理吸附。摘要未突出说明与其它二维材料（如纯石墨烯或石墨二炔）相比的具体性能优势。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）以及基于朗缪尔（Langmuir）模型的统计热力学建模。

papers.title: Spin resolved spectral topology and re-entrant localization in a non Hermitian quasiperiodic SSH chain
papers.abstract: We investigate localization and spectral topology in a non Hermitian quasiperiodic Su Schrieffer Heeger lattice with Rashba spin orbit coupling and spin-dependent hopping. By analyzing the inverse participation ratio, complex energy spectrum, and spectral winding numbers, we demonstrate the emergence of a re-entrant transition from extended to localized and back to extended phases as the non-Hermitian parameter increases. The localization transition is accompanied by a simultaneous real-complex-real spectral transition in the complex-energy plane. In the absence of spin dependent hopping, the spectrum forms two nearly spin-degenerate loops characterized by winding numbers w = 2. Upon introducing finite spin-dependent hopping, each loop splits into two independent spin-resolved spectral branches, resulting in four disconnected spectral contours carrying distinct winding sectors. Our results reveal a direct correspondence between localization, spectral topology, and spin-resolved spectral splitting in non-Hermitian quasiperiodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“分析”“证明”“揭示”等理论推导词汇，未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：非厄米准周期Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，包含Rashba自旋轨道耦合和自旋依赖跳跃的准周期非厄米系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着非厄米参数增大，系统出现从扩展态到局域态再回到扩展态的重入转变；该局域化转变伴随复能量平面上的实-复-实谱转变。自旋依赖跳跃导致能谱分裂为四个独立的自旋分辨谱分支，各自携带不同的绕数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着非厄米参数增大，系统出现从扩展态到局域态再回到扩展态的重入转变；该局域化转变伴随复能量平面上的实-复-实谱转变。自旋依赖跳跃导致能谱分裂为四个独立的自旋分辨谱分支，各自携带不同的绕数。；创新点：首次在非厄米准周期系统中揭示了局域化、谱拓扑与自旋分辨谱分裂之间的直接对应关系，并发现自旋依赖跳跃可诱导能谱从两个近简并环分裂为四个独立拓扑分支。
papers.method_zh: 通过分析逆参与率、复能量谱和谱绕数等理论工具，研究非厄米准周期SSH链的局域化与谱拓扑性质。

papers.title: A DFT+DMFT study of the electronic structure of Samarium
papers.abstract: The electronic structure of Samarium (Sm) was calculated using the density functional theory combined with the single-site dynamical mean-field theory. In this work, we investigated the electronic properties of α, \b{eta} and γ phases at ambient pressure, including the band structures, density of states, self-energy functions and valence state histograms. Our results agree with the experimental data.The calculation shows that the 4f electrons in all these phases are well localized, the Kondo peaks are suppressed and the hybridization between the 4f electrons and conduction electrons are quite weak. Our results also show the strong correlation effect is significant in Sm metal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：DFT+DMFT study、calculated、calculation shows。；研究对象：金属钐（Samarium, Sm）的三种相（α、β、γ）在常压下的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钐金属中4f电子在所有相中均高度局域化，Kondo峰被抑制，4f电子与传导电子的杂化很弱，且强关联效应显著。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钐金属中4f电子在所有相中均高度局域化，Kondo峰被抑制，4f电子与传导电子的杂化很弱，且强关联效应显著。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论结合单点动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）。

papers.title: Kinetic effects on the phase behavior and microstructural transitions of a thermoresponsive polymer solution
papers.abstract: The thermoresponsive behavior of Pluronic F127 solutions is governed by temperature-dependent micellization and complex self-assembly of these micelles. This study investigates the effect of thermal stimuli on the kinetics of phase transition of Pluronic systems during heating and cooling cycles. We employ Differential Scanning Calorimetry measurements to investigate the dependence of the micellization temperature on thermal stimuli, revealing that both the micellization temperature and the peak intensity vary systematically with the applied thermal ramp rate. Furthermore, we employ rheological characterization which reveals a sharp sol to soft-solid transition upon heating. Interestingly, we observe a novel multi-step transition during the cooling phase, indicating a more complex reorganization pathway with intermediate metastable states than typically assumed for reversible micellization. Our findings indicate that the characteristic multi-step cooling transition is transient, gradually weakening with successive thermal cycles. We also present a comprehensive mathematical model which accurately captures the kinetics and multiple step transition in viscoelastic parameters. Significantly, the distinct peaks in Small-Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS) measurements clearly reveal the evolution from a disordered unimers/micelles state at low temperatures to a highly ordered lattice with long-range spatial correlation at elevated temperatures. We also present a comprehensive phase diagram highlighting the critical role of thermal stimuli and pathways in defining the phase behavior of Pluronic system. This work, therefore, offers essential experimental and theoretical insights into the thermally driven self-assembly, transition kinetics, and microstructural evolution of thermoreversible Pluronic solution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有理论建模）。判断依据：Differential Scanning Calorimetry、rheological characterization、Small-Angle X-ray Scattering等实验手段，以及“comprehensive mathematical model”理论建模。；研究对象：热响应性聚合物Pluronic F127溶液的相行为与微观结构转变，特别是温度驱动的胶束化过程及其动力学效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现Pluronic F127溶液在冷却过程中存在多步转变，涉及中间亚稳态，且该多步冷却转变是瞬态的，随热循环次数增加而减弱；升温时则呈现尖锐的溶胶-软固体转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现Pluronic F127溶液在冷却过程中存在多步转变，涉及中间亚稳态，且该多步冷却转变是瞬态的，随热循环次数增加而减弱；升温时则呈现尖锐的溶胶-软固体转变。；创新点：揭示了冷却过程中此前未被报道的多步重组路径及其中间亚稳态，并指出该多步转变的瞬态特性（随热循环减弱），同时构建了能准确捕捉动力学与多步转变的数学模型。
papers.method_zh: 差示扫描量热法（DSC）测量胶束化温度对热刺激速率的依赖性；流变学表征溶胶-软固体转变；小角X射线散射（SAXS）揭示从无序单聚体/胶束到有序晶格的微观结构演化；并建立了描述动力学与多步转变的数学模型。

papers.title: Tunable Dual-Type Weyl Points in Dirac-Weyl Semimetal CaAgBi
papers.abstract: Dirac-Weyl semimetals host both Dirac and Weyl fermions and the exploration of material candidates with tunable topological properties is essential to realize topological spintronic devices. In this work, we propose CaAgBi as a Dirac-Weyl semimetal with tunable type-I and type-II Weyl points based on first-principle calculations. In addition to the three pairs of Dirac points located along the rotational axis as previously reported, our calculations reveal 18 additional pairs of dual-type Weyl points distributed across three distinct planes: type-I in the $k_z=0$ plane and type-II in the $k_z= \pm 0.0698\,\frac{2π}{c}$ planes. The topological features are further confirmed through chirality of the Weyl points as well as the existence of surface Fermi arcs. Moreover, we find that the position and annihilation of Dirac and Weyl points are tunable by the alloy engineering and external strains. The alloy engineering is employed to modulate the positions of Weyl points, revealing different annihilation concentrations for type-I and type-II Weyl points, potentially offering novel experimental strategies for Weyl point manipulation. Under tensile biaxial strain, the Weyl points in the $k_{z}=0$ plane annihilate along the $Γ$--$\mathrm{M}$ path at $2.1\%$ strain, whereas the Weyl points in the $k_{z}\neq 0$ planes remain robust within $6\%$ strain. This work provides a versatile platform for manipulating Dirac/Weyl interactions, with spin-orbit coupling (SOC) driven alloy control and strain-selective engineering opening avenues for topological electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“first-principle calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：Dirac-Weyl半金属CaAgBi，具体研究其可调谐的I型和II型Weyl点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CaAgBi中发现了18对额外的双类型Weyl点（I型在k_z=0平面，II型在k_z=±0.0698·2π/c平面），且这些Weyl点和Dirac点的位置与湮灭可通过合金工程和外加应变进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CaAgBi中发现了18对额外的双类型Weyl点（I型在k_z=0平面，II型在k_z=±0.0698·2π/c平面），且这些Weyl点和Dirac点的位置与湮灭可通过合金工程和外加应变进行调控。；创新点：首次在CaAgBi中揭示除已知Dirac点外还存在大量双类型Weyl点，并系统展示了通过合金工程（不同湮灭浓度）和双轴应变（选择性湮灭）分别调控I型和II型Weyl点的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principle calculations），并结合Weyl点手性分析及表面费米弧计算来确认拓扑特征。

papers.title: Biquadratic exchange coupling effect on the magnetic properties of (Fe/Ti) multilayers
papers.abstract: This work explores the static and dynamic magnetic properties of weakly antiferromagnetically coupled Fe/Ti superlattices, emphasizing the link between magnetic behavior and structural characteristics. HRTEM and XRD analyses confirm alternating Fe and Ti layers with rough interfaces, especially in upper layers. Magnetic measurements reveal two-step hysteresis loops and a temperature and thickness-dependent interlayer exchange coupling (IEC). A macrospin model incorporating bilinear and biquadratic coupling reproduces the experimental data and supports a phase diagram analysis identifying non-collinear configurations. The results underscore the impact of structural imperfections and highlight the crucial role of biquadratic exchange in Fe/Ti/Fe multilayers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论建模）。关键词：HRTEM、XRD、Magnetic measurements、macroscopic spin model。；研究对象：弱反铁磁耦合的Fe/Ti超晶格多层膜，具体研究其静态与动态磁性质，以及层间交换耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 双二次交换耦合（biquadratic exchange coupling）在Fe/Ti/Fe多层膜中起关键作用，导致非共线磁构型，并解释了实验中观察到的两步磁滞回线及温度、厚度依赖的层间交换耦合行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：双二次交换耦合（biquadratic exchange coupling）在Fe/Ti/Fe多层膜中起关键作用，导致非共线磁构型，并解释了实验中观察到的两步磁滞回线及温度、厚度依赖的层间交换耦合行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨透射电镜（HRTEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）分析结构；磁测量（Magnetic measurements）表征静态与动态磁性质；构建包含双线性与双二次耦合项的宏观自旋模型（macroscopic spin model）进行数值模拟与相图分析。

papers.title: Methane hydrate nucleation frustration and dimensional reduction of structural order under nanoconfinement
papers.abstract: Methane hydrate nucleation under nanoconfinement remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay between geometric restriction and molecular ordering. Here, we investigate the structural organization of water-methane systems confined between silica planar slit pores with widths ranging from 1 to 5 nm and temperatures between 250 and 295 K. Three-dimensional radial distribution functions reveal a clear suppression of hydrate-like ordering at strong confinement (below 2 nm), indicating frustrated nucleation. In contrast, projected two-dimensional correlations exhibit pronounced in-plane structural organization, evidencing a confinement-induced reduction in the dimensionality of molecular order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：investigate、radial distribution functions、projected two-dimensional correlations、confinement-induced reduction。；研究对象：甲烷水合物在二氧化硅平面狭缝孔（孔径1-5 nm）中的成核行为，特别是纳米限域效应下的结构有序性变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强限域（孔径小于2 nm）下，甲烷水合物成核受到抑制，表现为三维水合物有序性的显著降低；但二维面内结构关联增强，表明限域导致分子有序性的维度降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强限域（孔径小于2 nm）下，甲烷水合物成核受到抑制，表现为三维水合物有序性的显著降低；但二维面内结构关联增强，表明限域导致分子有序性的维度降低。；创新点：揭示了纳米限域下甲烷水合物成核的“受挫”现象，并首次明确指出限域导致结构有序性从三维向二维的维度降低。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟，通过三维径向分布函数和二维投影关联函数分析水-甲烷体系在二氧化硅狭缝孔中的结构组织。

papers.title: Matrix-Product Belief Propagation for continuous-state-space variables
papers.abstract: Computation of observables in discrete stochastic, possibly conditioned, dynamics over large sparse networks is at the basis of a myriad of applications. The Matrix-Product Belief Propagation method allows a semi-analytical estimation of such observables with a controlled error that depends on the size of the employed matrices, called bond size. Its computational cost is linear in the time horizon and the network size for a large family of models with discrete degrees of freedom. Here, a generalization of this method to models with continuous or mixed continuous/discrete degrees of freedom is presented, using a tunable expansion in a Hilbert function basis. The computational cost of the method is linear in the network size with a prefactor that depends on the basis size and the bond size. The method's efficacy is demonstrated by employing a Fourier basis for a mixed continuous/discrete representation of the Kinetic Ising dynamics with real-valued random couplings, where intermediate ``local fields'' are treated as continuous. The accuracy of the method is verified via comparison with Monte-Carlo simulations. For this model, we calculate time auto-correlations, time evolution of energy and magnetization, and finally we estimate the large deviation function of the magnetization at a given future time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：提出了一种新的计算方法（Matrix-Product Belief Propagation 的推广），并进行了数值验证（与蒙特卡洛模拟对比）。；研究对象：连续或混合连续/离散自由度的大规模稀疏网络上的随机动力学系统，具体以具有实值随机耦合的 Kinetic Ising 动力学模型为例，其中中间“局域场”被处理为连续变量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将 Matrix-Product Belief Propagation 方法推广到连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，通过使用可调谐的希尔伯特函数基展开，实现了对可观测量（如时间自关联、能量和磁化强度的时间演化、磁化强度的大偏差函数）的半解析估计，且计算成本在网络规模上呈线性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将 Matrix-Product Belief Propagation 方法推广到连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，通过使用可调谐的希尔伯特函数基展开，实现了对可观测量（如时间自关联、能量和磁化强度的时间演化、磁化强度的大偏差函数）的半解析估计，且计算成本在网络规模上呈线性。；创新点：将原本仅适用于离散自由度的 Matrix-Product Belief Propagation 方法推广到连续或混合连续/离散自由度系统，并利用希尔伯特函数基展开实现了这一推广。
papers.method_zh: 提出了 Matrix-Product Belief Propagation 方法的连续变量推广，采用可调谐的希尔伯特函数基展开（如傅里叶基）来处理连续自由度。计算成本与网络规模线性相关，前置因子依赖于基大小和键大小。通过对比蒙特卡洛模拟验证了方法的准确性。

papers.title: A Brownian dynamics study of liquid-liquid phase separation in multi-scale chromatin networks
papers.abstract: In living cells, proteins involved in specialized biochemical functions are often spatially organized within biomolecular condensates. Increasing evidence suggests that some of these condensates, including DNA repair condensates, emerge through liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). In the nucleus, however, condensates form within a highly heterogeneous environment composed of chromatin fibers, RNA, and additional protein scaffolds such as PAR chains, all of which may interact with phase-separating proteins. Moreover, condensate formation is frequently associated with specific chromatin conformations; for instance, loop extrusion has been proposed as a mechanism promoting DNA repair condensates. Here, we investigate how the surrounding fibrous environment controls the morphology and spatial organization of phase-separated condensates. Using Brownian dynamics simulations of minimal models combining Lennard-Jones particles with fixed fibrous substrates, we examine the respective roles of local fiber geometry and large-scale network organization, reflecting the multiscale architecture of chromatin. We show that protein-fiber interactions strongly influence droplet positioning relative to the substrate, in a manner analogous to wetting transitions in soft condensed matter systems. Both local geometric constraints and global network organization markedly affect droplet size, morphology, and multiplicity. In addition, large-scale asymmetries in fiber organization can induce robust spatial localization of the dense phase. Our results thus highlight how multiscale structural heterogeneity of the nuclear environment can regulate the emergence and organization of biomolecular condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Brownian dynamics simulations、minimal models、Lennard-Jones particles）；研究对象：多尺度染色质网络中液-液相分离（LLPS）形成的生物分子凝聚体，特别是其形态与空间组织受纤维环境调控的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 蛋白质与纤维的相互作用可类比软凝聚态体系中的润湿转变，强烈影响液滴相对于纤维基底的定位；局部纤维几何与全局网络组织均显著改变液滴尺寸、形态和数量，且纤维组织的大尺度不对称性可诱导致密相的空间局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：蛋白质与纤维的相互作用可类比软凝聚态体系中的润湿转变，强烈影响液滴相对于纤维基底的定位；局部纤维几何与全局网络组织均显著改变液滴尺寸、形态和数量，且纤维组织的大尺度不对称性可诱导致密相的空间局域化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用布朗动力学模拟，构建由Lennard-Jones粒子与固定纤维基底组成的简化模型，分别考察局部纤维几何与全局网络组织（反映染色质多尺度结构）的作用。

papers.title: Probing the Chirality of Trigonal Selenium and Tellurium by Spin and Orbital Hall Effects
papers.abstract: Chiral crystals exhibit enantiomer-dependent transport phenomena that generate pure spin or orbital currents, while the handedness sensitivity of spin and orbital Hall conductivities (SHC/OHC) remains insufficiently understood. Using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that trigonal selenium and tellurium -- prototypical chiral semiconductors -- exhibit opposite signs of the SHC/OHC tensor elements $σ_{yx}^{S_y}$ and $σ_{yx}^{L_y}$ between their left- and right-handed enantiomers. This behavior originates from the mirror operation relating the two structures, described by space groups $P3_221$ (left-handed) and $P3_121$ (right-handed). Although both enantiomers share identical band structures and four nonzero SHC/OHC tensor components, $σ_{yx}^{S_y}$ and $σ_{yx}^{L_y}$ reverse sign due to the antisymmetric transformation of the spin/orbital Berry curvature under the $M_{xy}$ mirror operation. More generally, for mirror-related enantiomorphic structures, selected SHC/OHC tensor components can exhibit symmetry-governed sign reversal. For trigonal Se and Te, the calculated signs of these components can be directly correlated with the left- and right-handed structures under the chosen coordinate convention. These results clarify the symmetry origin of handedness-dependent SHC/OHC and suggest a possible route for correlating measurable SHC/OHC signals with structural handedness in specific chiral materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：手性晶体材料：三角相硒（trigonal selenium）和碲（trigonal tellurium），以及它们中由自旋霍尔效应和轨道霍尔效应所揭示的手性（handedness）与输运现象的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三角相硒和碲的左、右手性对映体（enantiomers）的自旋霍尔电导率（SHC）和轨道霍尔电导率（OHC）张量分量σ_{yx}^{S_y}和σ_{yx}^{L_y}符号相反。这一符号反转源于两种结构之间的镜面对称操作，并由自旋/轨道贝里曲率在镜面操作下的反对称变换所决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三角相硒和碲的左、右手性对映体（enantiomers）的自旋霍尔电导率（SHC）和轨道霍尔电导率（OHC）张量分量σ_{yx}^{S_y}和σ_{yx}^{L_y}符号相反。这一符号反转源于两种结构之间的镜面对称操作，并由自旋/轨道贝里曲率在镜面操作下的反对称变换所决定。；创新点：揭示了手性依赖的SHC/OHC的对称性起源，即镜面对称操作导致特定张量分量的符号反转，并指出可通过测量SHC/OHC信号来关联特定手性材料的结构手性。摘要未突出说明与以往计算工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体用于计算自旋霍尔电导率（SHC）和轨道霍尔电导率（OHC）的张量分量，并分析其对称性起源。

papers.title: Accurate computation of the electron-phonon interaction contribution to the total energy
papers.abstract: The standard Hamiltonian of a coupled electron-phonon system is based on second-order perturbation theory. The EPI contribution in the standard Hamiltonian consists of two terms, the EPI contribution to the band-structure energy and the partial-Fan-Migdal (FM)-occupied contribution. Within the non-adiabatic approximation, we derive a new expression for the partial-FM-occ contribution and show that it has the structure of a higher-order term, and not a second-order term. Along similar lines, we derive new expressions for the computation of the partial-FM-occ term. The new expressions for the partial-FM-occ term must be preferred over the standard expressions, in theoretical and computational studies, because they incorporate the complete physics underlying this term. Unlike the EPI contribution to individual eigenstates, the EPI contribution to the total energy must be computed in the non-adiabatic approximation for all materials, Infra-red (IR) active and IR-inactive. We report the computation of the standard Hamiltonian, for the first time, for Carbon polymorphs (diamond and hexagonal lonsdaleite) by including the EPI contribution to the total energy. This is the most accurate ab initio total energy reported till date. The present work also opens the way to compute the ab initio free-energy more accurately at finite temperatures by including the EPI contribution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：non-adiabatic approximation、ab initio total energy、second-order perturbation theory。；研究对象：电子-声子耦合（EPI）对总能量的贡献，具体应用于碳的同素异形体（金刚石和六方蓝丝黛尔石）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出电子-声子耦合对总能量贡献中“部分-Fan-Migdal-占据项”的新表达式，证明其本质是高阶项而非二阶项；首次在碳同素异形体中实现了包含EPI贡献的标准哈密顿量的总能量计算，获得了迄今最精确的从头算总能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出电子-声子耦合对总能量贡献中“部分-Fan-Migdal-占据项”的新表达式，证明其本质是高阶项而非二阶项；首次在碳同素异形体中实现了包含EPI贡献的标准哈密顿量的总能量计算，获得了迄今最精确的从头算总能量。；创新点：1. 揭示了标准哈密顿量中部分-FM-占据项的高阶结构，并给出了更物理的新表达式；2. 首次在红外活性与非红外活性材料中均需采用非绝热近似计算EPI对总能量的贡献；3. 首次实现了包含EPI贡献的碳同素异形体总能量的精确从头算。
papers.method_zh: 基于非绝热近似，重新推导了部分-Fan-Migdal-占据项的解析表达式；采用从头算（ab initio）方法计算了金刚石和六方蓝丝黛尔石的总能量，并包含了电子-声子耦合贡献。

papers.title: High-Pressure Crystal Structure Database
papers.abstract: High-pressure research is a productive route to new structures and emergent properties. However, crucial high-pressure structural information remains highly fragmented across individual publications and heterogeneous computational repositories. This fragmentation creates a major bottleneck for data-driven materials design. To bridge this gap, we introduce the High-Pressure Crystal Structure Database (HPCSD), a traceable, pressure-resolved repository that integrates experimental and theoretical high-pressure structures. HPCSD is constructed from two complementary data streams: elemental high-pressure phases and a searchable configuration space of stable and metastable phases generated via CALYPSO crystal structure prediction. To ensure rigorous comparability, all retained structures underwent re-optimization under a unified density functional theory (DFT) framework , with continuous enthalpy curves systematically generated specifically for the elemental phases across their stability fields. The initial release encompasses 77,346 consistently evaluated structural entries spanning 89 elements. An analysis reveals that pressure-induced polymorphism is ubiquitous and exhibits pronounced family-dependent trends. Structural diversity is strongly influenced by an element's electronic adaptability , with the greatest structural complexity emerging at intermediate rather than highest pressures. By providing standardized, reusable, and rigorously evaluated high-pressure structural data, HPCSD establishes a robust infrastructure to accelerate experimental phase identification, facilitate cross-study thermodynamic comparisons, and support the development of machine-learning interatomic potentials and generative models for high-pressure systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动研究。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“CALYPSO晶体结构预测”、“统一密度泛函理论(DFT)框架”、“机器学习原子间势”等关键词，核心工作是构建数据库，而非实验测量。；研究对象：高压下的晶体结构。具体涵盖89种元素的高压相，包括实验已知相和通过结构预测生成的亚稳相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 压力诱导的多晶型现象普遍存在，且表现出明显的元素族依赖趋势。结构多样性受元素电子适应性的强烈影响，最大的结构复杂性出现在中等压力而非最高压力下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：压力诱导的多晶型现象普遍存在，且表现出明显的元素族依赖趋势。结构多样性受元素电子适应性的强烈影响，最大的结构复杂性出现在中等压力而非最高压力下。；创新点：构建了一个可追溯、压力分辨、且经过统一DFT标准重新评估的高压晶体结构数据库（HPCSD），解决了高压结构数据分散、难以直接比较的瓶颈问题，为数据驱动的材料设计提供了标准化基础设施。
papers.method_zh: 1. 数据整合：收集实验和理论的高压结构数据。2. 结构预测：使用CALYPSO方法生成稳定和亚稳态的构型空间。3. 统一计算：对所有收录的结构在统一的DFT框架下进行重新优化，并针对元素相在其稳定区间内系统生成连续的焓曲线。

papers.title: Periodic Behavior of Topology in Graphene with Nanohole Array
papers.abstract: We derive a way to diagnose band topology for graphene with triangular and/or honeycomb array of nanoholes directly from the lattice constant of superstructure $m\sqrt{3}\times m\sqrt{3}$ with integer $m$. Taking into account the $C_{6v}$ crystalline symmetry respected by nanoholes and their array, we demonstrate that nontrivial topology appears periodically with $m$ with period two (six) for triangular (honeycomb) array. These behaviors are verified by Wyckoff positions of Wannier centers and parity index of valence bands at high-symmetry points in Brillouin zone. The results provide a convenient guide for material design of topological electronic states based on graphene derivatives.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“derive a way to diagnose”“demonstrate”“verified by Wyckoff positions”等理论推导与对称性分析关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有三角形或蜂窝状纳米孔阵列的石墨烯超结构，具体为 \( m\sqrt{3} \times m\sqrt{3} \) 超晶格（\( m \) 为整数）中的拓扑能带性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持 \( C_{6v} \) 晶格对称性的纳米孔阵列中，石墨烯的能带拓扑性质随超晶格周期 \( m \) 呈现周期性变化：对于三角形阵列，周期为2；对于蜂窝状阵列，周期为6。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持 \( C_{6v} \) 晶格对称性的纳米孔阵列中，石墨烯的能带拓扑性质随超晶格周期 \( m \) 呈现周期性变化：对于三角形阵列，周期为2；对于蜂窝状阵列，周期为6。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性分析（\( C_{6v} \) 点群），利用Wannier中心的Wyckoff位置以及布里渊区高对称点处价带的宇称指标来诊断能带拓扑。

papers.title: Shaping Maximally Localized Wannier Functions via Discrete Adiabatic Transport
papers.abstract: Maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs) are conventionally constructed by iteratively minimizing a spread functional over a high-dimensional gauge landscape. In this work, we present a non-variational constructive algorithm that unifies gauge smoothing and the eigenvalue problem of the projected position operator into a single deterministic framework. We demonstrate that discrete adiabatic transport across band degeneracies emerges naturally as an integral part of the solution procedure for the position eigenvectors. In this transport-aligned gauge, the Bloch overlaps exhibit an approximately linear phase dependence, allowing the Wannier centers to be extracted via deterministic fixed-point iterations and self-consistent updates rather than spread-functional minimization. Benchmark calculations for one- and two-dimensional systems yield spreads and orbital shapes in good agreement with standard minimization schemes. Furthermore, this analytical approach transparently isolates the physical origin of the $\mathcal{O}(L)$ mesh-dependent spread scaling ($L$ being the boundary seam resolution) observed in graphene, demonstrating that it is an intrinsic geometric manifestation of non-commuting projected position operators forcing finite gauge defects to accumulate along a one-dimensional boundary seam.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：constructive algorithm、deterministic framework、benchmark calculations。；研究对象：最大化局域Wannier函数（MLWFs）的构造方法，具体应用于一维和二维系统（包括石墨烯）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种非变分的确定性算法，通过离散绝热输运统一了规范平滑与投影位置算符的本征值问题，并揭示了石墨烯中随边界缝分辨率线性发散的展宽（$\mathcal{O}(L)$）是投影位置算符不对易导致的固有几何效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种非变分的确定性算法，通过离散绝热输运统一了规范平滑与投影位置算符的本征值问题，并揭示了石墨烯中随边界缝分辨率线性发散的展宽（$\mathcal{O}(L)$）是投影位置算符不对易导致的固有几何效应。；创新点：将Wannier函数的构造从变分迭代优化转变为非变分的确定性框架，并首次将离散绝热输运作为位置本征矢求解过程的自然组成部分，透明地解释了石墨烯中展宽标度律的物理起源。
papers.method_zh: 基于离散绝热输运的确定性构造算法，通过固定点迭代和自洽更新提取Wannier中心，替代传统的展宽泛函最小化方法；在一维和二维系统中进行基准计算，并与标准最小化方案对比。

papers.title: Strain-Enhanced Hydrogen Evolution, Electrical, Optical, and Thermoelectric Properties of the Multifunctional 2D CrSi2N4 Monolayer
papers.abstract: First-principles density functional theory (DFT) is employed to evaluate the structural, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and electrocatalytic properties of monolayer CrSi2N4. Its symmetric N-Si-N-Cr-N-Si-N septuple-layer structure exhibits dynamic, thermal (300 K), and mechanical stability, supported by a -8.76 eV/atom cohesive energy. PBE and HSE06 functionals reveal an indirect bandgap of 0.58 eV and 2.16 eV, respectively, driven by localized Cr-3d and N-2p states. The monolayer features 15.57 static dielectric constant and maximum absorption coefficients of 0.9 X 10^6 cm-1 (visible) and 1.4 X 10^6 cm-1 (deep-UV). Semiclassical Boltzmann calculations predict an outstanding room-temperature n-type thermoelectric power factor of 3.5 x mW/mK2. For hydrogen evolution (HER), the basal plane yields a baseline hydrogen adsorption free energy (ΔGH) of 1.05 eV at the N-site. Applying +5% expansive biaxial strain improves HER kinetics, reducing ΔGH to 0.46 eV. Thus, CrSi2N4 is a resilient, tuneable candidate for waste-heat recovery, photodetectors, and sustainable electrocatalysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“First-principles density functional theory (DFT)”、“Semiclassical Boltzmann calculations”。；研究对象：二维单层材料 CrSi2N4 的多功能物性，包括其结构、电子、光学、热电和电催化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单层 CrSi2N4 是一种动态、热学和力学稳定的多功能材料，具有可见光到深紫外的强光吸收、优异的 n 型热电性能，并且其析氢反应（HER）催化活性可通过施加拉伸应变进行有效调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单层 CrSi2N4 是一种动态、热学和力学稳定的多功能材料，具有可见光到深紫外的强光吸收、优异的 n 型热电性能，并且其析氢反应（HER）催化活性可通过施加拉伸应变进行有效调控。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，使用了 PBE 和 HSE06 泛函评估电子结构；采用半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论计算热电性能；通过计算氢吸附自由能（ΔGH）评估析氢反应（HER）催化活性。

papers.title: From spin splitting to projected mass in altermagnetic Chern matter
papers.abstract: Altermagnetic spin splitting alone does not define Chern matter. The relevant object is the exchange mass projected onto Hall-active surface, valley, orbital or interface sectors. We formulate this projected-mass criterion for compensated magnetic topology. The resulting two-channel $(C,\mathcal{A})$ diagnostic separates hidden compensated Hall responses from additive altermagnetic quantum anomalous Hall phases in a global insulating gap. It also guides interface, thickness and materials design strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中讨论“formulate this projected-mass criterion”“two-channel diagnostic”等理论框架构建，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：交错磁Chern物质（altermagnetic Chern matter）中的自旋劈裂与投影质量，具体涉及补偿磁性拓扑体系中的霍尔效应、谷/轨道/界面等扇区的拓扑性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 交错磁自旋劈裂本身不足以定义Chern物质，关键在于交换质量在霍尔活性扇区（如表面、谷、轨道、界面）上的投影。该投影质量判据可区分隐藏的补偿霍尔响应与相加型交错磁量子反常霍尔相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：交错磁自旋劈裂本身不足以定义Chern物质，关键在于交换质量在霍尔活性扇区（如表面、谷、轨道、界面）上的投影。该投影质量判据可区分隐藏的补偿霍尔响应与相加型交错磁量子反常霍尔相。；创新点：首次将交错磁自旋劈裂与Chern物质的拓扑性质明确区分，提出以投影质量而非单纯自旋劈裂作为判断补偿磁性体系中拓扑相的关键量，并给出界面、厚度及材料设计策略的指导。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：提出“投影质量判据”（projected-mass criterion）用于补偿磁性拓扑，并构建双通道 (C, 𝒜) 诊断方法。

papers.title: Chiroptical Ternary Entropy Harvesting from Self-Assembled Block Copolymer Nanopatterns
papers.abstract: Nanoscale fabrication inevitably produces local stochasticity that is commonly treated as a defect, but can instead be harnessed as a material resource for information security. Here we report a chiroptical platform for ternary entropy harvesting based on stochastic Au nanopatterns formed by block copolymer self-assembly. By transducing fabrication-induced stochastic microstates into handedness-dependent optical responses through chiroptical mapping, our platform enables native ternary digitization rather than conventional binary encoding, allowing physically harvested ternary random sequences to be used for key generation. This raises the information density to log2(3) = 1.585 bits per trit, approximately 58.5% higher than the binary limit, enabling more entropy to be harvested from a limited physical footprint. The harvested outputs exhibit near-balanced symbol populations, negligible spatial and inter-sample correlations, Shannon entropy approaching the ternary ideal, and resistance to statistical and machine-learning-based prediction. These results establish self-assembled chiroptical nanostructures as a scalable platform for cryptographic key generation, secure edge devices, and distributed Internet-of-Things platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：self-assembled（自组装）、fabrication（制备）、optical responses（光学响应）、key generation（密钥生成）。；研究对象：基于嵌段共聚物自组装形成的随机金纳米图案（stochastic Au nanopatterns），以及由此构建的手性光学三元熵采集平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将制备过程中的随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应，实现了原生三元数字编码（而非传统二进制），使信息密度提升至约1.585比特/三进制位，比二进制极限高约58.5%，并可从有限物理面积中采集更多熵。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将制备过程中的随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应，实现了原生三元数字编码（而非传统二进制），使信息密度提升至约1.585比特/三进制位，比二进制极限高约58.5%，并可从有限物理面积中采集更多熵。；创新点：首次将自组装纳米结构中的随机性（通常被视为缺陷）转化为手性光学三元熵采集资源，实现原生三元数字化而非传统二进制编码，显著提升信息密度和物理熵采集效率。
papers.method_zh: 利用嵌段共聚物自组装制备随机金纳米图案；通过手性光学映射（chiroptical mapping）将随机微观态转化为手性依赖的光学响应；对输出进行统计相关性分析、香农熵计算以及统计与机器学习预测抗性测试。

papers.title: Quantum Criticality in Monolayer Amorphous Carbon
papers.abstract: Amorphous solids represent the extreme limit of broken translational symmetry, in which the absence of long-range order removes well-defined crystal momenta and invalidates the Bloch description of electronic states. Monolayer amorphous carbon (MAC) has emerged as a unique realization of a strictly two-dimensional (2D) amorphous lattice defined by a structurally contiguous but topologically disordered $sp^2$-bonded random network devoid of any defined long-range crystal symmetry. From atomic-resolution measurements of multifractal wavefunctions, we show that disorder in MAC effectively localizes the low-energy part of the electronic spectrum but retains an extended critical-like state near the band centre ($E\sim 0$). We conjecture that this state is protected from topological disorder by remnant chiral symmetry surviving within the continuous random network, described by a Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) topological term. Near criticality, we verify the multifractal scaling relation $η= -Δ_2$, providing quantitative agreement between independently measured spatial correlation decay and multifractal scaling exponents. Our results are confirmed by atomistic tight-binding calculations that closely mirror the multifractal scaling near $E\sim 0$. Our results establish MAC as the first strictly 2D amorphous electronic system to exhibit Anderson criticality driven purely by topological disorder
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要提到“原子级分辨率测量”（实验）和“原子紧束缚计算”（计算）。；研究对象：单层非晶碳（monolayer amorphous carbon, MAC），一种严格二维的、由拓扑无序的sp²键随机网络构成的非晶固体，以及其中由纯拓扑无序驱动的安德森临界现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单层非晶碳中，无序使低能电子态局域化，但在能带中心（E~0）附近保留了一个扩展的临界态；该临界态受残余手征对称性保护，并由Wess-Zumino-Witten拓扑项描述。实验验证了多分形标度关系η = -Δ₂，表明该体系是首个严格二维的、由纯拓扑无序驱动的安德森临界电子系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单层非晶碳中，无序使低能电子态局域化，但在能带中心（E~0）附近保留了一个扩展的临界态；该临界态受残余手征对称性保护，并由Wess-Zumino-Witten拓扑项描述。实验验证了多分形标度关系η = -Δ₂，表明该体系是首个严格二维的、由纯拓扑无序驱动的安德森临界电子系统。；创新点：首次在严格二维非晶电子体系中观察到由纯拓扑无序（而非传统化学或成分无序）驱动的安德森临界性，并揭示了残余手征对称性在保护临界态中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 原子级分辨率测量多分形波函数（实验手段）；原子紧束缚计算（计算方法）；多分形标度分析及空间关联衰减指数η与多分形标度指数Δ₂的定量比较。

papers.title: Ward identities and orbital magnetization in current density functional theory
papers.abstract: We revisit the derivation of the orbital magnetization formula for periodic crystals in current density functional theory (CDFT)[1]. Our new derivation computes the linear response of the energy density to a periodic magnetic field in the long-wavelength limit. We unveil a Ward identity which connects the current vertex to the derivative of the Kohn-Sham self-energy. The result of Ref.[1] is confirmed: the orbital magnetization of the interacting solid can be computed exactly (in principle) from the self-consistent eigenfunctions and eigenvalues of the Kohn-Sham equation of CDFT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derivation（推导）、Ward identity（Ward恒等式）、current density functional theory（流密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：周期性晶体在流密度泛函理论（CDFT）中的轨道磁化（orbital magnetization）公式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过长波极限下对周期磁场的线性响应计算，揭示了连接电流顶点与Kohn-Sham自能的Ward恒等式，并确认了相互作用固体中的轨道磁化原则上可由CDFT的Kohn-Sham方程自洽本征函数与本征值精确计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过长波极限下对周期磁场的线性响应计算，揭示了连接电流顶点与Kohn-Sham自能的Ward恒等式，并确认了相互作用固体中的轨道磁化原则上可由CDFT的Kohn-Sham方程自洽本征函数与本征值精确计算。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于流密度泛函理论（CDFT），通过计算能量密度对长波极限下周期磁场的线性响应，并利用Ward恒等式连接电流顶点与Kohn-Sham自能。

papers.title: Depletion-mode N-polar AlN-based high electron mobility transistors with improved on/off ratios
papers.abstract: We report N-polar AlN-based high-electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) with a GaN channel thickness of 5.2 nm on N-polar AlN on sapphire. The threshold voltage is around -2.4 to -3.0 V with saturation currents over 240 mA/mm and on/off ratios as high as 10,000, much higher than previously reported N-polar AlN-based HEMTs. The high on/off ratio is attributed to the use of an abrupt AlN/GaN heterostructure with a dedicated AlN transition layer, together with improved gate leakage. The high frequency properties as well as the on-resistance of ~20 Ohm mm are all limited by the 2000 Ohm/square sheet resistance of the channel layer.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“We report”、“saturation currents”、“on/off ratios”、“gate leakage”、“sheet resistance”等表明该工作为器件制备与电学性能测量。；研究对象：N极性AlN基高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMTs），具体为在蓝宝石衬底上生长的N极性AlN/GaN异质结构，GaN沟道层厚度为5.2 nm。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了阈值电压约-2.4至-3.0 V、饱和电流超过240 mA/mm、开关比高达10,000的N极性AlN基HEMT，开关比显著高于此前报道的同类器件。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了阈值电压约-2.4至-3.0 V、饱和电流超过240 mA/mm、开关比高达10,000的N极性AlN基HEMT，开关比显著高于此前报道的同类器件。；创新点：通过优化AlN/GaN异质结界面（使用陡峭界面和专用AlN过渡层）显著提升了N极性AlN基HEMT的开关比（达10,000），远高于此前报道的同类器件。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子束外延（MBE）或金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）方法在蓝宝石上生长N极性AlN及GaN沟道层（摘要未明确说明具体生长技术），通过引入陡峭的AlN/GaN异质结和专用的AlN过渡层来改善栅极漏电，并测量器件的直流输出特性、转移特性、开关比、高频性能及导通电阻。

papers.title: Unified definition of ferroelectricity
papers.abstract: Recent theoretical and experimental advances in quantum ferroelectrics suggest that ferroelectricity can also emerge in non-polar space group, highlighting the limitations of conventional polar space group criteria in identifying ferroelectric materials. Here, we introduce a unified definition based on switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states, which naturally encompasses conventional and quantum ferroelectrics. Guided by this principle, we implement a high-throughput screening strategy that systematically identifies both conventional and quantum ferroelectrics among experimentally synthesized materials. In particular, we identify a new type of quantum ferroelectric in which the quantized polarization arises from arbitrary ionic displacements, in contrast to previous quantum ferroelectrics (including both fractional and integer quantum ferroelectrics) where quantized polarization results from fractional or integer ionic displacements. Notably, we find that materials such as Ba3I6 and Cs2PdC2 exhibit low switching barriers and robust insulating behavior, highlighting their experimental viability. Our results reconcile conventional and quantum ferroelectrics, expand the accessible materials landscape, and provide a practical roadmap for discovering next-generation ferroelectrics with advanced switchable functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算筛选）。判断依据：提出统一理论定义，并基于该定义实施高通量计算筛选策略。；研究对象：铁电性的统一定义，以及新型量子铁电体（如 Ba₃I₆、Cs₂PdC₂ 等材料）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于可切换极化差（switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states）的统一铁电性定义，该定义自然涵盖传统铁电体和量子铁电体；并发现一种新型量子铁电体，其量子化极化来源于任意离子位移，而非分数或整数离子位移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于可切换极化差（switchable polarization differences between energetically equivalent states）的统一铁电性定义，该定义自然涵盖传统铁电体和量子铁电体；并发现一种新型量子铁电体，其量子化极化来源于任意离子位移，而非分数或整数离子位移。；创新点：突破了传统极性空间群判据的局限，首次将传统铁电体与量子铁电体纳入同一统一框架；识别出极化量子化来源于任意离子位移的新型量子铁电体，区别于此前已知的分数/整数量子铁电体。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析（提出统一定义）结合高通量计算筛选（high-throughput screening strategy），对实验已合成材料进行系统识别。

papers.title: Machine-learning-identified two-dimensional van der Waals multiferroics for four-state nonvolatile memory
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals (vdW) multiferroics offer an attractive platform for four-state nonvolatile memory by combining switchable ferroelectric polarization and magnetization within a single material system. However, their development is hindered by the scarcity of synthesizable candidates and the lack of non-destructive readout schemes. Here, we combine machine-learning screening with first-principles calculations to explore the 2D vdW ABC$_2$X$_6$ family and identify a set of high-confidence multiferroic candidates. Among them, AuCrP$_2$S$_6$ monolayer emerges as a representative system with a ferromagnetic ground state, a sizable out-of-plane polarization of 7.46 pC/m, and a moderate ferroelectric switching barrier of $\sim$130 meV/f.u. Moreover, the nonlinear optical response mediated by the bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) in AuCrP$_2$S$_6$ provides a dual-channel probe of the ferroic orders, in which the polarization direction governs the photocurrent sign while the magnetic order selects the spin channel via robust exchange splitting. This intrinsic coupling enables the non-destructive readout of four logic states within a single atomic layer, thereby providing a practical blueprint for next-generation multistate optoelectronic memory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：machine-learning screening、first-principles calculations、DFT计算筛选）；研究对象：二维范德华多铁材料ABC₂X₆家族，具体以AuCrP₂S₆单层为代表，研究其用于四态非易失存储器的多铁性及非破坏性读出机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习筛选与第一性原理计算，在ABC₂X₆家族中识别出高置信度的多铁候选材料，其中AuCrP₂S₆单层同时具有铁磁基态、面外铁电极化（7.46 pC/m）和适中的铁电翻转势垒（~130 meV/f.u.），并且其体光伏效应可实现四逻辑态的非破坏性光学读出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习筛选与第一性原理计算，在ABC₂X₆家族中识别出高置信度的多铁候选材料，其中AuCrP₂S₆单层同时具有铁磁基态、面外铁电极化（7.46 pC/m）和适中的铁电翻转势垒（~130 meV/f.u.），并且其体光伏效应可实现四逻辑态的非破坏性光学读出。；创新点：首次将机器学习筛选与第一性原理计算结合，系统探索ABC₂X₆家族中的二维多铁材料，并利用体光伏效应实现单个原子层内四逻辑态的非破坏性光学读出，克服了传统多铁存储中破坏性读出的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习筛选（材料基因组方法）结合第一性原理计算（密度泛函理论，具体为DFT计算），分析铁电/铁磁序参量、翻转势垒、体光伏效应及自旋-光电流耦合机制。

papers.title: Shear-stress-constrained superconductivity in Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates
papers.abstract: Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates exhibit superconductivity under pressure in bulk crystals and under epitaxial constraint in thin films, while remaining highly sensitive to sample quality, oxygen content, defects, and stress conditions. We propose that the metastable RP lattice becomes superconducting only when the local constrained deformation of the Ni-O framework falls within a bounded shear-strain window. This deformation controls octahedral rotations, the interlayer Ni-O-Ni bond angle, and coupling between Ni dz2 and dx2-y2 orbitals. This shear-stress-constrained superconductivity scenario unifies the understanding of the pressure threshold, reversibility, spatial inhomogeneity, pressure-medium dependence, film-substrate sensitivity, and reproducibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“propose”（提出）、“unifies the understanding”（统一理解），未提及具体实验或计算手段。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）相镍氧化物中的超导电性，具体关注其在外界压力或外延约束下的超导行为，以及Ni-O框架的局域剪切应变对超导的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有当Ni-O框架的局域约束变形处于一个有限的剪切应变窗口内时，亚稳态的RP晶格才会出现超导电性。该剪切应力约束超导机制统一解释了压力阈值、可逆性、空间不均匀性、压力介质依赖性、薄膜-衬底敏感性及可重复性等实验现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有当Ni-O框架的局域约束变形处于一个有限的剪切应变窗口内时，亚稳态的RP晶格才会出现超导电性。该剪切应力约束超导机制统一解释了压力阈值、可逆性、空间不均匀性、压力介质依赖性、薄膜-衬底敏感性及可重复性等实验现象。；创新点：提出了一个统一的“剪切应力约束超导”图像，将超导的出现与Ni-O框架的局域剪切应变窗口直接关联，从而解释了多个此前看似独立的实验现象。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架，仅提出基于剪切应变约束的物理模型。

papers.title: Open Quantum Theory of Shot Noise in Dissipative Chiral Transport
papers.abstract: We develop an open quantum theory for shot-noise dynamics in dissipative chiral transport. By mapping a system under consideration onto a quantum circuit, we show that current noise is governed by two competing factors: the average occupancy distribution and particle-number fluctuations. With energy fully relaxed, shot noise is strongly suppressed, reflecting the stacking of electrons into lower energy states due to dissipation.
