papers.title: Engineering topological flat bands in $Γ$-valley moiré systems with Ising-type SOC: twisted 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Twisted moiré superlattices hosting topological flat bands provide a platform to explore the interplay between topology and correlations. Here we investigate topological band structures in $Γ$-valley moiré systems based on 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$. Using large-scale ab initio calculations and continuum modelling, we demonstrate that both materials exhibit an approximate spin-$U(1)$ symmetry and host isolated topological moiré valence bands, including quantum spin Hall and high spin Chern states. By constructing a hierarchy of $Γ$-valley moiré continuum models, we show that isolated moiré bands carry a trivial $C_3$ symmetry indicator when the low-energy physics is described by a single effective orbital and a single layer-hybridized branch, either bonding or antibonding. Topological bands therefore arise from inter-branch and/or inter-orbital coupling. Moreover, we determine interaction-driven phase diagrams using Hartree--Fock and exact diagonalization, finding various phases tunable by twist angle, interaction strength, and displacement field. We identify specific conditions under which fractional Chern insulators are favored. Together with previous work showing that the moiré conduction bands of 1T-ZrS$_2$ and 1T-SnSe$_2$ realize $M$-valley twisting and host quasi-one-dimensional physics, our results establish these systems as ideal platforms for strongly correlated moiré physics and provide a systematic framework for understanding topological band structures in $Γ$-valley moiré materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：ab initio calculations、continuum modelling、Hartree--Fock、exact diagonalization。；研究对象：基于1T-ZrS₂和1T-SnSe₂的Γ谷莫尔超晶格体系，具体研究其拓扑平带工程及强关联物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Γ谷莫尔体系中，通过层间/轨道间耦合可产生拓扑莫尔价带（包括量子自旋霍尔态和高自旋陈数态），并可通过转角、相互作用强度和位移场调控出多种相互作用驱动相，其中特定条件下可形成分数量子陈绝缘体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Γ谷莫尔体系中，通过层间/轨道间耦合可产生拓扑莫尔价带（包括量子自旋霍尔态和高自旋陈数态），并可通过转角、相互作用强度和位移场调控出多种相互作用驱动相，其中特定条件下可形成分数量子陈绝缘体。；创新点：首次系统揭示了Γ谷莫尔体系中拓扑平带的起源（源于支间/轨道间耦合而非单轨道单支的C₃对称性指标），并建立了从能带拓扑到强关联相图的完整理论框架，将1T-ZrS₂和1T-SnSe₂确立为研究强关联莫尔物理的理想平台。
papers.method_zh: 大规模第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）、连续介质模型（continuum modelling）、Hartree-Fock方法、精确对角化（exact diagonalization）。

papers.title: Generalized Model Fractional Quantum Hall States on Lattices
papers.abstract: Model wave functions are essential for studying fractional quantum Hall phases, yet lattice model states have so far been limited to bosonic systems with on-site interactions. In this work, by combining analytical and numerical methods, we systematically construct lattice model states for the Laughlin, Moore--Read, and general $\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read--Rezayi series. Our lattice-specific states are characterized by their idealized energy and entanglement features and are distinguished from their continuum counterparts by a modified clustering behavior. Our theory advances the understanding of the stability of topologically ordered phases and illustrates the organizing principles of the conformal Hilbert space on lattices. Practically, this work paves the way for further studying lattice-specific excitations and offers a constructive route for engineering topological orders within density interactions, with potential immediate implications for cold-atom and synthetic flat-band platforms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（结合解析与数值方法）。关键词：analytical and numerical methods, systematically construct。；研究对象：晶格上的分数量子霍尔（FQH）态，具体为Laughlin态、Moore-Read态以及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列的模型波函数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在晶格上系统构建了Laughlin、Moore-Read及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列的模型波函数，这些晶格态具有理想化的能量和纠缠特征，并通过修正的聚集行为与连续体对应态相区分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在晶格上系统构建了Laughlin、Moore-Read及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列的模型波函数，这些晶格态具有理想化的能量和纠缠特征，并通过修正的聚集行为与连续体对应态相区分。；创新点：此前晶格模型态仅限于具有在位相互作用的玻色子系统，本工作将晶格模型态推广到Laughlin、Moore-Read及一般$\mathbb{Z}_k$ Read-Rezayi系列，并揭示了晶格特有的修正聚集行为。
papers.method_zh: 结合解析方法与数值方法，系统构建晶格模型态。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如精确对角化、DMRG等）或解析框架（如共形场论）的细节。

papers.title: Corner Charge Fluctuations in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract: Measuring charge fluctuations within a subregion provides a powerful probe of quantum many-body systems. In two spatial dimensions, the shape dependence of the dimensionless corner contribution encodes universal data of quantum critical points and reveals observables of quantum geometry in various quantum phases. Here, we systematically extend this framework to higher dimensions. In three dimensions, we derive the universal angle dependence associated with trihedral corners of a generic parallelepiped and benchmark the predictions against Monte Carlo simulations of lattice models at the O(3) quantum critical point. We further identify a wedge-corner contribution that directly probes the quantum metric, supported by numerical results for a lattice Weyl semimetal model. More generally, we obtain angle functions for polyhedral corners of arbitrary parallelotopes in general dimensions and clarify the scaling of the corner contribution across phases of matter. While insulators and conformal critical points exhibit similar behavior across dimensions, metals display a characteristic even-odd dimensional effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算验证）。判断依据：推导了通用角度依赖关系，并结合蒙特卡洛模拟和数值计算结果进行验证。；研究对象：高维量子多体系统中子区域电荷涨落的角部贡献（corner contribution），特别是三维空间中的三面角（trihedral corners）和楔形角（wedge-corner）的普适行为，以及不同维度下金属、绝缘体和共形临界点的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三维空间中，三面角的电荷涨落具有普适的角度依赖关系，且楔形角贡献可直接探测量子度量（quantum metric）。金属相表现出特征性的奇偶维度效应，而绝缘体和共形临界点在不同维度下行为相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三维空间中，三面角的电荷涨落具有普适的角度依赖关系，且楔形角贡献可直接探测量子度量（quantum metric）。金属相表现出特征性的奇偶维度效应，而绝缘体和共形临界点在不同维度下行为相似。；创新点：将角部电荷涨落框架系统推广到三维及更高维度，首次识别出楔形角贡献与量子度量的直接联系，并揭示了金属相中奇偶维度效应的普适规律。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导了任意维度平行多面体（parallelotope）多面体角的角函数；通过O(3)量子临界点的晶格模型蒙特卡洛模拟验证三维三面角预测；利用晶格Weyl半金属模型的数值结果支持楔形角与量子度量的关联。

papers.title: Fermi Surface Geometry from Charge Fluctuations in Three-Dimensional Metals
papers.abstract: For three-dimensional non-interacting multi-band metals, we show that important information about the shape and the quantum geometry of Fermi surfaces is encoded in the subleading logarithmic term of bipartite charge fluctuations. This logarithmic term is related to the dimensionless $|\mathbf{q}|^3$-coefficient of the structure factor in momentum space, and both quantities can be expressed as Fermi surface integrals of the Fermi surface curvature tensor and the quantum metric tensor. When the real-space partition surface is a quadric (i.e., sphere or ellipsoid), the logarithmic coefficient satisfies a topological bound depending only on the Euler characteristic and the Chern number of the Fermi surface, illustrating a non-trivial interplay between topology and quantum topology in multi-band metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：non-interacting multi-band metals、Fermi surface integrals、quantum metric tensor、topological bound。；研究对象：三维非相互作用多带金属中费米面的几何与拓扑性质，具体通过电荷涨落（bipartite charge fluctuations）的结构因子对数项来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维金属中费米面的形状和量子几何信息编码在电荷涨落的次主导对数项中；该对数项系数可表达为费米面曲率张量和量子度规张量的费米面积分，且在实空间分割面为二次曲面时满足仅依赖于费米面欧拉示性数和陈数的拓扑下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维金属中费米面的形状和量子几何信息编码在电荷涨落的次主导对数项中；该对数项系数可表达为费米面曲率张量和量子度规张量的费米面积分，且在实空间分割面为二次曲面时满足仅依赖于费米面欧拉示性数和陈数的拓扑下界。；创新点：首次将三维多带金属中费米面的量子几何（量子度规）与拓扑（陈数、欧拉示性数）通过电荷涨落的对数项建立非平凡关联，并揭示其满足拓扑下界。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：通过动量空间结构因子的无量纲 $|\mathbf{q}|^3$ 系数与实空间二分电荷涨落对数项的关系，将两者表达为费米面曲率张量和量子度规张量的费米面积分，并分析拓扑约束条件。

papers.title: Quantum Monte Carlo fermion spectroscopy of a non-compact CP$^1$ model
papers.abstract: We study a model describing electrons coupled to anti-ferromagnetic spin fluctuations, and consider the situation where hedgehog defects in the order parameter field are suppressed. Without hedgehogs, the bosonic sector of the theory can be taken to realize the physics of the non-compact CP$^1$ theory with a deconfined U$(1)$ gauge field. After strongly coupling the boson to fermion spins, we simulate the single-particle spectral properties of a hedgehog-suppressed electron-boson model defined on a bilayer square lattice with Quantum Monte Carlo, and interpret the results in terms of an effective theory with fractionalized spinon and chargon excitations. As one of our main results we show that the electron gap on top of the half-filled insulator with gapless photon fluctuations closely resembles the mean-field dispersion of an electron in an anti-ferromagnetic spin background, even though the system fully preserves both the translation and spin rotation symmetry. Finally, we discuss potential implications of our results for the high-temperature superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Quantum Monte Carlo（量子蒙特卡洛模拟）、effective theory（有效理论）、mean-field dispersion（平均场色散）。；研究对象：电子与反铁磁自旋涨落耦合的模型，具体为在双层正方晶格上定义的、抑制了序参量场中“hedgehog”（ hedgehog缺陷）的电子-玻色子模型，其玻色子部分实现非紧致CP¹理论（含退禁闭U(1)规范场）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在半填充绝缘体中，即使系统完全保持平移和自旋旋转对称性，存在无能隙光子涨落时，电子能隙的行为与电子在反铁磁自旋背景中的平均场色散高度相似。该结果对高温超导体具有潜在启示意义。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在半填充绝缘体中，即使系统完全保持平移和自旋旋转对称性，存在无能隙光子涨落时，电子能隙的行为与电子在反铁磁自旋背景中的平均场色散高度相似。该结果对高温超导体具有潜在启示意义。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用量子蒙特卡洛（Quantum Monte Carlo）方法模拟单粒子谱性质，并结合有效理论（含分数化自旋子与电荷子激发）对结果进行解释。

papers.title: Rongzai agent: A Large Language Model-Based Autonomous Assistant for Rietveld Refinement of Neutron Diffraction Data
papers.abstract: Neutron diffraction (ND) is an indispensable technique for determining atomic positions (especially light elements) and thus serves as a critical probe for revealing microscopic structures in materials science. However, traditional Rietveld refinement of ND data relies heavily on manual operation of specialized software, which is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and highly dependent on user expertise, severely hindering automated analysis. The automation of Rietveld refinement has long been a long-standing and challenging problem in crystallography. To address this challenge, this paper presents the Dr.Sai-Rongzai agent, an autonomous refinement assistant based on a large language model (LLM), a specialist knowledge base, and the GSAS-II refinement engine, achieving for the first time an intelligent refinement that integrates knowledge-driven decision-making. The agent accomplishes a fully automated workflow from natural language task parsing to autonomous decision-making, execution of refinement strategies, and report generation. Evaluation on five representative samples shows that the Rongzai agent achieves lower Rwp values than human specialists on three samples (2.88% vs. 4.42%, 5.06% vs. 5.40%, 7.60% vs. 9.00%), while on the other two samples its results are very close to those of the specialists. The agent is currently deployed at the China Spallation Neutron Source (CSNS) and is open for external user registration, providing an intelligent and user-friendly analytical tool for materials research. This work fully leverages the cutting-edge advantages of LLM, offers a new path to solve the long-standing problem of automated refinement, takes a key step toward intelligent and fully automated crystallographic analysis, and holds great potential to accelerate AI for Science discoveries in neutron-based materials characterization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（关键词：大语言模型、知识库、GSAS-II精修引擎、自动化工作流，属于计算与软件工具开发，结合实验数据分析）；研究对象：中子衍射数据的Rietveld精修自动化问题，涉及材料科学中原子位置（尤其是轻元素）的微观结构确定。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的Rongzai智能体首次实现了知识驱动的全自动Rietveld精修，在5个代表性样品中，3个样品的Rwp值低于人类专家（如2.88% vs 4.42%），其余2个结果与专家非常接近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于大语言模型的Rongzai智能体首次实现了知识驱动的全自动Rietveld精修，在5个代表性样品中，3个样品的Rwp值低于人类专家（如2.88% vs 4.42%），其余2个结果与专家非常接近。；创新点：首次将大语言模型与专业精修引擎结合，实现知识驱动的全自动Rietveld精修，解决了长期存在的自动化精修难题，并已部署于中国散裂中子源（CSNS）供外部用户使用。
papers.method_zh: 采用大语言模型（LLM）作为决策核心，结合专业领域知识库和GSAS-II精修引擎，构建从自然语言任务解析、自主决策、执行精修策略到生成报告的完整自动化流程。

papers.title: Controlled Zeno-Induced Localization of Free Fermions in a Quasiperiodic Chain
papers.abstract: We investigate measurement-induced localization in a continuously monitored one-dimensional Aubry--André--Harper model, focusing on the quantum Zeno regime in which the measurements dominate coherent dynamics. The presence of a quasiperiodic potential renders the problem analytically tractable and enables a controlled study of the interplay between monitoring and disorder. We develop an analytical description based on an instantaneous Schrödinger equation with a measurement-induced effective potential constructed self-consistently from individual quantum trajectories, without relying on postselection. In the quantum Zeno regime, an emergent dominant energy scale reduces the problem to a transfer-matrix formulation of an effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, which allows direct computation of the Lyapunov exponent. Complementarily, we extract the localization length numerically from long-time steady-state quantum state diffusion trajectories by reconstructing the intrinsic localized single-particle wave functions and analyzing their spatial decay. These numerical results show quantitative agreement with the effective theory predictions, with controlled corrections of order $J^2/[λ^2+(γ/2)^2]$ (where $J$ is the hopping amplitude, $γ$ the measurement strength, and $λ$ the quasiperiodic potential). Our results underscore the connection between the effective non-Hermitian description and the stochastic monitored dynamics, showing the interplay between Zeno-like localization, coherent hopping, and quasiperiodic-disorder-induced localization, while also laying the groundwork for understanding and exploiting measurement-induced localization as a tool for quantum control and state preparation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：analytical description、transfer-matrix formulation、numerical simulations、quantum trajectories）；研究对象：连续监测下的一维准周期Aubry–André–Harper模型中的测量诱导局域化现象，特别是量子Zeno regime下的自由费米子局域化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子Zeno regime下，测量主导相干动力学，系统可等效为一个非厄米有效哈密顿量的转移矩阵问题，其Lyapunov指数可直接计算；数值模拟得到的局域长度与有效理论预测定量一致，修正项为$J^2/[\lambda^2+(\gamma/2)^2]$量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子Zeno regime下，测量主导相干动力学，系统可等效为一个非厄米有效哈密顿量的转移矩阵问题，其Lyapunov指数可直接计算；数值模拟得到的局域长度与有效理论预测定量一致，修正项为$J^2/[\lambda^2+(\gamma/2)^2]$量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于瞬时薛定谔方程构建自洽的测量诱导有效势（无需后选择），将问题约化为非厄米有效哈密顿量的转移矩阵方法计算Lyapunov指数；同时通过长时间稳态量子态扩散轨迹数值重构局域单粒子波函数并分析其空间衰减，提取局域长度。

papers.title: Mixed-State Long-Range Entanglement from Dimensional Constraints
papers.abstract: We present a new mechanism for long-range entanglement (LRE) in strongly symmetric many-body mixed states that does not rely on symmetry anomalies or long-range correlations. Our primary example is the maximally mixed state in the translation-invariant subspace on a one-dimensional ring. This state is LRE because translationally symmetric short-range entangled states span a subspace whose dimension grows only polynomially with system size, whereas the full translation-invariant subspace grows exponentially. We further discuss certain unconventional properties of this state, including logarithmically growing conditional mutual information, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry-breaking, and Rényi-index-dependent operator-space entanglement. We also construct a geometrically non-local Lindbladian to stabilize this state as the steady state. Our results identify dimensional mismatch as a novel route to LRE that is intrinsic to many-body mixed states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：提出新机制、构造模型、理论分析。；研究对象：强对称多体混合态中的长程纠缠（LRE），具体以平移不变子空间中的最大混合态（一维环上）为主要例子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现一种不依赖对称性反常或长程关联的新机制，通过维度约束（dimensional mismatch）即可在混合态中实现长程纠缠。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现一种不依赖对称性反常或长程关联的新机制，通过维度约束（dimensional mismatch）即可在混合态中实现长程纠缠。；创新点：首次指出维度失配（dimensional mismatch）可作为多体混合态中长程纠缠的内在来源，区别于传统依赖对称性反常或长程关联的机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：利用平移对称性约束下的态空间维度分析（短程纠缠态子空间多项式增长 vs. 全平移不变子空间指数增长），并构造几何非局域林德布拉德方程（Lindbladian）来稳定该稳态。

papers.title: Translation symmetry-enforced long-range entanglement in mixed states
papers.abstract: We show by a counting argument that even though translation symmetry admits symmetric short-range entangled (SRE) eigenstates, there are not enough such SRE eigenstates to span the zero momentum sector. This means that the fixed point strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking state of translation symmetry is long-range entangled: it cannot be written as a mixture of SRE states. This is a subtle form of long-range entanglement in mixed states that cannot be detected by long-range connected correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“counting argument”“fixed point”“long-range entanglement”等理论概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：混合态中平移对称性所强制的长程纠缠现象，具体关注零动量子空间中的对称短程纠缠（SRE）态与强到弱自发对称破缺（SWSSB）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使平移对称性允许存在对称短程纠缠（SRE）本征态，这些SRE态的数量不足以张满零动量子空间，因此平移对称性的固定点强到弱自发对称破缺态必然是长程纠缠的，且这种纠缠无法通过长程关联函数检测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使平移对称性允许存在对称短程纠缠（SRE）本征态，这些SRE态的数量不足以张满零动量子空间，因此平移对称性的固定点强到弱自发对称破缺态必然是长程纠缠的，且这种纠缠无法通过长程关联函数检测。；创新点：揭示了一种混合态中微妙的、无法被长程连通关联函数探测的长程纠缠形式，并证明平移对称性本身即可强制这种纠缠存在，无需依赖其他对称性或拓扑序。
papers.method_zh: 采用计数论证（counting argument）进行理论分析，通过态空间维数约束证明SRE态无法覆盖零动量子空间。

papers.title: Universal quantum resource distillation via composite generalised quantum Stein's lemma
papers.abstract: The performance of quantum resource manipulation protocols, including key examples such as distillation of quantum entanglement, is measured in terms of the rate at which desired target states can be produced from a given noisy state. However, to achieve optimal rates, known protocols require precise tailoring to the quantum state in question, demanding a perfect knowledge of the input and allowing no errors in its preparation. Here we show that distillation of quantum resources in the framework of resource non-generating operations can be performed universally: optimal rates of distillation can be achieved with no knowledge of the input state whatsoever, certifying the robustness of quantum resource distillation. The findings apply in particular to the purification of quantum entanglement under non-entangling maps, where the optimal rates are governed by the regularised relative entropy of entanglement. Our result relies on an extension of the generalised quantum Stein's lemma in quantum hypothesis testing to a composite setting where the null hypothesis is no longer a fixed quantum state, but is rather composed of i.i.d. copies of an unknown state. The solution of this asymptotic problem is made possible through new developments in one-shot quantum information and a refinement of the blurring technique from [Lami, arXiv:2408.06410].
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及量子资源蒸馏、量子假设检验、广义量子Stein引理等理论框架，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子资源蒸馏协议，特别是量子纠缠蒸馏，在资源非生成操作框架下的通用性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在资源非生成操作框架下，量子资源蒸馏可以以最优速率通用地实现，无需任何关于输入量子态的知识，证明了量子资源蒸馏的鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在资源非生成操作框架下，量子资源蒸馏可以以最优速率通用地实现，无需任何关于输入量子态的知识，证明了量子资源蒸馏的鲁棒性。；创新点：首次证明在无需输入态先验知识的情况下，仍能实现量子资源蒸馏的最优速率，并为此提供了基于复合广义量子Stein引理的理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 扩展了量子假设检验中的广义量子Stein引理到复合设定（复合广义量子Stein引理），其中零假设不再是固定量子态，而是未知态的独立同分布副本。通过一次性量子信息理论的新进展以及Lami（arXiv:2408.06410）中模糊化技术的改进来解决该渐近问题。

papers.title: Extensive long-range magic in non-Abelian topological orders
papers.abstract: We show that the low-energy states of non-Abelian topological orders possess extensive magic which is long-ranged, and cannot be eliminated by a constant-depth local unitary circuit. This refines conventional notions of complexity beyond the linear circuit depth which is required to prepare any topological phase, and provides a new resource-theoretic characterization of topological orders. A central technical result is a no-go theorem establishing that stabilizer states--even up to constant-depth local unitarie--cannot approximate low-energy states of non-Abelian string-net models which satisfy the entanglement bootstrap axioms. Moreover, we show that stabilizer-realizable Abelian string-net phases have mutual braiding phases quantized by the on-site qudit dimension, and that any violation of this condition necessarily implies extensive long-range magic. Extending to higher spatial dimensions, we argue that any state obeying an entanglement area law and hosting excitations with nontrivial fusion spaces must exhibit extensive long-range magic. This applies, in particular, to ground-states and low-energy states of higher-dimensional quantum double models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, no-go theorem, argue, resource-theoretic characterization。；研究对象：非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态，特别是满足纠缠自举公理的弦网模型，以及高维量子双模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态具有不可被常数深度局域幺正电路消除的、长程的广泛“魔法”（magic），这为拓扑序提供了新的资源理论刻画。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非阿贝尔拓扑序的低能态具有不可被常数深度局域幺正电路消除的、长程的广泛“魔法”（magic），这为拓扑序提供了新的资源理论刻画。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论证明与论证。具体包括：建立了一个“不可行定理”（no-go theorem），证明稳定子态（即使经过常数深度局域幺正操作）无法近似满足纠缠自举公理的非阿贝尔弦网模型的低能态；通过分析阿贝尔弦网相的编织相位与局域qudit维度的量子化关系，论证违反该条件必然导致广泛长程魔法；并推广到高维，论证任何满足纠缠面积律且具有非平凡融合空间激发态的系统都必须具有广泛长程魔法。

papers.title: Mid-infrared Assisted THz Phonon Amplification in a 2D Semiconductor for Room Temperature Detection
papers.abstract: Efficient and selective excitation of lattice vibrations is central to controlling energy flow at the nanoscale, yet remains challenging under conventional optical excitation. Here, we introduce a mid-infrared-assisted phonon amplification approach, termed MIRAPA, that enables efficient energy injection directly into vibrational bonds. Using surface-enhanced resonant Raman scattering in few-layer $\mathrm{MoS_2}$, we exploit strong exciton--phonon coupling to monitor phonon populations. When mid-infrared (MIR) light is introduced, it couples directly to out-of-plane lattice vibrations, leading to room-temperature phonon amplification exceeding $80\%$. Crucially, MIRAPA bypasses electronic excitation pathways, allowing the MIR power density to be nearly $300\times$ lower than that required for visible excitation to achieve comparable enhancement. The resulting phonon modulation is robust, persisting over more than $2800$ on/off cycles and exceeding $15$ hours of continuous-wave laser illumination without degradation. Quantitative analysis yields an effective noise-equivalent power of approximately $0.3\,\mathrm{nW}/\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ for MIR detection, highlighting the sensitivity of the approach. By combining vibrational selectivity, low-power operation, and long-term stability, MIRAPA provides a robust platform for probing and amplifying phonons in two-dimensional semiconductors. These results open new opportunities for nanoscale vibrational sensing, mid-infrared detection, and phonon-based coherent devices, including routes toward phonon lasing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验方法（表面增强共振拉曼散射）和实验观测（室温声子放大超过80%）。；研究对象：二维半导体二硫化钼（MoS₂）中的晶格振动（声子），特别是面外晶格振动模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种中红外辅助声子放大方法（MIRAPA），可在室温下实现超过80%的声子放大，且所需中红外功率密度比可见光激发低近300倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种中红外辅助声子放大方法（MIRAPA），可在室温下实现超过80%的声子放大，且所需中红外功率密度比可见光激发低近300倍。；创新点：首次实现中红外光直接注入振动键能实现高效声子放大，完全绕过电子激发路径，从而大幅降低所需功率密度，并展现出超过2800次开关循环和15小时连续激光照射的长期稳定性。
papers.method_zh: 表面增强共振拉曼散射（SERS），利用少层MoS₂中激子-声子强耦合来监测声子布居数；引入中红外光直接耦合面外晶格振动。

papers.title: Fast contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products for equivariant graph neural networks
papers.abstract: We present an $\mathcal{O}(L^3)$ algorithm for evaluating contracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor products in $\mathrm{O}(3)$-equivariant machine learning potentials at fixed Canonical Polyadic (CP) rank. Mapping the angular integral to a structured Gauss--Legendre and Fourier tensor-product grid decouples the radial channel contractions from the angular transforms. The antisymmetric parity-odd Clebsch--Gordan channels, unreachable by the symmetric pointwise product on a scalar $S^2$ grid, are recovered through the surface-curl pairing $\hat r \cdot [\nabla_{S^2} A \times \nabla_{S^2} B]$, the spherical Poisson bracket, which supplies the $L=1$ angular momentum on the grid while preserving rotational equivariance. The construction extends to parity-aware equivariant message passing in atomic-cluster-expansion-style architectures and is verified by direct numerical quadrature. The full uncontracted Clebsch--Gordan tensor product remains subject to the $\mathcal{O}(L^4)$ output-size lower bound. A benchmark shows wall-clock scaling empirically as $L^2$ across the practical $l_{\max}$ range. For the on-site contraction this is pre-asymptotic, giving way to $L^3$ at large $l_{\max}$. For message passing it is structural and the runtime is memory-bandwidth bound on $L^2$-sized grid tensors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：算法、O(3)-equivariant machine learning potentials、numerical quadrature。；研究对象：O(3)等变图神经网络中收缩的Clebsch–Gordan张量积的高效计算方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种O(L^3)算法，通过将角向积分映射到结构化Gauss–Legendre和Fourier张量积网格，并利用球面泊松括号恢复反对称奇宇称通道，实现了固定CP秩下收缩Clebsch–Gordan张量积的快速计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种O(L^3)算法，通过将角向积分映射到结构化Gauss–Legendre和Fourier张量积网格，并利用球面泊松括号恢复反对称奇宇称通道，实现了固定CP秩下收缩Clebsch–Gordan张量积的快速计算。；创新点：通过球面泊松括号在标量S²网格上恢复原本无法通过对称点积获得的反对称奇宇称Clebsch–Gordan通道，同时保持旋转等变性，从而在固定CP秩下将收缩张量积的计算复杂度从O(L^4)降低至O(L^3)。
papers.method_zh: 采用Canonical Polyadic (CP)秩分解、Gauss–Legendre和Fourier张量积网格上的角向积分、球面泊松括号（表面旋度配对）构造，以及直接数值求积验证。算法应用于原子团簇展开（ACE）风格架构中的宇称感知等变消息传递。

papers.title: Multifunctional Barophotonic Control of Resonators and Metasurfaces
papers.abstract: Actively tunable nanophotonic platforms that control light-matter interactions enable reconfigurable optical systems and programmable photonic integrated circuits. Hydrostatic pressure provides a noninvasive and material-agnostic mechanism for modulating the refractive index and resonance conditions without introducing free carriers or structural damage. Here, we demonstrate multiple pressure-dependent functionalities in silicon nitride nanostructures, including resonance tuning, refractive index modulation, and polarization state conversion. Applying a pressure of up to 5 GPa, we observe a Fabry-Pérot resonance shift of up to 30 nm and a relative refractive index decrease of up to 4%. Based on the results, we design and examine, to the best of our knowledge, the first extreme-pressure-tunable, polarization-converting metasurface, which tunes the ellipticity and orientation angle of the output light. These findings establish pressure-controllable silicon nitride as a viable platform for reconfigurable photonics and extreme-environment nanophotonic systems, including deep-ocean exploration, planetary interiors, and space applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、observe、design and examine）；研究对象：氮化硅纳米结构中的多功能压力调控光学特性，包括法布里-珀罗谐振器与偏振转换超表面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加高达5 GPa的静水压力，实现了氮化硅纳米结构中法布里-珀罗共振峰30 nm的移动、相对折射率4%的降低，并首次设计了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面，可调控输出光的椭圆率和取向角。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加高达5 GPa的静水压力，实现了氮化硅纳米结构中法布里-珀罗共振峰30 nm的移动、相对折射率4%的降低，并首次设计了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面，可调控输出光的椭圆率和取向角。；创新点：首次展示了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面，并建立了压力可控氮化硅作为可重构光子学与极端环境（深海、行星内部、太空）纳米光子学平台的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静水压力调控（最高5 GPa），观测共振位移与折射率变化；基于实验结果设计并模拟了极端压力可调的偏振转换超表面。

papers.title: Hybrid Nanophotonic Scintillators for Enhanced X-ray Absorption, Emission, and Time Resolution
papers.abstract: Scintillators convert ionizing radiation into visible photons, enabling applications from cosmic ray detection to medical imaging. Two independent strategies for improving scintillator performance via nanoscale patterning have recently been demonstrated: engineering material properties to enhance absorption of ionizing radiation and integrating nanophotonic structures to enhance the spontaneous emission rate ("nanophotonic scintillators"). Here, we propose a nanophotonic scintillator that simultaneously enhances both the initial energy conversion and the spontaneous emission rate, by periodically stacking a fast-emitting scintillator and a visible-light-transparent material with strong X-ray attenuation ("stopping layer") to form a one-dimensional (1D) photonic crystal (PhC) scintillator. Photoelectric absorption in the stopping layer increases the number of photoelectrons that deposit energy in neighboring scintillator layers and contribute to scintillation. At the same time, the spontaneous emission rate is enhanced by the nanophotonic structuring itself. We design a 1D PhC comprising an organic scintillator and indium tin oxide (ITO) as the stopping layer and numerically simulate the enhancement in scintillation yield and decay rate. The total detected light output is enhanced by up to a factor of 700 compared to a bulk organic scintillator of equal thickness. We further investigate a 1D PhC structure integrating inorganic and organic scintillators for time-of-flight positron emission tomography (TOF-PET): replacing the non-scintillating stopping layer with an inorganic scintillator further increases the light yield, and the coincidence time resolution (CTR) is enhanced up to 3.5 times compared to a bulk inorganic scintillator of equal thickness. Our work presents a unified approach to improve key scintillation parameters within a single nanophotonic structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：numerically simulate、design、propose）；研究对象：一种一维光子晶体（1D PhC）闪烁体，由快速发射闪烁体与强X射线衰减材料（如ITO或无机闪烁体）周期性堆叠而成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时增强X射线吸收和自发辐射速率，该混合纳米光子闪烁体的总探测光输出相比等厚度体闪烁体可提升高达700倍，符合时间分辨率（CTR）可提升至3.5倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时增强X射线吸收和自发辐射速率，该混合纳米光子闪烁体的总探测光输出相比等厚度体闪烁体可提升高达700倍，符合时间分辨率（CTR）可提升至3.5倍。；创新点：首次在同一纳米光子结构中同时实现X射线吸收增强和自发辐射速率增强，提出将非闪烁“停止层”替换为无机闪烁体以进一步提升光产额和时间分辨率的统一方案。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟（numerically simulate），设计一维光子晶体结构，计算闪烁产额、衰减速率及符合时间分辨率。

papers.title: Analyzing the two-dimensional doped Hubbard model with the Worldvolume HMC method
papers.abstract: We apply the Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) method [arXiv:2012.08468] to the two-dimensional Hubbard model, which is known to suffer from a severe sign problem when the system is doped (away from half filling). We show that the method predicts physical observables with controlled statistical errors on an $8 \times 8$ lattice at temperature $T/t = 1/6.4 \approx 0.156$ and interaction strength $U/t = 8.0$ ($t$ is the hopping amplitude), for which the standard determinant quantum Monte Carlo fails.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) method”、“determinant quantum Monte Carlo fails”、“predicts physical observables”。；研究对象：二维掺杂哈伯德模型（two-dimensional doped Hubbard model），具体研究其在远离半填充（掺杂）条件下的物理性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: WV-HMC方法能够在标准行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法失效的掺杂区域，以受控的统计误差预测物理可观测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：WV-HMC方法能够在标准行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法失效的掺杂区域，以受控的统计误差预测物理可观测量。；创新点：将WV-HMC方法成功应用于二维掺杂哈伯德模型，解决了该体系在掺杂条件下严重的符号问题，使得在标准方法失效的参数区间（8×8晶格，温度T/t=1/6.4，相互作用强度U/t=8.0）仍能进行可靠计算。
papers.method_zh: Worldvolume Hybrid Monte Carlo (WV-HMC) 方法，这是一种改进的量子蒙特卡洛算法，用于处理符号问题。

papers.title: Weakly nonlinear analysis of Hopf bifurcations in the elastohydrodynamics of Cosserat rods
papers.abstract: We study the weakly nonlinear saturation of the flutter instability of a planar Cosserat rod in a viscous fluid driven by a terminal follower force. This instability, established in our preceding work as a Hopf bifurcation of a non-self-adjoint linear operator, produces stable limit-cycle oscillations in the fully nonlinear overdamped dynamics. Here we derive an analytical description of the emergence of this limit cycle near threshold. Working close to the critical follower force, we perform a multiple-scale expansion about the compressed straight base state and systematically remove secular growth at higher orders. Solvability at cubic order, enforced using the adjoint eigenmode of the non-Hermitian operator, yields a Stuart-Landau amplitude equation for the critical oscillatory mode. The Landau coefficients are expressed as explicit inner products involving the critical eigenmode, its adjoint, and quadratic corrections. The resulting reduced theory predicts a supercritical Hopf bifurcation with a steady-state tip oscillation amplitude scaling as the square root of the distance from threshold. These predictions rationalize the near-threshold scaling observed in nonlinear simulations and provide an analytical normal form for the onset of self-sustained beating in pressure-driven soft robotic arms at low Reynolds number.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：weakly nonlinear analysis、multiple-scale expansion、Stuart-Landau amplitude equation、analytical normal form。；研究对象：在粘性流体中受末端随动力驱动的平面Cosserat杆的弹性流体动力学系统，具体研究其颤振失稳（Hopf分岔）的非线性饱和行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界随动力附近，系统发生超临界Hopf分岔，产生稳定的极限环振荡，且稳态尖端振荡幅度与距临界点的距离的平方根成正比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界随动力附近，系统发生超临界Hopf分岔，产生稳定的极限环振荡，且稳态尖端振荡幅度与距临界点的距离的平方根成正比。；创新点：为低雷诺数下压力驱动软体机械臂中自持拍振的起始提供了解析正规形，并定量解释了非线性模拟中观察到的近阈值标度行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用弱非线性分析中的多尺度展开方法，围绕压缩直线基态展开，利用非厄米算子的伴随本征模消除高阶久期项，推导出描述临界振荡模的Stuart-Landau振幅方程，并将Landau系数表示为临界本征模、伴随模及二次修正的内积形式。

papers.title: Generalized Suzuki-Chin Factorization in Bosonic Path Integral Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract: Modern implementations of path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) simulations of distinguishable particles frequently make use of high order factorization schemes for the Boltzmann operator to expedite convergence of equilibrium averages. Among these methods is the generalized Suzuki-Chin factorization (GSF), which is accurate up to fourth order in the imaginary-time step. In this work, we show that the GSF decomposition of the Boltzmann operator is applicable to bosonic PIMD, and results in an improved convergence of estimators. In particular, we show that the recently developed quadratic scaling bosonic PIMD need not change when using the GSF. The GSF scheme is implemented as a re-weighting factor for observables, without affecting the sampling generated by the standard, second-order, primitive factorization. We study the effect of this factorization for bosons in a harmonic trap and a sinusoidal potential. We also assess the effectiveness of GSF in calculating fermionic expectation values for harmonically-trapped atoms. In all these cases, we find that the GSF speeds up convergence with the Trotter number by a factor of $\sim 2-4$ across a wide temperature range, at only a modest computational cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD)、factorization schemes、Boltzmann operator、re-weighting factor。；研究对象：玻色子系统（bosonic system）的路径积分分子动力学模拟，具体研究了谐振势阱（harmonic trap）和正弦势（sinusoidal potential）中的玻色子，以及谐振势阱中费米子期望值的计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）可应用于玻色子PIMD，在不改变二次缩放玻色子PIMD采样方式的前提下，通过重加权因子加速平衡平均值的收敛，在宽温度范围内将收敛速度提升约2-4倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）可应用于玻色子PIMD，在不改变二次缩放玻色子PIMD采样方式的前提下，通过重加权因子加速平衡平均值的收敛，在宽温度范围内将收敛速度提升约2-4倍。；创新点：首次将GSF分解推广至玻色子PIMD，证明其无需改变已有的二次缩放玻色子PIMD算法，仅通过重加权因子即可显著提升收敛效率，且计算成本较低。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义Suzuki-Chin分解（GSF）对玻尔兹曼算符进行高阶分解（精确到虚时步长的四阶），并将其作为可观测量的重加权因子，结合标准二阶原始分解（primitive factorization）生成的采样，实现玻色子PIMD模拟。

papers.title: Spontaneous symmetry breaking and Goldstone modes for deep information propagation
papers.abstract: In physical systems, whenever a continuous symmetry is spontaneously broken, the system possesses excitations called Goldstone modes, which allow coherent information propagation over long distances and times. In this work, we study deep neural networks whose internal layers are equivariant under a continuous symmetry and may therefore support analogous Goldstone-like degrees of freedom. We demonstrate, both analytically and empirically, that these degrees of freedom enable coherent signal propagation across depth and recurrent iterations, providing a mechanism for stable information flow without relying on architectural stabilizers such as residual connections or normalization. In feedforward networks, this results in improved trainability and representational diversity across layers. In recurrent settings, we demonstrate the same mechanism is valuable for long-term memory by propagating information over recurrent iterations, thereby improving performance of RNNs and GRUs on long-sequence modeling tasks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算分析）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically and empirically”（解析与实证结合），但未涉及具体实验手段，核心是理论建模与数值验证。；研究对象：深度神经网络中的信息传播机制。具体而言，研究具有连续对称性等变性的深度神经网络（包括前馈网络和循环网络）中，自发对称性破缺及其产生的类戈德斯通模式如何支持信号的长程传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有连续对称性等变性的深度神经网络中，自发对称性破缺会产生类似戈德斯通模式的自由度，这些自由度能够在不依赖残差连接或归一化等架构稳定器的情况下，实现跨深度和循环迭代的相干信号传播，从而提升网络的可训练性、表征多样性以及长序列建模性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有连续对称性等变性的深度神经网络中，自发对称性破缺会产生类似戈德斯通模式的自由度，这些自由度能够在不依赖残差连接或归一化等架构稳定器的情况下，实现跨深度和循环迭代的相干信号传播，从而提升网络的可训练性、表征多样性以及长序列建模性能。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中自发对称性破缺与戈德斯通模式的概念引入深度神经网络的信息传播问题，提出了一种不依赖传统架构稳定器（如残差连接、归一化）的稳定信号传播新机制。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析与数值实验相结合。解析部分推导了对称性破缺与类戈德斯通模式的存在条件；实证部分通过前馈网络和循环网络（RNN、GRU）的长序列建模任务验证了该机制的有效性。

papers.title: Entangled Telecom Photon Generation using Twisted Van der Waals Crystals
papers.abstract: Nanoscale quantum light sources are essential building blocks for integrated quantum photonic systems. Here, we report a wavelength-scale entangled-photon source based on van der Waals-engineered NbOBr$_2$, and benchmark its performance for telecom-wavelength quantum light generation. By exploiting the material's second-order nonlinearity, we generate quantum-correlated photon pairs via spontaneous parametric down-conversion. We then use a 90$^{\circ}$ twisted stacking to induce quantum interference in photon-pair generation, yielding polarization-entangled photons. This approach enables tunability of the quantum optical state via control of the excitation laser polarization. We experimentally obtain entanglement fidelities exceeding 95% for Bell states, along with a high coincidence-to-accidental ratio of $\sim$335, and a brightness approximately one order of magnitude higher than recently reported telecom sources based on transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) 2D materials. These results establish twisted van der Waals engineering as a powerful platform for highly tunable, high-brightness quantum light sources at telecom wavelengths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report, experimentally obtain, benchmark its performance。；研究对象：基于范德瓦尔斯工程化NbOBr₂的波长尺度纠缠光子源，用于电信波段量子光生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过90°扭转堆叠在NbOBr₂中诱导量子干涉，实现了偏振纠缠光子对生成，贝尔态纠缠保真度超过95%，亮度比近期报道的基于过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）二维材料的电信光源高约一个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过90°扭转堆叠在NbOBr₂中诱导量子干涉，实现了偏振纠缠光子对生成，贝尔态纠缠保真度超过95%，亮度比近期报道的基于过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）二维材料的电信光源高约一个数量级。；创新点：将扭转范德瓦尔斯工程作为平台，实现了高度可调谐、高亮度的电信波长量子光源，其性能显著优于基于TMD二维材料的现有光源。
papers.method_zh: 利用NbOBr₂的二阶非线性光学效应，通过自发参量下转换（SPDC）产生量子关联光子对；采用90°扭转堆叠结构诱导光子对生成中的量子干涉，实现偏振纠缠；通过控制激发激光偏振来调控量子光学态。

papers.title: Fraxonium: Fractional fluxon states for qudit encoding
papers.abstract: We propose a superconducting circuit hosting $d$ low-lying states, well separated from the rest of the spectrum, that naturally realizes a qudit system protected from leakage errors. The system represents a generalization of the fluxonium and the low-energy states are constituted by fractional fluxon states, that we call {\it fraxons}, localized in the minima of a suitably designed Josephson potential. The latter is tailored through a Fourier engineering approach, that employs multi-harmonic Josephson building block elements composed by a Josephson junction and an inductance connected in series. We present the spectrum of a $d=4$ and a $d=5$ qudit system and study in detail the qutrit case. We analyze the dipole matrix elements for coupling to radiation and propose a non-Abelian, stimulated Raman adiabatic passage (STIRAP) protocol for single-qutrit gates, that is particularly suited for the present system. The proposed platform opens novel perspectives in circuit engineering and quantum computing beyond the qubit paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose（提出）、present（展示）、analyze（分析）、propose a protocol（提出协议）。；研究对象：一种新型超导电路，该电路天然实现了一种名为“Fraxonium”的量子系统，其低能态由分数磁通量子态（fractional fluxon states，称为“fraxons”）构成，用于编码量子比特（qudit）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于分数磁通量子态（fraxons）的超导电路，该电路天然具有d个低能态，且与高能态能隙较大，从而可实现一种受泄漏错误保护的高维量子比特（qudit）系统。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于分数磁通量子态（fraxons）的超导电路，该电路天然具有d个低能态，且与高能态能隙较大，从而可实现一种受泄漏错误保护的高维量子比特（qudit）系统。；创新点：提出了一种超越传统量子比特（qubit）范式的超导电路工程新平台。其核心创新在于利用分数磁通量子态（fraxons）作为qudit的基矢，并利用傅里叶工程方法设计势能，从而天然地实现具有泄漏错误保护特性的高维量子系统。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与设计。具体包括：1）通过傅里叶工程方法设计约瑟夫森势能，利用由约瑟夫森结与电感串联组成的多谐波约瑟夫森构建模块来定制势能形状；2）计算了d=4和d=5的qudit系统能谱，并详细研究了qutrit（d=3）情况；3）分析了与辐射耦合的电偶极矩阵元；4）提出了一种用于单qutrit门操作的非阿贝尔受激拉曼绝热通道（STIRAP）协议。

papers.title: Autonomous Reshaping of Expression Landscapes by DNA Methylation
papers.abstract: DNA methylation is usually treated as an epigenetic memory mark: transcriptional history is written into regulatory DNA and later stabilizes a chosen cell identity. This picture explains persistence, but it makes memory passive. Here we show that the same promoter-level coupling required for methylation memory can instead turn methylation into an internal control variable for regulatory dynamics. Transcription-factor occupancy protects regulatory DNA from methylation, while methylation shifts later transcription-factor binding thresholds. Under time-scale separation, this reciprocal loop separates into fast expression dynamics conditioned on methylation and a slow methylation flow written by expression. Minimal promoter, self-activation, and fate-toggle models show that this feedback does more than preserve a past state: it autonomously reshapes the expression landscape. In a methylation-coupled toggle, the preferred expression state can move continuously through single-well drift, allowing commitment without first entering a multiwell regime. Stochastic simulations further show that evolving methylation reduces fate reversals relative to a frozen landscape, making weak early expression bias more predictive of later fate. These results recast DNA methylation from a downstream stabilizer of cell identity into a slow dynamical coordinate that can help determine how regulatory states are chosen.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：show、models、stochastic simulations、theoretical framework）；研究对象：DNA甲基化作为表观遗传调控的动力学机制，具体研究启动子层面的甲基化与转录因子结合的耦合反馈对基因表达景观的塑造作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DNA甲基化并非仅是被动的记忆标记，而是通过甲基化与转录因子结合的互反馈环路，自主重塑表达景观，使细胞命运选择可通过连续漂移实现，无需经过多稳态区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DNA甲基化并非仅是被动的记忆标记，而是通过甲基化与转录因子结合的互反馈环路，自主重塑表达景观，使细胞命运选择可通过连续漂移实现，无需经过多稳态区域。；创新点：将DNA甲基化从被动的细胞身份稳定器重新定义为慢动力学坐标，证明其能主动决定调控状态的选择方式，而非仅记录过去状态。
papers.method_zh: 构建最小启动子模型、自激活模型和命运切换模型（fate-toggle models）进行理论分析，并采用随机模拟（stochastic simulations）研究甲基化动态对命运逆转概率的影响。

papers.title: Lang2MLIP: End-to-End Language-to-Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Development with Autonomous Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract: Developing machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for complex materials systems remains challenging because it requires expertise in atomistic simulations, machine learning, and workflow design, as well as iterative active learning procedures. Existing automated pipelines typically assume a fixed sequence of stages or depend on domain experts, which limits their adaptability to heterogeneous materials systems where the optimal curriculum is not known in advance. To lower the barrier to developing MLIPs for non-experts, we propose Lang2MLIP, a multi-agent framework that takes natural-language input and formulates end-to-end MLIP development as a sequential decision-making problem solved by large language models (LLMs). At each step, a decision-making agent observes the current dataset, model, evaluation results, and execution log, and then automatically selects an appropriate action to improve the model. This removes the need for a predefined pipeline and enables the agent to self-correct by revisiting earlier subsystems when new failures arise. We evaluate this approach on a solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) system with multiple components and interfaces. These results suggest that LLM-based multi-agent systems are a promising direction for automating MLIP development and making it more accessible to non-experts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials, large language models, multi-agent framework, sequential decision-making）；研究对象：复杂材料体系，具体以具有多组分和多界面的固态电解质界面（SEI）体系为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为Lang2MLIP的多智能体框架，该框架利用大语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言输入转化为端到端的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）开发过程，无需预定义固定流程，并能通过自我纠错适应不同材料体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为Lang2MLIP的多智能体框架，该框架利用大语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言输入转化为端到端的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）开发过程，无需预定义固定流程，并能通过自我纠错适应不同材料体系。；创新点：提出了一种无需领域专家预定义固定流程的、端到端的自动化MLIP开发方法。通过LLM驱动的多智能体系统，实现了对异质材料体系的自适应学习流程和自我纠错能力，显著降低了非专家开发MLIP的门槛。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于大语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体框架。该框架将MLIP开发建模为一个序列决策问题，由一个决策智能体根据当前数据集、模型、评估结果和执行日志自动选择下一步行动（如主动学习、模型训练等），从而替代了传统的固定流水线。

papers.title: Power sensitivity of broadband radiofrequency detectors based on quantum diamond spins
papers.abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centres in diamond can be used to detect radiofrequency (RF) signals through coupling of the RF magnetic field with the NV spins, combined with optical readout of the spin state. The sensitivity of such RF detectors has so far been mainly studied in terms of magnetic field sensitivity, which is relevant when the RF signal is generated by a near-field source. However, for applications where the RF input is delivered externally, a more relevant quantity is the sensitivity in terms of the input RF power. Here we theoretically analyse the power sensitivity of NV-based RF detectors as a function of the RF-spin interface geometry. We derive scaling laws of the power sensitivity for both slope-detection and variance-detection RF sensing protocols, and for various noise regimes. We find that, in most scenarios, the power sensitivity scales inversely with the characteristic physical dimension of the RF-spin interface, for instance the width of a coplanar waveguide or the diameter of a loop antenna. In other words, the smaller the structure and the probed NV volume, the better the power sensitivity, which is contrary to the case of magnetic field sensitivity. Lastly, we numerically estimate that photon shot noise limited sensitivities of 10^{-20} W Hz^{-1} (slope) and 10^{-12} W Hz^{-1/2} (variance) are achievable. This work lays the groundwork for further optimisation of NV-based RF detectors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“theoretically analyse”“derive scaling laws”“numerically estimate”。；研究对象：基于金刚石氮-空位（NV）色心的宽带射频探测器，具体研究其功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面几何结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在大多数情况下，NV基射频探测器的功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面的特征物理尺寸成反比（结构越小、探测的NV体积越小，功率灵敏度越高），这与磁场灵敏度的标度行为相反。数值估计表明，光子散粒噪声极限下可实现10⁻²⁰ W Hz⁻¹（斜率检测）和10⁻¹² W Hz⁻¹/²（方差检测）的灵敏度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在大多数情况下，NV基射频探测器的功率灵敏度与射频-自旋界面的特征物理尺寸成反比（结构越小、探测的NV体积越小，功率灵敏度越高），这与磁场灵敏度的标度行为相反。数值估计表明，光子散粒噪声极限下可实现10⁻²⁰ W Hz⁻¹（斜率检测）和10⁻¹² W Hz⁻¹/²（方差检测）的灵敏度。；创新点：首次从输入射频功率角度（而非传统磁场灵敏度角度）系统分析NV基射频探测器的灵敏度，并揭示其与界面几何尺寸的反比标度关系，为优化探测器设计奠定理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导功率灵敏度的标度律，针对斜率检测和方差检测两种射频传感协议，并考虑不同噪声区间；结合数值估算评估光子散粒噪声极限下的灵敏度。

papers.title: Monolithic axial InGaAs quantum dot emitters in GaAs-based nanowires via Sb-mediated facet engineering
papers.abstract: GaAs-based nanowires hosting active quantum heterostructures provide a promising route toward monolithic integration of single-photon sources on silicon, a key requirement for scalable quantum photonics. However, ultrathin axial quantum-emitter formation is often hindered by facet-dependent growth dynamics and rotational twins, which induce lateral overgrowth and compromise interface abruptness. Here, we develop InGaAs-based quantum emitters by tailoring facet evolution via dilute Sb incorporation, which efficiently suppresses twins and promotes confined axial insertion at the growth-front facet. This approach significantly enhances the probability of obtaining abrupt, few-nanometer-thin quantum dots at the nanowire tip. Single-nanowire optical spectroscopy reveals intense, spatially localized emission from the active region with lifetimes as short as (0.51 $\pm$ 0.02) ns, and second-order photon-correlation measurements consistently exhibit pronounced antibunching with $g^{(2)}(0)<0.4$, confirming single-photon emission. These results establish a strong correlation between twin density and axial heterostructure formation, identifying defect control as a key factor in realizing monolithically integrated nanowire single-photon sources.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：optical spectroscopy、photon-correlation measurements、molecular beam epitaxy（基于摘要中提及的纳米线生长和光学表征推断）。；研究对象：GaAs基纳米线中轴向生长的InGaAs量子点发射器，具体通过Sb介导的晶面工程调控实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过掺入少量Sb抑制纳米线中的旋转孪晶，并调控生长前沿晶面演化，成功在纳米线尖端形成厚度仅几纳米的轴向InGaAs量子点，实现单光子发射（g²(0)<0.4，寿命0.51 ns）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过掺入少量Sb抑制纳米线中的旋转孪晶，并调控生长前沿晶面演化，成功在纳米线尖端形成厚度仅几纳米的轴向InGaAs量子点，实现单光子发射（g²(0)<0.4，寿命0.51 ns）。；创新点：提出利用稀Sb掺入进行晶面工程，有效抑制旋转孪晶并促进轴向量子点的受限插入，建立了孪晶密度与轴向异质结构形成之间的强关联，为缺陷控制实现单片集成纳米线单光子源提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 分子束外延（MBE）生长GaAs基纳米线及InGaAs量子点；单纳米线光学光谱（空间分辨发光谱）；二阶光子关联测量（Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪）验证单光子发射。

papers.title: All-Electric Quantum State Transfer via Spin-Orbit Phase Matching
papers.abstract: Semiconductor hole-spin qubits offer a promising route to quantum computation due to their weak hyperfine interaction, and strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling enabling electric control of qubits. Scalable architectures, however, require coherent long-distance quantum state transfer, which is hindered in these systems by spin-orbit induced anisotropic exchange. Here we show that this limitation can be overcome by using an all-electric control protocol. By tuning the electric field strength, we identify discrete spin-orbit phase-matching conditions that restore near-perfect state transfer, independent of the rotation axis. Complementarily, controlling the electric field direction aligns the spin-orbit axis, suppressing excitation non-conserving processes and enabling robust transfer without fine tuning. Our results establish that electrical control of spin-orbit phases through either magnitude tuning or axis alignment as a practical route for robust quantum information transport in hole-spin quantum dot arrays.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中描述“we show”、“we identify”、“our results establish”，未提及实验或计算细节，主要基于理论分析和控制协议设计。；研究对象：半导体空穴自旋量子点阵列中的长距离量子态传输，具体涉及自旋-轨道耦合诱导的各向异性交换作用及其对态传输的阻碍。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过全电场控制协议，调节电场强度可找到离散的自旋-轨道相位匹配条件，恢复近乎完美的量子态传输；调节电场方向可对齐自旋-轨道轴，抑制非激发守恒过程，实现无需精细调节的鲁棒传输。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过全电场控制协议，调节电场强度可找到离散的自旋-轨道相位匹配条件，恢复近乎完美的量子态传输；调节电场方向可对齐自旋-轨道轴，抑制非激发守恒过程，实现无需精细调节的鲁棒传输。；创新点：提出利用电场强度调谐或电场方向对齐两种全电学方式，克服自旋-轨道诱导的各向异性交换对长距离量子态传输的限制，实现无需旋转轴依赖的近乎完美态传输。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于自旋-轨道耦合的相位匹配条件推导，通过电场强度调谐和电场方向对齐两种控制策略，研究量子态传输的保真度与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Universal Spin Squeezing Dynamical Phase Transitions across Lattice Geometries, Dimensions, and Microscopic Couplings
papers.abstract: Recent work has identified a dynamical squeezing phase transition in power-law interacting bilayer XXZ spin models, separating a fully collective phase with Heisenberg-limited squeezing from a partially-collective phase with universal critical scaling. Here we test and establish the universality of this transition along two qualitatively different microscopic axes: lattice geometry, by studying square, triangular, and honeycomb $2\mathrm{D}$ bilayers as well as $1\mathrm{D}$ ladders, and a symmetry-preserving rescaling $λ$ of the interlayer couplings relative to the intralayer ones. Combining a Bogoliubov instability analysis with discrete truncated Wigner simulations, we find that the transition persists across all four lattice geometries and over a wide range of $λ$ with critical exponents consistent within error, providing strong evidence for a genuine non-equilibrium universality class. The Bogoliubov theory recovers the previously identified scaling $a_Z^* \propto L$ in the long-range interacting regime $α< d+2$, and yields an analytical scaling $a_Z^* \propto L^{2/(α-d)}$ for the critical aspect ratio with system size for $α>d+2$, with $α$ the power-law exponent in dimension $d$. This uncovers a previously unrecognized sub-linear regime for short-range interactions. By tuning $λ$ we vary the interlayer coupling strength at fixed layer spacing, demonstrating that the dynamical transition can be driven purely through interaction engineering without modifying the underlying geometry. These findings provide a versatile route toward controlling entanglement generation in Rydberg-array, polar molecule, and trapped-ion platforms with applications in quantum sensing and simulation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：结合Bogoliubov不稳定性分析与离散截断Wigner模拟（discrete truncated Wigner simulations），属于理论框架与数值计算混合类型。；研究对象：研究幂律相互作用双层XXZ自旋模型中的动力学压缩相变（dynamical squeezing phase transition），具体考察该相变在不同晶格几何（二维正方、三角、蜂窝晶格及一维梯子）和微观耦合参数下的普适性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该动力学压缩相变在多种晶格几何和层间耦合强度下均存在，且临界指数在误差范围内一致，为一种非平衡态普适类提供了有力证据。同时，在短程相互作用区域发现了一个此前未被识别的亚线性标度行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该动力学压缩相变在多种晶格几何和层间耦合强度下均存在，且临界指数在误差范围内一致，为一种非平衡态普适类提供了有力证据。同时，在短程相互作用区域发现了一个此前未被识别的亚线性标度行为。；创新点：系统性地验证了该动力学相变在晶格几何（从二维到一维）和层间耦合强度（通过对称性保持的缩放参数λ）两个微观维度上的普适性。此外，推导出短程相互作用下临界纵横比随系统尺寸的亚线性标度关系（a_Z^* ∝ L^{2/(α-d)}），并展示了仅通过调控相互作用（而非改变几何结构）即可驱动该动力学相变。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov不稳定性分析（Bogoliubov instability analysis）进行理论推导，并结合离散截断Wigner模拟（discrete truncated Wigner simulations）进行数值验证。

papers.title: A Twist on Scattering from Defect Anomalies
papers.abstract: In the presence of extended defects, familiar incoming particles can scatter into exotic outgoing states created by twist operators. We show that one possible mechanism driving these "categorical scattering" processes is the presence of localized 't Hooft anomalies on the defect's worldvolume. Defect anomalies trap non-trivial charges at junctions between the symmetry lines and the interface, opening new transmission channels that would naively appear to violate selection rules. After outlining the general mechanism, we investigate several concrete examples with defects, interfaces, and boundaries. For models of massless chiral fermions already studied in the literature, we show that the emergence of twist operators can be understood as a consequence of defect anomalies. We then introduce new massive integrable theories in which a similar phenomenon occurs, and we explicitly solve the associated scattering problem, obtaining new integrable solutions. Finally, we construct lattice spin chains with defects where similar physics is expected to arise.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, mechanism, theoretical framework, integrable solutions。；研究对象：凝聚态物理中扩展缺陷（extended defects）导致的异常散射现象，具体涉及缺陷世界体积上的局域't Hooft反常（localized 't Hooft anomalies）如何驱动“范畴散射”（categorical scattering）过程，使入射粒子散射为扭算符（twist operators）产生的奇异出射态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 缺陷世界体积上的局域't Hooft反常会在对称线与界面的连接处捕获非平凡荷，从而打开看似违反选择定则的新透射通道，这是驱动“范畴散射”的一种可能机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：缺陷世界体积上的局域't Hooft反常会在对称线与界面的连接处捕获非平凡荷，从而打开看似违反选择定则的新透射通道，这是驱动“范畴散射”的一种可能机制。；创新点：将缺陷反常（defect anomalies）确立为驱动“范畴散射”过程的一种具体机制，并在有质量可积理论中首次实现了该现象的显式可积散射解。摘要未突出说明与已有可积模型或范畴理论相比的具体理论突破点。
papers.method_zh: 采用理论分析框架，先概述一般机制，再通过具体例子验证：包括文献中已有的无质量手征费米子模型（展示扭算符的出现可归因于缺陷反常），以及新引入的有质量可积理论（显式求解散射问题，得到新的可积解）。最后，构建了预期出现类似物理的缺陷晶格自旋链模型。

papers.title: Non-Invertible Symmetries and Boundaries for Two-Dimensional Fermions
papers.abstract: We study the relation between boundary conditions and categorical symmetries of two-dimensional fermionic conformal field theories. We determine all anomaly-free invertible global symmetries of two free complex Weyl fermions, which take the form $\mathbb{Z}_k$ for each primitive Pythagorean triple $a^2 + b^2 = k^2$. The theory is self-dual under gauging any of these symmetries, and so to each there is associated a non-invertible topological defect. We study the properties of these lines, and show that any conformal boundary condition of two Dirac fermions that preserves a $U(1)^2$ symmetry can be found by dressing a trivial Dirichlet boundary with one of them. We discuss two microscopic descriptions of these defects: fermions coupled to a quantum-mechanical rotor degree of freedom; and an abelian gauge theory that realises symmetric mass generation in a half-space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确讨论“categorical symmetries”、“topological defect”、“gauging”等理论概念，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：二维费米子共形场论，具体为两个自由复Weyl费米子（即两个狄拉克费米子）的边界条件与范畴对称性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 确定了两个自由复Weyl费米子中所有无反常的可逆全局对称性，形式为每个本原毕达哥拉斯三元组 \(a^2+b^2=k^2\) 对应的 \(\mathbb{Z}_k\) 对称性；该理论在这些对称性下规范自对偶，从而每个对称性都关联一个非可逆拓扑缺陷；任何保持 \(U(1)^2\) 对称性的共形边界条件均可通过用其中一个非可逆缺陷修饰平凡的狄利克雷边界得到。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：确定了两个自由复Weyl费米子中所有无反常的可逆全局对称性，形式为每个本原毕达哥拉斯三元组 \(a^2+b^2=k^2\) 对应的 \(\mathbb{Z}_k\) 对称性；该理论在这些对称性下规范自对偶，从而每个对称性都关联一个非可逆拓扑缺陷；任何保持 \(U(1)^2\) 对称性的共形边界条件均可通过用其中一个非可逆缺陷修饰平凡的狄利克雷边界得到。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：利用共形场论中的范畴对称性框架，研究边界条件与拓扑缺陷的对应关系；通过规范变换和自对偶性推导非可逆缺陷；给出两种微观描述：费米子耦合量子力学转子自由度，以及实现半空间对称质量生成的阿贝尔规范理论。

papers.title: Efficiency in a repetitive pulse magnet
papers.abstract: A repetitive-pulse magnet is a promising tool when combined with repetitive excitations, such as pulsed lasers. Technically, the repetition and the magnetic field values in a repetitive-pulse magnet are limited by the Joule heating in the coil. Here, we analytically examine the relationship between the coil's dimensions and its efficiency, assuming negligible heating of the coil, to design an optimized high-repetition, high-magnetic-field coil. We calculated the dependence of the maximum magnetic field, energy loss, pulse duration, form factor, impedance, and maximum current on the coil's geometry. We found that the smaller the coil, the more pulses and the more intense the magnetic fields we can obtain under a given condition. We argue that the obtained trend arises from a complex interplay among various parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“analytically examine”（解析分析）和“calculated the dependence”（计算依赖关系），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：重复脉冲磁体（repetitive-pulse magnet）的线圈几何结构与效率之间的关系。具体物理现象为：在忽略焦耳加热的理想条件下，线圈尺寸对最大磁场、能量损耗、脉冲持续时间、形状因子、阻抗及最大电流等参数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在给定条件下，线圈尺寸越小，可获得的脉冲重复率越高、磁场强度越大。这一趋势源于多种参数之间的复杂相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在给定条件下，线圈尺寸越小，可获得的脉冲重复率越高、磁场强度越大。这一趋势源于多种参数之间的复杂相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析（analytical examination），通过数学推导计算线圈几何参数（如尺寸）与最大磁场、能量损耗、脉冲持续时间、形状因子、阻抗及最大电流之间的依赖关系。
